The weapon has one fewer upgrade slot than usual. When you Cast this Spell, you can automatically Install any upgrades you are holding in your hands as a locus into any upgrade slots the weapon has. When you Interact to stow the *junk weapon*, you can collapse it into an unassuming accessory on one of your limbs, such as a bracelet or glove made out of junk.

**Heightened (2nd)** You can create a tactical weapon.

**Heightened (4th)** You can create an advanced.

**Heightened (5th)** You can create a superior weapon.

**Heightened (6th)** You can create an elite weapon.

**Heightened (8th)** You can create an ultimate weapon.

**Heightened (9th)** You can create a paragon weapon.

entities.name: Junkbot
entities.description:
You shape nearby junk into a minibot of 1st level or lower whose formula you used as this spell's locus. Activate the Minibot. If the locus is a handheld tech item, such as a comm unit, you can use it to install any electronic storage necessary for the minibot to function, such as songs in a beatbot or storage for a camerabot. When the spell ends, the minibot turns into a pile of junk

**Heightened (3rd)** You create a minibot up to 2nd level.

**Heightened (4th)** You create a minibot up to 4th level.

**Heightened (5th)** You create a minibot up to 8th level.

**Heightened (6th)** You create a minibot up to 12th level.

**Heightened (7th)** You create a minibot up to 14th level.

entities.name: Junkify
entities.description:
You corrode a useful piece of tech into obsolete junk. The target takes 1d8 acid damage, with a basic Reflex save if the target is a creature or by a creature holding or wielding the target. The target becomes Glitching 2 on a failure (or if unattended). If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, it becomes junk, and as long as it's unattended, any space it occupies becomes difficult terrain.

**Heightened (+2)** Increase the damage by 1d8 and the glitching condition by 1.

Stats.Targets: 1 construct, item, or object that's made of metal or that has the tech trait

entities.name: Lock
entities.description:
The target's latch mechanism clinks shut, held fast by unseen magical wards. When you magically lock a target, you set an Athletics and Thievery DC to open it equal to your spell DC or the base lock DC with a +4 status bonus, whichever is higher. Any key or combination that once opened a lock affected by this spell does not do so for the duration of the spell, though the key or combination does grant a +4 circumstance bonus to checks to open the door. If the target is opened, the spell ends. Assuming the target is not barred or locked in some additional way, you can unlock and open it with an Interact action during which you touch the target. This does not end the spell. You can Dismiss this spell at any time and from any distance.

**Heightened (2nd)** The duration is unlimited, but you must expend 60 credits worth of precious metals as an additional cost.

Stats.Targets: 1 lock, or a door or container with a latch

entities.name: Mind Skewer
entities.description:
You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgments. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical failure, the target is also Stupefied 2 for 1 round.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d6.

entities.name: Motivating Ringtone
entities.description:
You cause the target comm unit to play a cosmically composed personal theme song specific to its owner. The creature who owns the target comm unit regains 1d8+4 Hit Points when you Cast the Spell, a +5-foot status bonus to all Speeds, and a +1 status bonus to saves against fear effects for the duration as long as the comm unit continues to play the ringtone.

Spell Effect: Motivating Ringtone

**Heightened (+1)** The amount of healing increases by 1d8+4.

Stats.Traits: auditory, concentrate, emotion, healing, manipulate, subtle

entities.name: Nanite Snipe
entities.description:
Make a spell attack roll against the target's AC, dealing 1d12 piercing damage on a hit with a tech target becomes Glitching 2. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage, and a tech target becomes Glitching 4.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d12.

entities.name: Optics Feed
entities.description:
You tap into the optical scanners of a machine and turn it into a live camera feed. For the spell's duration, you can stream what the target sees via any screen you touch.

**Heightened (3rd)** The spell's duration is 1 hour.

**Heightened (6th)** The spell's duration is 1 day.

entities.name: Overheat
entities.description:
You vent heat toward a nearby target. You deal 2d6 fire damage to the target. On a failed save, the target's held equipment becomes hot to the touch for the next round. Unless the target drops its currently held equipment at the start of its turn, it takes 3*@item.rank fire damage.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d6. Increase the damage of touching affected objects by 3.

entities.name: Phantasmal Minion
entities.description: You summon a phantasmal minion. The minion is roughly the shape of a humanoid. You can choose to have it be Invisible or have an ephemeral appearance, but it's obviously a magical effect, not a real creature.

entities.name: Read Memory
entities.description:
You touch a computer screen, learning what it has recently displayed, even if it's been rebooted or used for something else since then. You choose one of the following pieces of information, and the computer truthfully displays or plays it.

- The last command entered into the target.

- The name of the last file accessed on the target.

- The name of the last file downloaded to or uploaded from the target.

- The last 1 minute of audio played from the target.

**Heightened (3rd)** Choose two of the options.

**Heightened (5th)** Choose all of the options.

Stats.Targets: 1 functional comm unit or computer you can access

entities.name: Reparative Nanites
entities.description:
You conjure a cloud of nanites that repair the target on a molecular level. The target gains fast healing 1.

Spell Effect: Reparative Nanites

**Heightened (+1)** The fast healing increases by 1.

entities.name: Ricochet
entities.description:
A spinning disk or smooth orb of shimmering steel leaps from one target to another. You deal 2d4 bludgeoning or slashing damage (with a basic Reflex save).

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d4.

entities.name: Scrap Shell
entities.description:
**Trigger** You're critically hit by a damage-dealing effect or Strike.

You snap a layer of brittle scrap into place between you and the triggering blow, the scrap shatters and absorbs some of the force of the impact. The scrap has Hardness 5 and 10 healing Hit Points. If the scrap is destroyed, you take any excess damage that the scrap didn't absorb. After taking the blow, the scrap collapses into a pile of junk.

**Heightened (+1)** The scrap's Hit Points increase by 10.

entities.name: Scrap Spray
entities.description:
You spray a blast of jagged scrap in an area in front of you. The scrap spray deals 1d6 bludgeoning, slashing, or piercing damage to each creature in the area. Each creature must attempt a Reflex save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage and is Suppressed until the beginning of your next turn.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage and is suppressed until the beginning of your next turn.

**Heightened (+2)** Increase the damage by 3d6.

entities.name: Shifting Surge
entities.description:
You release a surge of magical energy that temporarily changes the type of damage dealt by a weapon. The next Strike the weapon makes deals your choice of acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage and deals an additional 1d6 extra damage of the same type as the weapon's normal damage.

**Heightened (+2)** The extra damage increases by 1d6.

Spell Effect: Shifting Surge

Stats.Targets: one weapon held by you or a willing ally that deals acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage

entities.name: Sonic Scream
entities.description:
You unleash a painfully rapid cone of vibrations by letting out a cathartic scream, dealing 1d8 sonic damage to creatures in the area with a basic Fortitude save. A creature that fails its saving throw also becomes Sickened 1.

**Heightened (+1)** Increases the damage by 1d8.

entities.name: Summon Robot
entities.description:
You summon a creature that has the tech trait and whose level is –1 to fight for you.

**Heightened** As listed in the summon trait.

entities.name: Supercharge Weapon
entities.description:
You draw in and condense ambient magical energy from around you to power up a weapon. The next Strike made using that weapon is supercharged. That Strike deals an additional 1d6 damage of the same type as the weapon's normal damage.

Spell Effect: Supercharge Weapon

**Heightened (+2)** The extra damage increases by 1d6.

Stats.Targets: 1 weapon held by you or a willing ally

entities.name: Wishborne Shot
entities.description: You wish for your next shot to go where you desire. The next time you make a Strike with the locus before the end of your turn, you ignore your target's cover and any flat check required due to the target being Concealed or hidden.

entities.name: Wisp Ally
entities.description:
You summon a Tiny bouncing wisp of light that easily distracts even the most determined of combatants. The wisp floats near your target. A wisp doesn't take up space, grant flanking, or have any other attributes a creature would. The wisp generates bright light in a 10-foot radius. When you Cast the Spell and each time you Sustain the spell, your wisp attempts to distract your target, which must succeed at a Will save or become Off-Guard until the start of your next turn. A creature who critically succeeds becomes immune to wisp ally for 1 hour.

**Heightened (+1)** You create one additional wisp, allowing you to choose a different target. Each wisp you create must have a different target, and all of them attempt to distract their targets at the same time when you cast or Sustain this spell.

entities.name: Build Bulkhead Stronghold
entities.description: You rapidly conjure a small technological stronghold that surrounds you, and all enemies are pushed to the nearest safe empty space outside of the area. The stronghold has AC 10, Hardness 10, and 150 healing Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage. It has the tech trait. Several large robotic legs sprout from the stronghold, allowing it to move with you, constantly keeping you at its center. The stronghold automatically opens to allow allies to enter while enemies are kept out. When you move in such a way that enemies would enter the area, they're instead pushed to the nearest safe empty space. Enemies can't enter the stronghold. Allies within the stronghold gain the benefits of standard cover, and all allies who start their turn within the stronghold gain 10 temporary Hit Points that last for the spell's duration.

entities.name: Event Horizon
entities.description:
You unleash the power of a supermassive black hole. All creatures in the area take 6d10 bludgeoning and 6d10 void damage. Event horizon ignores up to 10 resistance creatures in the area have to bludgeoning, and up to 10 resistance they have to void. Each creature attempts a Reflex save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage and is Slowed 1 until the end of its next turn.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage, is Slowed 3 until the end of its next turn, and slowed 1 for 1 minute.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage, is slowed 3 until the end of its next turn, and Slowed 2 for 1 minute.

entities.name: New Game
entities.description:
You draw creatures into a vidgame, digitizing their bodies and minds, including equipment, to play in virtual reality. The genre of the game and effect of the spell depend on who you target when you cast it. Any creature targeted by this spell becomes immune to it for 24 hours, no matter what genre they experience.

- If you cast the spell targeting yourself and any number of willing allies, the targets enter a relaxing slice-of-life social simulation game where they can perform up to 1 hour of activities for the duration of the spell, including Refocusing, Repairing items, or simply evading an enemy by hiding in this virtual extradimensional space.
- If you cast this spell targeting yourself or one willing ally, and one enemy, the targets enter a PvP game and are instructed to fight, using their current initiative. For the duration of the spell, either creature can manipulate fate once on each of its turns. This allows it to either roll twice and take the higher result on an attack roll or skill check it attempts against its opponent (a fortune effect) or force the opponent to roll twice on a saving throw against one of its abilities and take the lower result (a misfortune effect). The GM might decide that other genres of games exist that add additional rules or subsystems to resolving the spell. The spell ends if either target becomes unable to act or if they both agree to cease hostilities. Any results of the game, such as damage or conditions, persist after the game is over. If a player dies in this game, they die in real life.
- If you cast this spell targeting one enemy, the target enters a PvE or puzzle game that traps them until they can complete the game. Once each turn, the target can spend 1 action to attempt a Computers or Perception check against your spell DC to escape the game. Teleportation magic doesn't help the creature escape unless the magic can transport someone into or out of a virtual space. When the spell ends, either because the target escaped or the duration ran out, the target returns to the space it occupied when it was digitized, or to the nearest space if the original is now filled. The GM might decide that other genres of games allow for different skill checks but should only do so if the target has proficiency in the listed skill.

**Critical Success** The target completes the game and the spell ends.

**Success** The target makes progress toward completing the game. If the target already made progress, it completes the game and the spell ends.

**Failure** The target makes no progress toward completing the game.

**Critical Failure** The target loses the game and has to start over. It loses all progress it made.

entities.name: Animal Form
Biomechanical Symbiosis
entities.description:
You redirect magical power through your target's circuitry, stimulating hybrid magical and technological healing. The target regains 2 Hit Points immediately and the first time each round for the duration of the spell. Whenever the target takes electricity damage or rolls a flat check due to the glitching condition, it also regains 2 Hit Points.

**Heightened (+1)** The Hit Points regained increase by 2.

Stats.Targets: 1 creature with the tech trait or with a tech augmentation

entities.name: Bolster Weapon
entities.description:
You use some of your magic to empower a weapon, creating an idealized version of the armament. When you cast this spell, choose one of the following traits: agile, backswing, forceful, reach, or sweep. The target weapon gains the chosen trait.

Spell Effect: Bolster Weapon

**Heightened (5th)** You can target up to five weapons, choosing a trait for each weapon.

entities.name: Caustic Conversion
entities.description:
You launch a torrent of magical nanites that begin dissolving your target. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, you deal 3d8 acid damage plus 1d6 persistent acid damage. On a critical hit, double the initial damage, but not the persistent damage.

**Heightened (+2)** The initial damage increases by 2d8, and the persistent acid damage increases by 1d6.

entities.name: Circuit Trace
entities.description:
A tangle of golden and copper threads fills the space around you and trails behind you, making it difficult for others to pass. When you Cast the Spell and the first time you Sustain it on each subsequent round, you Stride up to your Speed or 25 feet (whichever is lower), trailing wires behind you as the square you left becomes difficult terrain for the duration. You ignore difficult terrain created by circuit trace.

**Heightened (5th)** The spell creates greater difficult terrain.

entities.name: Conjure Junkrod
entities.description:
You configure a heap of scrap within range into a fully functioning vehicle. The junk becomes a level 0 land vehicle, such as a hoverboard, in an unoccupied adjacent space. The vehicle is clearly temporary, can't be sold or traded, and falls apart into worthless junk when the spell ends. The spell ends early if the vehicle becomes broken.

**Heightened (3rd)** You create a 1st-level or lower land or water vehicle, such as a boatercycle or forklift.

**Heightened (4th)** You create a 4th-level or lower land or water vehicle, such as an urban cruiser or torpedo minisub.

**Heightened (5th)** You create a 5th-level or lower air, land, or water vehicle, such as a skyboat or turboglider.

**Heightened (6th)** You create a 7th-level or lower vehicle of any kind, such as a drop pod.

**Heightened (7th)** You create a 9th-level or lower vehicle.

**Heightened (8th)** You create an 11th-level or lower vehicle.

**Heightened (9th)** You create a 13th-level or lower vehicle.

**Heightened (10th)** You create a 15th-level or lower vehicle.

entities.name: Corrupt Machine
entities.description:
You fuse an unholy spirit into the target, causing it to morph into a visibly horrifying version. The weapon gains the unholy trait and deals an additional 1d4 fire damage on hit. Creatures critically hit by this weapon also become Frightened 1.

**Heightened (4th)** The damage increases to 2d4.

**Heightened (6th)** The damage increases to 3d4.

**Heightened (8th)** The damage increases to 4d4.

Stats.Targets: 1 tech weapon that’s unattended or wielded by a willing creature

entities.name: Detect Thoughts
entities.description:
You sense the presence of thinking creatures around you. You detect the presence or absence of thoughts from conscious creatures that have Intelligence modifiers of –3 or higher. You can choose to ignore the thoughts of creatures you're familiar with so they don't interfere with your detection of other thoughts. The spell can penetrate some barriers, but 3 feet of dirt or wood, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, a thin sheet of lead, or any force barrier blocks it. Creatures who are immune to mental effects are immune to detection by this spell.

**Heightened (4th)** You detect the number of thinking minds and whether or not the creatures are telepathic. Creatures with telepathy have louder thoughts than creatures who don't have telepathy and might be able to sense your intrusion, at the GM's discretion.

entities.name: Doom Scroll
entities.description:
You magically broadcast grim news onto nearby devices, holo projectors, screens, and other displays (including comm units on armor). Creatures in the area who can see one or more displays must attempt a Will save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is Fascinated by the display.

**Failure** The creature is fascinated by the display and Frightened 2 (even if the fascination ends).

**Critical Failure** The creature is fascinated by the display, Frightened 3, and Doomed 1 (even if the fascination ends).

entities.name: Emoji Shield
entities.description:
You create a shield emoji that protects you from harm and explodes in a burst of blinding light when it's broken into magical code. You gain a +1 status bonus to AC and the Emoji Burst reaction.

Spell Effect: Emoji Shield

entities.name: Everlight
entities.description:
The gemstone you touch glows, spreading bright light with a color of your choice in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet). The spell ends immediately if the gemstone is broken.

Spell Effect: Everlight

Stats.Targets: a gemstone worth 60 credits or more

entities.name: Inject Nanobots
entities.description:
You inject magical nanobots into a creature. Make a melee spell attack roll. On a hit, the target takes 4d6 acid damage. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage and becomes Confused for 1 round as nanobots swarm through the target's biological or mechanical systems.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d6.

entities.name: Instant Virus
entities.description:
Your touch installs a dangerous self-replicating virus that disrupts a technological creature's programming. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target is Glitching 1.

**Failure** The target is glitching 1 and Stunned 1.

**Critical Failure** The target is Glitching 2 and Stunned 2.

entities.name: Logic Bomb
entities.description:
You implant a hazard containing a mind-blowing amount of information into the target. The hazard has a Stealth and Disable DC equal to your spell DC and requires one successful  check to disable. The first time a creature unsuccessfully attempts to access, destroy, or otherwise manipulate the target (such as using the Computers skill, failing to hit with a Strike, or otherwise), logic bomb detonates, and the creature takes 6d6 mental damage with a basic Will save. The spell ends when it's triggered or the duration ends, whichever comes first.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d6.

Stats.Targets: 1 computer or item with the tech trait
Stats.Duration: until the next time you make your daily preparations

entities.name: Optic Blast
entities.description:
Your eyes boil with magical energy, building up pressure behind the locus until it bursts forth. Creatures in the area take 3d6 force damage with a basic Reflex save. Creatures that fail their save are also knocked back 5 feet.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d6.

entities.name: Peaceful Rest
entities.description:
The targeted corpse doesn't decay, nor can it be transformed into an undead. If the corpse is subject to a spell that requires the corpse to have died within a certain amount of time (for example, Raise Dead), do not count the duration of *peaceful rest* against that time. This spell also prevents ordinary bugs and pests (such as maggots) from consuming the body.

**Heightened (5th)** The spell's duration is unlimited, but the spell takes one more action to cast and requires a cost (embalming fluid worth 60 credits).

Stats.Duration: until the next time you make your daily preparations

entities.name: Robo-Fist
entities.description:
With a flash of magic, two of your limbs grow wires and plating before snapping together into a robotic structure, ending in an oversized and empowered robot fist. While you maintain these robot fists, the damage die for your fist increases to 1d6 instead of 1d4. You don't take the normal –2 circumstance penalty when making a lethal attack with your fist or any other unarmed attacks

Up to twice when you Sustain this spell, you can launch one of your robot fists as a rocket, dealing 2d6 fire damage to all creatures in a 10-foot burst up to 60 feet away (basic Reflex save). Once you've launched both your robot fists, the spell ends.

Spell Effect: Robo-Fist

**Heightened (+1)** The fire damage increases by 1d6.

entities.name: Sift the Sphere
entities.description:
You ritually sift through the local infosphere and gain mystical insight about a topic. During the casting of this spell, ask about the results of a particular course of action. The spell can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveals the GM's best guess among the following outcomes.

- **Weal** The results will be good.
- **Woe** The results will be bad.
- **Weal and Woe** The results will be a mix of good and bad.
- **Nothing** There won't be particularly good or bad results. The GM rolls a secret DC 6. On a failure, the result is always "nothing." This makes it impossible to tell whether a "nothing" result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of sift the sphere during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, it's possible to get a different result.

**Heightened (4th)** The spell can predict results up to 1 week into the future.

entities.name: Skim Data
entities.description:
You touch one object and concentrate on a dataset contained within it, such as a story, message, file, infosphere site, audio recording, or video. You understand the gist of the dataset and can quickly locate the most relevant pages or sections to your search. If the dataset is written or otherwise communicated in a language you don't know, or you attempt to gain information from a computer you don't have access to (such as one with a password you don't know), the spell fails.

If you Cast this Spell as part of a Research activity, you treat a critical failure as a failure instead.

Stats.Targets: one dataset contained within a touched object

entities.name: Soul Surge
entities.description:
You channel your life force into a spear of energy. You lose 6 Hit Points or, if you're in a bond with a vitality network that has at least 12 Hit Points, you can reduce the vitality bond's Hit Points by 12 instead. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, you deal 6d6 spirit damage. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage and becomes Drained 1.

**Heightened (+1)** Increase the damage dealt by 2d6 and the Hit Points lost by 2 (or by 4 if you spend Hit Points from a vitality network).

entities.name: Sure Tracking
entities.description:
You upgrade a weapon to fire ammunition that can make precise adjustments to its position in space to better track targets. A creature using the weapon reduces the penalty for firing into the weapon's second range increment from –2 to 0. Additionally, whenever a creature makes a ranged Strike with the weapon that targets a single creature, the attack ignores the target's circumstance bonus to AC from cover.

**Heightened (5th)** You can target up to 10 weapons.

Stats.Targets: 1 ranged weapon with the tech trait

entities.name: Temporal Bullets
entities.description:
**Trigger** You fail (but not critically fail) an attack roll with a weapon.

You rewind time and adjust probability to ensure an attack that just missed still does damage to its intended target. Roll damage as though you hit the target with the Strike, but the target only takes half the damage. You are then immune to temporal bullets for 10 minutes.

entities.name: Verdant Code
entities.description: You cause flowering vines or other plant matter to grow from an unattended tech object. Plant matter explodes from the target object, filling all squares within a 20-foot burst. Whenever a creature starts its turn in the area, it takes 2d6 piercing damage (basic Reflex save). On a critical failure, the creature is Immobilized for 1 round or until it Escapes against your spell DC. The growth covers the object, requiring a creature to succeed at a DC 5 to physically access the object for the spell's duration.

Stats.Targets: 1 unattended object with the tech trait

entities.name: Vibe Check
entities.description:
You share a mood by psychically projecting an intense emotion into a creature's mind. The target attempts a Will save. On a failure, the target experiences your choice of the following emotions, but if you pick anger or joy this spell gains the incapacitation trait.

- **Anger** On its next turn, the target spends its first action to attack the nearest creature, even if it's an ally.
- **Joy** The target can't take any hostile actions.
- **Fear** The target becomes Frightened 2.
- **Sorrow** The target is Slowed 1 and bursts into tears.

**Heightened (4th)** The spell affects all creatures in a 20-foot burst. Each creature must be affected by the same emotion.

entities.name: Void Seed
entities.description:
You plant a seed of entropy within a creature. The target gains the void healing ability. If the target would be healed by a non-void effect with the healing trait, it takes damage instead. An unwilling target can attempt a Will save to negate the effects.

Spell Effect: Void Seed

**Heightened (5th)** You can target up to six living creatures.

entities.name: Angelic Signal
entities.description:
**Trigger** An ally is targeted by an attack from a tech creature or a creature wielding a weapon with the tech trait.

An angelic messenger swarms the attacking creature with nonsensical data derived from prayers emanating from their tech devices. The target must attempt a Will saving throw. Regardless of the result, the target becomes immune to angelic signal for 10 minutes.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes a –1 status penalty to all attack and damage rolls with tech weapons until the end of the turn.

**Failure** The target takes a –2 status penalty to all attack and damage rolls with tech weapons until the end of the turn.

**Critical Failure** The target takes a –3 status penalty to all attack and damage rolls with tech weapons until the end of the turn.

Spell Effect: Angelic Signal

entities.name: Build Healing Station
entities.description:
You deploy a station in an adjacent empty space that floats in the air, fueling combatants and keeping them ready to fight on. The station is Small, visibly the source of the healing, has AC 10 and 30 Hit Points, and is immune to critical hits and precision damage. The station also has the tech trait. Anytime you or an ally ends a turn adjacent to the healing station, the adjacent character heals for 5 Hit Points and gains a +1 status bonus to saving throws for 1 round.

Spell Effect: Build Healing Station

**Heightened (+3)** The station's Hit Points increase by 30, and the healing increases by 5.

entities.name: Build Sentries
entities.description:
You deploy sentry turrets to attack intruders. For each action you spend Casting the Spell, you deploy a sentry turret into an empty space within range, attaching itself to any solid surface. These sentry turrets are Small and visibly dangerous. They have AC 10, Hardness 3, and 15 Hit Points and are immune to critical hits and precision damage. The sentries also have the tech trait. Whenever a visible creature that isn't Avoiding Notice, Hiding, or Sneaking comes within 15 feet of a sentry turret, you receive a ping and a small video feed of the creature on your comm unit. Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Interact with your comm unit to Command any number of sentry turrets to each fire a beam of energy at a creature within 30 feet of the sentry turret, dealing 2d6 fire damage (basic Reflex save). A creature can only be targeted by a single sentry turret each turn, even if it's within range of multiple sentries.

**Heightened (+2)** The Hit Points of each sentry turret increase by 10, and the damage increases by 1d6.

entities.name: Censormoji
entities.description:
**Trigger** A creature within range Casts a Spell or performs an action with the auditory trait. You interrupt a creature's speech with a censoring emoji resembling a speaker with a line through it or a giant red X around its mouth or speakers. The triggering creature must attempt a Will save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is Off-Guard until the end of your next turn.

**Failure** The creature is Stupefied 1 and off-guard for 1 minute.

**Critical Failure** The creature is Stupefied 3 and off-guard for 1 minute.

entities.name: Cozy Crashpad
entities.description:
You shape a shack 20 feet on each side and 10 feet high. This shack has the structure trait and the same restrictions as magic items that create structures. The walls of the cottage are simple and metal, with small, metal shuttered windows, and it has one metal door. It doesn't include its own lock, but it has a fastener to which a lock can be applied.

The interior contains three cots, one toilet, and a small stove powered by magic. The interior is lit with a small magical light that you can light or extinguish at will using a Sustain action. The climate inside the shack is comfortable and allows creatures inside it to withstand most hostile weather conditions, but incredible heat or cold, powerful storms, and winds of hurricane force or greater destroy the cottage. Other creatures can freely enter and exit the shack without damaging it, but if you exit the shack, the spell ends. You can Dismiss the spell.

entities.name: Dancemoji
entities.description:
You create a dancer emoji that inspires all that follow in its footsteps. When you Cast the Spell and the first time you Sustain it on each subsequent turn, the dancer emoji Flies or Strides up to 20 feet, leaving a trail of glowing dance floor in each space it travels through that lingers for the duration. Allies who enter the trail or start their turn there gain a +5-foot status bonus to their Speeds until the end of the turn. An ally who starts to Fly or Stride on the trail and doesn't leave it for the entire movement also gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their AC until the start of their next turn, mimicking the dancer's graceful movements.

Spell Effect: Dancemoji (Speed Bonus)

Spell Effect: Dancemoji (AC Bonus)

entities.name: Discharge
entities.description:
You ignite a sudden spark of electricity that surges into a technological creature or object. You de-energize an item with the tech trait or disrupt a creature with the tech trait, with effects based on the target being a creature or object.

- **Creature** If your target is a creature with the tech trait, it attempts a Will save. On a failure, the creature is Glitching 1; on a critical failure, the creature is Glitching 2.
- **Object** If you target an attended object, the creature with the object attempts a Will save. On a success, the object loses half of its maximum charges. On a failure, or if you target an unattended object, the object loses all its remaining charges.

Stats.Targets: 1 creature or object with the tech trait

entities.name: Electrotether
entities.description:
You supercharge the targets' electromagnetism and pull them with a tether of lightning. Make a ranged spell attack against each target. If you attack two targets, both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but it doesn't increase until after both attacks. The targets each take 4d8 electricity damage and are pulled 5 feet closer to you, or 10 feet closer on a critical hit. If both attacks hit, you can choose to move the creatures closer to one another instead of closer to you. Moving a target into a barrier, creature, or obstacle causes the target to stop before entering that space.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d8.

entities.name: Emoji Armament
entities.description:
You conjure an emoji of a weapon. Attempt a spell attack roll against a target's AC within 60 feet of the emoji (or adjacent if the emoji is a melee weapon), dealing 4d6 force damage on a hit (double damage on a critical hit). You can repeat the attack as a reaction when a creature in range uses a manipulate action (or move action, if the emoji is a melee weapon), but the spell ends at the start of your turn if you haven't used this reaction since the end of your previous turn. You can move the emoji each time you Sustain the Spell.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d6.

entities.name: Entropy Strike
entities.description:
You unleash a ray of entropy that rapidly and indiscriminately decays matter. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 5d8 void damage, or it takes 2d6 persistent acid damage and is glitching 1 if it has the tech trait. On a critical hit, double the damage, and if the creature has the tech trait, it's glitching 2 and Stunned 1.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1 die.

entities.name: Feline Senses
entities.description:
Your senses improve as you gain feline eyes, ears, and whiskers. You gain darkvision and electromagnetic scent as an imprecise sense out to 30 feet, allowing you to detect living and technological creatures.

Spell Effect: Feline Senses

**Heightened (4th)** The spell's range is touch and it targets 1 willing creature.

**Heightened (6th)** The spell's range is touch and it targets 1 willing creature. The duration is until your next daily preparations.

Spell Effect: Feline Senses (6th-Rank)

entities.name: Ghost Killer Weapon
entities.description: The target weapon becomes translucent and ghostly, and it can affect material and incorporeal creatures and objects. It gains the effects of the ghost killer weapon upgrade, meaning it becomes magical if it wasn't already, is especially effective against incorporeal creatures, and can be wielded by a corporeal or incorporeal creature.

Stats.Targets: 1 weapon that's either unattended or wielded by you or a willing ally

entities.name: Holographic Memory
entities.description:
You reach into the target's mind, extract a specific memory you have some awareness of, and project it into a hologram. Alternatively, when casting this spell, you can choose to pull a random memory left to the GM's discretion. The holographic memory can be no longer than 5 minutes; if the extracted memory is longer than this, the hologram simply ends at that point. The hologram includes audio as well as visual components, but it doesn't contain haptic, olfactory, or other components. The hologram typically plays a memory that takes place in a single scene, though it can cut to multiple scenes if they're accurate to the memory and its length allows. The hologram plays the memory exactly as the target experienced it and from the target's perspective, so it often lacks context.

This spell can target any living, Unconscious, or deceased sentient creature with an Intelligence modifier of –3 or higher. If the target is deceased, it can't have been dead for longer than 1 week, or this spell fails; once a corpse has been subjected to holographic memory by any caster, any subsequent castings of holographic memory fail.

If the target is unwilling to share this memory, it can attempt a Will save to resist this spell.

entities.name: Hot Swap
entities.description: You create a mystical bond between the targets, allowing them to switch positions. For the duration, creatures wielding either weapon gain the Swap action.

entities.name: Infuse Ammo
entities.description:
You enhance your next round of ammunition with the might of the elements, empowering the next round in the chamber. When you cast this spell, choose an elemental trait and corresponding type of damage: electricity or sonic for air, bludgeoning or piercing for earth, acid or slashing for metal, fire for fire, bludgeoning or cold for water, or piercing or poison for wood. The next Strike you make with the wielded weapon before the end of your next turn gains the chosen elemental trait, damage trait, and deals an additional 1d6 damage of the chosen type of damage.

Spell Effect: Infuse Ammo

**Heightened (6th)** The additional damage increases to 2d6.

entities.name: Instant Messaging
entities.description:
You use your comm unit as a focus for communication, projecting messages to those nearby. You can communicate telepathically with creatures within 30 feet by using a free hand to type a message into your comm unit or whispering into the mic. This communication is one-way, and you can only communicate with creatures that share a language with you. You can choose which creatures receive your communications, and those creatures know you were the one who transmitted the message.

**Heightened (5th)** You can communicate with images rather than words. *Instant messaging* loses the linguistic trait.

entities.name: Irradiate
entities.description:
You rapidly destabilize and decay the atoms around you to create a burst of magically enhanced mild radiation. Creatures in the area must attempt a Fortitude save against mild radiation sickness. This magical radiation uses your spell DC in place of the radiation's normal Fortitude DC, has an immediate onset, and the interval between each stage is 1 round. Technology doesn't gain the glitching condition from the radiation created by this spell.

**Heightened (5th)** The radiation increases to severe.

**Heightened (7th)** The radiation increases to extreme.

**Heightened (9th)** The radiation increases to incredible.

entities.name: Life Seal
entities.description:
**Trigger** A creature within range enters an environment that would be harmful to it.

A shimmering bubble envelops the target's body, allowing it to breathe normally in a vacuum or other unsafe environment and protecting it from severe temperatures and radiation.

**Heightened (7th)** You can target up to 5 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts for 8 hours and also protects against extreme temperatures and radiation.

**Heightened (10th)** You can target up to 10 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts until your next daily preparations and also protects against incredible temperatures and radiation.

entities.name: One with Junk
entities.description: You can either transform into junk or merge with it. This spell has the same effects as One with Plants but lets you merge with or turn into a pile of junk or a larger piece of junk, such as trash bags, a heap of scrap metal, or a broken construct. Junk you turn into has AC 23. You can Dismiss this spell.

entities.name: Personal Gravity
entities.description: You alter gravity's effects on you. You treat gravity as if it were your choice of one step higher or lower (for example, if you were in an area of low gravity, you could choose either standard gravity or zero-g). While the spell is active, you reduce the distance of any forced movement that would affect you by 5 feet (minimum 0 feet), and you ignore being clumsy and untethered because of gravity effects on you. You can Dismiss the spell.

entities.name: Positronic Helmet
entities.description:
A magical robotic headpiece builds out from you, transforming your brain into a central processing unit and bolstering your mind. You gain the tech trait for the duration of the spell. You gain a +1 status bonus to Perception checks and Will saves. You can Sustain this spell once per turn to fire a mental beam from the helmet that deals 2d10 mental damage to creatures in a 30-foot line with a basic Will save.

Spell Effect: Positronic Helmet

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d10.

entities.name: Selective Invisibility
entities.description:
A willing creature you touch becomes Invisible to everyone except a second target within the spell's range. If the invisible creature uses a hostile action against anyone who isn't the target that can see them, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

**Heightened (5th)** You can make up to 6 willing creatures within 30 feet invisible, but they all must have the same target.

Stats.Targets: 1 willing creature touched and one within range

entities.name: Share Pain
entities.description:
You telepathically share the sensation of agonizing pain with a creature. The target takes 3d12 mental damage and attempts a Will save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage and is Clumsy 1 for 1 minute.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes full damage and is Clumsy 2 for 1 minute.

**Heightened (6th)** The spell targets up to four creatures and deals 6d12 mental damage.

entities.name: Skyfire Wings
entities.description:
Wings of plasma grow from your body that propel you to soar high above your enemies, or scorch them for getting too close. You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater. Your arms (or primary set of arms) turn into wings that can't hold items or wield weapons. You drop any held equipment in those arms. You gain a wing unarmed attack that deals 1d8 fire damage and has the backswing, reach, and unarmed traits. On a critical hit, a target of your wing attack takes 2 persistent electricity damage.

Spell Effect: Skyfire Wings (3rd-Rank)

**Heightened (5th)** Your wings deal 2d8 fire damage and 4 persistent electricity damage on a critical hit. The duration increases to 5 minutes.

Spell Effect: Skyfire Wings (5th-Rank)

**Heightened (7th)** Your wings deal 3d8 fire damage and 6 persistent electricity damage on a critical hit. The duration increases to 1 hour.

Spell Effect: Skyfire Wings (7th-Rank)

**Heightened (9th)** Your wings deal 4d8 fire damage and 8 persistent electricity damage on a critical hit. The duration increases to 8 hours.

Spell Effect: Skyfire Wings (9th-Rank)

entities.name: Time's Edge
entities.description:
You refract latent energy from the Dimension of Time into your current plane in the form of a massive blade. The blade deals 5d6 slashing damage to all creatures in the area as it causes time to pass rapidly in a thin slice of their bodies. Creatures in the area must attempt a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage and is Sickened 1.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage and is Sickened 2.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d6.

entities.name: Turbulent Toys
entities.description:
Magical battery-powered children's toys fill the area and begin rolling, bumping, and flipping over one another. The toys are semi-corporeal constructs that can't be moved or damaged. When you Cast the Spell and the first time you Sustain it each subsequent round, you choose the turbulence the toys create, then move the area up to 5 feet.

- **Ankle Bumpers** The toys jostle against the feet of creatures in the area, and each creature must succeed at a Reflex save or fall Prone.

- **Battery Hogs** The toys steal energy to power themselves. All battery-operated devices in the area lose 2 charges.

- **Strobe Rave** The toys unleash a dizzying array of flashing lights and puffs of colored smoke. Each creature in the area must succeed at a Will save or be Dazzled until the start of your next turn. This effect has the visual trait.

entities.name: Upgrade Construct
entities.description:
You upgrade the weapons and armor of the target. The target gains a +1 status bonus to AC, and the target's Strikes deal an additional 2d4 damage of the same type as the base weapon.

Spell Effect: Upgrade Construct

**Heightened (+3)** The status bonus to AC increases by 1, and the additional damage increases by 1d4.

entities.name: Void Whispers
entities.description:
The target hears ominous sounds containing unspeakable mysteries from beyond the stars that disorient its mind. The target attempts a Will save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The target hears the strange whispers, becoming Stupefied 1 for 1 round.

**Failure** The target begins to wander aimlessly, using each action to Step in a random direction. When it moves, the target takes the safest route and doesn't enter hazardous terrain. The spell has a duration of 1 minute or until a creature uses a hostile action against the target.

**Critical Failure** As failure, except the target babbles incoherently. Any creature that begins its turn within 20 feet of the target must attempt a Will saving throw. On a failure, it must use its first action on its next turn to Step in a random direction and becomes immune to this spell for 24 hours. This is an incapacitation effect.

Stats.Traits: auditory, concentrate, incapacitation, linguistic, manipulate, mental

entities.name: Animate Armor
entities.description:
You imbue your armor with a fragment of your own will, causing the outer plating to fly off you and assist in the fight of its own accord. You summon an Animated Tech Armor to fight for you. The animated tech armor can use any abilities of the armor as if it were Activated and worn by it.

**Heightened (5th)** The summoned armor has the aerial and elite adjustments.

entities.name: Battle Sonata
entities.description:
This spell was composed by pahtra battle singers of Pulonis to amplify a dissonant song into a deadly wave that deals 4d10 sonic damage. Each creature must attempt a Will save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage and is Deafened for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage, is deafened for 1 minute, and becomes Stunned 1.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d10.

entities.name: Bombarding Emojis
entities.description: You conjure a barrage of emojis that rain from the sky. Creatures in the area take 6d8 force damage (basic Reflex save). When you Cast the Spell and the first time you Sustain it each subsequent round, each creature in the area takes 6d8 force damage (basic Reflex save).

entities.name: Build Booster Ring
entities.description:
You use magical tech to create a ring that's 1 inch thick, 10 feet wide, and 10 feet high. You must create the ring in an unbroken open space so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost. The ring contains a ripple in space-time that amplifies those that pass through it. Creatures or vehicles that move through the ring gain a +30-foot status bonus to their Speeds until the end of the turn.

Spell Effect: Build Booster Ring

entities.name: Build Shield Generator
entities.description:
You bind together magic and science to create a shield generator in an empty adjacent space. The generator is Small, visibly the source of the shields, has AC 10 and 40 Hit Points, and is immune to critical hits and precision damage. The generator also has the tech trait. This generator provides a small, shimmering light that covers you and all allies within 60 feet, granting a +1 status bonus to AC, as well as resistance 4 to acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, and sonic damage. If the generator is destroyed, the spell ends.

Spell Effect: Build Shield Generator

**Heightened (+1)** The generator's Hit Points increase by 10, and the resistance granted by the generator increases by 1.

entities.name: Burstmoji
entities.description:
You create an emoji of an explosion that erupts into a mass of flames. Creatures in the area take 6d6 fire damage (basic Reflex save), and the area becomes difficult and hazardous terrain for the duration. Creatures that start their turn in the area or move through a square in the area take @item.rank + @item.rank - 3  fire damage.

**Heightened (+1)** The initial fire damage increases by 2d6, and the hazardous terrain fire damage increases by 2.

entities.name: Cable Management
entities.description:
A massive tangle of interconnected computer cables springs forth from every direction at once. Spaces in the area become difficult terrain for the duration. Each time a creature begins a move action inside the tangle or enters the tangle during a move action, it must succeed at a Reflex save or take a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds until it leaves the area. On a critical failure, the creature is also Immobilized for 1 round. In addition, the cables are so thickly tangled that they provide standard cover to creatures in the area.

Spell Effect: Cable Management

entities.name: Cairn Form
entities.description:
Your target's skin becomes a thick carapace of solid stone, granting resistance 5 to physical damage, except adamantine. The target gains a fist unarmed attack that deals 2d6 bludgeoning damage. The target uses their highest weapon or unarmed attack proficiency with these attacks, and if they have weapon specialization or greater weapon specialization, they add this damage as well. On a critical hit with one of these unarmed attacks, the creature struck must succeed at a Fortitude save against the target's class DC or become Stunned 1 for 1 round.

Spell Effect: Cairn Form

**Heightened (6th)** The resistance increases to 10, and the damage dealt by the attacks increases to 3d6.

**Heightened (10th)** The resistance increases to 20, and the damage dealt by the attacks increases to 4d6.

entities.name: Cosmic Radiation Rods
entities.description:
You summon forth an intangible field of thousands of tiny control rods to absorb ambient radiation. These rods hover in the air all around you but are too small to affect sight lines or otherwise interfere with targeting. All allies within the area gain resistance 5 to damage from radiation effects and a +1 status bonus to Fortitude saves against poison and radiation effects.

Spell Effect: Cosmic Radiation Rods

**Heightened (+3)** The status bonus increases by 1, and the resistance increases by 5.

entities.name: Eldritch Wrath
entities.description:
You channel the bizarre powers that exist beyond the outer reaches of the universe, dealing 3d12 mental damage to each creature in the area as phantasmal claws, jaws, and tentacles lash out at each target. Each creature in the area must attempt a Will save. The area is difficult terrain for any creature sickened by the effects of this spell.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage and is Sickened 1.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage and is Sickened 2.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d12.

entities.name: Emoji Spam
entities.description:
You overwhelm a creature's senses with a barrage of different emojis, each eliciting a different sensation, memory, or otherwise deeply rooted connection that causes their brain to overload with information. The creature takes 6d6 mental damage and must attempt a Will save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage and is Dazzled until the start of your next turn.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage plus an additional @item.level - 3 d6 persistent,mental damage. While taking this persistent damage, the creature is dazzled and can only speak in emojis. While speaking in only emojis, the creature can't cast spells or use auditory and sonic effects, except those that have "emoji" or "moji" in their name or the subtle trait. The creature can still communicate by speaking, but doing so loses the auditory trait and gains the visual trait.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the creature takes double damage, and the creature is Blinded while taking the persistent damage. When it loses the persistent damage, it becomes dazzled until the end of its next turn.

**Heightened (+1)** The mental damage increases by 2d6, and the persistent mental damage increases by 1d6.

entities.name: Explosion of Rot
entities.description:
A giant pustule swells and explodes, coating everything around it in life-draining rot. Creatures and plants in the area take 6d6 poison damage and must attempt a Reflex save. Foliage and plant matter in the area damaged by the spell no longer provide cover.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes half damage.

**Failure** The target takes full damage and is Enfeebled 1.

**Critical Failure** The target takes double damage, floor @item.rank - 2 /2 d6 persistent,poison damage, and is Enfeebled 2.

**Heightened (+2)** The initial damage increases by 2d6, and the persistent damage on a critical failure increases by 1d6.

entities.name: Genetic Regeneration
entities.description:
You imbue the target's genetic code with a stimulating regenerative property that begins healing its wounds. The target temporarily gains regeneration 7, which restores 7 Hit Points to it at the start of each of its turns. While it has regeneration, the target can't die from taking damage, and its dying condition can't increase to a value that would kill it (this stops most creatures' dying condition at dying 3), though if its wounded value becomes 4 or higher, it stays Unconscious until its wounds are treated. If the target takes acid or fire damage, its regeneration deactivates until after the end of its next turn.

Once during the spell's duration, the creature can forgo healing Hit Points that round to regrow one damaged or ruined organ or reattach a severed body part by spending an Interact action to hold the body part to the area it was severed from.

Spell Effect: Genetic Regeneration

**Heightened (+1)** Increase the regeneration value by 2.

entities.name: Ghostmoji
entities.description:
You create a terrifying ghost emoji that only the target can see. The target must attempt a Will save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target is Frightened 1.

**Failure** The target is Frightened 2 and Stunned 2.

**Critical Failure** The target is Frightened 3 and Fleeing, and it's Slowed 2 for as long as it remains frightened.

Stats.Traits: concentrate, emotion, fear, incapacitation, manipulate, mental

entities.name: Holographic Stand-In
entities.description:
You create a convincing holographic copy of yourself. This hologram looks exactly like you, but it's incorporeal and mimics your movements. When you Sustain the spell, you can Command the hologram to act differently. Characters can discern the nature of the hologram with a Perception check, or by interacting with it in any way, such as attempting to Strike it. You can look through the hologram's eyes by closing your own as part of a seek action. The spell immediately ends if you lose line of effect to your hologram.

**Heightened (9th)** The maximum duration you can Sustain the spell increases to 10 minutes.

entities.name: Infectious Virus
entities.description:
You craft a dangerous computer virus. All creatures with the tech trait in the area take 10 persistent electricity damage and must attempt a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes half damage and is Glitching 1.

**Failure** The target takes full damage and is Glitching 2.

**Critical Failure** The target takes double damage and is Glitching 4.

**Heightened (+2)** The persistent damage increases by 5.

entities.name: Light Shift
entities.description: You fire the locus and instantly transfer yourself along the beam, transforming you and your equipment into photons for a fraction of a second. You teleport to an occupied space within the first range increment of the locus, and you shed bright light in a radius equal to the distance you teleported that lasts until the end of your turn.

entities.name: Speak with Computers
entities.description:
You can ask questions of and receive answers from the spirits inhabiting a computer. These synthetic spirits manifest within computer code and often have personalities colored by the nature of the device, its condition, and its applications and personalized settings. A computer's perspective, perception, and knowledge give it a worldview different enough from a human's that it doesn't consider the same details important. Computers can mostly answer questions about creatures that interfaced with them in the past and what information is concealed within their files.

**Heightened (6th)** The duration is 8 hours.

entities.name: Surveillance Vision
entities.description:
You create an invisible security camera with 1 HP and AC 10 anywhere within 10 feet on a solid surface. It sees in all directions with your normal visual senses. You can constantly perceive through your own senses and the vision of the camera as long as you're on the same plane. Only one camera can be active at a time; if you make a second camera, the first is destroyed. You can Dismiss this spell.

**Heightened (7th)** The duration becomes unlimited.

entities.name: Weight of Ages
entities.description:
You burden a creature's body and mind with the pains and sorrows of a lifetime. The target takes 3d8 bludgeoning damage and 3d8 mental damage and must attempt a Will saving throw.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes half damage.

**Failure** The target takes full damage and is Encumbered for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** The target takes double damage and is encumbered for 1 minute.

**Heightened (+1)** The mental damage increases by 2d8.

entities.name: Blinding Emoji
entities.description:
You create an emoji so bright that it wears sunshades to protect itself from its own light. Creatures in the area when you cast the spell or that start their turn in the area must attempt a Fortitude saving throw. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the area up to 30 feet.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune to blinding emoji for 1 minute.

**Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Failure** The creature is Blinded until the end of its next turn.

**Critical Failure** The creature is blinded for 1 minute.

entities.name: Carcinization
entities.description:
You manipulate the target's genetic code and accelerate the inevitable, pressuring the target to undergo carcinization and become a crab. A willing target fully transforms into a crab, as if it had cast animal form heightened to the same rank as this spell and using the following statistics.

- **Crab**

- Speed 25 feet, swim 15 feet
- **Melee** 1 big claw, **Damage** 2d8 piercing
- **Melee** 1 claw (agile), **Damage** 2d4 piercing.
- Can breathe air and water.

Spell Effect: Carcinization

Unwilling targets must instead attempt a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target's body gains minor features of a crab, its appendages turning into claws and causing it to become Clumsy 1.

**Failure** The target transforms into a partial crab-like being, becoming clumsy 1, Stupefied 1, and Sickened 1.

**Critical Failure** The target is transformed into a partial crab-like being and becomes Clumsy 2, Stupefied 2, and Sickened 2.

entities.name: Chrono Push
entities.description:
You push a creature across the battlefield so hard it slides through time. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, you knock the target back 15 feet in a straight line (30 feet on a critical hit). If the pushed creature makes contact with a solid barrier or another creature, its movement ends. At the end of this movement, the creature reenters the flow of time with a burst of temporal energy. The target and creatures now adjacent to the target take 7d8 force damage with a basic Reflex save.

**Heightened (+1)** The force damage increases by 1d8.

entities.name: Control Machine
entities.description:
You take control of a technological creature or object and command it telepathically. If you issue an obviously self-destructive order to a sapient target, the target doesn't act until you issue a new order. The effect depends on its Will save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target is Stunned 1 as it fights off your commands.

**Failure** You control the target. It gains the controlled condition, but it can attempt a Will save at the end of each of its turns. On a success, the spell ends.

**Critical Failure** As a failure, but the target receives a new save only if it's sapient and you give it a new order that's against its nature, such as killing its allies.

**Heightened (10th)** The duration is unlimited.

Stats.Targets: 1 creature or hazard with the tech trait
Stats.Duration: until the next time you make your daily preparations

entities.name: Cosmic Eddy
entities.description:
You conjure a swirling eddy of magical force, battering your targets and hindering their movement. Creatures in the area when you Cast the Spell or that start their turn there take 6d6 force damage with a basic Reflex save; on a failure, a creature also falls Prone. The area is difficult terrain, and creatures attempting to Fly in the area must attempt an Acrobatics check against your spell DC; on a failure, the movement is disrupted, and any remaining movement from the action is wasted. In addition, unattended items of light Bulk or less are thrown around within the eddy and land in a random space in the area when the spell ends.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d6.

entities.name: Divine Machine
entities.description:
You surround your target with shimmering divine magic that coalesces into technological armor, building them a large, resilient shell. For the duration of the spell, the target stands taller, functions more reliably, and gains supernatural protection from harm. The target grows to Large size unless it's already Large or larger. Its equipment grows with it but returns to its usual size if removed. Its reach increases by 5 feet (or by 10 feet if it started out Tiny). The target also gains a +2 status bonus to AC and saving throws and 20 temporary Hit Points for the duration. The spell ends immediately when the target has no temporary Hit Points.

Spell Effect: Divine Machine

**Heightened (+1)** The temporary Hit Points granted by this spell increase by 5.

entities.name: Illusory Scene
entities.description:
You craft an imaginary scene that includes up to 10 discrete creatures or objects of various sizes, all of which must be within the spell's area. These elements generate appropriate sounds and smells, and they feel right to the touch. Elements of an illusory scene are incapable of speech. Unlike with the Illusory Creature spell, creatures in your scene lack combat abilities and statistics. Your scene doesn't include changes to the environment around it, though you can place your scene within the illusory environment of other illusion spells.

When you create the scene, you can choose to have it be static or follow a program. Though a static scene is stationary, it includes basic natural movement. For example, wind blowing on an illusory piece of paper would rustle it. A program can be up to 1 minute long and repeats when finished. For instance, you could create a scene of two orcs fighting each other, and the fight would go the same way for each repetition. If you create a loop, the two fighters end up in the same place at the start of the scene and at the end of it, but you can smooth the program so it's hard to tell when the loop ends and begins. Anyone observing the scene for more than a few minutes almost always notices it looping. You're unable to alter the program after you create the illusion.

Any creature that touches any part of the image or uses the Seek action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion. If they interact with a portion of the illusion, they disbelieve only that portion. They disbelieve the entire scene only on a critical success.

**Heightened (6th)** Creatures or objects in your scene can speak. You must speak the specific lines for each actor when creating your program. The spell disguises your voice for each actor.

**Heightened (8th)** As the 6th-rank version, and the duration is unlimited.

Stats.Traits: auditory, concentrate, illusion, manipulate, olfactory, visual

entities.name: Overload Systems
entities.description:
You flood the area with a wave of electrical interference. You deal 7d8 electricity damage to creatures in the area. Each creature in the area must attempt a Reflex save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes half damage.

**Failure** The target takes full damage, and any of its items with the tech trait become glitching 1 for 1 minute or until the condition is removed.

**Critical Failure** The target takes double damage, and any of its items with the tech trait become glitching 2 for 1 minute or until the condition is removed.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d8.

entities.name: Paywall
entities.description:
You form a transparent wall of hardlight featuring payment terms in many languages. Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of the wall has AC 10, Hardness 18, and 60 Hit Points, and its immune to critical hits and precision damage. The wall can be passed through by paying 10 credits and verifying the transaction as an single action with the auditory trait. Creatures that carry a credstick can pass, even if its empty, though in this case they pass through by taking on 10 credits of debt.

**Heightened (+1)** The Hit Points of each section of the wall increase by 15.

entities.name: Plant Form
entities.description:
Taking inspiration from verdant creatures, you transform into a Large plant battle form. When you Cast this Spell, choose a listed battle form. You can substitute a similar specific plant to turn into (such as a pitcher plant instead of a flytrap), but this has no effect on the form's Size or statistics. While in this form, you gain the plant trait. You can Dismiss the spell.

You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which battle form you choose.

- AC = 19 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.

- 12 temporary Hit Points.

- Resistance 10 to poison.

- Low-light vision.

- One or more unarmed melee attacks specific to the battle form you choose, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +17, and your damage bonus is +11. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the Enfeebled condition, for example). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead.

- Athletics modifier of +19, unless your own modifier is higher.

You gain specific abilities based on the plant you choose.

- **Moonflower**

- Speed 30 feet;

- Resistance 10 to electricity;

- **Melee** 1 bite (reach 15 feet), **Damage** 2d10 piercing;

- **Melee** 1 root (reach 15 feet), **Damage** 2d8 bludgeoning, and you can spend an action after a hit to Grab the target.

- **Void Palm**

- Speed 15 feet;

- Resistance 10 to poison;

- **Melee** 1 void frond (reach 10 feet), **Damage** 2d8 slashing.

Spell Effect: Plant Form

**Heightened (6th)** Your battle form is Huge, and the reach of your attacks increases by 5 feet. You instead gain AC = 22 + your level, 24 temporary HP, attack modifier +21, damage bonus +16, and Athletics +22.

entities.name: Prayermoji
entities.description:
You project an emoji of your deity's religious symbol around yourself. When you Cast the Spell and the first time you Sustain it on each subsequent turn, choose one of the following benefits depending on the emoji used.

- **Prayer of Grace** You gain a +20-foot status bonus to your Speeds until the start of your next turn.

- **Prayer of Healing** You regain 4 Hit Points at the start of your next turn.

- **Prayer of Protection** You gain a +1 status bonus to AC and saving throws until the start of your next turn.

- **Prayer of Retribution** Until the start of your next turn, creatures that hit you with melee Strikes take 4 spirit damage.

Spell Effect: Prayermoji

**Heightened (+1)** The Hit Points regained increase by 1, and the spirit damage increases by 1.

entities.name: Reflective Paneling
entities.description:
The plates of your armor harden and become more reflective, enhanced with defensive magic. When you Cast this Spell, choose electricity, fire, piercing, or slashing damage. For the duration, you gain resistance 10 to that damage type and gain the Reflect Damage reaction.

Spell Effect: Reflective Paneling

**Heightened (8th)** You can choose two damage types, and the resistance increases to 15. You can only Reflect Damage of one type at a time.

**Heightened (10th)** As 8th, except the spell protects you against all four damage types, and the resistance increases to 20.

entities.name: Rewire Flesh
entities.description:
You rewrite the target's DNA as if it was code, painfully warping its biological functions to mimic the processes of a robot: its body becomes visibly robotic as its blood vessels form circuit-like patterns, its bones twist into straight lines, its movements become jerky, and its voice grows halting. The target takes 3d6 slashing damage and 3d6 persistent bleed damage and must attempt a Will save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes half damage and is Clumsy 1 for 1 round.

**Failure** The target takes full damage, is Clumsy 2 for 1 minute, and takes a –10-foot penalty to its Speeds for as long as it's clumsy.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the target takes double damage and is also Stupefied 1 for as long as it's clumsy.

**Heightened (+1)** The slashing damage and persistent bleed damage each increase by 1d6.

entities.name: Subjective Reality
entities.description:
You alter your perceptions to convince yourself that another creature or object is an illusion. Choose one object or creature you can perceive within range. For you, the target becomes transparent and doesn't create sound, smell, or other sensory output. You can move through the target, and the target can move through you. You gain resistance to all damage originating from the target equal to your level. If you are targeted by or are in the area of one of the target's abilities or effects, the target must succeed at a DC 5, and if it fails, you're unaffected by the ability or effect. You're immune to all of the target's auditory, linguistic, and scent-based attacks and effects. Your attacks deal no damage to the target, and the target is immune to your spells and other effects. You and the target can affect one another indirectly, such as through a Strike from a minion or through the environment affected by a witchwarper's quantum field. When this spell ends, the target becomes immune to subjective reality for 24 hours.

Spell Effect: Subjective Reality

entities.name: Summon Celestial
entities.description:
You summon a creature that has the celestial trait and whose level is 5 or lower to fight for you. The GM might determine your deity restricts the specific types of celestials you can summon in certain cases.

**Heightened** As listed in the summon trait.

entities.name: Summon Drift Prophet
entities.description:
You call forth a spectra tasked with monitoring the Drift and presenting its gift to technologically advanced civilizations. The spectra occupies the space of a Large creature, and has a Speed of 40 feet and a fly Speed of 60 feet with the cosmic trait.

**Arrive** *Establish Universal Network* With a burst of divine energy from the Drift, the spectra restores 5* @item.level - 1  healing |options:area-damage Hit Points to all creatures or objects with the tech trait within a 30-foot emanation and reduces their glitching condition by 5.

**Depart** *Terminate Connection* Each creature or attended object with the tech trait within a 30-foot emanation must attempt a Fortitude save. On a failed save, the creature or object becomes Glitching 5, and creatures are Slowed 1 while they're glitching.

**Heightened (+1)** Increase the Hit Points restored by 5.

Stats.Targets: until the end of your next turn

entities.name: Technological Combustion
entities.description:
You rapidly overheat the systems of a technological weapon, causing it to expel a devastating wave of heat. If the target is held or worn, the creature holding or wielding it attempts a Reflex save. On a failure, or if the target is unattended, the target becomes Glitching 2, and all creatures within 20 feet of the target take 5d10 fire damage with a basic Reflex save.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d10.

Stats.Targets: 1 object or weapon with the tech trait

entities.name: Technophobia
entities.description:
You gather the message threads of thousands of angry technology users from the infosphere, making their pain a reality for your target whenever they use technology. The target must attempt a Will saving throw.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The first time each round the target uses a tech item, it takes 2d10 mental damage.

**Failure** As success, but the target becomes Frightened 1 and takes 4d10 mental damage.

**Critical Failure** As success, but the target becomes Frightened 2 and takes 8d10 mental damage.

entities.name: Wall of Junk
entities.description:
You sculpt a barrier of trash that blocks sight and once broken, impedes foes. You create a 1-foot-thick wall of junk in either a hemisphere with a radius of 10 feet or a straight line up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high. The wall doesn't have to be vertical, but it must be anchored on both sides to a solid surface and can't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost.

Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of the wall has AC 10, Hardness 5, 20 Hit Points, and is immune to critical hits and precision damage. A destroyed section leaves behind a heap of jagged scrap that's difficult and hazardous terrain, dealing 2d6 slashing damage to a creature that enters the terrain for the first time on its turn.

**Heightened (+2)** The slashing damage increases by 1d6.

entities.name: Wave of Warning
entities.description:
You deter enemies with a wave of hostile intent. The target takes 7d8 nonlethal mental damage, and the target must attempt a Will save. The psychic energy then arcs to another creature within 30 feet of the first target, jumps to another creature within 30 feet of that target, and so on. You can end the wave at any point. You can't target the same creature more than once, and you must have line of effect to all targets. Roll the damage only once, and apply it to each target (halving or doubling as appropriate for its saving throw outcome).

**Critical Success** The target creature is unaffected, and the wave ends with that target.

**Success** The target takes half damage.

**Failure** The target takes full damage and is Frightened 1.

**Critical Failure** The target takes double damage and is Frightened 2.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d8.

Stats.Traits: concentrate, emotion, fear, manipulate, mental, nonlethal
Stats.Targets: 1 creature, plus any number of additional creatures

entities.name: Corrosive Haze
entities.description:
You unleash a cloud of corrosive nanites. Creatures that start their turn in the area take 6d8 acid damage and 1d6 persistent acid damage with a basic Fortitude save. The nanites also corrode any unattended objects in the area, dealing 3d8 acid damage. Each round you Sustain the spell, you can move the cloud up to 10 feet in any direction. You can Dismiss the spell.

**Heightened (+1)** The initial damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent acid damage increases by 1d6.

entities.name: Dragon Form
entities.description:
Calling upon powerful magic, you gain a Large dragon battle form. When you Cast this Spell, choose one type of common dragon or another type to which your GM allows access. While in this form, you gain the dragon trait. You have hands in this battle form and can take manipulate actions. You can Dismiss the spell.

You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which battle form you choose:

- AC = 18 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.

- 10 temporary Hit Points.

- Speed 40 feet, fly 100 feet. You gain any of the following Speeds the chosen dragon has, but with the listed amount: burrow 20 feet, climb 40 feet, swim 60 feet.

- Resistance 10 against the damage type of your Dragon Breath (see below).

- Darkvision and imprecise scent 60 feet.

- The following unarmed melee attacks, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +22, and your damage bonus is +6.
