These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the enfeebled condition, for example). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead. See below for more on these attacks.

- **Melee** 1 jaws, **Damage** 2d12 piercing plus 2d6 damage of the same damage type as your Dragon Breath (see below);

- **Melee** 1 claw (agile), **Damage** 3d10 slashing;

- **Melee** 1 tail (reach 10 feet), **Damage** 3d10 bludgeoning.

- Athletics modifier of +23, unless your own is higher.

- **Dragon Breath** 2 You exhale deadly magical energy in an area, dealing 10d6 damage to each creature in the area with a basic save against your spell DC. The shape, damage type, and save type match that of your chosen dragon's breath. If the chosen dragon's breath can deal more than one type of damage, choose one when you cast *dragon form*. The shape is a 30-foot cone or a 100-foot line. Once activated, Dragon Breath can't be used again for 1d4 rounds. Dragon Breath has the tradition trait matching the type of dragon and the damage trait matching the type of damage it deals, if applicable.

- **Tradition Resistance** If the dragon's magical tradition matches that of your dragon form spell, you gain the listed ability. **Arcane** resistance 5 against magic; **divine** resistance 10 to spirit, vitality, and void; **occult** resistance 10 to mental; **primal** resistance 5 to physical damage.

Spell Effect: Dragon Form

DragonTraditionSpeedsDragon BreathSaving Throw

AbysiumArcane—Cone of poisonFortitude

AkashicOccult—Cone of mentalWill

CosmicDivine—Cone of spiritWill

HostPrimalClimbCone of piercingReflex

**Heightened (8th)** Your battle form is Huge, you gain a +20-foot status bonus to your fly Speed, and your attacks have 10-foot reach (or 15-foot reach if they previously had 10-foot reach). You instead gain AC = 21 + your level, 15 temporary HP, an attack modifier of +28, a damage bonus of +12, and Athletics +28. Your Dragon Breath deals an additional 4d6 damage.

entities.name: Explosive Recall
entities.description: You capture and repeat the memory of a grenade's explosion within its shell. If you Area-Fire with the locus during the duration of the spell, the grenade's effect is repeated in the same area 1 round after the initial activation.

entities.name: Pocket Vacuum
entities.description:
You create a sudden vacuum, forcing creatures in the area to hold their breath or fall Unconscious and start suffocating. The explosive decompression deals 5d12 bludgeoning damage to each creature in the area when the spell is cast or that enters the area during the duration (unless they were already in a vacuum), with a basic Fortitude save. Creatures who critically fail the save are also knocked Prone.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d12.

entities.name: Promession
entities.description:
You flash freeze a target then send subsonic waves through it, potentially reducing it into fine powder. Make a spell attack against the target. If you hit a target, the target takes 6d8 cold damage and must attempt a Fortitude save. If you critically hit, the target gets a result one degree of success worse than it rolled on its Fortitude save. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points is blasted to fine powder; its gear remains.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected by further damage.

**Success** The target takes an additional @item.level -3 d8 sonic damage.

**Failure** The target takes an additional @item.level d8 sonic damage.

**Critical Failure** The target takes an additional @item.level +6 d8 sonic damage.

**Heightened (+1)** The cold and sonic damage each increase by 1d8.

Stats.Traits: attack, cold, concentrate, death, manipulate, sonic

entities.name: Raise Dead
entities.description:
You attempt to call forth the dead creature's soul, requiring the creature's body to be present and relatively intact. The creature must have died within the past 3 days. If Pharasma has decided that the creature's time has come (at the GM's discretion), or if the creature doesn't wish to return to life, this spell automatically fails, but the cost isn't consumed in the casting.

If the spell is successful, the creature returns to life with 1 Hit Point, no spells prepared or spell slots available, no points in any pools or any other daily resources, and still with any long-term debilitations of the old body. The time spent in the Boneyard leaves the target temporarily debilitated, making it Clumsy 2, Drained 2, and Enfeebled 2 for 1 week; these conditions can't be removed or reduced by any means until the week has passed. The creature is also permanently changed by its time in the afterlife, such as a slight personality shift, a streak of white in the hair, or a strange new birthmark.

**Heightened (7th)** The maximum level of the target increases to 15. The cost increases to the target's level (minimum 1) × 4,000 credits.

**Heightened (8th)** The maximum level of the target increases to 17. The cost increases to the target's level (minimum 1) × 8,000 credits.

**Heightened (9th)** The maximum level of the target increases to 19. The cost increases to the target's level (minimum 1) × 16,000 credits.

**Heightened (10th)** The maximum level of the target increases to 21. The cost increases to the target's level (minimum 1) × 32,000 credits.

Stats.Targets: 1 dead creature of 13th level or lower

entities.name: Rocket Dash
entities.description:
You emit a rocket of flame from behind you and blast forward. You move in a straight line up to twice your Speed; you can move through spaces occupied by creatures, and the movement doesn't trigger reactions. Creatures in the area take 6d12 fire damage with a basic Reflex save. On a critical failure, a creature also takes 2d6 persistent fire damage and is Dazzled for 1 round. You reappear at the end of the line.

**Heightened (+2)** The fire damage increases by 2d12, and the persistent fire damage on a critical failure increases by 1d6.

entities.name: Shield Wall
entities.description: You magnify the protective power of your shield, slamming it into the ground and causing it to grow into a wall up to 60 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1/4 inch thick. The wall is made of the same material as the locus and doesn't need to stand vertically, forming a straight line parallel to the shield's surface. If the wall would pass through a creature or object, the spell is lost. Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of the wall has AC 10, is immune to critical hits and precision damage, and has the same Hardness, HP, and BT as the locus. Creatures can move through a section of the wall that's broken.

entities.name: Slice Reality
entities.description:
You slice through reality, forming a chasm of life-draining entropy in a straight line 20 feet high, 120 feet long, and 2 inches thick. The chasm provides cover. The chasm deals 7d8 void damage to each creature that's in the chasm's space when it's created, that attempts to pass through the chasm, or that ends its turn inside the chasm, with a basic Reflex save. A creature that succeeds at this save when the chasm is created is pushed to the nearest space on the side of its choice. Creatures trying to move through the chasm fail to do so if they critically fail the save, ending their movement next to the chasm.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d8.

entities.name: Spark of the Spirit
entities.description:
You create a sphere of spiritual electricity. Each ally that begins their turn in the area is Quickened and can use this additional action only to Interact or Step. Allies quickened in this way immediately regain all charges on batteries in their possession and deal an additional 3d4 electricity damage when they Strike with a tech weapon.

Spell Effect: Spark of the Spirit

entities.name: Telekinetic Strangulation
entities.description: You telekinetically grasp a creature's throat or similar vital anatomy with a vicelike grip, forcefully lifting it a few inches off the ground as it struggles to breathe. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, you deal 6d12 bludgeoning damage, and the target is Immobilized. While immobilized in this way, it must hold its breath or begin suffocating. The first time each round you Sustain the spell, the target takes 1d12 bludgeoning damage, remains immobilized, and must continue holding its breath. The target can attempt to Escape (the Escape DC is your spell DC, and the attempt is affected by the incapacitation trait).

entities.name: Wall of Coiling Lightning
entities.description:
You create 20-foot-tall metal coils that harness the power of electricity, arcing current between two unoccupied spaces up to 30 feet apart. These coils each have AC 10, 60 Hit Points, and are immune to critical hits and precision damage. The spell ends if either coil is destroyed. A constant stream of electricity flows between these coils in a visible, straight line. Creatures can see and move through the coils; however, if a creature enters or starts its turn in the stream of electricity or within 5 feet of a coil, it takes 4d12 electricity damage with a basic Reflex save. On a failed save, the target is also Off-Guard for 1 round.

**Heightened (+2)** The damage increases by 1d12.

entities.name: Wall of Plasma
entities.description:
You shape a wall of crackling plasma that burns creatures passing through it. You create either a 5-foot-thick wall of plasma in a straight line up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high, or a 5-foot-thick, 10-foot-radius ring of plasma with the same height. The wall stands vertically in either form; if you wish, the wall can be of a shorter length or height. Everything on each side of the wall is Concealed from creatures on the opposite side. Any creature that crosses the wall or is occupying the wall's area at the start of its turn takes 4d6 fire damage and 2d6 persistent electricity damage.

**Heightened (+1)** The persistent electricity damage increases by 1d6.

entities.name: X-Ray Vision
entities.description: You empower yourself to see through most materials and walls within 60 feet. Your sight is blocked by 2 feet of wood or plastic, 1 foot of stone, 2 inches of common metal, or any amount of lead or any starmetal, and you can only see in black and white.

entities.name: Absolute Zero
entities.description:
A swirling vortex flash freezes the air, dealing 10d8 cold damage. Each creature in the area must attempt a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage and is Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage, is Immobilized by a layer of ice, and is slowed 1 as long as it's immobilized. The ice is an object with 50 Hit Points, Hardness 5, immunity to cold damage, and vulnerability 10 to fire. It has object immunities and is destroyed if the target Escapes.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d8 and the ice's Hit Points increase by 5.

entities.name: Boot Loop
entities.description:
You deliver a perfectly crafted command with the power of your voice, triggering mass reboots and shaking bodies apart. You deal 10d8 sonic damage to all creatures in the area. Each creature must attempt a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes half damage.

**Failure** The target takes full damage. Creatures with the tech trait become Glitching 1, and creatures without the tech trait are Deafened for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** The target takes double damage. Creatures with the tech trait become Glitching 2, and creatures without the tech trait are deafened for 1 minute.

entities.name: Death Sentence
entities.description:
You draw a line of universal condemnation and judge the target unfit to exist. The target takes 11d10 spirit damage with a basic Will save. On a failure, the creature also believes it's been imprisoned as it awaits punishment and becomes Paralyzed for 1 round (or paralyzed for 2 rounds on a critical failure).

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d10.

entities.name: Emoji Tsunami
entities.description:
You unleash a wave of emojis. Creatures in the area take 13d6 bludgeoning damage and must attempt a Reflex saving throw.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you. This is forced movement.

**Failure** As success, but the creature takes full damage and is also knocked Prone.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the creature takes double damage and is also Blinded for 1 minute by lingering water droplet emojis.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d6.

entities.name: Howl
entities.description:
You let out a powerful ululation full of psychic resonance that compels others who hear it to join in. You deal 7d12 sonic damage and 1d8 persistent mental damage to other creatures who can hear within the area. Targets must attempt a Will save. The persistent mental damage a creature takes from this spell increases by 1d8 if at least one other creature is howling. A howling creature can't use auditory actions or cast spells except for those with the subtle trait for 1 round. Calculate the persistent damage after all creatures attempt their saves.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes half damage and no persistent mental damage.

**Failure** The target takes full damage, persistent mental damage, and is compelled to howl as long as it takes persistent mental damage.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the target takes double the initial and persistent damage.

entities.name: Judgment Cannon
entities.description:
You create a ghostly, semi-corporeal turret made of divine force in an unoccupied space in range. The turret is Medium; creatures can move through the turret's space but can't end their movement in it. When you Cast the Spell and the first time you Sustain it each turn on subsequent rounds, the turret fires, dealing 8d8 spirit damage to all creatures in a 60- foot line originating from the turret (basic Reflex save).

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d8.

entities.name: Root of all Pain
entities.description:
Your finger pushes a tiny root into the target's body that begins to grow, burrowing through the nervous system as it feeds off the electric signals triggered by the agonizing pain of its intrusive spread. The target attempts a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes 2d8 mental damage the first time each round it performs any action other than an action that is purely mental, such as Recall Knowledge (or other actions as determined by the GM).

**Failure** As success, except the target takes 4d8 mental damage and is Slowed 1 for the duration of the spell.

**Critical Failure** As success, except the target takes 6d8 mental damage and is Slowed 2 for the duration of the spell.

entities.name: Void Scour
entities.description:
A well of desolate darkness scours all life, dealing 10d10 void damage to all living creatures in the area. Each creature in the area must attempt a Reflex save. If void scour overlaps with an area of magical light or affects a creature affected by magical light, void scour attempts to counteract the light effect.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage and @item.rank - 6 d6 persistent,void damage, and becomes Drained 1.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage and @item.rank - 5 d6 persistent,void damage, and becomes Drained 2.

**Heightened (+1)** Increase the initial void damage by 2d10. The persistent void damage increases by 1d6 on a failure, or by 2d6 on critical failure.

entities.name: Wall of Steel
entities.description:
You shape a wall of solid steel. You create a 4-inch-thick wall of steel up to 120 feet long and 20 feet high. You can shape the wall's path, placing each 5 feet of the wall on the border between squares. The wall doesn't need to stand vertically, so you can use it to form a bridge or set of stairs, for example. You must conjure the wall in an unbroken open space so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost.

Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of the wall has AC 10, Hardness 18, and 60 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage. A destroyed section of the wall can be moved through, but the rubble created from it is difficult terrain.

**Heightened (+1)** The Hit Points of each section of the wall increase by 15.

entities.name: Akashic Revival
entities.description:
You dispatch perfect documentation of the target's physical body to the Akashic Record, allowing it to later recall this record and reconstruct its body as it was when you cast this spell. The record includes the target's current Hit Points, augmentations, attribute modifiers, and any afflictions or conditions it had.

If the target dies of anything other than old age, it can recall its recorded body from the Akashic Record. This process takes 1 minute, after which time its corpse disappears, and the target instantly reappears in the recorded body in the corpse's space and with any worn equipment. It re-forms standing and can choose to pick up any equipment it dropped in the space from when it died, assuming the equipment is still there. If it can't occupy that space, it appears as close to the space as possible, though it must still retrieve its equipment. It retains its mind as it was at the time of the body's death, so it regains no expended spells, Focus Points, or uses of special abilities. Any mental effects affecting the target at the time of its death persist in its new body.

Retrieving the body from the Akashic Record or having the duration expire removes the stored information from the Akashic Record, requiring you to cast this spell again.

Casting the spell replaces any previous record you've stored with prior castings—you can store only one copy of any creature in the Akashic Record using this spell.

entities.name: Disappearance
entities.description: You shroud a creature from others' senses. The target becomes Undetected, not just to sight but to all senses, allowing the target to count as Invisible no matter what precise and imprecise senses an observer might have. It's still possible for a creature to find the target by Seeking, looking for disturbed dust, hearing gaps in the sound spectrum, or finding some other way to discover the presence of an otherwise-undetectable creature.

entities.name: Divine Firewall
entities.description:
You fill the space around you with divine flames that protect allies within it and burn away those who mean you harm, especially from unholy and technological threats. You and allies in the area are Concealed. As the nature of this effect still leaves the target's location obvious, the target can't use this concealment to hide or sneak.

Enemies beginning their turn in the area take 10 fire damage, become Glitching 1 if they have the tech trait, and become Off-Guard for 1 round if they have the unholy trait.

entities.name: Flight of the Lightning Bees
entities.description:
**Area** up to 4 non-overlapping 20-foot bursts

Beelike elementals made of pure electricity swarm out of countless portals. When you Cast the Spell and the first time you Sustain the spell each subsequent round, creatures in the area take 6d12 piercing damage and 3d6 persistent,electricity damage and must attempt a Fortitude save. The first time you Sustain the spell each subsequent round, you can also move one of the bursts 15 feet in any direction, though you can't move bursts so they overlap.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage and is Suppressed for 1 round.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage and is suppressed for as long as it takes the persistent damage.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage and is suppressed and Clumsy 2 for as long as it takes the persistent damage.

**Heightened (+1)** The piercing damage increases by 1d12.

entities.name: Gravity Field
entities.description:
Bending the laws of the Universe to your will, you increase the forces of gravity in an area. All flying creatures in the area descend 40 feet. The entire area is greater difficult terrain for Flying and Climbing creatures, and difficult terrain for creatures on the ground. Any creature pulled to the ground by a gravity field takes bludgeoning damage as though it had fallen.

Gravity in the area increases by one step (for example, zero-g becomes low gravity, low gravity becomes standard, standard gravity becomes high gravity, and high gravity becomes extreme gravity).

entities.name: Monstrosity Form
Phantasmal Fleet
entities.description: A menacing vision of a fleet of hostile starships fills the mind of each creature in the area. The ships appear to be 1,000 feet overhead bombarding the ground with laser fire. The vision deals 10d8 mental damage with a basic Will save. On a critical failure, the target also believes it's being pursued and moves to take cover. It must spend an action to Take Cover on each of its turns, which may require it to first move to a new space or Drop Prone. It can attempt a new Will save at the end of each of its turns, and on a success, it disbelieves the phantasm and stops being forced to Take Cover.

entities.name: Singularity Seed
entities.description:
A tiny particle of incredibly dense mass magically blossoms into a gravitational singularity that pulls creatures toward it and spatially compresses any creatures that are moved into it. You create a singularity in a 5-foot square that is unoccupied by any creatures. All creatures and unsecured objects in a 50-foot emanation around the singularity are moved toward the singularity when the spell is cast, depending on their Reflex save (see below). Creatures and objects are moved starting with those closest to the singularity, so they might block the path of other creatures and objects that are pulled in later.

Creatures' spaces can overlap in the square that contains the singularity. A creature or object that enters the singularity or ends its turn there takes 10d10 bludgeoning damage with no saving throw. While in the singularity, a creature can take no actions except to attempt to Escape against your Spell DC. When the spell ends, the singularity disappears, and overlapping creatures are moved to the closest unoccupied space, as determined by the GM.

Squares in the emanation are difficult terrain for creatures moving away from the singularity, and creatures moving toward the singularity can move 10 feet for each 5 feet of movement they spend.

A creature needs to attempt a Reflex save if it's in the area when the spell is cast and when it ends its turn in the area.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is pulled 10 feet toward the singularity.

**Failure** The creature is pulled 20 feet toward the singularity.

**Critical Failure** The creature is pulled 30 feet toward the singularity.

entities.name: Transfer Consciousness
entities.description:
You project your mind into an advanced piece of technology, allowing you to interact with its systems as if they were your own body. The target's level must be equal to or lower than your own. Your own body is helpless and falls Prone as if you were Unconscious. At the end of the spell, your mind returns to your body instantly as long as your body and the target are on the same plane. Otherwise, the spell becomes permanent, and your real body enters a coma.

While your mind is in a computer, for 1 hour, you can roll your spell attack modifier instead of Computers for Computers skill actions related to that system, and you can attempt trained Computers skill actions even if you're untrained.

While your mind is in a construct, you have access to its physical functions, allowing you to control it as if it was your own body for 1 minute. You can use any special actions the construct has access to, though you can't cast its spells, if any. You can cast your own spells using the construct's body.

entities.name: Void Vessel
entities.description:
You grant creatures the ability to survive in a vacuum. Targeted creatures gain the cosmic trait and sprout wings of shimmering energy that grant a fly Speed of 30 feet. The wings function only in a vacuum.

Spell Effect: Void Vessel

Stats.Targets: you and up to 10 willing creatures

entities.name: Atomic Blast
entities.description:
You magically split an atom, creating an explosion with radioactive fallout. All creatures in the area take 5d12 bludgeoning damage and 5d12 fire damage, and they're exposed to extreme radiation that uses your spellcasting DC as the Fortitude DC for radiation sickness incurred by exposure to this radiation. The onset and frequency of this magical radiation is 1 round, and the area remains radioactive for 10 minutes.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected by the initial damage.

**Success** The target takes half damage and is Dazzled for 1 minute.

**Failure** The target takes full damage and is Blinded for 1 minute.

**Critical Failure** As failure, and the target takes double damage.

entities.name: Call Cosmos
entities.description:
You reach into the void and call down a vertical column of dangerous cosmic material that rains destruction upon creatures in the area and shrouds the terrain around it in a swirl of stardust. This matter is made up of bits of burning stars and chunks of frozen comets, and it deals 5d12 cold damage and 5d12 fire damage to every creature in the area when you Cast the Spell. For the spell's duration, the cosmic material reduces visibility and mobility, making the area greater difficult terrain and making everything seen within or through the area Concealed.

**Heightened (10th)** The cold and fire damage each increase by 2d12.

entities.name: Kill Dash Nine
entities.description:
You send a brutal signal interruption straight into the central processor of a technological being. This signal wreaks havoc on the system and leaves behind lasting corruption. The target takes 15d8 mental damage, or electricity damage, if the target is immune to mental damage. Beings that are biomechanical (such as androids) or only partially mechanical (such as cyborgs) uses the outcome for one degree of success better than the result of their saving throw.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage and becomes Glitching 1.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage and becomes Glitching 2 and Stunned 1.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage, becomes Glitching 3 and Stunned 2, and must succeed at a Fortitude save or suffer catastrophic systems failure. This kills any creature reliant on technology to live. This Fortitude save has the death and incapacitation traits.

entities.name: Mycorrhizal Supremacy
entities.description:
You create a network of mind-controlling mycotoxins directly in targets' brains, attempting to seize command and force them to obey you. The first target must attempt a Will save. If it doesn't critically succeed, another target within 30 feet of the first attempts a Will save; if that target doesn't critically succeed, another target within 30 feet of it attempts a Will save, and so on. You can choose to end the spread at any point, and you can't target the same creature more than once. Once the spell has taken effect, you can only focus on one member of the network to control at a time. You can change the target of your focus by Sustaining the spell.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected, and your network can spread no farther.

**Success** The target is Stunned 1 as it fights off your spores.

**Failure** The target joins your mycorrhizal network. It gains the Controlled condition but can act normally unless it's the focus of your control. If it's the focus, it can attempt a Will save at the end of each of its turns. On a success, the target drops out of the network, and your focus automatically shifts to the closest remaining member of the network.

**Critical Failure** As a failure, but the target receives a new save only if you give it a new order that's against its nature, such as killing its allies.

entities.name: Summon Giant Robot
entities.description:
You call forth a titanic robot. The robot occupies the space of a Huge creature, and has a Speed of 80 feet and a fly Speed of 100 feet with the cosmic trait.

**Arrive** *Ultra Cannon Onslaught* (traversal) The robot Strides once in a straight line, trampling enemies underfoot to deal 10d8 bludgeoning |options:area-damage damage (basic Reflex save). It then unleashes a volley of lasers from its chest in a 60-foot cone or 120-foot line, which can't overlap with the area of the its Stride, dealing 10d8 force |options:area-damage damage (basic Reflex save).

**Depart** *Missile Silo* Unleashed The robot fires rockets at up to 8 different creatures up to 120 feet away, dealing 9d8 fire |options:area-damage damage (basic Reflex save).

Stats.Duration: until the end of your next turn

entities.name: Telekinetic Tantrum
entities.description:
You launch a barrage of powerful psychokinetic energy that overpowers creatures, hurls objects, and deals damage. When you Cast this Spell and the first time each round you Sustain the spell, you can choose one of the following effects. You can't choose the same effect twice in a row.

- **Back Off!** You hurl up to 15 objects or creatures up to 40 feet in any direction (including up or down). You can hurl up to a total weight of 40 Bulk per creature or object. Creatures take bludgeoning damage based on the distance they moved and land Prone, as though they'd taken falling damage. Creatures that succeed on a Fortitude save against the spell avoid being moved.
- **Hard Rain** You pummel all creatures in the area with debris and objects in the area, dealing 5d10 bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex save.
- **Psychokinetic Slam** Your psychokinetic storm slams into all creatures in the area. Make a ranged spell attack roll. All targets you hit take 7d6 force damage and are Stunned 1.

entities.name: Android Lore
entities.description:
You have a keen interest in the origins of your people. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Crafting and Thievery. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Android Lore.

entities.name: Emotionless
entities.description: Your inhibited or malfunctioning emotional processors make it difficult for you to feel strong emotions. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion effects. If you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.

entities.name: Memory Recovery
entities.description: You retain instincts and fragmentary memories from the androids who previously occupied your body or from ancient programming embedded in your system. During your daily preparations, you can tap into these archived memories to become trained in one skill of your choice. This proficiency lasts until you prepare again. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a skill increase or a permanent character option like a feat.

entities.name: Quickened Processor
entities.description: You can quickly identify your surroundings, and you can use that information to your advantage while in the midst of danger or while in the process of piloting vehicles in hazardous situations. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks for initiative rolls and a +2 circumstance bonus to Piloting checks for initiative rolls.

entities.name: Synthetic Speech
entities.description: You can cast Speak with Computers once per day as a 4th-rank arcane innate spell.

Stats.Prerequisites: artificial scion android or networked android heritage

entities.name: Memory Matrix
entities.description: You refuse to surrender your autonomy and have erected mental bulwarks and technological protocols to safeguard your mind and memories. Whenever you attempt a Will save against a spell or effect that would give you the Confused or Controlled condition, roll that save twice and use the higher result (this is a fortune effect). If you would start your turn confused or controlled, you can immediately attempt a DC 5. On a success, you fight that mental control, becoming Paralyzed until the end of your turn rather than acting against your will. If you roll a 20 on this flat check, you immediately end the confused or controlled condition.

entities.name: Nanite Form
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You change into a swarm of nanites for up to 1 minute or until you spend a single action to return to your normal shape. You become Huge, gain the swarm trait, and gain a fly Speed of 40 feet. As a swarm, you have the following characteristics.

- You're immune to the Grabbed, Prone, and Restrained conditions.
- You have weakness 5 to area and splash damage.
- You can occupy the same space as other creatures and must do so to use your damaging ability.
- As a 2-action activity, you can deal 10d6 acid damage to all creatures sharing your space (basic Reflex save with a DC equal to your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher).
- You can't speak, Cast Spells, use manipulate actions requiring your hands, Activate magic items, or make any Strikes with your normal body.
- You don't gain the swarm mind ability, so you're still affected normally by mental effects.

entities.name: Machine Saboteur
entities.description: You were created to fight other synthetic creatures. When you roll a critical hit against a creature with the tech trait, the target becomes glitching 1.

entities.name: Repair Module
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You trigger your body's self-repair programming, stimulating your body's nanites to heal your wounds. You gain fast healing equal to half your level for 1 minute. While Repair Module is active, if you use Nanite Surge or Nanite Form, this fast healing ends.

entities.name: Adaptable Limbs
entities.description: You grow sturdy lower limbs that allow you to walk on land. Increase your Speed to 20 feet. Additionally, you gain the Adaptive Locomotion action.

entities.name: Barathu Lore
entities.description:
From your upbringing, you've learned the ways of your people while also seeking to expand your own mind in the fields of creation. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Crafting and Medicine. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Barathu Lore.

entities.name: Darkvision Adaptation
entities.description: You've explored the darkest regions of space and found ways to adapt. You gain darkvision.

entities.name: Dermal Spikes
entities.description: Spiky protrusions jut from your body, which you can use to wound your attackers. Your Fortitude DC against Athletics checks to Grapple or Shove you increases by 1. Additionally, you gain the Piercing Spikes reaction.

entities.name: Grasping Tendrils
entities.description:
You've adapted more of your tendrils and limbs with complex musculature and cellular structures, improving articulation and fine motor skills. Increase your number of arms by two. At any time, one pair of your hands is designated as your active hands. You can change this designation from one pair of hands to another by taking the Switch Hands action, which is a single action. You can only wield items with your active hands.

**Special** You can take this feat multiple times.

entities.name: Metabolic Manipulation
entities.description: Through careful experimentation and selective adaptation, you've manipulated your immune system and internal chemistry to better fight off illness and infection. You gain the Fast Recovery skill feat and the Targeted Immunization action.

entities.name: Tentacle Whip
entities.description: You grow a tentacle that can lash out like a whip. You gain a tentacle unarmed attack that deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage. Your tentacle is in the brawling weapon group and has the barathu, finesse, reach, and unarmed traits.

entities.name: Corrosive Venting
entities.description: You can control causticity as you vent your gases. When you Vent Gas, increase the area of your emanation to 10 feet. You can choose to make the gas you vent caustic. If you do, any non-barathu creature that enters the emanation or starts its turn in the area takes 3d6 acid damage, with a  save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. On a critical failure, a creature additionally takes 1d4 persistent,acid damage. At 17th level, the acid damage increases by 2d6, and the persistent acid damage increases by 1d4.

entities.name: Internal Chemistry
entities.description: You tweak your anatomy and bodily systems to metabolize pharmaceuticals more efficiently. Regain additional Hit Points equal to half your level when you restore Hit Points to yourself using a consumable item with the healing trait.

entities.name: Combine
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You temporarily merge your body with that of an adjacent willing creature, overlaying yourself atop them to better shield them from harm. This transformation lasts for 10 minutes. You can Dismiss this effect. When you do, you emerge in a space adjacent to the target you merged with. While combined, you and your target each take your own turns as normal and must be targeted separately for the purposes of abilities and other effects. Additionally, you and your target gain the following benefits.

- If the target is Medium or smaller, their size increases to Large and their reach increases to 10 feet.
- You occupy the target's space and can't take actions with the move trait. If the target moves, you move with them.
- For each Speed you possess, compare it to that of your target. If your Speed is faster, or they lack that Speed, they gain your Speed.
- Your body shields the target from harm, granting them greater cover, though you don't gain cover. Your body doesn't obscure the target's vision or block line of sight.

entities.name: Manifold Evolution
entities.description: You've cataloged the genetic code from countless ancestries you've encountered, and you can draw upon any of them to enhance and evolve your body. Increase the number of ancestries you can select with Convergent Evolution to six. You gain two additional ancestry feats you qualify for of 13th level or lower, chosen from among the ancestries selected with Convergent Evolution. You can retrain one or both of these selected feats once per day during your daily preparations.

entities.name: Fluid Anatomy
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

**Trigger** An enemy scores a critical hit against you with a Strike.

Your anatomy adjusts to distribute damage from vital areas. The triggering attack deals only the damage it would deal on a hit (typically normal damage instead of double damage). Any other effects of the attack caused by a critical hit still occur, such as critical specializations effects. Until the beginning of your next turn, you're Off-Guard against the triggering enemy.

entities.name: Molecular Modification
entities.description:
You modify your body's genetics to resist certain damage types. You gain resistance to acid, bludgeoning, cold, electricity, fire, piercing, poison, slashing, or sonic damage equal to half your level.

**Special** You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, select a different damage type.

entities.name: Vent Gas
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

You vent gas to propel yourself forward. All squares in a 5-foot emanation become filled with gas. All creatures in the gas become Concealed, and all creatures outside the gas become concealed to creatures within it. This gas disperses at the beginning of your next turn.

You gain a +10-foot circumstance bonus to all your Speeds until the start of your next turn. Then you Stride.

entities.name: Convergent Evolution
entities.description: You sample the genetics of creatures and people you've made contact with and mimic them. When you take this feat, select up to three different ancestries with which you've had significant contact. You can select ancestry feats from the ancestries you chose, in addition to barathu ancestry feats. Additionally, you gain one ancestry feat you qualify for of 5th level or lower from one of the selected ancestries. You can retrain the selected feat once per day during your daily preparations.

entities.name: Expansive Verse
entities.description: Your songs become more complex and tinged with greater magic. Each day during your daily preparations, you can choose one common 2nd-rank spell from the occult spell list. You can cast this spell as an occult innate spell once before your next daily preparations.

entities.name: Baleful Gaze
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per minute

You have an ominous presence that unnerves the living. You have learned to harness this sinister aura to your own advantage and can scare your foes with a focused glance. Focus your ill intent at one living creature within 30 feet. The target must succeed at a DC resolve(@actor.system.attributes.classOrSpellDC.value) Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC, or become Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure) and Stupefied 1 as long as it's frightened. Once you've used Baleful Gaze against a creature, it's temporarily immune for 24 hours.

Stats.Traits: borai, concentrate, emotion, fear, mental, visual

entities.name: Borai Lore
entities.description:
Since your resurrection, you've learned a lot about yourself, your place in the cycle of souls, and other undead. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Intimidation and Religion. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Borai Lore.

entities.name: Death-Touched Caster
entities.description:
You exist on the boundaries between life and death, and you can channel your own imbalanced spiritual essence into magical spells. Choose one of the following cantrips: Vitality Lash or Void Warp. You can cast this spell as a divine innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

**Special** You can select this feat twice. Each time, you must select a different cantrip.

entities.name: Etheric
entities.description: You became a borai through a botched resurrection attempt—perhaps a magic spell was disrupted, a religious rite went awry, or faulty technology went haywire, resulting in your condition. Your soul is loosely tethered to your body, allowing you to temporarily shield your living form from the ravages of the void. You gain the Soul Shield reaction.

entities.name: Headstrong
entities.description: You became a borai through your own stubborn willfulness. When you died, you refused to accept your death and clung to your corpse, forcing your soul back into your body and regaining life along with it. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saving throws against fear and effects that would make you Confused or Controlled and to your Will DC against attempts to Demoralize you.

entities.name: Necrotized
entities.description: You became a borai intentionally through necromantic experimentation conducted by yourself or someone else before you died. This experimentation has strengthened your defenses against death but has also made you look more like a corpse than a living being. You gain the Diehard feat, and death effects no longer kill you if they reduce you to 0 Hit Points. This keeps you from being automatically killed or from having your dying value automatically decrease, but it doesn't make you immune to other parts of the spell or effect. For example, you can still take mental damage and become frightened by a vision of death spell, you just don't instantly die from it.

entities.name: Only Slightly Dead
entities.description: Your living body is flush with vitality, which easily hides your ichor-filled veins from sight. You don't have to attempt Deception checks against a creature's Perception DC to successfully Impersonate yourself as a living member of your ancestry or hide your borai heritage, nor do you require a disguise kit for such Impersonations. This is a non-magical effect that doesn't protect against detection, revelation, or scrying effects. Additionally, when a creature actively attempts a Perception check against you, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to your Deception DC, but only for the purposes of seeing through your disguise when you're Impersonating yourself as a living member of your ancestry or otherwise attempting to hide your borai heritage.

entities.name: Intuitive Talent
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

You enjoy embracing new experiences and have a knack for picking up new skills and talents, sometimes over the course of countless lifetimes, as your semi-dead nature grants you a wider perspective. Choose a skill that you're untrained in. Until the beginning of your next turn, you become trained in the chosen skill.

entities.name: Stubborn Corpse
entities.description: You're willful and stubborn, and you refuse to accept your own failure—traits that have served you well in life and after death. When you critically fail a saving throw against a mental effect, you get a failure instead. Additionally, you gain the Deny Failure reaction.

entities.name: Baleful Presence
entities.description: You've learned to unleash the anger and malice you've built up over the course of your life and restless undeath against multiple foes at once, creating a potent effect around yourself. You can choose to use Baleful Gaze as a 2-action activity, rather than 1. When you do, Baleful Gaze gains the divine trait, loses the visual trait, and affects each living creature in a 30-foot emanation, rather than a single living creature.

entities.name: Undying
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

**Trigger** You have the dying condition and are about to attempt a recovery check.

You have died once before and have no intention of dying ever again; your soul stubbornly resuscitates your body when you would otherwise perish. You are restored to 1 Hit Point, lose the dying and Unconscious conditions, and can act normally on this turn. You increase your wounded condition as normal.

entities.name: Deathly Constitution
entities.description: Thanks to your life-altering brush with death, your living body is better protected against the weaknesses of the flesh. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against disease and poison.

entities.name: Soul Sustenance
entities.description: Your soul is radiant and can sustain your living body indefinitely, without the need for outside nourishment. You don't need to eat or drink, and you count your Constitution modifier as one higher while determining how much you heal from resting.

entities.name: Unliving Memories
entities.description: Some element of your borai nature gives you flashes from the beyond: visions from the afterlife you were intended for or might still one day obtain. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Religion. If you're already trained in Religion, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the Additional Lore feat for a Lore subcategory about a specific plane tied to your afterlife (such as Heaven, Hell, Nirvana, or Outer Rifts Lore).

entities.name: Void Blood
entities.description: The ichor pulsing through your veins is infused with void energy, and it protects your body and soul from the same sinister power. You have void resistance equal to half your level.

entities.name: Resonant Weapon
entities.description: You release a pulse of spiritual energy into one weapon you're holding, making it resonate with immaterial soul stuff. Until the beginning of your next turn, your weapon gains the effects of the ghost killer weapon fusion. At 17th level, it deals an additional 1d6 spirit damage.

entities.name: Shroud of Shattered Spirits
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** An enemy's Strike or targeted effect would hit you, and you weren't already Concealed, Hidden, or undetected to that enemy.

Your mere presence attracts restless spirits, haunted objects, spiritually active substances, and fragmented souls, like a magnet attracts metal. You manifest these spirit shards in a chaotic whirlwind around you that you barely control with your thoughts. You become concealed until the beginning of your next turn, and the flat check for concealment applies to the triggering Strike or effect that would've hit you. If the flat check fails, the Strike or effect misses you.

entities.name: Unleash Pneuma
entities.description:
You unleash a portion of your spiritual essence—either the vitality of your living body or the void of your undead soul—in a violent burst around you. You deal 5d6 untyped damage of your selected type (see below) to all adjacent creatures (basic Reflex save using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher). At 11th level and every 2 levels thereafter, this damage increases by 1d6.

When you take this feat, choose either vitality or void. Once chosen, this selection can't be changed. Unleash Pneuma deals the chosen damage type and gains the chosen trait.

**Special** You can take this feat twice, but you must select a different damage type each time. If you do, Unleash Pneuma's frequency becomes once per day per damage type, rather than once per day.

entities.name: Adaptive Visual Receptors
entities.description:
Whether working as a spy or just tired of losing your comm unit at night, your optical receptors have been upgraded to see in poor lighting conditions. You gain low-light vision. If you already have low-light vision, you instead gain darkvision.

**Special** You can take this feat twice.

entities.name: Enhanced Olfactory System
entities.description:
Your olfactory system has been enhanced with a more powerful and precise sense of smell. You gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet. This means you can use your sense of smell to determine a creature's location. The GM will usually double the range if you're downwind from the creature or halve the range if you're upwind.

In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to seek a creature or object within the range of your scent.

entities.name: EVA Module
entities.description: Your frame is better equipped to deal with the vacuum of space, making you an ideal starship pilot or space explorer. You aren't clumsy while Untethered. In addition, you gain the cosmic trait, meaning you don't need to breathe while in space or a vacuum and are immune to the harmful environmental effects of being in space.

entities.name: GG-OS Frame
entities.description: The GG-OS frames were designed for military and corporate espionage applications, yet cyborgs in the seedier parts of society naturally gravitate to these builds as well. A few of these cyborgs find their way into athletic competitions. Your augmentations are sleek and subtle, and your frame is inherently faster than most other frames due to the lightweight materials used in its construction. You gain the Fleet general feat.

entities.name: Skill Download
entities.description:
You can temporarily download additional skills from the infosphere or an external memory unit. During your daily preparations, you become trained in one skill of your choice. This proficiency lasts until you prepare again. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a skill increase or a permanent character option like a feat.

At 9th level, you become an expert in the chosen skill. At 17th level, you instead become a master in the chosen skill.

entities.name: Subtle Cyborg
entities.description: Your augmentations are hidden under sheets of lab-grown flesh or synthetic alternatives, enabling you to pass as an unaugmented being without arousing suspicion. You become trained in Deception. If you're already trained in Deception (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. In addition, creatures perceive you as an unaugmented member of your ancestry and don't realize you're a cyborg or you have the tech trait. A creature that succeeds at a Perception check to seek dc=deception against your Deception DC notices the tech, but unless they get a critical success or are specifically looking for a cyborg, they are likely to assume you simply have augmentations.

entities.name: Thresher KO-1 Frame
entities.description:
Thresher models were developed with durability in mind and are built to be rugged, powerful, and festooned with defensive attachments. Your frame might have been constructed for combat, salvage, recovery operations, or heavy construction. Your sturdier design elements allow you a measure of protection not found in other frames. You treat your Strength modifier as 2 higher for the purposes of meeting the Strength requirements of armor.

In addition, you gain an integrated commercial dermal plating augmentation that doesn't count against your total implant limit and doesn't cost you any credits. You can improve the grade of this augmentation as normal by paying the difference in credits between its current grade and the intended grade.

entities.name: X-Hat Firewalker Frame
entities.description: The X-Hat frame's encrypted blueprints were anonymously published on the infosphere for the keen-eyed to decipher and alter. A handful of infosphere sleuths traced various parts of its design to organizations that peddle in digital espionage. You become trained in Computers. If you would automatically become trained in Computers (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the Phreaker skill feat.

entities.name: Dense Weave Musculature
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

**Trigger** You fail an Acrobatics check, Athletics check, or Reflex save.

Many of your muscles have been replaced with a densely woven fiber empowered by nanites, and you can push these muscles to function well beyond their usual limits in your moment of need. Reroll the triggering check or save, and use the better result.

entities.name: Flying Rocket Punch
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

You reroute power to your limbs to launch yourself through the air like a rocket. You leap to an unoccupied space of your choice within 60 feet. When you land, all adjacent spaces become difficult terrain as your impact shatters the ground, and you can make a melee Strike against a creature of your choice within reach. On a hit, the target is additionally knocked Prone by the force of your blow.

entities.name: Secondary Power Source
entities.description: You can draw energy from other parts of your body to power your limited use augmentations. During your daily preparations, select up to two augmentations installed in your body that have an activation frequency of once per day. Until your next daily preparations, increase the frequency of the selected augmentations to twice per day.

entities.name: Fire Crystal Beam
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You activate a magitech crystal integrated in your body, causing it to shoot a 120-foot-long line of otherworldly energy that tears the fabric of space and time. You deal 10d6 force damage to creatures in the line. Each creature in the area must attempt a  save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage, and you teleport the creature up to 15 feet into an unoccupied space of your choice along the line's area.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage, and you teleport the creature up to 30 feet into an unoccupied space of your choice along the line's area.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage, becomes Stunned 1, and you teleport the creature to any unoccupied space of your choice along the line's area.

entities.name: Machine Heart
entities.description: You've replaced or augmented nearly your entire body, becoming one with your artificial components and crossing the threshold of true cybergenesis. You cease aging, and you no longer need to sleep, eat, drink, or breathe. The first time each day that you would die, you don't. Instead, your body automatically resuscitates itself; you regain a number of Hit Points equal to your level, and you don't increase the value of your wounded condition due to losing the dying condition.

entities.name: Mortal Heart
entities.description: Despite the cybernetics, you are still very much a living being and within your soul beats the indomitable spirit of mortality that lets you exceed the limits of both flesh and steel. Once per day you can cast Moment of Renewal as an 8th-rank primal innate spell, targeting up to 6 living creatures within 100 feet who can hear the primal bellow affirming the nature of your heart and soul, including yourself.

entities.name: Data Retrieval
entities.description: You can use your internal uplink to swiftly augment your own mind and memory by rapidly accessing databases. You gain the Open-Source Research skill feat. Your Open-Source Research has a frequency of once per 10 minutes, rather than once per hour.

entities.name: Deflective Plating
entities.description: Your body is coated in microscopic plates specially treated to resist a specific kind of damage. You gain resistance equal to half your level to one damage type of your choice from the following options: acid, bludgeoning, cold, electricity, fire, piercing, slashing, or sonic.

entities.name: Hardpoint
entities.description:
Your body has a hardpoint, hidden away in an internal compartment within one of your arms, that can hold one weapon. You gain a tactical hideaway limb for free that doesn't count against your total implant limit, except it can only hold one weapon, and this weapon must be a one-handed weapon of light Bulk or less. When you Draw this weapon, the weapon drawn is integrated into your body and can't be disarmed, dropped, or stolen. These effects last until you stow the weapon in the hideaway compartment.

**Special** If you have the Thresher KO-1 Frame lineage feat, the weapon can instead be a one-handed weapon of 1 Bulk or less.

entities.name: Hydraulic Pistons
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per round

Your limbs are fitted with advanced hydraulic pistons to increase their power, allowing you to exert more force using your arms, legs, and other appendages. You gain the Quick Jump skill feat, even if you don't meet its prerequisites. In addition, your fist gains the boost d4 and tech traits, and you don't take the normal –2 circumstance penalty when making a lethal attack with your fist. When you get a critical hit with your fist, you gain the critical specialization effects of unarmed attacks.

entities.name: Shroud in Static
entities.description:
**Trigger** You impose the glitching condition on a tech creature, hazard, or tech equipment with a camera.

You know how to use technological glitches and malfunctions to your advantage to disguise your presence. You become Concealed to the triggering creature, hazard, or creatures using the glitching tech item to perceive you as long as it has the glitching condition.

**Special** If you have the X-Hat Firewalker Frame lineage feat, you become Invisible, rather than concealed.

entities.name: Biotech Os Upgrade
entities.description: Through a comprehensive upgrade to your frame's operating system, your cybernetic components have been systematically replaced with biotech components cloned from your own genetic markers. You lose the tech trait and gain the biotech trait. All cybernetic augmentations you've installed in your body, and that you install in yourself in the future, lose the tech trait and gain the biotech trait.

entities.name: Sensor Mask
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You activate a sensor mask program installed in your body that distorts digital recordings of you. Select one of the following effects.

- You become the target of a 3rd-rank Illusory Disguise spell, except the *illusory disguise* is only visible to tech creatures, tech hazards, and tech visual sensors and recording devices (such as security cameras).

- You become Concealed to tech creatures, tech hazards, and tech visual sensors and recording devices (such as security cameras) for 10 minutes. You can't use this concealment to hide or sneak.

entities.name: Uncanny Dash
entities.description:
1 to 2

**Frequency** once per hour

You move at incredible speeds, covering great distances in the blink of an eye thanks to your mostly mechanical body. Stride twice. You can increase the number of actions this activity takes to 2 to instead Stride up to four times.

**Special** If you have the GG-OS Frame lineage feat, you additionally gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speeds for the duration of Uncanny Dash.

entities.name: Adapted Augmentations
entities.description: You embrace ultimate adaptation by integrating cutting-edge augmentations into your body. Choose one common augmentation with an item level of 1 or less. You begin with this augmentation already installed in your body (you don't need to pay the credits to purchase this starting augmentation). This augmentation doesn't count toward your implant limit.

entities.name: Inner Wellspring
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

When you must endure times of extreme stress and pain, you dig deep and draw on the memories or stories of your lost ancestral home world of Golarion, tapping into inner reserves of power to pull off just one more miracle. You regain 1 Focus Point.

entities.name: Persistent Confidence
entities.description: You always believe in yourself. You can use Confident Actualization once per hour, rather than once per day.

entities.name: Too Stubborn to Die
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You would die.

You return from the brink of death, hauling yourself back to consciousness through exhaustion and pain. If you have the dying or Unconscious conditions, you lose the dying and unconscious conditions. If you're at 0 Hit Points, you have 1 Hit Point. Increase the value of your wounded and doomed conditions by 1. You can use this reaction while unconscious.

entities.name: Confident Actualization
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You're about to attempt a saving throw or skill check.

Your utter confidence in your own abilities helps you push yourself to reach your desired goals. Roll the triggering check or save twice and use the better result.

entities.name: Multitalented
entities.description: You've learned to split your focus between multiple classes with ease. You gain a 2nd-level multiclass dedication feat, even if you normally couldn't take another dedication feat until you take more feats from your current archetype.

entities.name: Calm Before the Storm
entities.description: You maintain a calm demeanor even when facing mortal peril. When frightened, at the end of your turn, reduce your frightened condition by 2 instead of 1.

entities.name: Crew Member
entities.description:
**Trigger** An ally within 30 feet attempts to Aid and rolls a failure.

You're always able to help in a pinch. Attempt a skill check or attack roll of the same type attempted by your ally and replace the result of the failed Aid with your result, even if you didn't prepare to help.

entities.name: Kasatha Lore
entities.description:
You've studied the kasathan traditions of balance and harmony. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Diplomacy and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Kasatha Lore.

entities.name: Kasathan Weapon Familiarity
entities.description:
You have a respect for melee combat, and you've trained to wield a few more elegant examples in battle. You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the kasatha trait. You have familiarity with weapons with the kasatha trait plus the dueling sword, plasma sword, shock truncheon, and singing spear—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

entities.name: Natural Grace
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You fail an Acrobatics check or Reflex saving throw.

You have an almost supernatural control of your movements, which can sometimes save you in dangerous situations. You can reroll the triggering skill check or saving throw, using the second result even if it's worse.

entities.name: Disciple of the Cycle
entities.description: While it pales in comparison to the powers of a true solarian, you are a devoted disciple of the Cycle and can temporarily manifest control over the powers of the cosmos. You gain Entropy Strike and Skyfire Wings as 3rd-rank occult innate spells. You can cast each of these occult innate spells once per day.

entities.name: Perfectly Balanced
entities.description: You've come closer to finding balance between two extremes of energy, learning how to expel or draw in excess heat when necessary. You gain resistance 5 to cold and fire. Additionally, you gain the Redirect Energy reaction.

entities.name: Cleanse Spirit
entities.description: Through your knowledge of traditional kasathan healing rituals and meditative practices, you've learned to cleanse the body and mind of the ill or troubled. You gain Cleanse Affliction and Sound Body as 4th-rank occult innate spells. You can cast each of these occult innate spells once per day.

entities.name: Reliable Grace
entities.description: You have exceptional control over your body. You can use Natural Grace once per hour, rather than once per day.

entities.name: Historian
entities.description: You become trained in a Lore skill of your choice. You can spend 10 minutes checking your notes or research materials to Recall Knowledge about a piece of history with any Lore skill in which you aren't trained, using your highest Lore skill modifier instead of your modifier with that skill.

entities.name: Kasatha Weapon Elegance
entities.description:
You've learned how to adapt your martial expertise to wield other weapons. When wielding a weapon you aren't proficient with, treat your level as your proficiency bonus.

At 11th level, you become trained in all weapons.

entities.name: Masked
entities.description: Your masked face prevents others from scrutinizing your appearance, and you've learned to leverage this uncertainty to your advantage in social situations. While your mouth is covered, increase the DC of any Perception check to Sense Motive against you by 2. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Lie, make a Request, or Make an Impression.

entities.name: History Buff
entities.description: You've cataloged countless customs, histories, and traditions. You can cast hypercognition once per day as a 3rd-rank occult innate spell. You can use your modifier for the Lore skill you chose for Historian in place of any other skill modifier when attempting a Recall Knowledge check while casting Hypercognition.

entities.name: Uncanny Awareness
entities.description: You are in tune with your surroundings and can instinctively sense when danger is near. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks for initiative rolls. If your initiative roll result is tied with that of an opponent, you go first, regardless of whether you rolled Perception or not. The first time each day that you roll Perception for initiative, you roll initiative twice and use the higher result.

entities.name: Alluring Pheromones
entities.description: You influence others with pheromones, even when you lack other means of communication. You can use Diplomacy to Make an Impression on creatures with whom you don't share a language and to make simple Requests of them. This could include getting directions or getting the target to pick a specific individual out from a crowd. When you do, Make an Impression and Request lose the linguistic trait and gain the olfactory trait.

entities.name: Center Thoughts
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You fail a Will saving throw against a mental effect.

You center your thoughts and focus your mind, shaking off emotional turmoil and harmful mental intrusions. Reroll the triggering saving throw and use the better result.

entities.name: Commanding Pheromones
entities.description: You can leverage your alluring pheromones to soothe ill will and take the edge off your threats, turning your attempts at coercion into acts of leadership. When you Coerce a creature, if your target would become unfriendly (and they aren't already unfriendly or hostile), they become indifferent instead.

entities.name: Lashunta Lore
entities.description:
You've studied the lives and achievements of other lashuntas who have improved both their psychic powers and their communities. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Occultism and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Lashunta Lore.

entities.name: Focus Pheromones
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

You can purposefully deploy your pheromones to manipulate the reactions of those around you. If your next action is to attempt a Deception check to Create a Diversion, a Diplomacy check to Request, or an Intimidation check to Demoralize, roll that skill check twice and use the better result.

entities.name: Psychic Investigator
entities.description: You can use your telepathic abilities to quickly assess your circumstances or subtly glean information from the minds of others. You can cast Hypercognition and Mind Reading as 3rd-rank occult innate spells. You can cast each of these occult innate spells once per day.

Stats.Prerequisites: Psychic Bully, Psychic Scholar, or Psychic Talent

entities.name: Centered Mind
entities.description: You know your own mind and instinctively resist attempts to unbalance your thoughts or control your emotions. You can use Center Thoughts once per hour, rather than once per day.

entities.name: Mental Deflection
entities.description:
**Trigger** A creature Casts a Spell with the mental trait.

**Requirements** You have at least 1 Focus Point.

When a foe Casts a Spell that has the mental trait and you can see or otherwise detect its manifestations, you use your psychic powers to disrupt it. You expend 1 Focus Point to counter the triggering creature's casting of the spell. You then attempt to counteract the triggering spell using your spellcasting attribute modifier plus your spellcasting proficiency bonus as your counteract modifier and half your level, rounded up, as your counteract rank.

entities.name: Psychic Paragon
entities.description: Your psychic abilities have grown stronger. Choose one common 6th-rank spell from the occult spell list. You can cast that spell as an occult innate spell once per day.

entities.name: Psychic Bully
entities.description: You can leverage your telepathic abilities to influence the minds of others, imparting orders or inflaming fears. You can cast Command and Fear as 1st-rank occult innate spells. You can cast each of these occult innate spells once per day.

Stats.Prerequisites: korasha lashunta or unbound lashunta heritage

entities.name: Psychic Scholar
entities.description: You can transfer vast amounts of information to the minds of others in mere moments. You can cast Mindlink as a 1st-rank occult innate spell twice per day.

Stats.Prerequisites: Damaya Lashunta or Unbound Lashunta heritage

entities.name: Sensitive Antennae
entities.description:
Your antennae are covered in fine hairs that make them more sensitive to psychic vibrations than most. You gain thoughtsense as a vague sense with a range of 30 feet. This means you can use your antennae to determine if a creature is within range. Your thoughtsense detects only thinking creatures, so a creature that's unthinking or otherwise immune to mental effects can't be perceived using your thoughtsense. This doesn't give you the ability to read or understand their thoughts.

At 9th level, this becomes an imprecise sense.

entities.name: Guarded Thoughts
entities.description: Your psychic training allows you to block attempts to read your thoughts. Any effect that specifically attempts to read your mind to glean information must succeed at a counteract check against the higher of your class DC or your spell DC to do so successfully; otherwise, it gains no information. The counteract rank is equal to half your level rounded up.

entities.name: Psychic Mastery
entities.description: Your psychic abilities have grown stronger, allowing you to tap into entirely new dimensions of psychic power. Choose one common 2nd-rank spell from the occult spell list. You can cast that spell as an occult innate spell once per day.

entities.name: Aerial Hologram
entities.description:
Your core can levitate, enabling your hardlight body to fly. You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed. When you Disable Hardlight Projector, your core hovers in place 3 feet above the ground, rather than falling to the ground.

**Special** If you're a hover ad living hologram, you instead gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed + 10 feet.

entities.name: Emoticon Slinger
entities.description: You've tapped into the captivating magical power of emoji. You can cast *emoticon* as an occult innate cantrip at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

entities.name: Hardlight Refraction
entities.description:
You've installed an algorithm that uses a refraction of your hardlight to allow you to see in the absence of any other light. You gain low-light vision.

**Special** You can take this feat a second time. When you do, you gain darkvision.

entities.name: Hardlight Weapon
entities.description:
You have a unique weapon integrated into your hardlight body, perhaps a bladed arm, a shoulder-mounted cryo cannon, or a kiss attack that fires sparkling cartoon hearts. When you select this feat, you gain one of the following unarmed attacks of your choice. Each of these attacks has the unarmed trait.

- A melee unarmed attack that deals 1d8 damage.

- A melee unarmed attack that deals 1d6 damage and has the agile and finesse traits.

- A ranged unarmed attack that deals 1d6 damage and has a range increment of 30 feet.

- A ranged unarmed attack that deals 1d4 damage and has a range increment of 60 feet.

Once you make this decision, select the type of damage your weapon deals and an associated weapon group from among the following options: acid (corrosive weapon group), bludgeoning (brawling, club, or hammer weapon group), cold (cryo weapon group), electricity (shock weapon group), fire (flame or laser weapon group), piercing (brawling, knife, or spear weapon group), slashing (brawling, knife, or sword weapon group), or sonic (sonic weapon group).

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with your hardlight weapon, you get its critical specialization effect.

entities.name: Plugged In
entities.description: You're perpetually online, surfing the infosphere, chatting with friends, and scrolling your social feeds. Your core has an integrated comm unit you can operate by thought alone, even making calls without audibly speaking. At 5th level, this functions as a Commercial Hacker's Toolkit and an Advanced Hacker's Toolkit at 8th level. This doesn't count as an augmentation and is immune to the glitching condition.

entities.name: Reprogram Appearance
entities.description: You reprogram the appearance of your hardlight body over the course of 10 minutes. As part of this activity, you can change your size to one of the following of your choice: Small, Medium, or Large. You maintain this size and appearance until you next Reprogram Appearance.

Stats.Prerequisites: You aren’t an aeonheart living hologram.

entities.name: Roly-Polygon
entities.description: You can roll your core around with surprising mobility, allowing you to move without a projected body. Add Step and Stride to the list of actions you can take while you aren't projecting your hardlight body.

entities.name: Shielded Projection
entities.description: Your hardlight projectors are adjusted to provide you with flexible defensive capabilities. You can cast Shield as an arcane innate cantrip at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

entities.name: Activate Repair Mode
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You've added automated repair subroutines to your core in case of extreme damage. You Disable Hardlight Projector and gain fast healing 10 for 1 minute or until you Project Hardlight Body, whichever happens first.

entities.name: Blinding Light
entities.description: Instead of directing your hardlight at a single foe, you cause it to flash impossibly bright all around you. Whenever you use Trick of the Light, you can choose to have it affect every creature in a 15-foot emanation rather than a single target.

entities.name: Hotkey
entities.description:
You've got a favored routine you perform repeatedly and have learned how to do so efficiently without risk. Select one of the following actions: Anti-Glitch Response, Let Me Hear You Cheer, or Light Hop. The frequency of the selected action becomes once per 10 minutes, rather than once per day.

**Special** You can take this feat more than once, selecting a different action each time.

Stats.Prerequisites: Anti-Glitch Response, Light Hop, or mascot living hologram heritage

entities.name: Fast Forward
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You overclock your core and its movement subroutines to move so fast that everything else seems to slow down. For 1 minute, you gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speeds, and you become Quickened. You can use the extra action each round only to Stride.

**Special** If you have the Light Hop feat, you can use the extra action gained from Fast Forward to Light Hop or Stride; when you Light Hop in this way, it doesn't count toward Light Hop's frequency.

entities.name: See Light Through You
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

As a living hologram, you know how to blend in with other forms of light and how light can be used to your advantage to distract or misdirect those who aren't as experienced manipulating light. These lived experiences have made you aware of the little clues that can give away the position of someone trying to avoid notice. You heighten your senses, gaining the effects of a Truesight spell.

entities.name: Anti-Glitch Response
entities.description:
