**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You fail or critically fail a flat check you attempted due to the glitching condition.

After much trial and error, you've programmed your core to diagnose and repair glitching systems. Reroll the triggering flat check, and use the better result.

entities.name: Extra Stretchy
entities.description:
You can stretch your arms extra far! When you Cartoonish Stretch, you increase your reach by 10 feet, rather than 5 feet.

**Special** You can take this feat three times. The second time you do, you increase your reach by 15 feet when you Cartoonish Stretch, rather than 5 feet. The third time you do, you increase your reach by 20 feet when you Cartoonish Stretch, rather than 5 feet.

entities.name: Light Hop
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

For the briefest of moments, you're able to move as a beam of light. You teleport yourself (and any items you're wearing and holding) to an unoccupied space you can see within 60 feet.

entities.name: Realistic Appearance
entities.description:
Your core projects incredibly lifelike holograms. Your holographic body is no longer semi-translucent and doesn't look like a hologram.

**Special** If you have the Reprogram Appearance feat, you don't require a holoskin to Impersonate, and if you critically fail a Deception check to Impersonate, you get a failure instead.

entities.name: Trick of the Light
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

You redirect some of your hardlight at a creature's eyes in an attempt to dazzle them. One creature of your choice within 30 feet must attempt a  save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

**Failure** The creature is Dazzled for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** The creature is dazzled for 3 rounds.

entities.name: Troubleshooting Core
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

Your integrated toolkit repairs a touched common tech item with a level up to your level with the broken or glitching condition. It loses the broken condition until the end of your turn, allowing you to use the item as normal. You also reduce the glitching value of the item you touch by 1.

entities.name: 2D in a 3D World
entities.description:
**Frequency** three times per day

**Trigger** You fail a Reflex saving throw.

You take advantage of your hardlight body's malleability and shape by turning sideways or flattening your body in an attempt to avoid incoming danger. You reroll the triggering save and use the better result.

entities.name: Additional Limbs
entities.description:
You've improved your core's manipulation routines, enabling more of your holographic limbs to function. Your hardlight body gains one additional pair of arms.

**Special** You can take this feat multiple times, gaining one additional pair of arms each time.

entities.name: Hide in Plain Light
entities.description: You take advantage of your hardlight body by bending light around your core to hide in plain sight. You can cast Invisibility twice per day as a 2nd-rank arcane innate spell.

entities.name: Zoom In, Zoom Out
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per round

You swiftly change size, becoming Small, Medium, or Large. If you became smaller, you can Create a Distraction or hide as part of this action. If you became larger, you can demoralize as part of this action. You remain this size until you next Reprogram Appearance or Zoom In, Zoom Out.

entities.name: Competitive Spirit
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

**Trigger** An ally attempts a skill check with a skill that you have trained or better proficiency rank in.

You push yourself to be the best by competing with the triggering ally. Until the end of your next turn, you can attempt the same skill check to perform the same action or activity that the triggering ally performed. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this skill check. If you achieve at least one degree of success higher than the triggering ally, this use of Competitive Spirit doesn't count toward its frequency. If you roll a critical failure on this skill check, you take a –1 circumstance penalty to all skill checks attempted with that skill for the next hour as you try new techniques to improve your future attempts.

entities.name: Harmonic Sensitivity
entities.description: You've developed keen organs that have a sensitivity to sound—and you know how to put them to use. You become trained in Performance or gain the Assurance skill feat with Performance if you're are already trained in that skill. In addition, you can accurately recall a melody or lyrics you've heard within the last week, granting you a +2 circumstance bonus to all Deception and Performance checks that involve mimicking speech or a specific sound.

entities.name: Long Whiskered
entities.description: Your whiskers function as advanced electroreceptors, allowing you to orient yourself more easily. At the end of each round in which you're untethered, attempt a DC 15. On a success, you ignore the Clumsy and Off-Guard conditions imposed by being in zero-g for 1 minute.

entities.name: Pahtra Lore
entities.description:
You're an expert in both the traditional and modern pahtra performing arts. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Acrobatics and Performance. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Pahtra Lore.

entities.name: Predatory
entities.description:
Battle is a dance, and you've honed your body into an instrument as exquisite as it is deadly. When you select this feat, you gain your choice of a claw unarmed attack or a jaws unarmed attack. Both of these attacks are in the brawling weapon group.

A claw unarmed attack deals 1d6 slashing damage and has the agile, finesse, pahtra, and unarmed traits.

A jaws unarmed attack deals 1d6 piercing damage and has the finesse, grapple, pahtra, and unarmed traits.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these attacks, you get its critical specialization effect.

**Special** You can take this feat a second time. If you do, select the other attack from the options above.

entities.name: Remix World's Rhythm
entities.description: Whether through intense musical training, magical insight, or Meyel's divine blessing, you can feel the rhythm of the world around you and tug on time's chords to manipulate its melody and flow. You gain Haste and Slow as 3rd-rank primal innate spells. You can cast each of these spells once per day.

entities.name: Scrupulous Stalker
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per round

You quickly scan your surroundings for threats. You Seek. If you use electromagnetic sense, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this check.

entities.name: Boundless Brachiator
entities.description: You can take a leap of faith and usually land on your feet. You can Leap up to 30 feet in any direction without touching the ground and without requiring an Athletics check; when doing so, you must land on a surface you can Climb or adjacent to an Edge you can Grab within 30 feet of you, or else you fall after using your next action. You can exceed your normal Speed while Leaping.

entities.name: Song of My People
entities.description: You perform a mournful dirge tinged with supernatural grief that compels the soul of a lost comrade to return to its body. You can cast Breath of Life once per day as a 7th-rank primal innate spell. It gains the auditory trait.

entities.name: Battleblessed
entities.description: You're an accomplished battledancer and warrior, blessed by seers, honed by ancestral tradition, and capable of feats beyond the natural abilities of your peers. You gain Tailwind as a 1st-rank primal innate spell that you can cast once per day.

entities.name: Climbing Claws
entities.description: You can extend your claws to aid you in climbing. You gain a climb Speed equal to your land Speed.

entities.name: Electromagnetic Whiskers
entities.description: You've honed your whiskers' sensitivity to the degree that you can sense the movement of the weak electric fields emitted by potential enemies. You gain electromagnetic sense as an imprecise sense out to 15 feet. Electromagnetic sense allows you to detect nearby living and technological creatures, but you might have to use the Seek action to find an undetected creature in an environment with too much electromagnetic radiation, such as inside the engine room of a spaceship or near a powerful source of radio waves.

entities.name: Harmonic Shielding
entities.description: You've learned to compensate for your hypersensitivity to sound. You gain sonic resistance equal to half your level. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a sonic effect, you get a critical success instead.

entities.name: Melodic Adaptation
entities.description:
You can hear the thrum of magic as if it were a swirling note, a shifting melody, a harmonic chord, or a percussive beat, pulsing in tune with your heart. You can detect the presence of magic as though you were always using a 1st-rank Detect Magic spell. This detects magic within a 30-foot emanation.

At 13th level, the rank of detect magic increases to 3rd. At 17th level, the rank of detect magic increases to 4th.

Stats.Prerequisites: trained in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion

entities.name: Meyel's Melody
entities.description: Divine rhythm pulses through your blood, and your life is the music. You gain a +2 status bonus to Performance checks. In addition, you can use Performance to Create a Diversion, Demoralize, or Make an Impression. If you listen to music while resting, you regain a number of additional Hit Points equal to your level.

entities.name: Data Jockey
entities.description: You can easily send data to technological devices like a spectra. You can cast the Implant Data cantrip as a divine innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

entities.name: Drift-Touched
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You were born or gestated inside the Drift, and hyperspace is always a part of you. With a thought, you seize a fragment of the Drift and temporarily transplant it onto the battlefield as an intangible barrier of colorful light. This shimmering field appears within 30 feet and is straight and vertical, stretching up to 10 feet long and 10 feet high. The barrier grants concealment to creatures targeted through it, and it sheds colorful bright light for 10 feet on each side and dim light for the next 10 feet. You can ignore any concealment granted by the barrier. The barrier lasts for 5 rounds.

entities.name: Living Battery
entities.description:
Your body produces an overabundance of electrical energy, which you can emit as a blast of lightning or use to power technological devices. You can cast the Electric Arc cantrip as a divine innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

When you cast electric arc, you can also target batteries or tech items powered by batteries (in any combination). If you target a battery or tech item powered by a battery, that item isn't damaged. Instead, it regains 2 charges per spell rank. If the target is a tech item that needs a battery but doesn't currently have one, treat the item as if it had a battery with 2 charges per spell rank for 1 minute.

entities.name: Prismeni Lore
entities.description:
You've learned to leverage your intrinsic link to the Drift, making you an excellent pilot. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Piloting and Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Prismeni Lore.

entities.name: Spectrasoul
entities.description: You became a prismeni after a close encounter with one or more spectra. You can communicate mentally with spectra and with intelligent constructs with the tech trait within 30 feet. You don't need to share a language to communicate with such creatures in this way. This doesn't give you any special access to their thoughts and communicates no more information than normal speech would.

entities.name: Tech Familiarity
entities.description: You have an intuitive understanding of computers, machines, and other technological devices. You become trained in Computers and Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

entities.name: Triune's Chosen
entities.description: Triune chose you specifically to become a prismeni. You hold the All-Code close in your heart and cherish the data it's imparted upon you. You become trained in Religion and Triune Lore. You have familiarity with the pulse gauntlet, and for the purpose of determining your proficiency, the pulse gauntlet is a simple weapon. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in simple weapons, you also gain that proficiency in the pulse gauntlet.

entities.name: Drift Blink
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per minute

**Trigger** An enemy's Strike would hit you, and you weren't already Concealed, Hidden, or undetected to that enemy.

You momentarily slip into the Drift, becoming concealed against the triggering Strike. If the flat check for concealment fails, the Strike misses you. After resolving the triggering Strike, you reemerge from the Drift in an unoccupied space adjacent to your original square.

entities.name: Encode Presence
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

You instinctively encode your presence, obscuring your identity and scrambling your visual appearance to technological visual sensors. You become Concealed to all technological visual sensors, such as security cameras, ocular cybernetic augmentations, and the visual processors of technological constructs, for 1 minute. As the nature of this effect still leaves your location obvious, you can't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak.

entities.name: Frequent Drifter
entities.description: Your connection to the Drift grows even stronger, allowing you to travel through it more often. The frequency of Drift Hop changes to once per hour.

entities.name: Scramble Tech
entities.description: With a thought, you can infect a technological creature or device with a short-lived virus, causing the object to glitch and malfunction. You can cast Discharge as a 3rd-rank divine innate spell twice per day.

entities.name: Drift Strike
entities.description:
**Frequency** once every 10 minutes

**Requirements** Your last action was a melee Strike that critically hit a creature.

You launch the creature you hit with the required Strike into the Drift to reposition it across the battlefield. The creature is teleported to a location of your choice up to a distance of 20 feet from its starting location and within your line of sight. If you're in the Drift, the distance you can teleport the creature is doubled. The creature must be able to fit in its new location, and its new location must be unoccupied. The creature can attempt a  save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The distance you can teleport the creature is halved, and it can't be moved to a location that is hazardous or would result in a fall.

**Failure** You teleport the creature up to the noted distance.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the distance you can teleport the creature is doubled.

entities.name: Spectra Ascendant
entities.description: Whether through a quirk of your bloodline, the interference of powerful spectra, or Triune's blessing, your body has been flooded by the essence of the Drift, transforming you into a spectra. You cease aging. You gain darkvision, the cosmic trait, and a fly Speed equal to your land Speed. While you're in the Drift, your fly Speed is equal to double your land Speed. Additionally, you gain the Cosmic Blast action.

entities.name: Drift Hop
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You travel across the battlefield via the Drift. You teleport up to a distance equal to your Speed within your line of sight. If you're in the Drift, the distance you can teleport is doubled.

entities.name: Electrical Shielding
entities.description: Your body is insulated from electrical attacks. You gain electricity resistance equal to half your level. Additionally, you gain the Redirect Current reaction.

entities.name: Spectra Transmission
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

You can project your speech through wireless transmission, rather than speaking aloud, causing your words to emit from unsecured technological devices as either audio, text, or both. For example, your voice could emit audibly from an intercom or appear as text on a vidscreen or holosign. Select an unsecured technological device within 100 feet. For 1 minute, you can choose to transmit anything you say through that output device, rather than say it aloud. You can change which device you use as an output as a single action. Doing so doesn't extend the duration.

entities.name: Tech Caster
entities.description: Your ability to control and empower technological devices has improved. You gain Delete and Supercharge Weapon as 1st-rank divine innate spells. You can cast each of these divine innate spells once per day.

entities.name: Cosmic Traveler
entities.description: The Drift is your true home, and you can survive within it indefinitely. While you're in the Drift, you gain the cosmic trait, and you don't need to eat or drink. While you're in the Drift or a vacuum, you gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed.

entities.name: Remote Access
entities.description: You know how to probe computer systems with your mind as easily as others might handle a hacking toolkit. You can communicate wirelessly with technological devices within 10 feet, allowing you to attempt Computers checks on these devices without a user interface or hacking toolkit. If you can already attempt Computers checks at range, you increase the distance that you can do so by an additional 10 feet.

entities.name: Revitalized by the Drift
entities.description:
The Drift revitalizes your spirit and restores your vitality, physically healing your wounds. If you rest for 10 minutes while within the Drift, you gain Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier × your level. This is cumulative with any healing you receive from Treat Wounds.

Once per hour, you can focus or meditate on your inherent connection to the Drift. This is a 10-minute activity that has the concentrate and exploration traits. When you do, you're treated as if you'd rested for 10 minutes while in the Drift, save that the number of Hit Points you regain from this feat is halved.

entities.name: Cheek Pouches
entities.description: Your cheeks are stretchy, and you can store up to four items of light Bulk or less in these cheek pouches. None of these items can have a dimension longer than 1 foot. As long as you have at least one item in your cheek pouches, your speech is noticeably difficult to understand. Placing an item in your cheek pouch or retrieving one is an Interact action. You can empty your mouth with a single action, causing everything you had stored in your cheek pouches to fall to the ground in your square.

entities.name: Psychic Talent
entities.description: Your psychic abilities have developed beyond simple communication. Choose one cantrip from the occult spell list. You can cast this cantrip as an occult innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

entities.name: Prehensile Tail
entities.description: Your tail functions like an extra limb. You can hold one extra hand's worth of equipment with your tail, and you can use your tail to perform Interact actions. You tail is considered one pair of hands for the purposes of designating your active hands with the Switch Hands action.

entities.name: Telepathic Conduit
entities.description:
**Lashunta** When you use limited telepathy to communicate with another creature, you act as a conduit for their thoughts, allowing them to respond to you for a few scant moments—if they wish. The creature can give you a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action at the beginning of their next turn as long as they remain within range of your telepathy.

**Shirren** When you use limited telepathy to communicate with another creature, the creature can give you a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action at the beginning of their next turn.

entities.name: Additional Arms
entities.description:
You install one additional pair of arms onto your frame.

**Special** You can take this feat multiple times, gaining one additional pair of arms each time.

entities.name: Communalism
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** An ally within 10 feet fails a skill check requiring 3 actions or fewer.

You broadcast helpful encouragement or pertinent information to your ally's mind. Your ally rerolls the triggering skill check and takes the better result.

entities.name: Shirren Lore
entities.description:
Your ability to adapt to various beliefs instills you with knowledge of many cultures. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Diplomacy and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Shirren Lore.

entities.name: Consistent Communalism
entities.description: You're always ready to help your allies when they need you the most. You can use Communalism once per hour, rather than once per day.

entities.name: Linguistic Master
entities.description: Your mastery of language reaches supernatural levels. You can cast Truespeech as a 5th-rank occult innate spell once per day on yourself only. You gain a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy checks for the duration of the spell when speaking to creatures with whom you already shared a language before Casting the Spell.

entities.name: Unconventional Expertise
entities.description: You've continued to advance your powers using your unconventional weapon. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in certain weapons, you also gain that proficiency in the weapon you chose for Unconventional Weaponry.

entities.name: Scatter Thoughts
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You're targeted by a mental effect.

You can shield your mind by using similar techniques that your ancestors once mastered to escape the Swarm. You block the intruding effect by scattering your thoughts, making you immune to the triggering mental effect for the next minute.

entities.name: Swarm Evolution
entities.description: Whether gradual or in an instant burst of glorious evolution, you've metamorphosed into a powerful Swarm-like creature. You gain a +2 status bonus to saves against fear, and you gain acid resistance equal to half your level. You can cast Mask of Terror as a 7th-rank primal innate spell once per day.

entities.name: Eager Assistant
entities.description: You love helping your friends and allies achieve their goals. At the start of your turn, you gain one additional reaction, which you can use only to Aid.

entities.name: Learning Experience
entities.description: Your body can partially absorb persistent damage to learn from it. Before you roll damage from a persistent effect, you can choose to take half damage from the effect. When you do, you automatically fail your flat check to end the persistent damage and you can immediately Recall Knowledge as a free action to recall information related to the source of the persistent damage. If you have any special abilities or free actions that would normally be triggered when you Recall Knowledge, you can't use them with this action.

entities.name: Basic Insectile Flight
entities.description:
Some shirrens are born with wings, but others grow them later. You evolve a pair of insectile wings that grant you a fly Speed of 20 feet. In addition, when you fall, you take no falling damage.

**Special** If you're a winged shirren, you either grow a second set of wings or your existing wings morph into a stronger set of wings, increasing your fly Speed to 25 feet.

entities.name: Psychic Master
entities.description: Your psychic abilities have grown stronger. Choose one common 2nd-rank spell from the occult spell list. You can cast that spell as an occult innate spell once per day.

entities.name: Clinging Bite
entities.description: You have excellent control over your stomach-mouth. Your jaws unarmed attack gains the grapple trait. When you critically hit with your jaws attack, you can use your next action to attempt to Grapple that creature with your jaws or automatically extend the Grabbed condition on a creature you're restraining with your jaws. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward your multiple attack penalty.

entities.name: Dauntless
entities.description: You're rarely discouraged or afraid. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against fear and to your Will DC against attempts to Demoralize you. If you get a success on a save against a fear effect, you get a critical success instead.

entities.name: Fixation
entities.description: You're fascinated with a particular topic, such as the religion of a small sect of worshippers, the process of spaghettification, or the songs sung by asterays. You gain the Additional Lore feat and the Assurance feat for the chosen Lore.

entities.name: Hug Master
entities.description: A good, solid hug makes everything better, and you're bringing hugs to the battlefield. You gain the Titan Wrestler skill feat. Additionally, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to Grapple and to your Fortitude DC to avoid being Grappled.

entities.name: Hyper
entities.description: You're full of energy, and you often bound into action faster than your friends can keep up. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.

entities.name: Skittermander Lore
entities.description:
You're gregarious and friendly but also passionately interested in the history of your people, going out of your way to learn traditional stories and unearth lost secrets. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Diplomacy and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Skittermander Lore, and you learn Morandomandranan, the original skittermander language that has long been suppressed by the Veskarium.

entities.name: Chattermander
entities.description: You never let the inability to communicate stop you from chatting with nufriends! You gain Speak with Animals as a 2nd-rank primal innate spell, and Speak with Plants and Translate as 3rd-rank primal innate spells. You can cast each of these primal innate spells once per day.

entities.name: Opportunistic Hug
entities.description:
**Trigger** A creature critically fails a melee Strike against you.

**Requirements** The triggering creature is within your reach, you have at least one free active hand, and your target is no more than one size larger than you.

You seize the opportunity to give your foe a big hug to help them feel better or calm down. You attempt an Athletics check to Grapple the triggering creature.

**Special** If you have the Titan Wrestler skill feat, you can use Opportunistic Hug against creatures up to two sizes larger than you, or up to three sizes larger than you if you're legendary in Athletics.

entities.name: Supersonic Speed
entities.description: You move incredibly fast, becoming a colorful blur of erratic motion. When you Stride while Quickened from Zoomies, you gain concealment until the start of your next turn. As usual for concealment involving an obvious visual manifestation, you can't use this concealment to Hide.

entities.name: Allsix
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Requirements** You aren't holding any items except in your active hands.

You put forth your best effort and focus everything you've got on the task at hand, putting allsix of your hands (three of your sets of arms) into it! The next time you roll an attack roll or skill check, roll it three times and use the highest result.

entities.name: Boundless Energy
entities.description: Your wells of energy are unending, and your exuberance can't be contained. You can use Zoomies once every hour, rather than once per day.

entities.name: Helping Hand
entities.description:
**Frequency** once every 10 minutes

In the blink of an eye, you ready yourself to help your ally with a task. This counts as preparing to help an ally for the purposes of using the Aid reaction. You must still explain to the GM exactly how you're helping.

entities.name: Lucky Improviser
entities.description: You're a master improviser with a bit of talent at everything—even if you have no idea what you're doing. You gain the Untrained Improvisation general feat. In addition, you gain the Beginner's Luck action.

entities.name: Hush
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You fall utterly silent and focus strenuously on a problem at hand. You attempt to Recall Knowledge with a +2 circumstance bonus to the skill check. If you would get a critical failure, you get a failure instead, and if you would get a success, you get a critical success instead.

entities.name: Secrete Numbing Saliva
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

**Requirements** Your last action was a successful Strike with your stomach-mouth jaws unarmed attack.

Your stomach-mouth secretes numbing saliva into your target, exposing them to the poison.

**Numbing Saliva** (injury, poison)

**Saving Throw**  (the higher of your class or spell DC)

**Maximum Duration** 6 rounds

**Stage 1** Clumsy 1 (1 round)

**Stage 2** clumsy 1 and Suppressed (1 round)

**Stage 3** Clumsy 2 and suppressed (1 round)

entities.name: Zoomies
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You unleash your pent up energy in a flurry of unpredictable motion. You gain the Quickened condition for 4 rounds. You can use the extra action each round only to Stride.

entities.name: Charging Port
entities.description: You've incorporated a charging station into your frame, enabling you to recharge spent batteries with your own body. In addition, you can cast the Recharge Weapon cantrip as an arcane innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

entities.name: Coarctated Frame
entities.description: You've adjusted your frame to fit into tight spaces and contort impressively. You gain the Quick Squeeze and Nimble Crawl skill feats (even if you don't meet the prerequisites).

entities.name: Defy the Past
entities.description:
**Trigger** You attempt a saving throw against a mental effect, but you haven't rolled yet.

You clutch a memento from your past life—the time before you gained self-awareness and awakened as yourself—and you use it to fuel your defiance in the face of injustice, bolster your confidence in times of self-doubt, and remind you of the miracle of your independence. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against mental effects until the beginning of your next turn. This bonus also applies to the triggering save.

entities.name: Hoverbot
entities.description: You've installed tiny thrusters and vents into your frame that enable you to hover a few inches above the ground, avoiding the dirt and grime below. Your land Speed gains the hover trait. In addition, you gain the Overload Thrusters action.

entities.name: Mechanical Resilience
entities.description: Your mechanical body resists ailments better than other living creatures. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases, poisons, and radiation.

entities.name: Networker
entities.description: You gain a shortwave radio transmitter, allowing you to communicate wirelessly with any creatures within 30 feet, as long as they have shortwave or are a construct with the tech trait. This doesn't give any special access to their thoughts or programming and communicates no more information than normal speech would.

entities.name: Off-Road Transport
entities.description: You have heavy duty treads, wheels, or appendages that make it easy for you to navigate uneven surfaces. You ignore difficult terrain caused by plants, stone, and trash and uneven ground made of earth, plants, stone, and trash.

entities.name: Optical Upgrade
entities.description:
You've installed advanced optical sensors into your frame, calibrated to function in suboptimal lighting conditions. You gain low-light vision.

**Special** You can take this feat a second time. When you do, you gain darkvision.

entities.name: Sro Lore
entities.description:
Like many SROs, you value the miracle of life and believe all creations are worthy of respect. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Crafting and Nature. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for SRO Lore.

entities.name: Unreadable
entities.description: Your face—if you have one—emotes differently than most creatures, making it hard for others to read your intentions and emotions. You become trained in Deception. In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to create-a-diversion and Lie. If you would automatically become trained in Deception (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

entities.name: Weapon Mount
entities.description:
Your body has an integrated weapon mount that can hold a one-handed weapon. You can install or uninstall a weapon into this weapon mount using the Install Upgrade activity. You're always wielding a weapon installed in your weapon mount. An installed weapon can't be disarmed, dropped, or stolen.

Choose one common commercial simple weapon you can install on your weapon mount. You begin with this weapon already installed in your weapon mount. You don't need to pay the credits to purchase this starting weapon, but you do need to purchase any ammo it requires.

**Special** If you have the combatant SRO heritage, you can instead install a one-handed martial weapon or a two-handed weapon in your weapon mount.

entities.name: Reinforced Chassis
entities.description: You have a reinforced chassis to protect your frame from harm without interfering with your movements or increasing your size. During your daily preparations, you can apply a specially formulated coating and additional reinforcement to your outer chassis. This coating grants you Hardness equal to half your level rounded up. The first time each day you're damaged by a critical hit or reduced to half your Hit Points or less, this coating wears off, and you lose the Hardness granted by this feat until your next daily preparations.

entities.name: Root Access (SRO)
entities.description: You've got a way with machines, so you can communicate even with those that lack self-awareness as if they were an old friend. You can cast Speak with Computers once per day as a 4th-rank arcane innate spell.

entities.name: Virtual Sandbox
entities.description:
**Trigger** You gain the Confused, controlled, Fascinated, frightened, or stupefied condition.

You've created a virtual sandbox, a digital clone of your mental programming that contains all your memories and other aspects of your mind except your consciousness. Attempt a DC 15. On a success or critical success, you isolate and shunt the condition into your virtual sandbox and don't gain the condition, but you become immune to Virtual Sandbox for 10 minutes.

entities.name: Akashic Backup
entities.description: A spark in your evolving consciousness allows you to create a backup of your awakened mind and body. Once per day, you can cast Akashic Revival as an 8th-rank occult innate spell.

entities.name: Electromagnetic Pulse
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You emit a powerful EMP in a 30-foot-radius emanation. Each tech creature, hazard, and item in the area must attempt a Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. You, your allies, your equipment, and your allies' equipment are unharmed by this EMP.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target becomes Glitching 1.

**Failure** The target becomes Glitching 2.

**Critical Failure** The target becomes Glitching 3.

entities.name: Empower Healing Circuits
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

Confident in your sense of self to the point of recklessness, you send extra power to your healing circuits, pushing them to their limits. For 1 minute, you gain fast healing 10. In addition, the first time during the duration that a source would restore a variable number of Hit Points to you, it restores the maximum number of Hit Points possible.

entities.name: Climbing Clamps
entities.description: You've integrated a variety of clamps, pitons, and other climbing equipment into your frame that allow you to scale sheer surfaces. You gain a climb Speed of 20 feet.

entities.name: Electromagnetic Manipulation
entities.description:
You've installed a powerful electromagnet in your frame that you can use to move and manipulate items from afar. You can move 1 unattended object of 1 Bulk or less that has the tech trait or is made from metal within 30 feet to anywhere within 30 feet as a single action with the concentrate trait.

In addition, if you attempt to disarm an item with the tech trait or that's made of metal, you don't need to have a hand free, and you can attempt to Disarm at a range of 30 feet.

**Special** If you have the combatant SRO or worker SRO heritage, the range at which you can move such objects and Disarm such objects increases to 60 feet.

entities.name: Medical Nanites
entities.description:
You're adept at producing and using nanites to treat a variety of medical conditions. You gain the Inject Nanites action.

**Special** If you have the medic SRO heritage, you can Inject Nanites once per 10 minutes.

entities.name: Reconfigurable Frame
entities.description:
Your body's frame is highly reconfigurable, allowing for additional augmentations. You can Implant Augmentation on yourself in 10 minutes using a medkit or repair toolkit. In addition, increase your augmentation implant limit by 1.

**Special** You can select this feat more than once, increasing your augmentation implant limit by 1 each time you do.

entities.name: Stretching Reach
entities.description: You can leverage your size to extend your reach. When you wield a melee weapon that requires two hands and doesn't have reach, you can change between a typical two-handed grip and an extended two-handed stretch using an Interact action. Weapons wielded in your extended two-handed stretch gain a reach of 10 feet.

entities.name: Temp-Regulators
entities.description: You've installed a complex system of liquid cooling tubes and thermal insulators throughout your frame to ensure your sensitive internal components maintain a consistent temperature, in addition to sensors that constantly adjust these components to keep you safe. You gain resistance to fire and cold equal to half your level.

entities.name: Transmit Virus
entities.description:
**Requirements** Your last action was a successful Strike against a tech creature, hazard, or item. You transmit a virus that hampers the operation of the required target. The target must attempt a  against the higher of your class DC or spell DC with the following results.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to Transmit Virus for 1 hour.

**Success** The target is unaffected.

**Failure** The target becomes Glitching 1.

**Critical Failure** The target becomes Glitching 2.

entities.name: 360 Optics
entities.description: To increase your odds of survival, you've installed visual sensors that provide a 360-degree view of your surroundings. You aren't Off-Guard to creatures that are flanking you.

entities.name: Jet Thrusters
entities.description:
You've installed powerful jet thrusters into your frame, granting you the ability to fly. You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed.

**Special** If you have the Hoverbot feat, when you Overload Thrusters, you gain a fly Speed equal to twice your land Speed, and your thrusters don't deactivate.

entities.name: Manipulate Glitch
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per round

**Requirements** You're adjacent to a creature, hazard, or item that has the glitching condition.

You know how to manipulate errors in high-tech programming and complex machinery, enhancing or mitigating the resulting glitches. You can either increase or reduce the value of the required target's glitching condition by 1.

**Special** If you have the repair SRO heritage, you can use Manipulate Glitch on a target up to 30 feet away.

entities.name: Power Absorption
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

**Trigger** You take electricity damage.

You convert some of the excess electricity surging through your systems into kinetic energy by accelerating your internal motors and processors to handle the expedited movements. You become Quickened for 2 rounds. You can use the extra action each round only to Stride.

entities.name: Distant Telepath
entities.description:
Whether through training or innate talent, you've expanded the range at which you can telepathically communicate. Increase the range of your limited telepathy by 15 feet.

**Special** You can select this feat more than once.

entities.name: Devotional's Shield
entities.description:
**Trigger** You attempt a saving throw against a magical effect, but you haven't rolled yet.

Your ardent devotion to your faith or philosophy shields you from other divine magic and effects. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the triggering saving throw or a +2 circumstance bonus if it's a divine magical effect.

entities.name: Easily Augmented
entities.description:
Whether due to biological evolution, scientific experimentation, or intentional modification, your body naturally integrates augmentations. Your implant limit increases by 1.

**Special** If you have the synthflesh verthani heritage, your implant limit increases by 2, rather than 1.

entities.name: Enhanced Vision
entities.description: You have excellent vision thanks to your large, bulbous eyes. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus when using the seek action to find hidden or undetected creatures within 30 feet of you. When you target an opponent that's Concealed from you or hidden from you, reduce the DC of the flat check to 3 for a concealed target or 9 for a hidden target.

entities.name: Ingenious Inventor
entities.description: You're a talented engineer or programmer who frequently creates new innovations in your field. You become trained in your choice of either Computers or Crafting. If you selected Crafting, you gain the Specialty Crafting skill feat. If you chose Computers, you gain the Programmer skill feat.

entities.name: Innovative Scientist
entities.description: You're insatiably curious and driven to experiment, often attempting to push the boundaries of science. You gain the Additional Lore skill feat for your choice of either Life Science Lore or Physical Science Lore. In addition, you gain the Eureka! action.

entities.name: Peacekeeper
entities.description: You're a natural leader, adept at bringing people together, settling arguments, and guiding a group toward a common goal. You become trained in Diplomacy. If you would automatically become trained in Diplomacy (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. In addition, you gain the Group Impression skill feat.

entities.name: Urbanite
entities.description: You grew up in a megacity and are used to the hustle, bustle, and crowds of major cities. You become trained in Acrobatics and gain the Crowd Surfing skill feat.

entities.name: Verthani Lore
entities.description: You've immersed yourself in your people's history and culture. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Crafting and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Verthani Lore.

entities.name: Dazzling Surge
entities.description:
**Trigger** You take damage, and a creature is adjacent to you.

The color of your skin flickers wildly when you're hurt. Select one adjacent creature; that creature must attempt a  save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Regardless of the result of its saving throw, the creature is then temporarily immune to Dazzling Surge for 1 hour.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes a –1 circumstance penalty to Perception checks until the beginning of your next turn.

**Failure** The creature is Dazzled until the end of your next turn.

**Critical Failure** The creature is dazzled for 2 rounds.

entities.name: Instinctive Camouflage
entities.description: You match your skin's color and patterns to your surroundings, vastly improving your ability to pass unseen and gaining perpetual camouflage. For 10 minutes, you can hide or sneak without cover or being Concealed.

entities.name: Long Reach
entities.description: When you wield a melee weapon that requires two hands and doesn't have reach, you can change between a typical two-handed grip and an extended two-handed stretch using an Interact action. Weapons wielded in your extended two-handed stretch gain a reach of 10 feet.

entities.name: Paint the Future
entities.description: You can divine the patterns and colors of your skin. Twice per day, you can spend 10 minutes to cast Augury as a 2nd-rank divine innate spell. Once per day, you can spend 10 minutes to cast Read Omens as a 4th-rank divine innate spell. These spells gain the visual trait.

entities.name: Peripheral Precision
entities.description: Your wide-angle vision makes it hard for enemies to surprise you. You aren't Off-Guard to melee attacks from creatures flanking you.

entities.name: Augmented Perfection
entities.description: Your augmentations push past their limits. Increase your implant limit by 2. You gain the Miraculous Activation action.

entities.name: Instant Shift
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per round

You can shift the colors and patterns on your skin with barely a second thought, changing your appearance in an instant. You Shift Skin.

entities.name: Persistent Mimicry
entities.description: You've spent your waking hours impersonating others to your heart's content and can effortlessly mimic those you've just met or shift into your own alternate personas to disguise yourself and slip away. The frequency of Identity Mimicry becomes once per 10 minutes rather than once per day.

entities.name: Disorienting Display
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

You cause your skin to rapidly flicker between a clashing array of colors and patterns, disorienting anyone who can see you. Creatures within 30 feet that can see you must attempt a  save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is Off-Guard against your next attack before the end of your turn.

**Failure** The creature is off-guard against your attacks until the end of your turn.

**Critical Failure** The creature is off-guard until the beginning of your next turn.

entities.name: Evolved Acclimation
entities.description: You have adapted to extreme temperature, even beyond that of other bioharmonic verthanis. You gain resistance equal to half your level against cold and fire damage. If you use Temperature Acclimation, you gain resistance equal to your level to the triggering damage type for 1 minute, instead of the normal effects of Temperature Acclimation.

entities.name: God-Vessel
entities.description:
You can tap into and channel the divine energies of the Universe to cast spells. You might be blessed, pious, an esoteric scientist, or—as most other verthanis assume—a chosen God-Vessel representing your divinity. Choose one of the following 1st-rank divine spells: Bane, Bless, Command, Fear, or Protection. You can cast the selected spell as a divine innate spell once per day.

**Special** If you have the devotional verthani heritage, you can instead select two spells from the listed options, and you can cast each of the selected spells as a divine innate spell once per day.

entities.name: Keeper of Traditions
entities.description: You possess a deep knowledge of your people's history and customs, and you can leverage that knowledge to influence your fellow verthanis and other citizens of Verces. You might be a scholar or diplomat, or you might be a member of the Pure Ones. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on Society checks to Recall Knowledge about Verces and verthanis. In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Charisma-based skill checks against verthanis and other citizens of Verces.

entities.name: Leverage Ingenuity
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

You come up with a unique and ingenious way to accomplish a task, taking longer to achieve your goal with better results. Perform a skill action that takes a single action to perform and requires a skill check to accomplish or measure its success, such as an Acrobatics check to balance, a Medicine check to treat-poison, or a Stealth check to hide. Roll this skill check twice, and use the better result.

entities.name: Talented Pilot
entities.description: Whether it springs from a love of exploration, a desire for freedom, or a need for speed, you're never happier than when you're behind the wheel of a vehicle or at the helm of a starship. You become trained in Piloting, or if you're already trained in Piloting, you instead become expert in Piloting. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on Piloting checks to Navigate, Plot Course, Stunt, and perform starship actions at the piloting station. When you roll a success on a check to Navigate or Plot Course, you get a critical success instead.

entities.name: Blur the Details
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

You adjust the pigments of your skin, making it difficult to discern details about your body and even determine what parts of your body are where. You become Concealed until the beginning of your next turn. As the nature of this effect still leaves your location obvious, you can't use this concealment to hide or sneak. When this effect ends, your skin becomes a mottled mess, so it doesn't blend in with your surroundings.

entities.name: Galactic Traveler
entities.description: You've traveled distant worlds and lived among other cultures for years, leading you to become a talented linguist. You gain the Multilingual skill feat twice, even if you don't meet the prerequisites. In addition, you can cast Translate once per day on yourself as a 3rd-rank divine innate spell.

entities.name: Identity Mimicry
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You're incredibly talented at mimicking others, using your ability to alter your skin's pigmentation and patterns alongside your more mundane skills to perfectly disguise yourself and impersonate others. You gain the effects of a 3rd-rank Illusory Disguise spell, targeting yourself, except this transformation is non-magical and doesn't have the illusion trait.

entities.name: Modification Synchronization
entities.description:
F to 1

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

You've achieved near-perfect integration with your augmentations, allowing you to react with uncanny speed and precision. Activate an augmentation currently installed in your body. If the augmentation would usually take 1 action to Activate, Modification Synchronization is a free action. If the augmentation would usually take 2 actions to Activate, Modification Synchronization is 1 action. For example, Activating a Commercial Dragon Gland to Exhale would be a free action, while Activating Commercial Psychoactive Eyes to Gaze would be 1 action.

entities.name: Sudden Assistance
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per round

You're accustomed to collaborating with others and know how to lend a hand to an ally without slowing your own progress down or losing focus on your own goals. You prepare to help an ally with a task. This follows all the usual rules and steps detailed in the Aid action, except preparing to help is a part of Sudden Assistance and doesn't require a single action.

entities.name: Armor Ace
entities.description: You've learned through trial and painful error how to make the most out of your armor, deflecting damage from explosions and similar effects. When donning armor, you can grant it the bulwark trait until you remove it. When you're wearing armor that already has the bulwark trait, increase the modifier to Reflex saves to avoid damaging effects granted by that armor to +4, rather than +3.

entities.name: Brutal Anatomy
entities.description:
You're a natural predator trained to use part of your body as a weapon. When you select this feat, you gain one of the following unarmed attacks of your choice: claw, jaws, or tail. Each of these attacks is in the brawling weapon group.

A claw unarmed attack deals 1d6 slashing damage and has the agile, finesse, unarmed, and vesk traits.

A jaws unarmed attack deals 1d6 piercing damage and has the grapple, unarmed, and vesk traits.

A tail unarmed attack deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage and has the sweep, trip, unarmed, and vesk traits.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these attacks, you get its critical specialization effect.

**Special** You can take this feat three times. Each time you do, select a different attack from the options listed above.

entities.name: Command Tactics
entities.description: You're a skilled leader. Whenever an ally selects you as the target of their attempts to Follow the Expert, you increase the circumstance bonus they receive to their skill check by an additional +1, or an additional +2 if you have master proficiency or higher (for a total of +3 for expert, +5 for master, and +6 for legendary).

entities.name: Fearless
entities.description: Whether it comes from a sense of duty or a desire to succeed, you rarely flinch when confronted by fearsome foes. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a fear effect, you get a critical success instead.

entities.name: Vesk Weapon Familiarity
entities.description:
You're trained with all doshkos. In addition, you gain access to all uncommon weapons with the vesk trait. For the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

entities.name: Advantageous Assault
entities.description: When your foe is weak, you press on. When you successfully Strike a creature that has the frightened or persistent bleed condition with a melee or ranged weapon, you gain a circumstance bonus to the damage roll equal to the number of weapon damage dice of the weapon used for the Strike.

entities.name: Damoritosh's Claw
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Requirements** You're engaged in combat.

You pray to Damoritosh (or a battle saint) for a blessing in the heat of battle—and he answers. You regain 1 Focus Point, up to your usual maximum.

entities.name: Overcome Shame
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Trigger** You critically fail a Strike against an enemy.

You clear your mind of distractions and focus on your foe, determined to overcome the shame of your failure lest it forever blemish your reputation. The next time before the end of your turn that you attempt a Strike with the same weapon and target as the triggering attack, you roll the attack roll twice and use the higher result. If the attack misses, you're overwhelmed with shame, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn.

entities.name: Battle Saint
entities.description: You have ascended to the rank of living battle saint and are on a path to become a true divine servant of Damoritosh when you meet him in the afterlife. You can cast Rocket Dash and Haste as 7th-rank divine innate spells once per day each.

entities.name: Bolstered By Battle
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

**Trigger** You deal the killing blow to an enemy.

You don't just fight because you have to; the threat of battle and the thrill of victory invigorate you. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute or until the encounter ends, whichever comes first.

entities.name: Blood Sense
entities.description: You have a keen sense of smell and are capable of detecting bloody wounds at a distance. You gain blood sense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. This means you can use your sense of smell to determine the exact location of a living creature who isn't at its full Hit Points. Creatures that don't have blood, such as oozes and most constructs, can't be detected with your blood sense.

entities.name: Menacing Snarl
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

**Trigger** You frighten a creature.

You snarl, hiss, shout, or otherwise verbally menace the triggering creature as you frighten them. Increase the value of the frightened condition by 1 (maximum 3).

entities.name: Terrifying Bravado
entities.description:
**Trigger** You critically succeed on a save against a fear effect whose source was a creature, or a creature fails or critically fails an Intimidation check to Demoralize you.

You laugh at your enemy's failed attempts to bully you, turning the tables on your foe with a display of terrifying bravado. You attempt an Intimidation check to Demoralize the triggering creature.

entities.name: Eager Combatant
entities.description:
**Trigger** You roll Athletics or Intimidation for initiative.

You eagerly stride into battle, giving no thought to the consequences. You Stride in a straight line directly toward an enemy.

entities.name: Opening Roar
entities.description: At the start of a combat encounter, if you are aware of your foes and aren't attempting to Sneak or Hide, you can roll an Intimidation check for your initiative and can use the result to Demoralize one observed foe.

entities.name: Plated Deflection
entities.description: You've mastered using your own plate scales or worn armor to absorb devastating strikes. You gain the Plate Deflection reaction.

Stats.Prerequisites: plated vesk heritage or Armor Ace

entities.name: Grandmother's Lore
entities.description:
You follow Lao Shu Po's teachings and aren't afraid to lie, cheat, or steal to get what you desire. Thanks to your extra devotion, you gain the trained proficiency rank in Deception and Thievery. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You gain the Additional Lore general feat for Lao Shu Po Lore.

entities.name: Nimble Tail
entities.description: You have an incredibly nimble tail that helps you balance in zero gravity; this could be a hereditary gift from your ancestors as they adapted to spaceflight or the result of personal augmentation. You can use your tail to Push Off while in zero-g without needing a free hand. In addition, you ignore the clumsy and Off-Guard penalties while Untethered in zero gravity.

entities.name: Tinkering Fingers
entities.description: You grew up learning to tinker with devices, repair objects, and take things apart. You're trained in Crafting. If you're trained in Crafting from another source (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You can Repair an item without using a repair toolkit without taking the –2 circumstance penalty, improvising tools from whatever you have at hand. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Crafting checks to Repair an item when you have a repair toolkit.

entities.name: Ysoki Lore
entities.description:
Years of experience living among ysoki communities have trained your nimble steps and sneaky moves. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Acrobatics and Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Ysoki Lore.

entities.name: Explosive Surprise
entities.description: You've mastered the infamous ysoki martial art of spitting a live grenade from your mouth. It takes 10 minutes to safely prepare a grenade and store it in your cheek pouch. As a single action, you can draw and throw this specially prepared grenade using your mouth. You don't need a free hand to do so.

entities.name: Skulking Strike
entities.description:
**Trigger** An enemy occupying the same space as you uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

You launch a surprise attack from below. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If your attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, you disrupt that action. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

entities.name: Grandmother's Favorite
entities.description: Your steadfast faith in Grandmother Rat yields more rewards. You gain Divine Decree as a 7th-rank divine innate spell once per day. Additionally, once per month, whenever you would die, your body instead transforms into a swarm of dispersing rats. After 1d6 days, these rats gather in a safe space of the GM's choosing (a site dedicated to Lao Shu Po, if possible) and reform your body. You're returned to life at your maximum Hit Points.

entities.name: Slip From Sight
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

**Trigger** You successfully use Stealth to Hide and become Hidden from all your current foes, or use Stealth to Sneak and become undetected to all your current foes.

Using clever technology, magical talent, a divine blessing, or uncanny luck, you slip from sight completely, becoming Invisible for 1 minute, or until you take a hostile action, whichever comes first.

entities.name: Cornered Fury
entities.description: When you're physically outmatched, you fight with unexpected ferocity. If a foe of a larger size than you critically hits and damages you, that foe is Off-Guard to you for 1 round.

entities.name: Quick Stow
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per round

You're trained in the trick of quickly moving items into your cheek pouches. You Interact to store one held item in your cheek pouches (provided it fits).

entities.name: Big Mouth
entities.description: Your cheek pouches are especially large and stretchy. Instead of storing up to four items of light Bulk in your cheek pouches, you can store up to 1 Bulk worth of items. The maximum size of a given item is unchanged.

entities.name: Underfoot
entities.description: You use your size against larger foes, quickly moving around them to avoid notice or stay out of reach. As long as you're Small, you can end a successful Tumble Through action in a Medium or larger enemy's space. The enemy must have appropriate limbs or otherwise leave you enough room for this maneuver, as determined by the GM. You couldn't, for example, occupy the space of an ooze that matches the full dimensions of the square. While you occupy an enemy's space, that enemy is Off-Guard to you.

Stats.Prerequisites: shipborn ysoki or tunnel ysoki heritage

entities.name: Augmentation Power Surge
entities.description: You've synced and tuned your augmentations, allowing them to power each other. If one of your augmentations is out of limited uses, you can squeeze out one more use by drawing power from other augmentations that haven't expended all of their limited uses or don't have limited uses. The item level of the augmentation used for power must match or exceed the item level of the augmentation powered in this way. Exceeding the powered augmentation's level doesn't give any other benefit. For example, you can power a 3rd-level augmentation with a 5th-level augmentation, but it would still be considered an effect from a 3rd-level item. The augmentations used for power as well as the augmentation powered in this way then lose functionality until your next daily preparations.

entities.name: Augmented Harmony
entities.description: Your body has adapted to perform in perfect harmony with your augmentations. You're permanently Quickened, but you can use this extra action only to Activate an augmentation.

entities.name: Augmented Dedication
entities.description: You've developed a profound connection with your own body with every customized addition to it. You gain the Augmented Body general feat. You increase your implant limit by two.

entities.name: Augmentation Surgeon
entities.description: You've studied augmentations in depth. You become trained in Medicine. If you were already trained in Medicine, you become an expert instead. When you Implant Augmentation, you can install or remove augmentations in 10 minutes.

entities.name: Augmented Mobility
entities.description: You've learned that to push your augmentations to their limits, you must first hack your own body. By trying out new foods, using supplements, or engaging in esoteric workout routines, you increase the power your body provides to certain augmentations. If you have an augmentation that gives you a type of movement, increase that movement's Speed by 5 feet.

entities.name: Finely Tuned
entities.description:
You can adjust a common augmentation installed on your body during your daily preparations. One action with a daily frequency on that augmentation can be Activated an additional time that day.

**Special** You can take this feat multiple times. For each time you take this feat, you can adjust an additional augmentation.

entities.name: Reduce Reuse Recycle
entities.description: All commercially available augmentations are tailor-made to the individual undergoing installation. You have, however, tinkered with your body to the point where you're confident you can accept any augmentation, even one not made for you. You gain the Monster Crafting feat and can use it to gather materials needed to make augmentations to install in yourself. The augmentations must match the type of creature being salvaged, such as a construct for cybernetics, a dragon for magitech, or an undead for necrografts.

entities.name: Breaching Grenades
entities.description: You know how to throw your grenades to deal severe structural damage. All grenades you throw gain the razing trait.

entities.name: Double Toss
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per round

You Quick Toss twice. Any creature in the area of the first grenade gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its saving throw against the second grenade.

**Special** If you have the Primary Target class feature, you can select a primary target for only one of the two grenades you throw, not both.

entities.name: Grenadier Dedication
entities.description:
You specialize in throwing highly explosive portable ordnances. You become trained with grenades. You gain the Quick Toss action.

At 5th level, your proficiency rank with grenades increases to expert, and you gain access to the critical specialization effects of all grenades.

**Special** If you have the Soldier Dedication feat, you can take this feat even if you haven't taken two additional soldier archetype feats. Soldier archetype feats count as grenadier archetype feats, and vice-versa, for purposes of completing the archetypes.

entities.name: Long Thrower
entities.description: You can throw grenades a ridiculously long distance while maintaining accuracy. When you throw a grenade, it has a range of 140 feet, instead of the usual 70 feet.

entities.name: Soldier Synchronization
entities.description:
You count grenades as an area weapon with the area (burst) trait for the purposes of all soldier feats and class features, including Primary Target and Suppressing Fire. If you're holding a grenade, you meet the requirements for soldier feats that require you to wield an area weapon.

When you use primary target with a grenade, the grenade counts as a simple thrown weapon with expend 0, the area (burst) trait, and a range of 70 feet (or 140 feet if you have the Long Thrower feat). The Strike against the grenade's primary target deals one damage die of the same dice size and damage type dealt by the grenade. This damage increases to two damage dice if the grenade is advanced or superior, to three damage dice if the grenade is elite or ultimate, or to four damage dice if the grenade is paragon. If the grenade doesn't usually deal damage, it doesn't deal damage using primary target.

Stats.Prerequisites: Grenadier Dedication, primary target or suppressing fire class features

entities.name: Selective Blast
entities.description: You can put just the right spin on your grenade tosses to avoid hitting your friends or yourself. Whenever you Area Fire a grenade, you can select up to four creatures within the grenade's area; these creatures are unaffected by the grenade until the end of the Area Fire action.

entities.name: Disorienting Grenades
entities.description: You know how to take advantage of your enemies getting distracted by your explosions. A creature that fails or critically fails a saving throw against a grenade you throw additionally becomes Off-Guard against the next attack you make against it before the end of your turn.

entities.name: Extra Rebound
entities.description: You can bounce grenades off solid surfaces up to three times before they explode, rather than once. You don't need to see the surfaces, but you do need to have a general idea of where they are. If the grenade hits a solid surface you didn't expect to be there, it explodes. For example, if you toss a grenade down a hall you can't see completely, the grenade will bounce off the hall's walls and doors but would explode if it hit a chair or a janitor's cart.

entities.name: Junkomancer Dedication
entities.description: You excel at junkomancy, the art of magically sculpting trash into less-useless trash. You have researched junkomancy extensively and can even cast junk spells beyond the magical traditions of your peers. You become an expert in Crafting. Add one common junk spell of any rank you can cast to your spell list. Whenever you gain another junkomancer feat, add another common junk spell of a rank you can cast to your spell list.

Stats.Prerequisites: able to cast arcane or occult spells, trained in Crafting

entities.name: Junk Ammo
entities.description: You fabricate potent ammunition from everyday scrap. As part of your daily preparations, you create up to 10 projectiles and 1 commercial battery per character level. When you create the ammunition, choose if the ammunition counts as cold iron or silver for the purposes of applying immunities, weaknesses, and resistances. Any unexpended ammunition you created reverts into useless junk 24 hours later.

entities.name: Roughcast Armor
entities.description: You're a wiz at forging armor from junk. During your daily preparations, you can review the formula of one armor upgrade in your formula book of your level or lower. Until your next daily preparations, whenever you cast Junk Armor, you can Install this Upgrade even if there are no available upgrade slots. If you're a master in Crafting, you gain the armor specialization effect of any *junk armor* you wear.

Stats.Prerequisites: Junkomancer Dedication, able to cast junk armor, expert in Crafting

entities.name: Roughcast Weapons
entities.description: The weapons you cobble together are bigger, meaner, and junkier. During your daily preparations, you can review the formula of one weapon upgrade in your formula book of your level or lower. Until your next daily preparations, whenever you cast Junk Weapon, you can Install this Upgrade even if there are no available upgrade slots. If you're a master in Crafting, you gain access to the critical specialization effects of weapons you create using *junk weapon*.

Stats.Prerequisites: Junkomancer Dedication, able to cast junk weapon, expert in Crafting

entities.name: Junk Barricade
entities.description: You magically assemble a barricade using nearby items, junk and scrap. The barricade occupies a 5-foot square and provides lesser cover for you and one ally, though you can take-cover to increase this benefit to standard cover. The barricade has Hardness 15 and 54 HP. When destroyed, the junk barricade creates an area of clutter that is difficult terrain.

entities.name: Improved Junk Ammo
entities.description: Ammunition you create from scrap and trash is imbued with more special properties. When you create junk ammo as part of your daily preparations, choose two precious materials from the following list: abysium, adamantine, aucturnite, cold iron, siccatite, or silver. The ammunition created with this feat counts as both materials for the purposes of applying immunities, weaknesses, and resistances.

entities.name: Adaptive Talent
entities.description:
You gain the Adaptive Talent class feature, but you do not gain additional skill feats at higher levels.

**Special** You can select this feat a second time as a 10th level feat and a 16th level feat, increasing the number of skill feats you gain using adaptive talent by 1.

entities.name: Advanced Leadership
entities.description:
You gain one envoy feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your envoy level is equal to half your character level.

**Special** You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another envoy feat.

entities.name: Basic Leadership
entities.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level envoy feat of your choice.

entities.name: Envoy Dedication
entities.description:
You gain the Envoy Directives class feature, but do not gain the Lead by Example benefits of the Get 'Em! envoy directive. You become trained in Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation plus another skill of your choice. If you were already trained in Deception, Diplomacy, and Intimidation, you instead become trained in an additional skill of your choice. You also become trained in envoy class DC.

Envoy

entities.name: Leader's Confidence
entities.description: You gain the Leader's Confidence class feature.

entities.name: Really Get Em!
entities.description: You gain the Lead by Example benefit for your Get 'Em! directive, except you and your allies get a +2 status bonus to damage on both the initial and subsequent Strikes.

entities.name: Advanced Engineering
entities.description:
You gain one mechanic feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your mechanic level is equal to half your character level.

**Special** You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another mechanic feat.

entities.name: Basic Engineering
entities.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level mechanic feat of your choice.

entities.name: Expert Mechanic
entities.description: You become an expert in mechanic class DC, and in Computers or Crafting. If you're already an expert in those skills, you instead become an expert in another skill you're trained in.

entities.name: Mechanic Dedication
entities.description: You gain the Custom Rig and Exocortex class features, but you can't Modify your exocortex, and you don't gain the unique mods granted by your exocortex. You become trained in Computers and Crafting. If you were already trained in Computers and Crafting, you instead become trained in an additional skill of your choice. You also become trained in mechanic class DC.

entities.name: Mechanic's Ingenuity
entities.description: You gain the Mechanic's Ingenuity class feature. However, you gain the listed benefits at 6th and 14th level.

entities.name: Mobile Exocortex
entities.description: You gain the Mobile Exocortex class feature.

entities.name: Modify
entities.description:
You gain the Modify class feature. In addition, you can Modify your exocortex (as noted in your Exocortex} class feature), and you gain the unique mods granted by your exocortex.

**Special** If you're at least 10th level, you can select this feat a second time to gain the Damage Customizations class feature.

entities.name: Remote Mods
entities.description: You gain the Remote Mods class feature. However, you don't get the additional benefits usually acquired at 15th level.

entities.name: Advanced Mysticism
entities.description:
You gain one mystic feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your mystic level is half your character level.

**Special** You can select this feat more than once. Each time you do, you gain another mystic feat.

entities.name: Basic Epiphany
entities.description: You gain your connection's initial epiphany spell. If you don't already have one, you also gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can Refocus by reflecting on your connection.

entities.name: Basic Mystic Spellcasting
entities.description: You gain the Basic Spellcasting benefits. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the mystic archetype, add a spell of the appropriate spell rank to your repertoire: a common spell of your connection's tradition, or one of your connection's granted spells.

entities.name: Basic Mysticism
entities.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level mystic feat.

entities.name: Expanded Connection
entities.description: Increase the number of spells in your repertoire and number of spell slots you gain from mystic archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest mystic spell slots.

entities.name: Expert Mystic Spellcasting
entities.description: You gain the Expert Spellcasting benefits.

Stats.Prerequisites: Basic Mystic Spellcasting, master in connection skill

entities.name: Master Mystic Spellcasting
entities.description: You gain the Master Spellcasting benefits.

Stats.Prerequisites: Expert Mystic Spellcasting, legendary in connection skill

entities.name: Mystic Dedication
entities.description:
Choose a Connection. You become trained in the connection's skill or, if you were already trained, you become trained in a skill of your choice. You don't gain any other abilities from your choice of connection. You gain the Mystic Bond class feature.

You cast spells like a mystic and gain the Cast a Spell activity. You gain a spell repertoire with two common cantrips from the spell list granted by your connection, from the spells granted by your connection, or any other cantrips of that tradition you learn or discover. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for mystic archetype spells is Wisdom, and they are mystic spells of your connection's tradition.

Mystic

entities.name: Vitality Network
