entities.description: You gain a Vitality Network with 10 Hit Points and can use Transfer Vitality to transfer up to 10 HP. Increase the maximum capacity of your vitality network by 10 at 10th, 15th, and 20th-level. Increase the amount you can transfer by 5 at 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th-level.

entities.name: Advanced Gunner
entities.description:
You gain one operative feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your operative level is half your character level.

**Special** You can select this feat more than once. Each time you do, you gain another operative feat.

entities.name: Basic Gunner
entities.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level operative feat.

entities.name: Gun Expert
entities.description: Your proficiency ranks for simple and martial guns increase to expert.

Stats.Prerequisites: Operative Dedication, expert in any kind of weapon or unarmed attack

entities.name: Master Spy
entities.description: Your proficiency rank for Perception increases to master.

entities.name: Operative Dedication
entities.description:
You become trained in simple and martial guns. You become trained in operative class DC.

You gain the Aim action, it doesn't deal additional damage, but still reduces the bonus to AC your mark gains from cover (which does not increase as you gain levels).

Operative

entities.name: Operative Exploit
entities.description: You gain the exploit of your chosen specialization.

entities.name: Operative Resiliency
entities.description: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each operative archetype class feat you have. As you continue selecting operative archetype class feats, you continue to gain additional Hit Points in this way.

Stats.Prerequisites: Operative Dedication, class granting no more Hit Points per level than 6 + your Constitution

entities.name: Sharpshooter
entities.description: Your ranged Strikes against the target of your Aim using the required ranged weapon deal an additional 1d4 precision damage until the end of your turn. This damage increases to 2d4 at 6th level.

entities.name: Specialized Operative
entities.description: Choose a specialization. You become trained in one skill determined by your specialization; if you were already trained in that skill, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain a skill feat associated with that skill. You don't gain any other benefits from your specialization.

entities.name: Advanced Stellar Attunement
entities.description:
You gain one solarian feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your solarian level is half your character level.

**Special** You can select this feat more than once. Each time you do, you gain another solarian feat.

entities.name: Basic Stellar Attunement
entities.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level solarian feat.

entities.name: Solar Flare
entities.description: You can create and maintain a solar flare, but do not add your Strength modifier to damage rolls with your solar flare or any additional benefits based on your attunement.

entities.name: Solar Manifestation Expert
entities.description: Your proficiency ranks for solar flare, solar weapon, and your solarian class DC increases to expert.

Stats.Prerequisites: Solarian Dedication, expert in any kind of weapon or unarmed attack

entities.name: Solar Nimbus
entities.description: You gain the Nimbus Surge reaction, but do not gain any additional benefits based on your attunement.

entities.name: Solar Weapon Customization
entities.description: You can select up to one trait for your solar weapon. When you reach level 6, you can choose a second trait, or the reach or two-hand 1d10 trait instead of two traits.

entities.name: Solarian Dedication
entities.description:
You gain the stellar attunement class feature, but you do not Attune as a free action when you roll initiative. You become trained in solar flare, solar weapon, and solarian class DC.

You can manifest a solar weapon. Your weapon has the attuned and solarian traits, but you can't select additional traits and it gains no benefits based on your attunement. You gain the Re-Forge Solar Weapon action.

Solarian

entities.name: Solarian's Resiliency
entities.description: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each solarian archetype class feat you have. As you continue selecting solarian archetype class feats, you continue to gain additional Hit Points in this way.

Stats.Prerequisites: Solarian Dedication, class granting no more Hit Points per level than 8 + your Constitution modifier

entities.name: Advanced Soldier Training
entities.description:
You gain one soldier feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your soldier level is half your character level.

**Special** You can select this feat more than once. Each time you do, you gain another soldier feat.

entities.name: Basic Soldier Training
entities.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level soldier feat.

entities.name: Primary Target
entities.description: You gain the Primary Target class feature.

entities.name: Soldier Dedication
entities.description:
You become trained in Intimidation. If you were already trained in Intimidation, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. Increase your maximum and encumbered Bulk limits by 2. You become trained in soldier class DC.

You become trained in light armor and medium armor. If you already were trained in light armor and medium armor, you gain training in heavy armor as well. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in any type of armor (but not unarmored defense), you also gain that proficiency in the armor types granted to you by this feat. If you have a class feature that grants you expert proficiency in unarmored defense and you're 13th level or higher, you also become an expert in the armor types granted to you by this feat.

Soldier

entities.name: Soldier's Resiliency
entities.description: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each soldier archetype class feat you have. As you continue selecting soldier archetype class feats, you continue to gain additional Hit Points in this way.

Stats.Prerequisites: Soldier Dedication, class granting no more Hit Points per level than 8 + your Constitution modifier

entities.name: Soldier's Toughness
entities.description: Your proficiency rank in Fortitude saves increases to master.

Stats.Prerequisites: Soldier Dedication, expert in Fortitude saves

entities.name: Suppressing Fire
entities.description: You gain the Suppressing Fire class feature.

entities.name: Advanced Technomancy
entities.description:
You gain one technomancer feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your technomancer level is half your character level.

**Special** You can select this feat more than once. Each time you do, you gain another technomancer feat.

entities.name: Basic Magic Hack
entities.description: You gain your programming language's initial magic hack spell. If you don't already have one, you also gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point.

entities.name: Basic Technomancer Spellcasting
entities.description: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the technomancer archetype, add two common arcane spells of the appropriate spell rank to your database.

entities.name: Basic Technomancy
entities.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level technomancer feat of your choice.

entities.name: Expert Technomancer Spellcasting
entities.description: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

Stats.Prerequisites: Basic Technomancer Spellcasting, master in Arcana

entities.name: Firmware Enhancement
entities.description: You gain your programming language's firmware enhancement.

entities.name: Jailbreak the System
entities.description: You gain the Jailbreak Spell class feature. You gain the spellshape and basic jailbreak benefit listed in your programming language.

entities.name: Master Technomancer Spellcasting
entities.description: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

Stats.Prerequisites: Expert Technomancer Spellcasting, legendary in Arcana

entities.name: Overclock Pulse Expert
entities.description: You gain your programming language's Overclock Pulse action. After you use this action, your gear stops being overclocked.

entities.name: Parallel Computing
entities.description: Your repertoire expands. Increase the number of spells in your database and the number of spell slots you gain from technomancer archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest technomancer spell slots.

entities.name: Technomancer Dedication
entities.description:
Choose a Programming Language. You gain the Overclock Gear action. You gain your programming language's overclock boost benefits as if you were a 1st-level technomancer.

You cast spells like a technomancer, gaining a spell database with two common arcane cantrips of your choice. You gain access to the Cast a Spell activity. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for technomancer archetype spells is Intelligence, and they're arcane technomancer spells.

entities.name: Advanced Distortion
entities.description:
You gain one witchwarper feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your witchwarper level is half your character level.

**Special** You can select this feat more than once. Each time you do, you gain another witchwarper feat.

entities.name: Basic Distortion
entities.description: Your disruptive powers grow. You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level witchwarper feat.

entities.name: Basic Quantum Field
entities.description: Your quantum field gains the effect of your chosen paradox.

entities.name: Basic Warp Spell
entities.description: You gain your paradox's initial warp spell. If you don't already have one, you also gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can Refocus by contemplating infinite worlds. (For more on warp spells, see page 165.)

entities.name: Basic Witchwarper Spellcasting
entities.description: You gain the Basic Spellcasting benefits. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the witchwarper archetype, add a spell of the appropriate spell rank to your repertoire: a common spell of your paradox's tradition, or one of your paradox's granted spells.

entities.name: Expert Witchwarper Spellcasting
entities.description: You gain the Expert Spellcasting benefits.

Stats.Prerequisites: Basic Witchwarper Spellcasting, master in Arcana or Occultism, depending on paradox

entities.name: Master Witchwarper Spellcasting
entities.description: You gain the Master Spellcasting benefits.

Stats.Prerequisites: Expert Witchwarper Spellcasting, legendary in Arcana or Occultism, depending on paradox

entities.name: Quantum Breadth
entities.description: Your repertoire expands, and you can cast more spells of your paradox's tradition each day. Increase the number of spells in your repertoire and number of spell slots you gain from witchwarper archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest witchwarper spell slots.

entities.name: Witchwarper Dedication
entities.description:
Choose a paradox. You become trained in the paradox's skill or, if you were already trained, you become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the Warp Reality action, but your quantum field is a 10-foot burst.

You cast spells like a witchwarper. You gain access to the Cast a Spell activity. You gain a spell repertoire with two common cantrips from the spell list associated with your paradox, from the spells granted by your paradox, or any other cantrips of that tradition you learn or discover. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for witchwarper archetype spells is your choice of Intelligence or Charisma, and they are witchwarper spells of your paradox's tradition. You don't gain any other abilities from your choice of paradox.

Witchwarper

entities.name: Enhanced Nanite Armaments
entities.description: You've upgraded your nanites to be able to form even more complex weapons. When you use Alteration Array, add the following traits to those you can choose from for your nanite unarmed attack: backswing, grapple, or kickback. In addition, you can choose to give your nanite unarmed attack one of the following traits instead of choosing two from the normal list: boost (1d8), deadly (1d8), or reach.

entities.name: Naknight Form
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

When faced with danger, your nanites can envelop your body in a shimmering metallic armor. You gain the effects of a 5th-rank Elemental Form spell, except that you must choose either metal or water as your element, and you gain weakness 10 to electricity while the effect is active. At 14th level, you gain the effects of a 6th-rank *elemental form* spell, and at 18th level, you gain the effects of a 7th-rank *elemental form* spell.

entities.name: Repair Array
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

Your nanites knit together wounds. You or another creature within 10 feet of you gains fast healing equal to half your level for 1 minute, then becomes temporarily immune to Repair Array for 24 hours. If the creature takes electricity damage, the fast healing ends immediately.

Effect: Repair Array

entities.name: Corrosive Array
entities.description:
**Requirements** Your Cloud Array is active.

You command your nanites to sweep across the battlefield, damaging your enemies. You extend the duration of the cloud created by your Cloud Array until the end of your next turn, then you can move each square of the cloud up to 10 feet. The squares must each be contiguous to at least one other square of the cloud when the movement is complete. Until the start of your next turn, enemies that start their turn in the cloud take floor @actor.level/4 d6 acid |options:area-damage damage with a  save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. At 16th level and every four levels thereafter, increase the acid damage by 1d6.

entities.name: Restoration Protocol
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You or a creature within 10 feet would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.

To well-programmed nanites, a body is simply another array to assemble. The triggering creature and its equipment are engulfed in a thick nanite mist and vanish, reappearing in a free space within 30 feet. The target remains at 1 Hit Point, gains a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level for 1 minute, then becomes Wounded 1 or increases the value of its wounded condition by 1.

Effect: Restoration Protocol

entities.name: Nanocyte Dedication
entities.description:
Your body is infused with nanites programmed to execute specific protocols called arrays. During your daily preparations, you can register one or more pieces of equipment in your possession as nanocyte gear until your next daily preparations. You can't have more registered nanocyte gear than the number of nanocyte archetype feats you have, and no piece of nanocyte gear can have a Bulk greater than your Constitution modifier.

Your nanites completely cover your registered nanocyte gear, allowing it to be harmlessly broken down and stored within your body. While stowed, your nanocyte gear is hidden from inspection that can't detect nanites. If your registered nanocyte gear is more than 10 feet away from you at the end of your turn, it turns into its nanite form and returns to your body, stowed. If you are knocked Unconscious or die, stowed nanocyte gear appears in your space, fully formed.

In addition, you gain the Gear Array action.

**Special** You can use Gear Array as a free action triggered when you roll for initiative.

entities.name: Alteration Array
entities.description:
Your nanites shape your body into a fluid weapon with customized features as you require them. When you use this action, you gain a nanite unarmed attack for 1 minute. Your nanite unarmed attack deals 1d6 damage, has the tech trait, and is in the brawling group. When you use this action, choose from bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing, and choose two of the following traits: finesse, forceful, razing, shove, or trip. Your nanite unarmed attack deals that type of damage and has those traits.

**Special** You can use Alteration Array as a free action triggered when you roll for initiative instead of using Gear Array.

entities.name: Cloud Array
entities.description: Your nanites become a silvery cloud. The cloud covers a number of contiguous 5-foot squares equal to your Constitution modifier, at least one of which must be adjacent to you. It persists for 1 round and grants all creatures within lesser cover.

entities.name: Ferrofluid Defense
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Trigger** You're hit by a Strike.

Your nanites surge out of your body to form a shield. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last until the start of your next turn.

entities.name: Magitech Nanites
entities.description: Your nanites are infused with magic to recreate spell effects. Choose two common cantrips from the arcane spell list. You can cast those cantrips as arcane innate spells at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

entities.name: Nanite Bind
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

Your nanites shoot forth and wrap around the limbs of a creature within 10 feet, binding them together with a powerful magnetic force. The target must attempt a  save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is Off-Guard to the next attack made against it.

**Failure** As success, and the creature is Suppressed until the end of its next turn.

**Critical Failure** As success, and the creature is suppressed until the end of its next turn and knocked Prone.

entities.name: Debilitating Nanites
entities.description:
**Requirements** You're wielding a melee weapon registered as nanocyte gear, or you have a nanite unarmed attack.

You attack and infect your target, eroding them and hampering their movements from within. Attempt a melee Strike with the required weapon or unarmed attack. If you hit and deal damage, the target takes an additional 1d4 persistent,acid damage and becomes Clumsy 1 for 1 round. On a critical hit, the target becomes Clumsy 2 instead.

entities.name: Nanite Wave
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

You unleash your nanites in a wave of metal. Enemies in a 15-foot take floor @actor.level/2 d6 bludgeoning |options:area-damage damage and must attempt a  save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. Increase the bludgeoning damage by 1d6 at 8th level and every two levels thereafter.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage and is knocked back 5 feet away from you.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage and is knocked back 10 feet away from you.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage and is knocked back 15 feet away from you.

entities.name: Airborne Array
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

Your nanites disperse your consciousness and body into a cloud, allowing you to transcend the limits of your physical frame. You gain the effects of a 3rd-rank Vapor Form spell for 1 minute or until you Dismiss the effect.

entities.name: Quickened Nanites
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** Your turn begins.

Your nanites move as rapidly as your thoughts. You become Quickened until the end of your turn and can use the extra action only to use Alteration Array or Gear Array.

entities.name: Refracting Cloud
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

Your nanites refract light and reflect sound. If your next action is to use Cloud Array, creatures within the cloud are Concealed in addition to gaining lesser cover, and creatures outside the cloud are concealed to those within it.

entities.name: Pharmacologist Dedication
entities.description:
You study and brew medicine to treat patients. You become an expert in Medicine, and you gain the Serum Crafting feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites. You can use Medicine instead of Crafting to Craft medical consumables.

Each day during your daily preparations, you can make four medical consumables with an item level up to your level. You must know each item's formula. An item created this way is a temporary item and loses its potency the next time you make your daily preparations if you haven't already used it.

entities.name: Efficient Clinician
entities.description:
You know how to effectively and safely administer medication in dire situations. You Interact to draw a medical consumable and Activate it.

**Special** If you have the Inject Serum skill feat, you can use Efficient Medicator as a 2-action activity to Interact to draw a hypopen or serum, Interact to load that consumable into an injection weapon you're holding, then Strike with that weapon.

entities.name: Inorganic Adjustments
entities.description: You've learned how to apply engineering and necromancy to help heal constructs and undead. Medical consumables you create with Pharmacologist Dedication during your daily preparations affect constructs (if you're trained in Crafting) and undead (if you're trained in Religion) as if they were living creatures.

Stats.Prerequisites: Pharmacologist Dedication, trained in Crafting or Religion

entities.name: Medical Weapon Familiarity
entities.description:
You know how to use the tools of your trade so well you're capable of using weapons with similar features to defend yourself. You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the injection trait and all uncommon weapons in the knife weapon group. For the purposes of proficiency, you treat any injection and knife weapons that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons. When wielding a simple weapon with the injection trait or in the knife group, you increase the damage die size of that weapon by one step.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with an injection weapon or a weapon in the knife group, you get its critical specialization effect.

entities.name: Advanced Pharmacologist
entities.description:
You've made further medical advances, enabling you to make a greater number of medical consumables every day. You can create two additional medical consumables during your daily preparations.

**Special** You can select this feat a second time.

entities.name: Crisis Care
entities.description: By winning the trust of a panicking patient, you can apply world-class care. Whenever you use a medical consumable that restores a creature's Hit Points or removes a condition, that creature gains temporary Hit Points equal to the item's level for 1 minute. The target is then immune to Crisis Care for 10 minutes.

entities.name: Pharmaceutical Spell
entities.description:
**Requirements** You're holding a medical consumable.

You can weave magic and medicine together to save lives. If your next action is to Cast a Spell with the healing trait, you can expend a medical consumable you're holding. One willing target affected by your spell is also affected by the medical consumable.

entities.name: Dual Shielded Defense
entities.description: When you Raise a Shield, you can raise up to two shields at once. Additionally, at the start of each of your turns, you gain an additional reaction that you can use only to Shield Block.

entities.name: Mirror Shield
entities.description:
**Trigger** An opponent casting a spell that targets you critically fails a spell attack roll against your AC.

**Requirements** You have a shield raised.

Make a ranged attack roll against the attacker using your highest proficiency with a ranged weapon. If you cast spells, you can choose to make a spell attack roll instead. If you succeed, your opponent takes the effects of a successful spell attack roll for their own spell (or the effects of a critical success if your attack roll was a critical success).

entities.name: Shield Ace Dedication
entities.description: Whether to protect yourself or your allies, your training emphasizes effective use and maintenance of shields. You gain the Shield Block general feat and the Quick Repair skill feat. Whenever you successfully Repair a shield, you restore additional Hit Points to the shield equal to your level.

entities.name: Area Defender
entities.description:
You can use your shield to protect yourself from explosions and other area attacks. You can use the Shield Block reaction while you have your shield raised and you would take physical damage from an area effect, even if that effect isn't an attack, in addition to its usual trigger. When you do, if you're between any allies and the source of the damage (the origin of a line or cone or the center of a burst or emanation), you prevent damage to those allies up to the shield's Hardness.

You can use Area Defender to Shield Block area effects that deal energy damage if you can Shield Block when you would take energy damage from an attack, such as with the Energetic Defender feat or a shield with the blocking trait.

entities.name: Energetic Defender
entities.description: Your shield blocks more than just projectiles. You can use the Shield Block reaction while you have your shield raised and you would take energy damage from an attack, in addition to its usual trigger. Whenever you Shield Block with a shield that has the blocking trait for the same type of damage you would take, that shield gains the deflecting trait for that damage type against the triggering attack.

entities.name: Guarded Repositioning
entities.description:
**Requirements** You have your shield raised.

You keep your guard up and Stride up to half your Speed; and this movement doesn't trigger reactions.

entities.name: Shield Warden
entities.description: When you have a shield raised, you can use your Shield Block reaction when an attack is made against an ally adjacent to you. If you do, the shield prevents that ally from taking damage instead of preventing you from taking damage, following the normal rules for Shield Block.

entities.name: Always on Alert
entities.description: After countless unexpected encounters you've developed a second sense for danger. You can perform the Scout exploration activity at the same time as the Avoid Notice, Investigate, or Search exploration activity. The bonus to initiative you grant when you Scout is +2 instead of +1.

entities.name: Mission Briefing
entities.description: Coming prepared to mission briefings gives you extra time to ask questions and research a topic relevant to your next adventure. You are trained in Mission Lore, a special Lore skill that can be used only to Recall Knowledge, but on any topic related to an assignment, mission, or quest performed on behalf of another individual or organization. If you fail a check to Recall Knowledge with Mission Lore, you get the effects of the Dubious Knowledge skill feat unless the question was already answered during a mission briefing. If you have legendary proficiency in Society, you gain expert proficiency in Mission Lore, but you can't increase your proficiency rank in Mission Lore by any other means.

entities.name: Starfinder Field Agent Dedication
entities.description:
You are a trained agent of the Starfinder Society. You become an expert in Society. You gain the Additional Lore feat for Starfinder Society Lore; if you were already trained in Starfinder Society Lore, you also become trained in a Lore skill of your choice.

**Special** You can take this feat if you have the Xenoarchaeologist Archetype Dedication feat even if you haven't taken two additional xenoarchaeologist feats. Xenoarchaeologist archetype feats count as Starfinder field agent feats, and vice-versa, for purposes of completing the archetypes.

Starfinder Field Agent

Stats.Prerequisites: member of the Starfinder Society, trained in Society

entities.name: Starfinder Provisions
entities.description: The Starfinder Society provides you with provisions to aid you on your adventures. Each day during your daily preparations while you're in a settlement, a Starfinder Society delivery drone delivers two consumable items with an item level no higher than half your level. The drone might not be able to arrive if you're in a remote location or based on GM's discretion. If you receive a subsequent delivery and have items remaining from the prior delivery, you must return any unused consumables to the drone before receiving new stock.

entities.name: Swap Upgrades
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Requirements** You are holding a repair kit, or you are wearing it and have a hand free.

You've meticulously prepared your gear to allow for quick adjustments in the field without damaging any delicate components. You draw and Install an Upgrade into a wielded weapon or worn armor. You can uninstall and stow an upgrade as part of this activity. If you have master proficiency in Crafting, you can Install two upgrades.

entities.name: Veteran Trap Finder
entities.description: You can use Mission Lore instead of Computers or Thievery to disable traps in locations you researched using Mission Briefing. You can disable traps that require a proficiency rank of master in Computers or Thievery. If you have master proficiency in Computers or Thievery, you can disable traps that require a proficiency rank of legendary in that skill instead, and increase the circumstance bonus you gain from Danger Awareness to +2.

entities.name: Roadkill
entities.description:
**Requirements** You're piloting a vehicle.

Every vehicle is a weapon. Whenever you Run Over, you can use your class DC in place of the vehicle's collision DC. Your vehicle can Run Over any number of creatures up to one size smaller than the vehicle or ram any one target creature or object in your path up to the size of your vehicle.

entities.name: Drive-By Attack
entities.description:
**Requirements** You're piloting a vehicle.

You can smoothly line up an attack without disrupting your control. You Drive, gaining the effects of the Drive action for the same number of actions you spent to Drive-By Attack. At any point during your vehicle's movement, you Strike.

entities.name: Vehicle Pilot Dedication
entities.description: You know the ins and outs of piloting, including just how far you can push a vehicle. You become an expert in Piloting. You gain the Stunt Maneuver skill feat. Whenever you attempt a 2-action Drive, you can turn normally.

entities.name: Defensive Driving
entities.description: They say the weakest part of any vehicle is the pilot, so you've learned how to protect that critical component by shielding yourself as you maneuver through the battlefield. While piloting a vehicle, you have lesser cover. If you would already have lesser cover, you instead gain standard cover. If you would already have standard cover, you instead gain greater cover.

entities.name: Shake 'Em Off
entities.description:
**Requirements** You're piloting a vehicle.

You drive erratically, swerving from side to side or changing speeds. Attempt a  check against the Fortitude DC of one creature aboard the vehicle you're piloting.

**Critical Success** You move the creature up to 5 feet in a direction of your choice, and they fall Prone. If they're Climbing on the exterior or your vehicle, you instead knock them off your vehicle.

**Success** The creature falls prone, or if they're Climbing on the exterior of your vehicle, they're knocked off your vehicle.

**Critical Failure** A random ally on your vehicle falls prone.

entities.name: Shielding Kickflip
entities.description:
**Requirements** You're piloting a Hoverboard.

You use careful angling to turn your hoverboard into a makeshift shield. You can Raise a Shield and Shield Block with your hoverboard, and you're wielding your hoverboard as long as you're piloting it. Your hoverboard is a commercial-grade shield that grants a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and can be improved.

entities.name: Crash Ready
entities.description: You know how to expertly mitigate the damage from a crash. Whenever you Run Over, or a vehicle you're piloting is Run Over, reduce the collision damage dealt to you and your vehicle by your character level.

Stats.Prerequisites: Vehicle Pilot Dedication, master in Piloting

entities.name: Hover Pro
entities.description: Whenever you use an action with the traversal trait, if you're piloting a hoverboard, you can substitute a Drive action in place of the Stride action. In addition, while piloting a Hoverboard, you can Leap, using your hoverboard's speed in place of your own, and you can roll a Piloting check in place of an Athletics check when you high-jump skill=piloting or long-jump skill=piloting. If you critically fail and would fall Prone, you're also thrown off your hoverboard.

Stats.Prerequisites: Vehicle Pilot Dedication, master in Piloting

entities.name: Go to Ground!
entities.description:
You succinctly direct your allies to find cover by any means necessary. You and all allies within 60 feet count any form of lesser cover as standard cover until the start of your next turn.

**Lead by Example** If you used two actions, Take Cover. Any allies within 60 feet can Take Cover as a reaction.

entities.name: Pardon Me
entities.description: You distract your foes with a clever comment as you maneuver around them. You can use  instead of Acrobatics to Tumble Through using the target's Will DC instead of Reflex DC. When you successfully Tumble Through using Deception, the foe whose space you passed through is Suppressed until the end of its next turn.

entities.name: Quip
entities.description:
**Trigger** A creature within 30 feet is damaged by an ally's Strike.

You follow up on your ally's success by hurling a cunning, well-timed taunt at a foe they wounded. Attempt to Demoralize the triggering creature.

entities.name: Size Up
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

You spend 1 minute observing a specific individual, 10 minutes researching a specific individual on the infosphere, or 1 hour networking and gathering information. This subject is your asset. If you assess your asset via observation, you don't need to know their identity, but if you assess your asset via research or networking, you must know their identity, which requires at least two relevant pieces of information about them. Examples of relevant information could include their name, their place of origin, their current residence, the name of their parent or significant other, their employer, or their organizational affiliation. The GM determines what constitutes relevant information for this purpose, based on the asset you've selected.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, and Perception checks against or in relation to your asset, and a +1 circumstance bonus to attempts to Recall Knowledge about your asset.

You gain the benefits of the 2-action Get 'Em! when using 1-action Get 'Em! on an asset.

You can maintain a number of assets equal to your Charisma modifier. If you Size Up other assets after that, your new asset replaces a previous one.

Effect: Size Up

entities.name: Take 'Em Alive!
entities.description:
You urge your allies to take down your enemies without incurring any loss of life. Until the beginning of your next turn, you and your allies can add the nonlethal trait to your attacks with weapons (without taking the normal penalty), and to your spells that deal damage and don't have the death or void trait.

**Lead by Example** If you used two actions, Strike a target with a nonlethal attack. On a success, you gain a status bonus to damage equal to your Charisma modifier. On a critical success, an ally within 30 feet can Strike the target as a reaction using a nonlethal attack.

Effect: Take 'Em Alive

entities.name: Watch Out
entities.description:
**Trigger** A creature targets an ally within 60 feet with an attack, and you can see both the attacker and your ally.

You signal a warning to your ally, granting them a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

Effect: Watch Out

entities.name: Cut 'Em Deep
entities.description:
Your insults and threats almost always hit the mark. When you roll a failure on a Demoralize action, you get a success instead. You can still critically fail.

When you successfully Demoralize the target of your Get 'Em!, the target doesn't become immune to your further attempts to Demoralize them.

entities.name: Got 'Em
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per round

**Trigger** An ally's Strike hits the target of your Get 'Em!

You provide a quick follow-up to your ongoing directive, encouraging your ally when they successfully hit your designated target. Your ally gains a status bonus to damage equal to your Charisma modifier.

Effect: Got 'Em

entities.name: Smooth Diversions
entities.description:
You're practiced in the art of diverting attention quickly and subtly. When you succeed at an attempt to Create a Diversion, you can immediately Sneak or Step as a free action.

Additionally, creatures only become aware you were trying to trick them if you critically fail to Create a Diversion. Otherwise the creature assumes that your diversion was part of your regular bravado.

entities.name: Tag Team
entities.description:
**Trigger** The target of your Get 'Em! is critically hit by an ally's attack or critically fails a Reflex save against an ally's attack or spell.

You seize the opening your ally has provided, quickly attacking your foe. Make a Strike against the triggering creature. If it's a ranged Strike, it must be in your weapon's first range increment. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

entities.name: Secondary Directive
entities.description:
**Requirements** Your last action this turn was issuing a 2-action directive.

You follow-up your issued directive with an understood order by attacking a notable foe. Make a Strike. If the Strike hits, the target is affected by a 1-action Get 'Em.

entities.name: Situational Awareness
entities.description: You Ready a directive. If the trigger you designated occurs before the start of your next turn, you can use the 2-action version of the directive instead of the 1-action.

entities.name: That'll Show 'Em
entities.description: When you warn an ally of an attack, you follow up with a shot at your enemy. The first time each round you use your Watch Out reaction, you can make a melee or ranged Strike against the triggering creature. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike. If you hit, your target is Suppressed until the start of its next turn.

entities.name: Unstoppable Directives
entities.description:
Your confidence is a battery that keeps your allies going. When you use a directive that grants temporary Hit Points, increase the temporary Hit Points by your level. When you use a directive that doesn't grant temporary Hit Points, you can grant one ally affected by that directive temporary Hit Points equal to half your level. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute.

Effect: Unstoppable Directives

entities.name: Down to the Wire
entities.description:
**Trigger** The final action on your turn is a 1-action directive.

You act quickly to show your teammates exactly how it's done. Resolve the directive you just issued as though it was a 2-action version instead of the 1-action that you used.

entities.name: Master Plan
entities.description: During your daily preparations, you can review stratagems with up to five allies. Later, you can quickly advise each of these allies on your schemes using the New Plan reaction.

entities.name: Ready to Roll
entities.description:
**Trigger** You roll initiative.

You instinctively react to trouble by directing your allies to act at the exact moment their intervention would matter most. Issue a 1-action directive.

entities.name: You Can Do It
entities.description:
**Requirements** Your last action was a 1-action directive.

You motivate an ally within 60 feet to lead by example. As a free action, that ally can immediately perform the lead by example actions of your last action, gaining any benefits and using any abilities that would normally be used as if you used two-actions to issue the direction. Use your Charisma modifier instead of your ally's when determining any relevant benefits, such as the status bonus to damage for Get 'Em!

entities.name: Effortless Influencer
entities.description:
You've become such a master manipulator that spotting an opening to ply your influence has become second nature. You gain the Assurance skill feat three times for Deception, Diplomacy, and Intimidation. Furthermore, when you succeed at a check with Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation, allies within 60 feet who witnessed your success gain a +1 status bonus to the next check they attempt with that skill within 1 minute (or a +2 bonus if your check was a critical success).

Effect: Effortless Influencer

entities.name: Extend Directive
entities.description:
**Trigger** Your turn begins, and you issued a 2-action directive on your last turn.

With exceptional flair, you can repeat your orders with a single word or gesture. You immediately issue the 1-action version of the directive that you issued on your previous turn.

entities.name: Get Them!
entities.description: When you use Get 'Em!, you can choose any number of enemies within range instead of a single target (you still only Strike one target if you spent 2 actions).

entities.name: Fast Synergy
entities.description: People follow your lead because you help push them to their ultimate potential. Each of your allies gain a second reaction if they start their turn within 100 feet of you and can perceive you. This second reaction can only be used for directives you issue.

entities.name: Improvised Legend
entities.description: You can use Improvised Mastery once per hour, rather than twice per day.

entities.name: Acquire Asset
entities.description: You assess a foe while in the thick of battle by observing their reactions to your attack. Make a melee or ranged Strike against a creature that isn't your asset. On a hit, your target becomes your asset as if you'd used Size Up. On a critical hit, you can also immediately attempt a check to Recall Knowledge about the target.

entities.name: Change of Plans
entities.description:
**Trigger** The target of your Get 'Em! is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

**Requirements** You used Get 'Em! against a creature on your last turn.

When the target you directed your allies to take down falls Unconscious or is destroyed, you quickly direct them at another target. You use Get 'Em! against a new target following all the normal targeting restrictions for Get 'Em! You don't count as leading by example against this new target.

entities.name: Don't You Die on Me
entities.description: You encourage your ally to hang on and keep going, despite life-threatening wounds or other serious injuries that might take them out. Select an adjacent dying ally. Reduce the target's dying value by 1. If this would reduce their dying value to 0, they lose the dying condition, don't increase their wounded condition, and remain Unconscious. The targeted ally then becomes temporarily immune to Don't You Die on Me for 1 hour.

entities.name: Get in There!
entities.description:
You urge your allies to hustle into the fight or to get out of the way. Until the beginning of your next turn, you and your allies within 100 feet who can sense you gain a +5-foot status bonus to Speed. As your envoy level increases, increase the bonus by an additional 5 feet at 7th level, 12th level, and 17th level.

Effect: Get in There!

**Lead by Example** If you used two actions, Step or Stride. Each of your allies within 100 feet who can sense you can immediately Step or Stride up to half their Speed (rounded down to the nearest 5 feet) as a reaction.

entities.name: Search High and Low!
entities.description:
You alert your allies to look for enemies and Hidden things in a stressful situation, coordinating their efforts so they can do so more efficiently. Until the beginning of your next turn, you and your allies gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to Seek. As your envoy level increases, increase the bonus to +3 at 7th level, +4 at 12th level, and +5 at 17th level.

Effect: Search High and Low!

**Lead by Example** If you used two actions, Seek. Each of your allies within 100 feet who can sense you can also immediately Seek as a reaction.

entities.name: Endlessly Adaptive
entities.description: Your varied life experiences let you adapt to nearly any situation. When you gain skill feats using adaptive talent, you gain two additional skill feats. In addition, you can adapt to the day's challenges by spending 10 minutes to plan. If you do, you can reselect the feats chosen with adaptive talent as if you'd made your daily preparations. You can't trade out feats with limited-use abilities that you've already used that day.

entities.name: True Leader
entities.description: You've worked with a team for so long that you've learned to convey orders with a glance, a single word, or the tiniest flick of your hand (or suitable appendage, depending on ancestry). Once per turn, you can issue a 1-action envoy directive as a free action. This directive doesn't count toward your total number of directives issued this turn.

entities.name: Diverse Schemes
entities.description: You're an efficient multitasker, and you always have more than one goal in mind or scheme on the go. You can maintain twice your Charisma modifier of assets.

entities.name: Influence
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You're about to roll a Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation check, but you haven't rolled yet.

With masterful timing and a careful choice of words, you can manipulate the emotions and thoughts of others. You roll the triggering Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation check twice, and use the higher result.

entities.name: Not in the Face
entities.description:
**Trigger** A creature targets you with a melee attack.

You wave your arms to shield your face from harm and cower, acting meek and pitiful. Attempt a  check against the triggering creature's Will DC. The triggering creature is then immune to Not in the Face for 1 hour.

**Critical Success** Your attacker has second thoughts about harming you and is thoroughly thrown off. It takes a –2 status penalty to attack and damage rolls against you until the start of its next turn.

**Success** Your attacker is thrown off. It takes a –1 status penalty to attack rolls against you until the start of its next turn.

**Failure** Your attacker is temporarily thrown off. It takes a –1 status penalty to the triggering attack roll.

**Critical Failure** Your attacker is unaffected.

Effect: Not in the Face

entities.name: Saw it Coming
entities.description:
**Trigger** You're about to roll initiative.

You read the demeanor, body language, and instinctive tics of your foes as easily as you read a comm unit, allowing you to react a moment before those around you and gain an edge in the coming battle. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your initiative roll, and you can immediately do one of the following: Interact to draw a weapon, Step, or Stride.

entities.name: Dirty Retort
entities.description:
**Trigger** A creature misses you with a melee Strike.

You turn the tables on your attacker, using underhanded tactics to temporarily hinder it, such as throwing dirt in its eyes, shining a light in its face, pulling its coat over its head, or otherwise being a meddlesome nuisance. The triggering creature becomes your choice of Clumsy 1 or Enfeebled 1 until the end of its next turn.

entities.name: Distant Feint
entities.description: You're an incredible actor, and you can use your over-the-top bits and dramatic gestures to throw a foe off its game. If you're wielding a ranged weapon, you can Feint against an opponent at a range of 100 feet, rather than just within melee reach. If you succeed, the opponent is Off-Guard against your melee and ranged attacks, rather than only your melee attacks.

entities.name: Hang in There
entities.description:
You encourage yourself or an ally, psyching them up for a coming challenge and granting them temporary Hit Points. Choose yourself or an ally within 30 feet, then attempt a DC 20 check. If you have master proficiency in Diplomacy, you can instead attempt a DC 30 check to increase the temporary Hit Points gained on a successful check by 5. If you have legendary proficiency, you can instead attempt a DC 40 check to increase the temporary Hit Points gained on a successful check by 10. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute. The target is then temporarily immune to your Hang in There for 1 day.

**Critical Success** The target gains temporary Hit Points equal to double their level plus your Charisma modifier.

**Success** The target gains temporary Hit Points equal to their level plus your Charisma modifier.

**Failure** The target is unaffected, and you can't use Hang in There again for 1 minute.

**Critical Failure** The target is unaffected, and you can't use Hang in There again for 1 hour.

entities.name: Hurry
entities.description: You urge an ally to pick up the pace and contribute more to the events happening around them. One ally within 30 feet who can sense you becomes Quickened for 1 round. They can use the extra action to Interact, Step, or Stride. The target is then temporarily immune to Hurry for the next 10 minutes.

entities.name: Cheer Up
entities.description: You encourage an adjacent ally to overcome their minor ailments by patting them on the back, providing them useful advice, or offering some form of comfort or inspiration. The target reduces the value of one of the following conditions of their choice by 2: Clumsy, Enfeebled, Frightened, Sickened, Stupefied. The target then becomes temporarily immune to Cheer Up for 1 day.

entities.name: Confounding Disquisition
entities.description:
You attempt to enthrall a foe with a convoluted and utterly pointless monologue that leaves your audience dumbfounded. Attempt a  or  check against the Will DC of a single creature within 30 feet. The target is then temporarily immune to your Confounding Disquisition for 1 day.

**Critical Success** The target is Stunned 1 and is Stupefied 1 for 1 round.

**Success** The target is stupefied 1 for 1 round.

**Failure** The target takes a –1 status penalty to Perception checks and Will saves for 1 round.

Effect: Confounding Disquisition (Failure)

**Critical Failure** The target is unaffected.

entities.name: Look Alive
entities.description:
You warn your ally to move away from danger. You can use Watch Out before an ally in range attempts a Reflex save in addition to its original trigger. If you do, the circumstance bonus applies to their Reflex save against the triggering effect.

When you use Watch Out and the triggering attack fails or critically fails, or your ally succeeds or critically succeeds at the saving throw, your ally can also Stride up to 10 feet as a free action.

entities.name: Sidestep
entities.description:
**Trigger** The attack roll for a Strike targeting you fails.

You deftly step out of the way of an attack, letting the blow continue to the creature next to you. You redirect the attack to a creature of your choice that's adjacent to you and within range or reach of the triggering attack. The attacker rerolls the Strike's attack roll against the new target.

entities.name: Commercial Customization
entities.description:
You've modified your drone, granting it a new ability. Your drone gains one additional commercial customization.

**Special** You can select this feat up to three times.

entities.name: Critical Explosion
entities.description: Your mines use bursts of shrapnel that shred through a creature, causing lasting harm. A creature that fails its saving throw against one of your mines takes an additional 1 persistent damage (or persistent damage equal to your Intelligence modifier on a critical failure). If the mine dealt physical damage, this is persistent bleed damage. Otherwise, the persistent damage is of the same type dealt by the mine.

entities.name: Explosive Shot
entities.description:
You've designed a nozzle that can split fire into dangerous new shapes. You gain the following new mod.

- **Explosive Shot (weapon):** Strikes with the modded item deal an additional 1 splash damage per weapon damage die. This splash damage is the same damage type the modded item deals.

entities.name: High-Tech Medic
entities.description:
You can make the most of limited medical supplies. You can store up to 3 items with the healing or serum trait in your custom rig. You gain the following new mods.

- **Numbing Analgesic (medpatch or serum):** In addition to its usual effects, the item reduces the value of the Sickened condition by 1.

- **Powerful Stimulant (medpatch or serum):** In addition to its usual effects, the item reduces the value of the Enfeebled or Frightened condition by 1.

- **Protective Excretions (medpatch or serum):** In addition to its usual effects, the item attempts a DC 10 to end one persistent damage type afflicting the target with a DC of 10.

- **Restorative Boost (medpatch or serum):** In addition to its usual effect, the item grants fast healing equal to half the item's level (rounded up) for 3 rounds.

entities.name: High Voltage
entities.description: Your drone can discharge excess electricity. Your drone gains the Electrical Discharge action.

entities.name: Shielded Turret
entities.description: Your turret is bulky. Your turret provides standard cover instead of lesser cover. Taking Cover behind it provides greater cover.

entities.name: Spontaneous Crafting
entities.description:
**Requirements** You're holding or wearing your custom rig.

You swiftly craft items. Choose a common level 0 weapon, shield, or piece of adventuring gear of 1 Bulk or less. The item lasts for 1 hour or until you next use Spontaneous Crafting.

entities.name: Advanced Customization
entities.description:
You've further modified your drone, granting it a new ability. Your drone gains one additional advanced customization.

**Special** You can select this feat up to three times.

entities.name: Deploy Bunker
entities.description:
**Requirements** Your drone or turret is in a space that includes a solid surface.

Your drone or turret plants itself on the ground, then extends retractable barriers that create a temporary wall. You either create a 5-foot-wide metal wall in a space adjacent to your drone or turret, or you extend a wall you've already created by an additional 5 feet, up to a maximum of 15 feet. The walls created by your exocortex are 1 inch thick, 5 feet high, and placed vertically on the border between squares. They must be placed on a solid horizontal surface. The walls are a part of your exocortex and use the the same statistics and Hit Points.

These walls automatically retract back into your exocortex if the drone or turret that created the walls moves (or is forced to move) from its location.

entities.name: Energy Expulsion
entities.description:
**Requirements** Your turret's array deals energy damage.

You've customized your turret to fire explosive blasts of energy. Make a ranged Strike with your turret against a target. Regardless of the result of the attack, additional energy from this shot is expelled around your turret, dealing damage to creatures in your choice of a 10-foot around your turret or a 15-foot originating from your turret. All creatures in the area take damage equal to your turret's ranged Strike with a  save against your class DC.

entities.name: Improved Debilitating Exocortex
entities.description: You've adjusted your exocortex's debilitating features, making it even more of a hindrance to your enemies. When you apply the debilitating exocortex mod to your exocortex, add the following to the list of conditions you can select from: Clumsy 1, Enfeebled 1, or Stupefied 1.

entities.name: Kinetic Resonator
entities.description: You've created a custom kinetic dampener that diverts incoming kinetic energy. While there are still some gaps in its coverage, you find it's a reliable invention. You gain resistance equal to your Intelligence modifier to physical damage (bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage). In addition, you gain the Rebound Kinetic Energy reaction.

entities.name: Parallel Deployment
entities.description:
You've become accustomed to controlling multiple machines at the same time with perfect efficiency, your mind being able to process and calculate the positions and velocities of different devices at the same time. You do one of the following.

- You Reposition Exocortex your mine and Reposition Exocortex your turret.

- You Reposition Exocortex to move your turret and then Deploy Mine.

- You Reposition Exocortex your mine and then Deploy Turret.

Stats.Prerequisites: Exocortex Experimenter, mine exocortex, turret exocortex

entities.name: Parallel Reposition
entities.description: You've become accustomed to controlling multiple machines at the same time with perfect efficiency. You Synchronized Step and then Reposition Exocortex.

entities.name: Proximity Alert Mines
entities.description: You've rigged your mines so that whenever you Deploy Mine, you can make the deployed mine a proximity alert mine. If you do, the mine automatically Detonates when a creature enters or leaves a square within the burst area of the mine. This doesn't take an action, and you can't choose to delay the mine's detonation when it would trigger.

entities.name: Rocket Boosters
entities.description: You put rocket boosters into your drone's chassis that allow them to soar across the battlefield. Your drone gains a fly Speed of 20 feet. If your drone already has a fly Speed of 20 feet or more, it increases its fly Speed by 5 feet instead. Additionally, it gains the Activate Thrusters action.

entities.name: Steady Modifications
entities.description: Despite the speed with which you apply them, your modifications are stable and long-lasting. Whenever you Modify an item, it remains modded for 1 minute rather than until the end of your next turn. The first time the modded item would gain the Glitching condition, reduce the value of the glitching condition by 1.

entities.name: Advanced Transmutative Casing
entities.description: You've expanded the materials your transmutative casing can mimic. When you apply the transmutative casing mod, add the following to the list of precious materials you can select from: adamantine (standard-grade), aucturnite, and noqual.

entities.name: Enhanced Energy Neutralizer
entities.description: You've tweaked the formula for your energy neutralizer, increasing its effectiveness. When you apply the energy neutralizer mod to an item, the resistance is equal to your level, rather than your Intelligence modifier.

entities.name: Glitch Pulse
entities.description:
Your devices can emit a disrupting pulse that causes tech to malfunction. You gain the following new mod.

- **Glitch Pulse (weapon):** Strikes from the modded weapon disrupt technology. On a hit with the modded weapon, the target must attempt a  save against your class DC with the following results.

**Critical Success** The creature is immune to glitch pulse mods for 24 hours.

**Success** The creature and its gear are unaffected.

**Failure** If the creature has the tech trait, the creature is Glitching 3 for 1 round. Otherwise, one random item with the tech trait in the creature's possession becomes glitching 3 for 1 round, beginning with items they're wielding or holding.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but glitching 3 for 1 minute.

entities.name: Impressive Healing Mines
entities.description: You've greatly improved the effectiveness of your healing mines. Whenever you apply the healing mines mod, rather than creatures in the area regaining a number of Hit Points equal to the mine's number of damage dice + your Intelligence modifier, creatures in the area regain 1d6 healing Hit Points per the mine's number of damage dice + your Intelligence modifier.

entities.name: Spinning Blades
entities.description: You've programmed your drone to spin around while attacking everyone nearby. It gains the Spin to Win action.

entities.name: Double Debilitating Exocortex
entities.description: You've further improved your exocortex's debilitating features, increasing the intensity of its effects. When you apply the debilitating exocortex mod to your exocortex, you can select two conditions, rather than one. In addition, if you select the clumsy, enfeebled, or stupefied conditions, the value of the condition is 2, rather than 1.

entities.name: Redeploy Munitions
entities.description: You tactically redeploy your mines in the heat of battle. You Reposition Exocortex for every mine you've deployed.

entities.name: Shaped Blast
entities.description: You know how to alter the shape of explosions. When you activate a grenade (or Detonate Mine, if applicable), you can cause it to explode in a cone with an area equal to double the area of the burst it would've affected, though it must still originate from the activated grenade (or mine).

entities.name: Superior Drone
entities.description:
You further customize your drone. It becomes a specialized companion and gains one specialization of your choice. In addition to the one superior customization it automatically gains from becoming a specialized robot companion, your drone gains one additional superior customization.

**Special** You can select this feat up to three times. Each time, add a different specialization to your companion, but it doesn't gain the additional superior customization.

entities.name: Exploitive Assault
entities.description:
You've devised a means to tear down and bypass the defenses of your enemies. You gain the following new mod.

- **Exploitive Assault (grenade or weapon):** Using careful calculations, chemical reactions, quantum physics, and the magic of clever engineering, you tweak the item to foil resistances. Choose one damage type the modded item can deal. Any damage dealt by the item (including splash and persistent damage) ignores an amount of that resistance equal to your level.

entities.name: Foolproof Debilitations
entities.description: Using advanced targeting systems and scanners that adjust your weapons to your target's anatomy, you've made it nearly impossible to avoid the debilitating effect imposed by your exocortex. When you apply the debilitating exocortex mod to your exocortex, enemy targets avoid the condition the modded exocortex imposes only if they critically succeed at their saving throws.

entities.name: Superior Customization
entities.description:
You've further modified your drone, granting it a new ability. Your drone gains one additional superior customization.

**Special** You can select this feat up to three times.

entities.name: Superior Transmutative Casing
entities.description: You've further expanded what your casing can mimic. When you apply the transmutative casing mod, add the following standard grade precious materials to the list you can select from: abysium, djezet, cold siccatite, or hot siccatite.

entities.name: Automated Exocortex
entities.description: Painstaking contingency plans and a reliable backup power source allow your exocortex to continue processing data and follow your programming even when you're Unconscious or dying. When you have 0 Hit Points or are otherwise unable to act, you can take 3 actions per round on your turn, but all of these actions must involve your exocortex. You can't use any actions with the manipulate or move trait. For example, you could still Command your drone, fire your turret, Detonate Mine, or Reposition Exocortex, but you can't Deploy Mine, Modify, or Synchronized Step.

entities.name: Convertible Chassis
entities.description:
Your drone changes forms. When you pick this feat, select a robot companion chassis that your drone doesn't have; your drone gains this chassis. During your daily preparations, select the customizations for all of your drone's chassis individually, then select which chassis your drone begins that day as. Your drone gains the Mobile Reconfiguration action, which it can use to switch between its available chassis.

**Special** You can select this feat more than once, selecting a different chassis each time.

entities.name: Extra Enduring Mods
entities.description: During your daily preparations, when you Modify one item with your enduring mods class feature, you can instead Modify three items. All three mods last for 24 hours. In addition, you can spend 10 minutes Modifying an item with an enduring mod to change that item's enduring mod to another mod you know. This newly selected mod is an enduring mod.

entities.name: Area Denial Turret
entities.description: Your turret rains down a hail of destructive attacks. You can Area Fire your turret. When you do, your turret gains the area (cone) or area (line) trait (your choice whenever you Area Fire). If the turret has area (cone), its range is 20 feet. If it has area (line), its range is equal to the weapon's range increment.

entities.name: Coordinated Fire (Mechanic)
entities.description: You fire in tandem with your exocortex to overcome your enemy's defenses. You and either your drone or your turret each attempt a ranged Strike against the same target, each using your current multiple attack penalty. If both attacks hit, combine their damage. Apply the target's resistances and weaknesses only once. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty.

entities.name: Grenade Specialist
entities.description:
You can craft a few rudimentary grenades each day. You gain the formulas for two common grenades. Each day during your daily preparations, you can create two temporary grenades of your level or lower from your formulas. Grenades prepared in this way don't cost you any resources to Craft and don't have any sale value. They're temporary items and fall apart the next time you make your daily preparations.

If you're an expert in Crafting, you can create three grenades per day. If you're a master in Crafting, you can create four grenades per day. If you're legendary in Crafting, you can create six grenades per day.

entities.name: Healing Mines
entities.description:
You've designed a mine that explodes with healing medicine. You gain the following new mod.

- **Healing Mines (mine exocortex):** Your mine uses tiny four-sided syringes full of concentrated medicine. Instead of dealing damage, your healing mine causes creatures to regain a number of Hit Points equal to the mine's number of damage dice. Unlike your usual mines, creatures in the area don't attempt a saving throw. At 8th level, add your Intelligence modifier to the number of Hit Points regained.

**Special** If you have the High-Tech Medic feat, you can apply any of the mods granted by that feat to your healing mines.

entities.name: Hunker Down (Mechanic)
entities.description: You dash across the battlefield and hunker down behind cover before unleashing hell on your enemies. You Stride and take-cover. You can either Detonate Mine, make a ranged Strike with your turret, or your drone can make a Strike.

entities.name: Instant Deployment
entities.description:
**Trigger** You roll initiative.

You're always ready to unleash your exocortex. If you have a drone exocortex, your drone Strides. If you have a mine or turret exocortex, you can Deploy Mine or Deploy Turret.

entities.name: Mobile Deployment
entities.description: You rapidly deploy your exocortex while on the move. You Stride twice. At any point during this movement, you can Deploy Mine or Deploy Turret.

entities.name: Apocalyptic Explosions
entities.description: You make the best explosions. Whenever you Area Fire, Auto-Fire, Detonate Mine, or activate a grenade, the area is doubled.

entities.name: Auto Loop
entities.description: You've made automated shortcuts for your exocortex. At the start of each enemy's turn, you gain an additional reaction you can use only during that turn to use a mechanic reaction.

entities.name: Multitasker
entities.description: Your exocortex has become such a seamless extension of your own body and mind that you can flawlessly activate it without a second thought. You're permanently Quickened. You can use your extra action to only to Command your drone (or to provide 1 of the actions if you choose to spend 2 actions to Command your drone), make a ranged Strike with your turret, or Detonate Mine.

entities.name: Double Detonation
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per round

You unleash a flurry of synchronized explosions. You Detonate Mine twice. If a creature is in the area of both of these detonations, combine the damage for the purposes of applying that creature's resistances and weaknesses.

entities.name: Energy Neutralizer
entities.description:
You've created an adaptable coating that can neutralize a variety of energies. You gain the following new mod.

- **Energy Neutralizer (armor):** Select an energy type when you apply this mod: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. The item and the item's wearer gain resistance equal to your Intelligence modifier against the selected energy type. At 10th level, you can select two energy types, and at 15th level, you can select three energy types.

entities.name: Self-Destruct
entities.description:
**Requirements** Your turret is Deployed and within 150 feet.

You overload your turret's systems, causing it to self-destruct in a volatile explosion. Your turret deals floor @actor.level/4 +1 d6 piercing , floor @actor.level/4 +1 d6 fire |options:area-damage damage to all creatures in a 15-foot. Creatures in the area can attempt a  save against your class DC. Your turret is reduced to 0 Hit Points and automatically recalled to your custom rig.

At 8th level and every 4 levels thereafter, both the piercing damage and the fire damage increase by 1d6.

entities.name: Tactical Drone
entities.description:
You've improved your drone, making it a tactical robot companion and granting it additional capabilities. In addition to the one tactical customization it automatically gains from becoming a tactical robot companion, your drone gains one additional tactical customization.

During an encounter, even if you don't Command your robot companion, it can still use 1 action that round on your turn to Stride or Strike. It can do this at any point during your turn, as long as you aren't currently taking an action. If it does, that's all the actions it gets that round—you can't Command it later.

entities.name: Transmutative Casing
entities.description:
You can coat ammunition with a substance capable of mimicking rare materials. You gain the following new mod.

- **Transmutative Casing (grenade or weapon):** Physical damage dealt by the item uses one of the following precious materials of your choice: cold iron or silver.

entities.name: Boosting the Basics
entities.description:
No matter how advanced your inventions become, you never neglect the basics. In fact, you've even developed a few improvements to enhance some old favorites.

- Whenever you apply the big boom mod to an item, you increase the item's radius by 10 feet if it's a burst or a cone (rather than by 5 feet), and its area by 20 feet if it's a line (rather than 10 feet).

- Whenever you apply the bunker buster mod to an item, you increase the additional damage by 5 (for a total of 10 additional damage, rather than 5).

- Whenever you apply the incapacitant mod to an item, creatures damaged by the item additionally become Frightened 1 if the attack was a critical hit or they critically failed their save.

- Whenever you apply the long-range propulsors mod to an item, you increase the item's range or range increment by 60 feet (rather than by 30 feet).

- Whenever you apply the magnetic levitators mod to an item, the wearer gains a fly Speed of 20 feet (rather than a fly Speed of 10 feet).

- Whenever you apply the troubleshoot mod to an item, you reduce its Glitching condition by 2 (rather than by 1).

entities.name: Debilitating Exocortex
entities.description:
You've outfitted your exocortex with a variety of minor distracting features. You gain the following new mod.

- **Debilitating Exocortex (exocortex):** Select one of the following conditions: Dazzled, Deafened, Off-Guard, or Suppressed. Creatures damaged by your exocortex must succeed at a  save against your class DC or gain the chosen condition until the end of their next turn.

entities.name: Exocortex Experimenter
entities.description:
You're constantly experimenting with your exocortex and expanding its capabilities. Choose an exocortex other than your own. You gain that exocortex.

**Special** You can select this feat a second time if you're 12th level or higher, gaining an additional new exocortex.

entities.name: Maneuvering Mines
entities.description:
Your mines push or pull creatures away from them. You gain the following new mods.

- **Big Bang (mine exocortex):** Your mines blow enemies away. Creatures that fail their saving throw against the mine are pushed 5 feet directly away from the mine (or pushed 10 feet directly away from the mine and knocked Prone on a critical failure). This is forced movement.

- **Black Hole (mine exocortex):** Your mines harness gravity-bending technology. Creatures that fail their saving throw against the mine are pulled 5 feet toward the mine (or pulled 10 feet toward the mine and Slowed 1 on a critical failure). This is forced movement.

entities.name: Tactical Customization
entities.description:
You've further modified your drone, granting it a new ability. Your drone gains one additional tactical customization.

**Special** You can select this feat up to three times.

entities.name: Tactical Team-Up
entities.description: Your turret unleashes a hail of gunfire. You can make a ranged Strike against a target within the first range increment of your turret's weapon, and the target is Off-Guard against this Strike.

entities.name: Activate Targeting System
entities.description: You activate the targeting system you've built into your exocortex. The next time before the end of your turn that you, your drone, or your turret makes an attack roll, the attack ignores circumstance penalties to the attack roll and any flat check required due to the target being Concealed or Hidden.

entities.name: Advanced Drone
entities.description: You've further upgraded your drone, which becomes either a burly or deft companion and gains additional capabilities determined by its type. In addition to the one advanced customization it automatically gains from becoming a burly or deft robot companion, your drone gains one additional advanced customization.

entities.name: Auto Target
entities.description:
**Trigger** A creature within 30 feet of your drone or turret uses a manipulate action or a move action, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Your drone or turret can automatically attack foes. Your drone or turret makes a ranged Strike against the triggering creature. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

entities.name: Deploy Motion Dampener
entities.description:
1 to 2

You activate dampeners in your exocortex that slow motion and dilate time. Either you, your exocortex, or one of your Deployed Mines emits a 10-foot of difficult terrain for a number of rounds equal to your Intelligence modifier. You and your exocortex are unhindered by difficult terrain created this way.

You can Deploy Motion Dampener as 2 actions. When you do, you Deploy the Motion Dampener into an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you. This cloaking field is immobile and can't be moved.

entities.name: Double Deployment
entities.description:
**Frequency** once per round

You've programmed your exocortex to deploy mines together to create a choke point. You Deploy Mine twice. Both mines must be within 30 feet of one another.

entities.name: Expansive Array
entities.description:
You design additional custom arrays for your turret. Select two of the following arrays. Add the selected arrays to your list of available arrays.

- 1d8 mental damage, range increment 60 feet, tech trait, mental weapon group

- 1d8 poison damage, range increment 60 feet, tech trait, dart weapon group

- 1d8 vitality damage, range increment 60 feet, tech trait, laser weapon group

- 1d8 void damage, range increment 60 feet, tech trait, void weapon group

**Special** You can take this feat a second time. When you do, you must select different arrays.

entities.name: Instant Install
entities.description: You've worked a few shortcuts into your custom rig, enabling you to install and uninstall upgrades swiftly. You can Install Upgrade with your custom rig, instead of a repair toolkit, as a single action.

entities.name: Plentiful Grenades
entities.description:
You can make additional grenades each day. Increase the number of temporary grenades you can create each day by 2.

**Special** You can select this feat a second time if you're 14th level or higher.

entities.name: Divine Bond
entities.description: As a disciple of a god, you wield some of their divine power. You become trained in the listed divine skill associated with the deity and add the listed cleric spells to your spell list and spell repertoire as signature spells. If you were already trained in the listed divine skill, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You become bound by that deity's anathema and can receive that deity's divine sanctification.

Stats.Prerequisites: connection with divine spellcasting, you worship a deity

entities.name: Xenodruid Bond
entities.description:
You join a primal order of xenodruids with ties to nature and the biodiversity of the Universe, such as the Xenowardens. Choose one of the following xenodruid orders.

**Order** Animal; **Skill** Animal Lore; **Spells** 1st: Pest Form; 2nd: Animal Form; 5th: Carcinization

**Order** Plant; **Skill** Plant Lore; **Spells** 1st: Summon Plant or Fungus; 2nd: Verdant Code; 5th: Plant Form

**Order** Viral; **Skill** Genealogy Lore; **Spells** 1st: Detect Poison; 2nd: Instant Virus; 5th: Toxic Cloud

You become trained in the listed skill associated with the order and add the listed spells to your spell list and spell repertoire as signature spells. If you were already trained in the listed skill, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice.

entities.name: Data Bond
entities.description: You can speak with computers. Any construct creatures you summon are considered part of your bond and don't count against the maximum number of creatures in your bond. During your daily preparations, choose one of the following spells: Instant Virus, Mending, Summon Construct, or Summon Robot. You add the selected spell to your spell repertoire and signature spells until your next daily preparations.

entities.name: Greater Epiphany
entities.description: You see into the truth of the cosmos through your connection. You gain the greater epiphany spell for your chosen connection.

entities.name: Life Bond
