entities.description: Shameless requests are your specialty. When you Request something, you reduce any DC increases for making an outrageous request by 2, and if you roll a critical failure for your Request, you get a failure instead. While this means you can never cause your target to reduce their attitude toward you by making a Request, they eventually tire of requests, even though they still have a positive attitude toward you.

entities.name: That's Not What I Heard
entities.description:
You attempt to convince someone that you've seen nasty rumors about them on the infosphere. Choose a target within 30 feet, and attempt a  check against its Will DC.

**Critical Success** The distracted target takes a –3 status penalty to Will saves and Diplomacy checks for 1 minute. The target can end this effect early by checking a comm unit or other computer as a single action that has the manipulate trait or with the assistance of another creature checking a device.

**Success** As critical success, but the penalty is –2.

**Critical Failure** The target doesn't care about your accusation or knows it's a lie, ruining your reputation and giving you a –2 circumstance penalty to your Deception, Diplomacy, and Society checks for 1 minute.

Stats.Traits: auditory, concentrate, emotion, general, linguistic, mental, skill

entities.name: Aerosol Spray Nozzle
entities.description: This atomizing nozzle uses gas compressors to spray chem in a fine mist. An aerosol spray requires a commercial chem tank that must be purchased separately. You can expend one chem to spray into an adjacent square as an Interact action. If there's an invisible creature, object, or light in that square, it becomes temporarily observed until the end of your turn, though the subject still has concealment due to invisibility.

entities.name: Archaic Text
entities.description: This book could be a religious text, a collection of ancient recipes, a romance novel, or vintage mechanical schematics.

entities.name: Autograppler (Commercial)
entities.description: You can attach this anchoring device to a cable line with an Interact action. Clamps automatically slide from the base of the autograppler along the attached cable, allowing it to be climbed like a knotted rope. You can throw the autograppler to attach it to a solid surface, attempting a ranged attack roll using your simple weapon proficiency against a DC depending on the target, typically at least DC 20. This attack has the secret trait. On a success, your autograppler has a firm hold, but on a critical failure, the grappler seems like it will hold but detaches when you're partway up.

entities.name: Autograppler (Tactical)
entities.description:
You can attach this anchoring device to a cable line with an Interact action. Clamps automatically slide from the base of the autograppler along the attached cable, allowing it to be climbed like a knotted rope. You can throw the autograppler to attach it to a solid surface, attempting a ranged attack roll using your simple weapon proficiency against a DC depending on the target, typically at least DC 20. This attack has the secret trait. On a success, your autograppler has a firm hold, but on a critical failure, the grappler seems like it will hold but detaches when you're partway up.

A tactical autograppler has a sensor to detect whether it has a firm hold, causing it to automatically retract if you critically fail your ranged attack to attach it.

entities.name: Cable Line (50 Feet, Commercial)
entities.description: This industrial cable is typically made of high-durability plastic coated in metal. A commercial cable line is coated in titanium alloy.

entities.name: Cable Line (50 Feet, Tactical)
entities.description: This industrial cable is typically made of high-durability plastic coated in metal. A tactical cable line is coated in adamantine alloy.

entities.name: Camping Kit
entities.description: A camping kit contains a weatherproof tent for four Medium or two Large creatures, bedrolls, a fire igniter, 1 week of rations, and a survival knife.

entities.name: Chemalyzer
entities.description: This handheld sampling unit grants a +1 circumstance bonus to skill checks to identify an unknown drug, medicinal, poison, or other chemical substance.

entities.name: Climbing Kit (Commercial)
entities.description:
A commercial climbing kit includes 50 feet of cable line, a grappling hook, harnesses, pulleys, pitons, a hammer, and crampons. Climbing kits allow you to attach yourself to the wall you're Climbing, moving half as quickly as usual (minimum 5 feet) but letting you attempt a DC 5 whenever you critically fail to prevent a fall.

A single kit has only enough materials for one climber; each climber needs their own kit.

entities.name: Climbing Kit (Tactical)
entities.description:
A commercial climbing kit includes 50 feet of cable line, a grappling hook, harnesses, pulleys, pitons, a hammer, and crampons. Climbing kits allow you to attach yourself to the wall you're Climbing, moving half as quickly as usual (minimum 5 feet) but letting you attempt a DC 5 whenever you critically fail to prevent a fall. You gain a +1 item bonus to Athletics checks to Climb while using a tactical climbing kit.

A single kit has only enough materials for one climber; each climber needs their own kit.

entities.name: Comm Unit
entities.description:
A personal comm unit is a pocket-sized device that combines a minor portable computer and a cellular communications device, allowing instantaneous wireless communication with other comm units in both audio- and text-based formats at planetary range. A personal comm unit also includes a calculator, a flashlight (emits bright light in a 5-foot radius around you and dim light in the next 5 feet), a browser that accesses any local infospheres, and several entertainment options (including games).

Personal comm units integrated into armor have some voice-activated capabilities; you can communicate with other comm units in audio-based formats and receive responses without needing a free hand, but typing a message, browsing the infosphere, or using an app requires the use of at least one hand.

Comm units that function at longer ranges aren't as portable; they include built-in generators that provide the necessary amount of power and rely on active Drift beacons to communicate. Short-term use of these units can be purchased in most major settlements.

entities.name: Container (Designer)
entities.description:
Containers include backpacks, briefcases, duffel bags, and handbags. A container holds up to 4 Bulk and the first 2 Bulk of those items don't count against your Bulk limits. If you're carrying or stowing the container rather than wearing it on your person, its Bulk is light instead of negligible.

You gain a +1 item bonus to checks to Make an Impression on high society individuals while carrying a designer container, such as a designer handbag.

entities.name: Container (Ordinary)
entities.description: Containers include backpacks, briefcases, duffel bags, and handbags. A container holds up to 4 Bulk and the first 2 Bulk of those items don't count against your Bulk limits. If you're carrying or stowing the container rather than wearing it on your person, its Bulk is light instead of negligible.

entities.name: Creator Capsule (Advanced)
entities.description: A creator capsule is a small 3D printer with a programmable interface that allows you to quickly Craft items using the Fabricator skill feat. Unlike normal Crafting, this process takes 1 hour of work to set up and complete, but you can't spend additional downtime days working on it to reduce the value of the materials you need to expend to complete the item. You must have the item's formula and can't Craft items with a level higher than the level of the creator capsule. Crafting items with more than 1 Bulk requires using an additional creator capsule for each additional Bulk, but you still roll to Craft only once.

entities.name: Creator Capsule (Commercial)
entities.description: A creator capsule is a small 3D printer with a programmable interface that allows you to quickly Craft items using the Fabricator skill feat. Unlike normal Crafting, this process takes 24 hours of work to set up and complete, but you can't spend additional downtime days working on it to reduce the value of the materials you need to expend to complete the item. You must have the item's formula and can't Craft items with a level higher than the level of the creator capsule. Crafting items with more than 1 Bulk requires using an additional creator capsule for each additional Bulk, but you still roll to Craft only once.

entities.name: Creator Capsule (Elite)
entities.description: A creator capsule is a small 3D printer with a programmable interface that allows you to quickly Craft items using the Fabricator skill feat. Unlike normal Crafting, this process takes 1 minute of work to set up and complete, but you can't spend additional downtime days working on it to reduce the value of the materials you need to expend to complete the item. You must have the item's formula and can't Craft items with a level higher than the level of the creator capsule. Crafting items with more than 1 Bulk requires using an additional creator capsule for each additional Bulk, but you still roll to Craft only once.

entities.name: Creator Capsule (Paragon)
entities.description: A creator capsule is a small 3D printer with a programmable interface that allows you to quickly Craft items using the Fabricator skill feat. Unlike normal Crafting, this process takes 1 minute, and 4th-level or lower items can be Crafted as a 1-action activity, to set up and complete, but you can't spend additional downtime days working on it to reduce the value of the materials you need to expend to complete the item. You must have the item's formula and can't Craft items with a level higher than the level of the creator capsule. Crafting items with more than 1 Bulk requires using an additional creator capsule for each additional Bulk, but you still roll to Craft only once.

entities.name: Creator Capsule (Superior)
entities.description: A creator capsule is a small 3D printer with a programmable interface that allows you to quickly Craft items using the Fabricator skill feat. Unlike normal Crafting, this process takes 10 minutes of work to set up and complete, but you can't spend additional downtime days working on it to reduce the value of the materials you need to expend to complete the item. You must have the item's formula and can't Craft items with a level higher than the level of the creator capsule. Crafting items with more than 1 Bulk requires using an additional creator capsule for each additional Bulk, but you still roll to Craft only once.

entities.name: Creator Capsule (Tactical)
entities.description: A creator capsule is a small 3D printer with a programmable interface that allows you to quickly Craft items using the Fabricator skill feat. Unlike normal Crafting, this process takes 12 hours of work to set up and complete, but you can't spend additional downtime days working on it to reduce the value of the materials you need to expend to complete the item. You must have the item's formula and can't Craft items with a level higher than the level of the creator capsule. Crafting items with more than 1 Bulk requires using an additional creator capsule for each additional Bulk, but you still roll to Craft only once.

entities.name: Creator Capsule (Ultimate)
entities.description: A creator capsule is a small 3D printer with a programmable interface that allows you to quickly Craft items using the Fabricator skill feat. Unlike normal Crafting, this process takes 1 minute, and 1st-level or lower items can be Crafted as a 3-action activity, to set up and complete, but you can't spend additional downtime days working on it to reduce the value of the materials you need to expend to complete the item. You must have the item's formula and can't Craft items with a level higher than the level of the creator capsule. Crafting items with more than 1 Bulk requires using an additional creator capsule for each additional Bulk, but you still roll to Craft only once.

entities.name: Data Chip
entities.description: A data chip contains enough memory for a religious text, photo album, personal journal, or the like. You can view the information on a data chip with a computer, such as the one in your comm unit.

entities.name: Datapad
entities.description: These ubiquitous handheld computers incorporate a comm unit, microphone, speaker, camera, infosphere browser, and data storage. They can store thousands of hours of recordings, play games, and perform simple computing functions, such as time tracking and notifications, word processing, calculations, data processing, streaming media, and broadcasting emergency alerts from local governments. In most societies, commercial datapads are relatively flimsy, designed to rapidly wear out or fall behind on the latest features and updates to encourage the consumer to replace it with a newer model. In contrast, higher-end datapads are made to last and often include a sturdier chassis and extra functions.

entities.name: Emergency Beacon
entities.description: This item requires a battery to be installed for it to operate. When activated, this small, pod-shaped device transmits its location and emits a flash of bright red light once per round, consuming 1 charge per day. Any device capable of receiving signals can pick up a signal from an emergency beacon, which can then be traced with a successful DC 15 or DC 15 check. An emergency beacon's transmissions have a range of 100 miles over flat terrain, 50 miles in forests or hills, and 25 miles in mountainous terrain or underwater. Alternatively, an emergency beacon can be installed in a starship's or vehicle's communications system. In this case, its range is equal to that of the communications array, and it consumes 1 charge per hour.

entities.name: Explorer's Canteen
entities.description:
This thermos has two compartments. The upper compartment contains nanomachines and filters that target common contaminants, making most food and water safe to consume and granting a +1 item bonus to saves against any poisons or diseases present in the food or water. The lower compartment converts inserted UPBs into edible nutri-paste at a rate of 2 UPBs per 1 day of nourishment.

Effect: Explorer's Canteen

entities.name: Field Scientist's Toolkit (Commercial)
entities.description: A field scientist toolkit contains a Chemalyzer, microscope, recording tools, and specimen bags.

entities.name: Field Scientist's Toolkit (Tactical)
entities.description: A field scientist toolkit contains a Chemalyzer, microscope, recording tools, and specimen bags. A tactical field scientist toolkit grants a +1 item bonus on Recall Knowledge checks using Nature or an appropriate Lore skill.

entities.name: Fire Extinguisher (Advanced)
entities.description: A fire extinguishes sprays foam in a 15-foot cone, automatically putting out non-magical fires and attempting to counteract any magical fire effects at 6th rank with a +19 counteract modifier. A fire extinguisher expends one chem each time it's used and uses a chem tank up to advanced grade.

entities.name: Fire Extinguisher (Commercial)
entities.description: A fire extinguishes sprays foam in a 15-foot cone, automatically putting out non-magical fires and attempting to counteract any magical fire effects at 2nd rank with a +7 counteract modifier. A fire extinguisher expends one chem each time it's used and uses a commercial chem tank.

entities.name: Fire Extinguisher (Tactical)
entities.description: A fire extinguishes sprays foam in a 15-foot cone, automatically putting out non-magical fires and attempting to counteract any magical fire effects at 4th rank with a +14 counteract modifier. A fire extinguisher expends one chem each time it's used and uses a chem tank up to tactical grade.

entities.name: Flashlight (Commercial)
entities.description: A flashlight sheds bright light. A commercial flashlight emits light in a 30-foot emanation (and dim light in the next 30 feet).

entities.name: Flashlight (Tactical)
entities.description: A flashlight sheds bright light. A tactical flashlight emits its light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light in the next 60 feet) and is equipped with filters, which you can close to block or dim the light. Activating the filters takes an Interact action.

entities.name: Hacking Toolkit (Advanced)
entities.description: A hacking toolkit is required for Computers checks to Hack computers. You can use a hacking toolkit to access a computer without using a user interface, but this requires physical contact with the computer or contact via an infosphere or a similar linked network. An advanced hacking toolkit adds a +1 item bonus to checks made with it and allows you to access computers at a range of 30 feet, unless you're in a radioactive environment.

entities.name: Hacking Toolkit (Commercial)
entities.description: A hacking toolkit is required for Computers checks to Hack computers. You can use a hacking toolkit to access a computer without using a user interface, but this requires physical contact with the computer or contact via an infosphere or a similar linked network.

entities.name: Hacking Toolkit (Tactical)
entities.description: A hacking toolkit is required for Computers checks to Hack computers. You can use a hacking toolkit to access a computer without using a user interface, but this requires physical contact with the computer or contact via an infosphere or a similar linked network. A tactical hacking toolkit adds a +1 item bonus to checks made with it.

entities.name: Holoskin (Commercial)
entities.description: A holographic projector mounted to a belt or limb strap can be activated as an Interact action. It can be programmed to project the appearance of another creature of the same size category as yourself, hiding your true appearance. A holoskin doesn't change your voice, scent, or mannerisms. The appearance of held and worn items aren't affected. You usually need a holoskin to set up a disguise in order to Impersonate someone using the Deception skill.

entities.name: Holoskin (Tactical)
entities.description: A holographic projector mounted to a belt or limb strap can be activated as an Interact action. It can be programmed to project the appearance of another creature of the same size category as yourself, hiding your true appearance. A holoskin doesn't change your voice, scent, or mannerisms. The appearance of held and worn items aren't affected. You usually need a holoskin to set up a disguise in order to Impersonate someone using the Deception skill. A tactical holoskin adds a +1 item bonus to relevant checks.

entities.name: Holospark
entities.description: This tiny holoprojector is often disguised as an earring, lapel pin, or pendant, It stores a simple visual projection of personal flair, such as a halo or wings, accompanied by short audio, such as a clip of a popular song or a sound effect. Your holospark can be programmed with a computer, such as the one in your comm unit.

entities.name: Hygiene Kit
entities.description: This kit contains all the tools and products needed to practice good grooming and hygiene. Kits designed for specific creatures include supplies (such as scale-care products for vesk or antennae grooming oil for lashuntas or shirrens) that are of less use to other creatures.

entities.name: Infiltrator's Toolkit (Commercial Picks)
entities.description: These are replacement picks for Infiltrator's Toolkit (Commercial).

entities.name: Infiltrator's Toolkit (Commercial)
entities.description: You need an infiltrator's toolkit to Pick Locks or Disable Devices (of some types) using the Thievery skill.

entities.name: Infiltrator's Toolkit (Tactical Picks)
entities.description: These are replacement picks for Infiltrator's Toolkit (Tactical).

entities.name: Infiltrator's Toolkit (Tactical)
entities.description: You need an infiltrator's toolkit to Pick Locks or Disable Devices (of some types) using the Thievery skill. A tactical infiltrator's toolkit adds a +1 item bonus to checks to Pick Locks or Disable Devices.

entities.name: Infinity Deck
entities.description: A replica of an artifact that appeared during the Gap, this deck of playing cards is used to play countless games.

entities.name: Lifesuit
entities.description: This whole-body garment provides basic environmental protection. A lifesuit's environmental protections lasts for 10 days and can be equipped with an additional battery, providing 1 day of protection per charge.

entities.name: Lock (Advanced)
entities.description: Picking an advanced lock requires four successful DC 25 Thievery checks.

entities.name: Lock (Commercial)
entities.description: Picking a commercial lock requires two successful DC 15 Thievery checks.

entities.name: Lock (Elite)
entities.description: Picking an elite lock requires six successful DC 40 Thievery checks.

entities.name: Lock (Superior)
entities.description: Picking a superior lock requires five successful DC 30 Thievery checks.

entities.name: Lock (Tactical)
entities.description: Picking a tactical lock requires two successful DC 20 Thievery checks.

entities.name: Magboots
entities.description: Magboots can be activated or deactivated with an Interact action. While active, they grant you a +1 item bonus to Athletics checks to Climb metal surfaces as well as a +1 item bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to Reposition, Shove, or Trip you when you're standing on a metal surface. In areas of zero gravity, while wearing a pair of magboots, you can move your Speed across metal surfaces and don't gain the untethered condition.

entities.name: Magnetic Jack
entities.description:
**Activate** 1 (manipulate)

A magnetic jack is a simple machine used to lift and move large or heavy objects. Consisting of two powerful magnets with a ferrous plate between them, the jack can be placed under and Activated to lift an object of up to 200 Bulk and then pushed or pulled at a creature's Speed using two hands. Creatures supported by an activated magnetic jack are Off-Guard.

entities.name: Maker's App
entities.description: This comm unit app contains formulas for Crafting the common items in this section.

entities.name: Maker's Toolkit (Commercial)
entities.description: You need a maker's toolkit to create items from UPBs with the Craft skill.

entities.name: Maker's Toolkit (Tactical)
entities.description: You need a maker's toolkit to create items from UPBs with the Craft skill. A tactical maker's toolkit gives you a +1 item bonus to the check.

entities.name: Medkit (Commercial)
entities.description: These contain analgesics, bandages, sterile gauze, and suturing tools necessary for Medicine checks to Administer First Aid, Treat Disease, Treat Poison, or Treat Wounds.

entities.name: Medkit (Tactical)
entities.description: These contain analgesics, bandages, sterile gauze, and suturing tools necessary for Medicine checks to Administer First Aid, Treat Disease, Treat Poison, or Treat Wounds. Tactical medical toolkits provide a +1 item bonus to such checks. A medkit is a toolkit.

entities.name: Microgoggles
entities.description: These bulky goggles include adjustable magnifying lenses and lights, granting you a +2 item bonus to any skill check that benefits from exceedingly close vision, such as detecting complicated forgeries, identifying pathogens in blood samples, or crafting drugs or medicinals.

entities.name: Microphone
entities.description: This cordless handheld device records and transmits audio, typically to a speaker or computer.

entities.name: Musical Instrument (Handheld, Commercial)
entities.description: All but the most traditional instruments use modern technology to amplify their sound, provide musical accompaniment, or connect wirelessly to other instruments. Handheld instruments include autohorns, guitars, psychoactive wave plates, digital synth decks, holoflutes, and more. The GM might rule that an especially large handheld instrument has greater Bulk. Some instruments have the tech trait.

entities.name: Musical Instrument (Handheld, Tactical)
entities.description:
All but the most traditional instruments use modern technology to amplify their sound, provide musical accompaniment, or connect wirelessly to other instruments. Handheld instruments include autohorns, guitars, psychoactive wave plates, digital synth decks, holoflutes, and more. The GM might rule that an especially large handheld instrument has greater Bulk. Some instruments have the tech trait.

A tactical instrument gives a +1 item bonus to Performance checks using that instrument.

entities.name: Musical Instrument (Heavy, Commercial)
entities.description: All but the most traditional instruments use modern technology to amplify their sound, provide musical accompaniment, or connect wirelessly to other instruments. Heavy instruments, such as drumdecks and theremins, are less portable and generally need to be stationary while played. Some instruments have the tech trait.

entities.name: Musical Instrument (Heavy, Tactical)
entities.description:
All but the most traditional instruments use modern technology to amplify their sound, provide musical accompaniment, or connect wirelessly to other instruments. Heavy instruments, such as drumdecks and theremins, are less portable and generally need to be stationary while played. Some instruments have the tech trait.

A tactical instrument gives a +1 item bonus to Performance checks using that instrument.

entities.name: Neurocam
entities.description:
**Activate** 10 minutes

This strange helmet is covered in flashing lights and adjustable straps with a blinder that covers the eyes. When activated, the device scans your brain and creates a digital copy in a specially designed memory card that can be used with a mnemonic editor to restore your brain to the same state it was in when the recording took place. This retroactively restores any options changed due to retraining, but if you've gained a character level since using the neurocam using options you no longer qualify for, the mnemonic editor adjusts your memories to compensate, and you can immediately select new options.

Some spellcasters have used neurocams as components with the Resurrect ritual to return a loved one as a living hologram or SRO, especially when the cause of the target's death involves especially traumatic memories.

entities.name: Portable Amp
entities.description: This small device is typically synced up to an instrument, microphone, or the audio playback on a datapad. It amplifies the audio volume, reducing the DC of Perception checks to hear the audio by 5.

entities.name: Radiation Sweeper
entities.description: This handheld device is capable of detecting radiation within 120 feet. When you Interact with the device, it emits pings in different tones to indicate the presence of low, medium, high, or severe radiation. It also displays the areas of radiation on a simple screen. It automatically updates the data as you move until the beginning of your next turn. After that, you must Interact with the device again to conduct another sweep. A radiation sweeper can't detect radiation through 3 feet of dirt or wood, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or any force field. A radiation sweeper is immune to the effects of radiation.

entities.name: Repair Toolkit (Commercial)
entities.description: A repair toolkit contains a variety of delicate tools and supplies that allows you to perform simple repairs while traveling. You can use a repair toolkit to Repair items using the Crafting skill. You can draw and replace a worn repair toolkit as part of the action that uses it.

entities.name: Repair Toolkit (Tactical)
entities.description: A repair toolkit contains a variety of delicate tools and supplies that allows you to perform simple repairs while traveling. You can use a repair toolkit to Repair items using the Crafting skill. A tactical repair toolkit gives you a +1 item bonus to the check. You can draw and replace a worn repair toolkit as part of the action that uses it.

entities.name: Sunshades (Commercial)
entities.description: Sunshades make everyone look cooler.

entities.name: Sunshades (Tactical)
entities.description: Sunshades make everyone look cooler. You gain a +1 item bonus to saves against effects that cause the Blinded or Dazzled condition while wearing tactical sunshades.

entities.name: Wheelchair
entities.description: Wheelchairs come in a variety of sizes and styles to suit countless alien body types, including hoverchairs. Automated mechanisms allow wheelchairs to traverse stairs, ladders, and uneven ground without any additional difficulty (difficult terrain still affects your Speed while using a wheelchair).

entities.name: Vesk Scales
entities.description: Your ancestors were the hardiest specimens of vesk, having traveled far and wide while enduring hostile environments. Your scales count as medium armor in the plate armor group. They grant a +3 item bonus to AC, have a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, and a Strength threshold of +3, and have the comfort and exposed traits. This item bonus increases to +4 at 5th level. You can wear a flight suit, but you can't wear other armor. You can etch armor runes onto your scales, but you can't install armor upgrades.

entities.name: Active Camouflage (Advanced)
entities.description: Hardlight projectors shift the appearance of your armor using shifting colors and patterns that respond to your environment. You gain a +3 item bonus to Stealth checks while wearing the armor.

entities.name: Active Camouflage (Commercial)
entities.description: Hardlight projectors shift the appearance of your armor using shifting colors and patterns that respond to your environment. You gain a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks while wearing the armor.

entities.name: Active Camouflage (Tactical)
entities.description: Hardlight projectors shift the appearance of your armor using shifting colors and patterns that respond to your environment. You gain a +2 item bonus to Stealth checks while wearing the armor.

entities.name: Adaptive Energy Shielding
entities.description:
This device changes the chemical composition of the insulation installed on your armor, reacting to different types of energy.

**Activate—Adapt** r

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Trigger** You take acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage

**Effect** Your energy shielding upgrade changes to the triggering damage type. This lasts until you Adapt again or uninstall any adaptive energy shielding or Energy Shielding upgrade from the same armor. If you have multiple energy shielding upgrades on this armor, choose one to change when you Adapt.

entities.name: Adrenal Autoinjectors (Advanced)
entities.description:
This set of adrenaline capsules are mounted above key veins. The onboard computer manages the injectors, ensuring the capsules are deployed when they're needed most.

You can also Inject Adrenaline as a free action with no trigger.

**Activate—Inject Adrenaline** r (healing, vitality)

**Frequency** three times per day

**Trigger** You're reduced to 0 Hit Points as a result of a critical hit or a critical failure on a saving throw

**Effect** You gain 1 Hit Point and are Confused for 1 round.

entities.name: Adrenal Autoinjectors (Commercial)
entities.description:
This set of adrenaline capsules are mounted above key veins. The onboard computer manages the injectors, ensuring the capsules are deployed when they're needed most.

**Activate—Inject Adrenaline** r (healing, vitality)

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You're reduced to 0 Hit Points as a result of a critical hit or a critical failure on a saving throw

**Effect** You gain 1 Hit Point and are Confused for 1 round.

entities.name: Adrenal Autoinjectors (Tactical)
entities.description:
This set of adrenaline capsules are mounted above key veins. The onboard computer manages the injectors, ensuring the capsules are deployed when they're needed most.

You can also Inject Adrenaline as a free action with no trigger.

**Activate—Inject Adrenaline** r (healing, vitality)

**Frequency** twice per day

**Trigger** You're reduced to 0 Hit Points as a result of a critical hit or a critical failure on a saving throw

**Effect** You gain 1 Hit Point and are Confused for 1 round.

entities.name: Aeon Transmitter (Commercial)
entities.description:
This magical comms array transmits the benefits of an *aeon stone*. Your armor gains the aeon trait. If it already has the aeon trait, it can fit a second *aeon stone* or *spell gem*.

**Activate—Transmit** f

**Requirements** Your armor has an *aeon stone* attached, and it has an activation that isn't a reaction

**Effect** If the next action you use is to Activate the attached *aeon stone*, the effects apply to another willing creature within 30 feet instead as if they'd activated it.

entities.name: Aeon Transmitter (Tactical)
entities.description:
This magical comms array transmits the benefits of an *aeon stone*. Your armor gains the aeon trait. If it already has the aeon trait, it can fit a second *aeon stone* or *spell gem*.

**Activate—Transmit** f

**Requirements** Your armor has an *aeon stone* attached, and it has an activation that isn't a reaction

**Effect** If the next action you use is to Activate the attached *aeon stone*, the effects apply to another willing creature within 30 feet instead as if they'd activated it.

**Activate—Broadcast** 1 (manipulate, concentrate)

**Requirements** Your armor has an *aeon stone* attached, and the *aeon stone* provides one or more item bonuses

**Effect** All item bonuses conferred by the attached *aeon stone* apply to you and all allies within 30 feet for 1 hour. After the effect ends, the *aeon stone* and the *aeon transmitter* are both exhausted, providing no benefits until your next daily preparations.

entities.name: Aqua Jets (Commercial)
entities.description:
Propellers, underwater jets, and other hydrodynamic propulsion systems enhance your aquatic mobility.

**Activate—Propel** 1

**Effect** You activate the propulsion system to gain a swim Speed of 20 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you Dismiss it.

entities.name: Aqua Jets (Tactical)
entities.description:
Propellers, underwater jets, and other hydrodynamic propulsion systems enhance your aquatic mobility.

You don't take a penalty to bludgeoning or slashing attack Strikes underwater.

**Activate—Propel** 1

**Effect** You activate the propulsion system to gain a swim Speed of 40 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you Dismiss it.

entities.name: Auto-CPR Unit
entities.description: This device monitors your vital signs and automatically administers aid. When you have the dying condition while wearing this armor, the DC of your recovery checks is equal to 8 + your dying value (instead of 10 + your dying value).

entities.name: Cloaking Device (Commercial)
entities.description:
This projector bends light around your body.

**Activate—Bend Light** 1 (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You become Invisible for 1 minute, gaining the effects of a 2nd-rank Invisibility spell.

entities.name: Cloaking Device (Tactical)
entities.description:
This projector bends light around your body.

**Activate—Bend Light** 1 (manipulate)

**Frequency** three times per day

**Effect** You become Invisible for 1 minute, gaining the effects of a 2nd-rank Invisibility spell.

entities.name: Darkvision Visor
entities.description: This visor wraps around your visual organs, enhancing your natural senses. You gain darkvision.

entities.name: Drift Drive Relay (Advanced)
entities.description:
This advanced containment unit stores and channels entangled Drift particles, allowing you to briefly flicker into the Drift as you move. When you successfully tumble-through a creature's space, you don't treat its squares as difficult terrain.

As a 10-minute activity, you can attune this armor upgrade to a Drift engine you can physically access to further enhance the relay's abilities.

**Activate—Warp** 2

**Frequency** once per day

**Requirements** You're within planetary range of an attuned, functional Drift engine

**Effect** You warp through space, gaining the effects of a 5th-rank Translocate spell.

**Activate—Drift Homeward** 3 (concentrate, manipulate, teleportation)

**Frequency** once per day

**Requirements** You're within planetary range of an attuned, functional Drift engine

**Effect** You fall fully into the Drift, teleporting to a space adjacent to the Drift engine your armor is attuned to.

entities.name: Drift Drive Relay (Commercial)
entities.description:
This advanced containment unit stores and channels entangled Drift particles, allowing you to briefly flicker into the Drift as you move. When you successfully tumble-through a creature's space, you don't treat its squares as difficult terrain.

As a 10-minute activity, you can attune this armor upgrade to a Drift engine you can physically access to further enhance the relay's abilities.

**Activate—Warp** 2

**Frequency** once per day

**Requirements** You're within planetary range of an attuned, functional Drift engine

**Effect** You warp through space, gaining the effects of a 4th-rank Translocate spell.

entities.name: Drift Drive Relay (Tactical)
entities.description:
This advanced containment unit stores and channels entangled Drift particles, allowing you to briefly flicker into the Drift as you move. When you successfully tumble-through a creature's space, you don't treat its squares as difficult terrain.

As a 10-minute activity, you can attune this armor upgrade to a Drift engine you can physically access to further enhance the relay's abilities.

**Activate—Warp** 2

**Frequency** once per day

**Requirements** You're within planetary range of an attuned, functional Drift engine

**Effect** You warp through space, gaining the effects of a 5th-rank Translocate spell.

entities.name: Duality Circuit (Advanced)
entities.description:
This bleeding-edge runic mesh absorbs and redirects the fundamental energies of life and death.

**Activate—Absorb** r (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You would take damage from or be healed by a vitality or void effect

**Effect** You gain resistance to the triggering damage equal to four times your level or reduce the number of Hit Points you regain by the same amount.

**Activate—Redirect** 1 to 3 (manipulate)

**Requirements** You've used the Absorb reaction since the end of your last turn

**Effect** You invert and redirect the absorbed energy. You cast a 3rd-rank Harm or Heal spell with the same number of actions you spent on the activation. If you absorbed a void effect, you cast heal, and if you absorbed a vitality effect, you cast harm.

entities.description:

**Activate—Redirect** 1 to 3 (manipulate)

**Requirements** You've used the Absorb reaction since the end of your last turn

**Effect** You invert and redirect the absorbed energy. You cast a 1st-rank Harm or Heal spell with the same number of actions you spent on the activation. If you absorbed a void effect, you cast heal, and if you absorbed a vitality effect, you cast harm.

entities.name: Easypatcher (Advanced)
entities.description:
This upgrade contains tiny robotic arms and sensors to detect injuries. The easy patcher can hold up to four medpatches, which you can install as a 10-minute activity. The medpatch's level must be equal to or less than the easypatcher's level or the armor's level, if it's higher.

**Activate—Patch Up** 1 (manipulate)

**Requirements** A medpatch is installed in the easypatcher's compartment

**Effect** The robotic arms hiss and unfold from the compartment, applying the medpatch to your injuries and replicating the consumed medpatch's effect. The medpatch is consumed.

You can replicate the consumed medpatch's effect on a creature up to 10 feet away instead of yourself

entities.name: Easypatcher (Commercial)
entities.description:
This upgrade contains tiny robotic arms and sensors to detect injuries. The easy patcher can hold up to two medpatches, which you can install as a 10-minute activity. The medpatch's level must be equal to or less than the easypatcher's level or the armor's level, if it's higher.

**Activate—Patch Up** 1 (manipulate)

**Requirements** A medpatch is installed in the easypatcher's compartment

**Effect** The robotic arms hiss and unfold from the compartment, applying the medpatch to your injuries and replicating the consumed medpatch's effect. The medpatch is consumed.

entities.name: Easypatcher (Tactical)
entities.description:
This upgrade contains tiny robotic arms and sensors to detect injuries. The easy patcher can hold up to four medpatches, which you can install as a 10-minute activity. The medpatch's level must be equal to or less than the easypatcher's level or the armor's level, if it's higher.

**Activate—Patch Up** 1 (manipulate)

**Requirements** A medpatch is installed in the easypatcher's compartment

**Effect** The robotic arms hiss and unfold from the compartment, applying the medpatch to your injuries and replicating the consumed medpatch's effect. The medpatch is consumed.

entities.name: Energized Spikes (Advanced)
entities.description:
These protruding spikes give armor an aggressive appearance. When you take energy damage, the spikes become charged with that energy type until the next time they're Activated (even if the damage was completely prevented by resistance).

**Activate—Impale** f

**Frequency** once per round

**Trigger** Your turn begins

**Requirements** You're Grabbed, Restrained, or swallowed by a creature or have a creature grabbed or restrained

**Effect** You deal 8d4 untyped damage to the required creature. This damage is piercing unless the spikes are charged with an energy type, in which case you can have them deal damage of that type instead.

entities.name: Energized Spikes (Commercial)
entities.description:
These protruding spikes give armor an aggressive appearance. When you take energy damage, the spikes become charged with that energy type until the next time they're Activated (even if the damage was completely prevented by resistance).

**Activate—Impale** f

**Frequency** once per round

**Trigger** Your turn begins

**Requirements** You're Grabbed, Restrained, or swallowed by a creature or have a creature grabbed or restrained

**Effect** You deal 2d4 untyped damage to the required creature. This damage is piercing unless the spikes are charged with an energy type, in which case you can have them deal damage of that type instead.

entities.name: Energized Spikes (Tactical)
entities.description:
These protruding spikes give armor an aggressive appearance. When you take energy damage, the spikes become charged with that energy type until the next time they're Activated (even if the damage was completely prevented by resistance).

**Activate—Impale** f

**Frequency** once per round

**Trigger** Your turn begins

**Requirements** You're Grabbed, Restrained, or swallowed by a creature or have a creature grabbed or restrained

**Effect** You deal 5d4 untyped damage to the required creature. This damage is piercing unless the spikes are charged with an energy type, in which case you can have them deal damage of that type instead.

entities.name: Energy Shielding (Advanced)
entities.description: This armor is specially treated with insulation to protect against a specific type of damage. You gain resistance 15 to acid, cold, electricity, or fire. The crafter chooses the damage type when creating the upgrade. Multiple energy shielding upgrades can be placed into a suit of armor, but each must provide resistance to a different damage type.

entities.name: Energy Shielding (Commercial)
entities.description: This armor is specially treated with insulation to protect against a specific type of damage. You gain resistance 5 to acid, cold, electricity, or fire. The crafter chooses the damage type when creating the upgrade. Multiple energy shielding upgrades can be placed into a suit of armor, but each must provide resistance to a different damage type.

The crafter chooses the damage type when creating the upgrade. Multiple energy shielding upgrades can be placed into a suit of armor, but each must provide resistance to a different damage type.

entities.name: Explosive Defense Unit
entities.description:
Reinforced custom armor plates automatically generate a containment field to protect you from nearby explosions, granting you resistance 2 to area damage (acid, cold, electricity, and fire damage only). You can also store a grenade in the explosive defense unit and detonate it without harming yourself.

**Activate—Store Grenade** 2 (manipulate)

**Effect** You place a grenade inside a reinforced compartment in the explosive defense unit. You can Interact to retrieve the grenade normally. You can store only one grenade in the armor upgrade at a time.

**Activate—Defensive Detonation** 1 (manipulate)

**Requirements** You have a stored grenade

**Effect** You detonate the grenade stored in the explosive defense unit. The explosion is centered on your space, but the upgrade generates a containment field to protect you from its effects. The grenade otherwise functions as if you'd activated it normally.

entities.name: Flechette Launcher (Advanced)
entities.description:
Generally mounted on the shoulder, this popup launcher fires flechettes. The flechette launcher holds nine cartridges of standard projectile ammunition. Reloading it is a laborious process that can be done only during your daily preparations.

**Activate—Barrage** 3 (manipulate)

**Requirements** The flechette launcher is loaded with at least one cartridge

**Effect** You fire any number of cartridges. Each cartridge hits automatically, dealing 1d4+1 piercing damage to a creature within 120 feet. If multiple flechettes hit the same target, combine the damage before applying resistances, weaknesses, and so on.

entities.name: Flechette Launcher (Commercial)
entities.description:

entities.name: Force Field (Advanced)
entities.description:
Force fields absorb damage. A force field's Hit Points are based on its version. While your force field is active, any physical or energy damage you would take is applied to the force field's Hit Points first before being applied to your Hit Points (including temporary Hit Points). If you have a shield raised, your force field and shield both take damage. If damage from an attack or effect reduces the force field to 0 Hit Points, you take any excess damage, the force field deactivates, and it can't be activated again for 10 minutes. Force fields replenish the indicated number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of your turn while they're active.

If your force field is tactical or better, it also protects you from deadly blows. Each time you're critically hit while your force field is active, attempt a flat check against the listed DC. On a success, it becomes a normal hit.

The force field has 20 Hit Points and replenishes 4 Hit Points on your turn, and DC 19.

Effect: Force Field 20

**Activate—Raise Force Field** 1 (manipulate)

**Frequency** three times per day

**Effect** Your force field becomes active. It remains active for 1 minute or until it's reduced to 0 Hit Points.

*SFS Note:* If a PC takes damage with both a force field up and a shield raised, the force field takes damage first. Shield Block only triggers if there is damage remaining afterwards, at which point the shield would potentially be damaged.

entities.name: Full-Spectrum Sensor Suite (Advanced)
entities.description:
This set of sensors use a helmet-mounted, heads-up display to provide detailed information about your surroundings.

You also gain scent as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet, and the activation's frequency becomes twice per day.

Your hearing additionally becomes a precise sense with a range of 30 feet.

**Activate—Scan** 1 (manipulate)

**Frequency** three times per day

**Effect** You gain tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet for 10 minutes.

entities.name: Full-Spectrum Sensor Suite (Commercial)
entities.description:

entities.name: Glamer Projector
entities.description:
Adjustable rings project magical holograms onto your armor, changing its appearance to match your personal style and suit any occasion. Glamer projectors come programmed with preset options, including casual, corporate, and fashion. You can customize your glamer projector using a computer, like the one in your comm unit.

**Activate—Glamerize!** 1 (manipulate)

**Effect** You instantly change the appearance of your armor to any set of normal clothes or any other type of light or heavy armor. This upgrade is capable of changing only the appearance of your armor, not yourself or the rest of your equipment. You can copy the look of any type of clothing, but you don't gain any item bonuses provided by special types of clothing, such as luxury fashion attire. Only a creature that's benefiting from truesight or a similar effect can attempt to disbelieve this illusion, opposed by your class DC.

entities.name: Glitch Compensator
entities.description: A complex series of redundancies reduces computer glitches. When you roll a critical failure on the flat check to use glitching equipment or when starting your turn while glitching, you get a failure instead. This upgrade is immune to glitching.

entities.name: Jetpack (Commercial)
entities.description:
Boosters attached to your armor allow you to fly.

**Activate—Fly** 1 (manipulate)

**Effect** You activate a jetpack to gain a fly Speed of 20 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you Dismiss it. You can use an action to Fly 0 feet to hover in place, but you're Off-Guard while doing so. A jetpack can't lift you if you're encumbered.

Effect: Jetpack

entities.description:

Effect: Jetpack

entities.name: Jump Jets
entities.description:
Boosters attached to your armor supercharge your leap.

**Activate—Jump** 1 (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per round

**Effect** You activate the jump jets to get a quick boost. You Fly up to 20 feet with a maximum height of 10 feet, or you Fly up to 20 feet straight up. You must land at the end of this movement or fall. Jump jets can't lift you if you're encumbered.

entities.name: Kinetic Generator (Advanced)
entities.description:
This generator converts your movement into electrical energy, recharging an attached battery. The kinetic generator produces 1 charge per 10 minutes of movement; typical daily activities produce enough movement to charge the generator, but no charges are produced while you sleep or sit still. The kinetic generator can hold one battery at a time, and batteries can be attached or removed with a single Interact action.

**Activate—Short Circuit** r (electricity)

**Trigger** You're hit by a creature's melee attack

**Requirements** A battery with at least 10 charges is attached to the kinetic generator

**Effect** You consume all the attached battery's charges, dealing 6d6 electricity damage to the triggering creature (DC 28 save).

entities.name: Load Lifter (Advanced)
entities.description: This series of support braces allow you to carry and lift beyond your normal capacity. You can carry an amount of Bulk equal to 8 plus your Strength modifier without becoming encumbered, and you can hold and carry a total Bulk up to 13 plus your Strength modifier.

entities.name: Load Lifter (Tactical)
entities.description: This series of support braces allow you to carry and lift beyond your normal capacity. You can carry an amount of Bulk equal to 7 plus your Strength modifier without becoming encumbered, and you can hold and carry a total Bulk up to 12 plus your Strength modifier.

entities.name: Maneuvering Unit (Advanced)
entities.description:
Internal stabilizers and jets synchronize your movements in zero gravity. You aren't Off-Guard or clumsy while Untethered.

**Activate—Thrust** 1 (move)

**Requirements** You're in a zero-g environment

**Effect** You move 15 feet in any direction you choose. You begin to float in that direction.

entities.name: Micro-cutters (Commercial)
entities.description:
Tiny spinning blades strategically installed at various locations on the armor let you burrow in loose material and bore through harder surfaces.

**Activate—Burrow** 1 (manipulate)

**Effect** You enable the cutters and gain a burrow Speed of 20 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you Dismiss it.

**Activate—Bore** (concentrate, manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You enable the cutters and bore a hole 5 feet wide, 5 feet tall, and 1 foot deep in a solid, non-metal surface. This activity takes a number of minutes equal to 5 × the surface's Hardness.

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You enable the cutters and bore a hole 5 feet wide, 5 feet tall, and 1 foot deep in a solid, non-metal surface. This activity takes a number of minutes equal to the surface's Hardness.

entities.name: Mobility Enhancer (Commercial)
entities.description: Automated braces help you to move faster in bulky armor. Reduce your armor's penalty to Speeds by 5 feet.

entities.name: Mobility Enhancer (Tactical)
entities.description: Automated braces help you to move faster in bulky armor. Reduce your armor's penalty to Speeds by 10 feet.

entities.name: Moisture Harvester
entities.description:
This advanced temperature and moisture regulation technology was developed on Kasath. You're protected from severe heat, and you can survive for four times as long as normal without water before taking damage.

**Activate—Vent** 2 (manipulate, water)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You release a blast of stored heat and vapor in a 15-foot cone, filling the area with mist that lasts for 1 minute. All creatures within the mist become Concealed, and all creatures outside the mist become concealed to creatures within it.

entities.name: Molten Vambrace (Advanced)
entities.description:
This vambrace is outfitted with a small fabricator that flash-forges temporary weapons.

**Activate—Molten Finale** 1 (fire, metal)

**Frequency** once per minute

**Requirements** You have a free hand, and an adjacent creature was critically hit in the last round

**Effect** Your bracer fabricates a elite molten edge into your free hand, then you Strike the required creature with it.

entities.name: Piloting Instruments (Commercial)
entities.description: This set of advanced piloting instruments is integrated directly into your armor and includes a set of spinal ports that directly connect to vehicles you pilot. You gain a +1 item bonus to Piloting checks, and you can Take Control as a free action once per turn unless it would normally be a multi-action activity.

entities.name: Piloting Instruments (Tactical)
entities.description:
This set of advanced piloting instruments is integrated directly into your armor and includes a set of spinal ports that directly connect to vehicles you pilot. You gain a +2 item bonus to Piloting checks, and you can Take Control as a free action once per turn unless it would normally be a multi-action activity.

You don't take the usual penalty to Piloting checks to perform a Stunt or use the 3-action version of Drive.

entities.name: Psychic Shielding (Advanced)
entities.description:
This armor has a carefully enchanted lining that prevents psychic intrusions and mental harm. You gain resistance 15 to mental damage.

**Activate—Cleanse Mind** r (concentrate, manipulate)

**Frequency** three times per day

**Trigger** You gain the Stupefied condition

**Effect** You reduce the value of the triggering stupefied condition by 1; if this reduces the value to 0, you aren't stupefied.
