entities.description:
These kinetic actuators convert the raw force and rush of superheated air created by an explosion into motion.

**Activate—Backdraft** r (air, move, traversal)

**Frequency** once per minute

**Trigger** You attempt a Reflex save against a damaging effect and don't critically fail

**Effect** After resolving the triggering effect, you leap. If you critically succeeded on the triggering save, you can Stride instead.

entities.name: Rebound Actuator (Tactical)
entities.description:
These kinetic actuators convert the raw force and rush of superheated air created by an explosion into motion.

**Activate—Backdraft** r (air, move, traversal)

**Frequency** once per minute

**Trigger** You attempt a Reflex save against a damaging effect and don't critically fail

**Effect** After resolving the triggering effect, you leap. If you critically succeeded on the triggering save, you can Stride instead. When activated, a willing adjacent creature is carried with you to a free space adjacent to your destination.

entities.name: Sound System (Advanced)
entities.description:
This set of speakers can project your voice or audio from a connected device. You gain a +3 item bonus to Diplomacy, Intimidation, and Performance checks for auditory actions.

**Activate—Feedback** 2 (auditory, manipulate)

**Frequency** once per hour

**Effect** You initiate a powerful feedback loop that deals 10d6 sonic |options:area-damage damage to creatures in a 15-foot emanation (DC 32 save).

entities.name: Sound System (Commercial)
entities.description: This set of speakers can project your voice or audio from a connected device. You gain a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy, Intimidation, and Performance checks for auditory actions.

entities.name: Sound System (Tactical)
entities.description:
This set of speakers can project your voice or audio from a connected device. You gain a +2 item bonus to Diplomacy, Intimidation, and Performance checks for auditory actions.

**Activate—Feedback** 2 (auditory, manipulate)

**Frequency** once per hour

**Effect** You initiate a powerful feedback loop that deals 5d6 sonic |options:area-damage damage to creatures in a 15-foot emanation (DC 18 save).

entities.name: Spell Gauntlet
entities.description:
Spell gauntlets are often custom ordered, bearing a personal inscription from the spellcaster who commissioned them. The gauntlets blaze with power when the wearer uses magic.

**Activate—Curve Spell** f (concentrate, spellshape)

**Effect** If your next action is to Cast a Spell that requires a spell attack roll against AC, choose Fortitude DC or Reflex DC. You make your spell attack roll against that defense instead of AC. If the spell has multiple targets, the choice of DC applies to all of them.

entities.name: Spell Refactoring Matrix
entities.description:
This runic pillar is integrated into your armor in a convenient location. The *spell refactoring matrix* within captures wasted magical particles, keeping them charged for another volley.

**Activate—Refactor Magicule** r

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You Cast a heightened spell from a spell slot, and you failed or critically failed all spell attack rolls or all affected creatures critically succeeded at their saving throws against the spell

**Effect** The matrix captures a portion of the wasted spell. You can cast the same spell again at two ranks lower than the rank you originally cast it, without using a spell slot. If the spell can't be cast at that rank or you don't cast the spell before the end of your next turn, the captured spell is wasted.

entities.name: Survival Subroutine
entities.description:
This autonomous subroutine subordinates all mobility systems in an emergency, providing a last-chance, best-effort attempt to escape immediate danger.

**Activate—Retreat** r (move, traversal)

**Trigger** You would gain the dying condition

**Requirements** You aren't already dying or wounded

**Effect** You Stride, avoiding danger as much as possible. This movement doesn't trigger reactions. You then gain the triggering dying condition as normal.

entities.name: Void Mesh
entities.description: This synthetic biomesh is installed beneath your armor, replacing its fabric substrate with a form-fitting material reminiscent of necrotic tissue. The mesh was designed for joint missions between the Eoxian military and their Pact World allies. If you have the void healing ability, allied creatures can choose to treat you as living or undead when using vitality effects, and you can be healed by healing vitality effects. You're still damaged by vitality damage.

entities.name: Zeroedge Blade Sharpener
entities.description:
Chefs all over Near Space swear by Forgeworks Innovations' patented ZeroEdge technology to sharpen their knives without having to slow down the kitchen.

**Activate—Sharpen** 1 (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per hour

**Requirements** You're wielding a melee weapon that deals slashing damage and does not have the deadly trait

**Effect** The required weapon gains the deadly d6 trait until the start of your next turn. The weapon becomes immune to the zero edge blade sharpener for 24 hours.

entities.name: Abadarcorp Travel Suit
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 2

AbadarCorp executives popularized these armored business suits for boardrooms and battle. Contingent force fields and concealed plating protect the wearer in hostile situations. Higher grades of travel suits offer more protection—along with a designer label.

entities.name: Aegis Series
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 0

Aegis armor suits are starmetal-infused shells that encase the wearer entirely, including an attached visorless helmet that's often sculpted into a custom style. Sensors built into the suit feed sensory information to the wearer, and powered limbs aid maneuvers. Movement in an aegis suit is clumsy, but powerful.

entities.name: Aeon Guard Battle Dress
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 0

The mainstay of the Aeon Guard is solid armor that provides a fair amount of mobility for the wearer. The Aeon Guard believes in being armed and armored at all times and stresses a certain amount of flexibility in how their gear operates so soldiers can adapt to any situation.

entities.name: Aquavarius Armor
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Equipped with a sturdy dorsal fin and webbed extremities, this armor facilitates underwater exploration and mobility. Aquavarius armor is beloved by marine biologists, xenowardens, and ocean enthusiasts alike. AbadarCorp markets it as the definitive beachwear for adventurers seeking sunken treasures. Aquavarius armor always has commercial aqua jets installed at no extra cost and using no upgrade slot.

entities.name: Archon Armor
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 0

Archon armor was designed by those who aspire to reach the heavens. Taking inspiration from angels, archon armor offers lightweight and flexible composite protection while using small jet nozzles in a wing pattern to propel the wearer forward at high speeds.

entities.name: Armored Coat
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This overcoat is made of real or synthetic leather and reinforced with armored plates. Armored coats are often tailor-made to match the wearer's personal style. Standard versions are issued to military officers as part of their uniforms.

entities.name: Bonecowl Armor
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 0

This menacing skeletal armor is adorned with a drapery of hanging wires and biotech mesh, and usually features a stylish cape. For generations, Eoxian heads of state and bone sages have worn bonecowl armor to inject some drama and theater to political gatherings while protecting themselves from assassins.

entities.name: Carapace Armor
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 0

Originating from the distant world of Shimrinsara, carapace armor is grown, not built, and remains alive while attached to an owner. After a short period of acclimation, during which it grows to cover the body, the armor perfectly matches the wearer's movements and provides environmental protection. The living carapace is self-sustaining, surviving on dead skin cells and body fluids without harming the wearer.

entities.name: Carbon Skin
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This form-fitting suit of carbon fiber encases the body. Most are usually dull-gray, functional garments, while pricier, bespoke suits dazzle like diamonds.

entities.name: Carvesong
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Chiseled from sacred bark gathered from Vesk-3's remaining jungles, this armor surrounds the wearer with a magical magnetic field that ensures their survival in extreme environments. Rumors suggest that pahtra sorcerers who wear this armor can enhance their spells by channeling their planet's magnetic melodies through the runic carvings along the wooden plates.

entities.name: Clandestine Suit
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 0

This all-black bodysuit features two coattail-like cables hanging from the shoulders. When the suit's cloaking device is activated, the cables come alive and their tips project a gravitational field that bends light around the wearer. Clandestine suits always have tactical active camouflage and a tactical cloaking device installed at no extra cost and using no upgrade slots.

entities.name: Defiance Series
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This squad armor is a molded shell of reinforced polycarbon with a helmet and retractable visor.

entities.name: Defrex Hide
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Made from the hide of a ferocious mammal native to Vesk-2, this medium armor is especially popular among vesk. Tanned slabs of the creature's thick hide are stitched together with metal wires, and the joints are reinforced with metal studs or scales.

entities.name: Drifter's Jacket
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This stylish jacket comes equipped with integrated environmental protections and air thrusters to aid zero-g mobility. It also features two bulky shoulder pads that conceal a localized Drift transportation device. Drifter's jackets always have a commercial Drift drive relay installed at no extra cost and using no upgrade slot.

entities.name: Estex Suit
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This bulky flight suit is reinforced with thin polycarbon panels sewn between layers of tactical fabric.

entities.name: Evolutionary Armor
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

These jellyfish-like symbiotes are commonplace on Bretheda. For much of the planet's history, their properties weren't well-understood since native barathus have little need for the symbiote's benefits. When offworlders first arrived on exploratory missions, however, they found the living spacesuits immensely useful.

entities.name: Flight Suit
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 0

This comfortable coverall is made from lightweight thermal fabric and often adorned with patches displaying personal insignia, military rank, or even favorite bands or sports teams.

entities.name: Freebooter Armor
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Freebooter armor is named for the pirates and outlaws who often wear these outfits. Freebooter armor typically consists of a breastplate worn under a jacket or flight suit, heavy boots and gloves, a helmet, and hidden straps and holsters for concealing weapons.

entities.name: Hardlight Series
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

A projector fastened to a belt or lapel encases the wearer's body in this shimmering hardlight shell. Military-issue hardlight armor follows a predictable standard, but private users enjoy a range of customizable fashion options.

entities.name: Hellknight Plate
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 0

Unbowed, unrelenting, and unforgiving. This iconic black heavy armor bears protruding spikes and an ominous silhouette. Each set features a distinct design matching the stylings of its owner's Hellknight order. Hellknight plates always have commercial energized spikes installed at no extra cost and using no upgrade slot.

entities.name: Hidden Soldier Armor
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This suit of heavy armor features a slitted helmet that reveals only the wearer's eyes. This high-tech ceramic suit consists of breastplate, shoulder guards, bracers, and greaves that flex with the body's movements.

entities.name: Kyokor Plating
entities.description:
**Upgrade:** 1

This armor incorporates a full-coverage polycarbon suit studded with ports and sockets and layered with plates from Daimalko's infamous colossi. Kyokor plating comes with boots, gloves, and a helmet with a clear visor.

entities.name: Lucidity Shawl
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 0

This fetching armor features folding neck plates that protect its wearer's vitals. When an aeon stone or spell gem is socketed into it, this "shawl" comes alive with vibrant particles and flows softly as if in a gentle breeze.

entities.name: Mageplate
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 0

Mass produced by the Veskarium, this armor's dense plates are inlaid with mystical filigree that glows when its wearer channels magic. At the heart of each set of mageplate is a splinter of enchanted bark that bends magnetic fields into defensive spellpower.

entities.name: MED-shell
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 0

This bulky armor features massive shoulder pads and plated vambraces that protect its wearer's articulating extremities and digits. Iconically worn by Pact Worlds field medics during the height of the Silent War, MED-shells have since become the de facto choice for athletic healers. MED-Shells always have an Auto-CPR Unit installed at no extra cost and using no upgrade slot.

entities.name: Microcord Armor
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This light armor is woven from ultralight fibers that flex with a wearer's movements but turn hard as steel on impact.

entities.name: Myrmidon Siegebreaker
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Created as the pinnacle of personal protection, myrmidon siegebreaker plate transforms its wearer into a walking tank. It's designed to walk into extreme punishment and out the other side. This protection comes at the cost of mobility, so soldiers wearing siegebreaker armor are usually hot-dropped on the front lines to minimize this limitation.

entities.name: Nanosuit
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 0

*Nanosuits* were developed to hide the fact that the wearer was armored and prepared for trouble. Using a combination of nanotechnology and spellcraft, the armor can appear and disappear at will, protecting the owner when needed and hiding away in a secure pocket or even under the skin when not in use.

entities.name: Quilted Armor
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This armor is made of layered fabrics stitched together and is popular with scavengers. On Akiton, some suits of quilted armor are actually constructed of heirloom blankets and garments repurposed for protection.

entities.name: Rescue Suit
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 0

Every stellar voyage carries a risk of accident or open combat. Few travelers, however, want to be armored at all times, so many commercial star lines provide these rescue suits, quick to deploy and put on from convenient containers placed throughout the ship.

entities.name: Retrieval Harness
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

First developed by Starfinder scientists, this armor is outfitted with prolific aramid pouches, straps, and intricate rail systems that keep a full complement of equipment and consumables at the ready. Retrieval harnesses always have a commercial easypatcher installed at no extra cost and using no upgrade slot.

entities.name: Rocketeer Armor
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 0

This armor has a built-in jetpack and auxiliary thrusters mounted in the boots and thighs. It offers unparalleled aerial mobility, all while sporting a stylish leather jacket. Rocketeer armor always have a jetpack installed at no extra cost and using no upgrade slot.

entities.name: Second Skin
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 0

Soft but resilient fabric contours perfectly to the wearer's body, offering basic protection without sacrificing comfort. Second skin is commonly worn underneath casual clothing.

entities.name: Sensory Amplification Suit
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

While most armor dampens the senses in favor of superior protection, some tasks require exceptional awareness while still being safe from harm. This armored harness is equipped with a full sensory suite and is especially popular among spies and scouts. Sensory amplification suits always have a commercial full-spectrum sensor suite installed at no extra cost and using no upgrade slot.

entities.name: Shotalashu Armor
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Flexible but sturdy plates layered together form this traditional armor worn by lashunta cavalry on Castrovel. In times past, a shotalashu cavalry member forged their armor from their mount's shed skin, or more rarely, the skin of a fallen mount, to honor them in future battles. Synthetic imitations are fashionable on some parts of Castrovel.

entities.name: Skyfire Armor
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 0

These decorative suits of medium armor feature exaggerated shoulder guards, stylized dragon wings, and draconic emblems across the breastplate's back and chest. Skyfire armor is often plated with gold or other attractive metals, sacrificing upgrade space for style.

entities.name: Stormbreaker Armor
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This dark-blue armor features a series of conductive rods along the spine that draw and discharge high-voltage electricity without harming the wearer. Originally developed to protect Veskarium troopers from Vesk-5's deadly vortex storms, stormbreaker armor is now worn most often by stormrunners and other smugglers who skim what profits they can from the dangerous gas giant. Stombreaker armor always has commercial energized spikes and commercial energy shielding (electricity) installed at no extra cost and using no upgrade slots.

entities.name: Swarmsuit
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Specialized nanites form a mesh suit that shifts to fit wearers with unique or transformable physiologies.

entities.name: Tempweave
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Tempweave suits are reinforced hooded garments woven with thermal fabric and venting wires, popularly worn for trips to humid climates like the jungles of Castrovel or Pulonis.

entities.name: Thinplate
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This sleek but rigid plate armor is often constructed from translucent materials to show off a wearer's dermal circuitry and worn under baggy clothing.

entities.name: Veskarium Brigandine
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 0

Thanks to its inertial dampeners and broad range of motion, this lightweight armor is a gold standard across the Pact Worlds for military personnel and adventurers alike. The breastplate consists of interlocking polymer hexagons that mimic fabric but harden like steel against impact.

entities.name: Veskarium Imperial Plate
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This heavy armor is made of interlocking metal plates contoured to the wearer's body with a scaled pattern. Tailguards and clawed gloves are standard for this armor.

entities.name: Artificial Immortalizer
entities.description:
This extra organ assimilates with and enhances your circulatory and immune systems. When you succeed at a Fortitude save against an ongoing disease or poison, you recover completely, regardless of its current stage. When you get this augmentation, you either increase your Constitution modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

**Activate—Life Buffer** 1 (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You gain 50 temporary Hit Points, which last for 1 hour.

Effect: Artificial Immortalizer

entities.name: Cognition Accelerator
entities.description:
A miniature supercomputer augments your brain's ability to process information. You gain a +3 item bonus to checks to Recall Knowledge with any skill. When you get this augmentation, you either increase your Intelligence modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value. This gives you additional trained skills and languages, as normal for increasing your Intelligence modifier. You must select skills and languages when the augmentation is first installed, and they can't be changed.

**Activate—Access Database** 1 (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per hour

**Effect** Immediately attempt three checks to Recall Knowledge about related topics, selecting each topic after learning the results of the prior checks. If you would fail one of these checks, you succeed instead.

entities.name: Cosmic Connector
entities.description:
This augmentation opens your mind to the underlying cosmic truths of the universe. When you get this augmentation, you either increase your Wisdom modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

**Activate—Reground in Reality** r (concentrate, fortune)

**Frequency** once per hour

**Trigger** You fail a saving throw against a magical effect

**Effect** You can reroll the save and use the better result.

entities.name: Hypernerves
entities.description:
This augmentation enhances your muscles and nervous system to dramatically improve your flexibility and reaction time. You gain a +3 item bonus to Acrobatics checks. When you get this augmentation, you either increase your Dexterity modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

**Activate—Engage Hypernerves** f (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** One of your reactions triggers, but you have no remaining reactions to spend

**Effect** You gain a reaction and immediately use the triggering reaction. You're Slowed 1 on your following turn.

entities.name: Muscle Invigorator
entities.description:
This augmentation keeps your muscles in peak condition. You gain a +3 item bonus to Athletics checks. When you get this augmentation, you either increase your Strength modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

**Activate—Strength of the Colossi** 1 (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You temporarily become as destructive and powerful as a colossus. For 1 hour, your melee Strikes ignore the hardness of all objects and structures not made of adamantine or a harder material.

entities.name: Presence Intensifier
entities.description:
This augmentation strengthens your personality, intensifying the parts of you that form the core of your identity. You gain a +2 item bonus to Diplomacy and Intimidation checks. When you get this augmentation, you either increase your Charisma modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

**Activate—Irresistible Idea** 2 (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per hour

**Effect** You manipulate your cosmetics to influence a creature as a 4th-rank Suggestion (DC 38).

entities.name: Claws (Commercial)
entities.description: Claws are grafted to the ends of your hands, feet, or other appropriate appendages. You gain a claw unarmed attack that deals 1d6 slashing damage, is in the brawling group, and has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits.

entities.name: Claws (Tactical)
entities.description:
Claws are grafted to the ends of your hands, feet, or other appropriate appendages. You gain a claw unarmed attack that deals 1d6 slashing damage, is in the brawling group, and has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits.

Whenever you critically hit with your claw unarmed attack, you get its critical specialization effect.

entities.name: Dragon Gland (Advanced)
entities.description:
With cutting edge surgery, you're implanted with an magical gland modified to function for a creature of your ancestry at the back of your throat. Choose your breath weapon's damage type when the organ is biocrafted from the following list: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. You gain the following activation.

**Activate—Exhale** 1 (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Effect** Each creature in a 15-foot cone takes 4d6 untyped damage with a DC 23 save. The damage depends on the augmentation's version.

entities.name: Dragon Gland (Commercial)
entities.description:
With cutting edge surgery, you're implanted with an magical gland modified to function for a creature of your ancestry at the back of your throat. Choose your breath weapon's damage type when the organ is biocrafted from the following list: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. You gain the following activation.

**Activate—Exhale** 1 (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Effect** Each creature in a 15-foot cone takes 1d6 untyped damage with a DC 15 save. The damage depends on the augmentation's version.

entities.name: Dragon Gland (Elite)
entities.description:

Choose your breath weapon's damage type when the organ is biocrafted from the following list: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. You gain the following activation.

**Activate—Exhale** 1 (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Effect** Each creature in a 15-foot cone takes 10d6 untyped damage with a DC 37 save. The damage depends on the augmentation's version.

entities.name: Dragon Gland (Superior)
entities.description:

Choose your breath weapon's damage type when the organ is biocrafted from the following list: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. You gain the following activation.

**Activate—Exhale** 1 (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Effect** Each creature in a 15-foot cone takes 6d6 untyped damage with a DC 29 save. The damage depends on the augmentation's version.

entities.name: Dragon Gland (Tactical)
entities.description:
With cutting edge surgery, you're implanted with an magical gland modified to function for a creature of your ancestry at the back of your throat. Choose your breath weapon's damage type when the organ is biocrafted from the following list: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. You gain the following activation.

**Activate—Exhale** 1 (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Effect** Each creature in a 15-foot cone takes 2d6 untyped damage with a DC 16 save. The damage depends on the augmentation's version.

entities.name: Dragon Gland (Ultimate)
entities.description:
With cutting edge surgery, you're implanted with an magical gland modified to function for a creature of your ancestry at the back of your throat. Choose your breath weapon's damage type when the organ is biocrafted from the following list: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. You gain the following activation.

**Activate—Exhale** 1 (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Effect** Each creature in a 15-foot cone takes 14d6 untyped damage with a DC 43 save. The damage depends on the augmentation's version.

entities.name: Elastic Skin (Advanced)
entities.description: Your skin appears normal for your species but stretches dramatically when pulled, giving you more freedom of movement in tight spaces. You gain a +3 item bonus to Acrobatics or Athletics checks to Escape or Squeeze.

entities.name: Elastic Skin (Commercial)
entities.description: Your skin appears normal for your species but stretches dramatically when pulled, giving you more freedom of movement in tight spaces. You gain a +1 item bonus to Acrobatics or Athletics checks to Escape or Squeeze.

entities.name: Elastic Skin (Tactical)
entities.description: Your skin appears normal for your species but stretches dramatically when pulled, giving you more freedom of movement in tight spaces. You gain a +2 item bonus to Acrobatics or Athletics checks to Escape or Squeeze.

entities.name: Emergency Buoyancy Bladder (Advanced)
entities.description:
This pliable bladder placed in your abdominal cavity produces specially designed enzymes. On command, the bladder's contents rapidly catalyze, inflating the bladder and dramatically reducing your body's density. The bladder can only keep you afloat, so you must still Swim to move horizontally.

**Activate—Bloat** 1

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** The bladder inflates. You rise to the surface of a body of any liquid (or gas denser than air) at a rate of 60 feet per round. Once you reach the surface, you float for up to 8 hours or until you deflate the bladder with a single Interact action.

entities.name: Emergency Buoyancy Bladder (Commercial)
entities.description:
This pliable bladder placed in your abdominal cavity produces specially designed enzymes. On command, the bladder's contents rapidly catalyze, inflating the bladder and dramatically reducing your body's density. The bladder can only keep you afloat, so you must still Swim to move horizontally.

**Activate—Bloat** 1

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** The bladder inflates. You rise to the surface of a body of water (or any liquid denser than water) at a rate of 20 feet per round. Once you reach the surface, you float for 30 minutes or until you deflate the bladder with a single Interact action.

entities.name: Emergency Buoyancy Bladder (Tactical)
entities.description:
This pliable bladder placed in your abdominal cavity produces specially designed enzymes. On command, the bladder's contents rapidly catalyze, inflating the bladder and dramatically reducing your body's density. The bladder can only keep you afloat, so you must still Swim to move horizontally.

**Activate—Bloat** 1

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** The bladder inflates. You rise to the surface of a body of any liquid at a rate of 40 feet per round. Once you reach the surface, you float for up to 1 hour or until you deflate the bladder with a single Interact action.

entities.name: Filament Mesh (Advanced)
entities.description:
A network of filaments drawn from tashtari fur is implanted under your skin, allowing you to absorb and release solar radiation. The mesh is faintly visible as a reflective tracery under your skin when exposed to bright light. Your filament mesh is charged if you've spent at least 4 of the past 24 hours in bright light or direct sunlight. The mesh can't absorb or release light if your skin is completely covered by protective gear, though armor or clothing can be adjusted at no additional cost to accommodate this augmentation.

**Activate—Solar Flash** 2 (visual)

**Requirements** Your filament mesh is charged

**Effect** You discharge the solar energy stored in your filament mesh, creating an intense flash. Creatures in a 10-foot emanation must succeed at a DC 28 save or be Blinded and Dazzled for 2 rounds.

**Requirements** Your filament mesh is charged

**Effect** You discharge the solar energy stored in your filament mesh, creating an intense flash. Creatures in a 10-foot emanation must succeed at a DC 17 save or be Dazzled for 1 round.

**Requirements** Your filament mesh is charged

**Effect** You discharge the solar energy stored in your filament mesh, creating an intense flash. Creatures in a 20-foot emanation must succeed at a DC 41 save or be Blinded and Dazzled for 2 rounds.

**Requirements** Your filament mesh is charged

**Effect** You discharge the solar energy stored in your filament mesh, creating an intense flash. Creatures in a 10-foot emanation must succeed at a DC 34 save or be Blinded and Dazzled for 2 rounds.

entities.name: Filament Mesh (Tactical)
entities.description:
A network of filaments drawn from tashtari fur is implanted under your skin, allowing you to absorb and release solar radiation. The mesh is faintly visible as a reflective tracery under your skin when exposed to bright light. Your filament mesh is charged if you've spent at least 4 of the past 24 hours in bright light or direct sunlight. The mesh can't absorb or release light if your skin is completely covered by protective gear, though armor or clothing can be adjusted at no additional cost to accommodate this augmentation.

**Activate—Solar Flash** 2 (visual)

**Requirements** Your filament mesh is charged

**Effect** You discharge the solar energy stored in your filament mesh, creating an intense flash. Creatures in a 10-foot emanation must succeed at a DC 23 save or be Dazzled for 2 rounds.

entities.name: Fins (Advanced)
entities.description: Bony fins are grafted to your arms, legs, or other appropriate appendages. These fins seamlessly fold alongside your natural appendages, though frilly "old Golarion" models still exist. You can deploy the fins with an Interact action, but you can't deploy or use them while you're wearing more than light armor, as they require enough space to unfold. While the fins are deployed and you aren't encumbered, you gain a swim Speed of 40 feet.

entities.name: Gill Sheath
entities.description: Oxygen-filtering nodules line the outside of your lungs. If you breathe in water, the gill sheath filters the oxygen into your lungs. This allows you to breathe underwater or in the air. You exhale normally.

entities.name: Glittergland (Advanced)
entities.description:
Your lungs or palms are implanted with an organ that produces reflective, sticky dandruff, popularly known as a glittergland. The muscles surrounding the gland can contract in a spasm, expelling the glitter forward.

**Activate—Glitterburst** 1 (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** A 15-foot cone becomes coated in glitter. Invisible creatures in the area become Concealed instead. Creatures in the area that were already concealed for any other reason are no longer concealed. Affected creatures must attempt a DC 29 saving throw. Affected creatures are also Dazzled for the duration.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The glitter affects the creature for 2 rounds.

**Failure** The glitter affects the creature for 1 minute.

**Critical Failure** The glitter affects the creature for 10 minutes.

**Failure** The glitter affects the creature for 1 minute.

entities.name: Laser Eye
entities.description: A laser eye from an Akashic dragon (or other creature) has been implanted into your body. Whether the eye was vat grown or carved from a kill is your secret. You gain a laser eye unarmed attack that deals 1d4 fire damage with a range increment of 60 feet. Your laser eye is in the laser group and has the agile, concealable, fire, tech, and unarmed traits.

entities.name: Neck Frill
entities.description: These colorful folding frills can dramatically unfold in an instant. You can flare your neck frill when you demoralize to have the action lose the auditory trait and gain the visual trait. If you do, you don't take a penalty for not speaking a language or sharing the target's language.

entities.name: Noxious Sweat (Advanced)
entities.description:
Enhanced sweat glands secrete a foul, oily substance on command, surrounding you in a noxious stench.

**Activate—Skunk It** 1 (aura, manipulate, poison)

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Effect** You create a stench cloud in a 5-foot emanation for 1d4 rounds. Creatures that enter the cloud or begin their turn inside it must succeed at a DC 34 save or be Sickened 1.

entities.description:

entities.name: Patagium (Commercial)
entities.description:
A thin, fleshy membrane stretches between your front and hind limbs. You can spread your patagium as a single Interact action as long as you aren't encumbered or wearing heavy armor. While your patagium is spread, you gain a fly Speed of 20 feet, but you can't gain altitude using this fly Speed and must descend at least 1 foot for every 5 feet you move horizontally.

**Activate—Emergency Spread** r

**Trigger** You fall at least 10 feet

**Requirements** You aren't encumbered or wearing heavy armor

**Effect** You Interact to spread your patagium, arresting your fall. If you hit the ground before the start of your next turn, you take no damage from falling.

entities.name: Patagium (Tactical)
entities.description:

**Activate—Airbrake** r

**Trigger** You would be moved by a forced movement effect other than falling

**Effect** You snap your patagium open, arresting your momentum. You're moved only 5 feet by the triggering effect.

entities.name: Pheromone Gland (Commercial)
entities.description: Enhanced pheromone glands are implanted in your throat and wrists, constantly releasing faint but effective chemical hormones. These pheromones don't have a smell, and their effects are imperceptible unless you're communicating with a creature that normally communicates primarily through pheromones. You get a +1 item bonus to Nature checks to Command an Animal. If you have a wildwise graft or other way of communicating directly with animals, you also get a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy checks on animals.

entities.name: Pheromone Gland (Tactical)
entities.description: Enhanced pheromone glands are implanted in your throat and wrists, constantly releasing faint but effective chemical hormones. These pheromones don't have a smell, and their effects are imperceptible unless you're communicating with a creature that normally communicates primarily through pheromones. You get a +2 item bonus to Nature checks to Command an Animal. If you have a wildwise graft or other way of communicating directly with animals, you also get a +2 item bonus to Diplomacy checks.

entities.name: Photosynthetic Skin
entities.description: Specialized nanites enhance your natural surface cells, allowing them to convert solar radiation into nourishment for your body. You don't need to eat, and you're never Fatigued as a result of hunger or starvation as long as you spend at least 1 hour per day basking in direct sunlight. You can bask as part of a normal 8-hour rest period.

entities.name: Predator Teeth (Commercial)
entities.description: Your incisors are replaced with viciously pointed versions based on a predator of your choice. Models that instead replace all your teeth with fangs are also available. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage, is in the brawling group, and has the grapple and unarmed traits.

entities.name: Predator Teeth (Tactical)
entities.description:
Your incisors are replaced with viciously pointed versions based on a predator of your choice. Models that instead replace all your teeth with fangs are also available. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage, is in the brawling group, and has the grapple and unarmed traits.

Whenever you get a critical hit with your jaws unarmed attack, you get its critical specialization effect.

entities.name: Quills (Advanced)
entities.description:
Your skin is enhanced with retractable quills or bone spines that hide in puckered pores when not in use. You can extend or retract the quills with an Interact action but can't use or deploy them while wearing heavy armor.

**Activate—Prickly Defense** r

**Trigger** A creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack or successfully Grapples you

**Requirements** Your quills are extended

**Effect** You deal 6d6 piercing damage to the triggering creature. If the triggering attack was a critical hit, the attacker also takes 2d6 persistent,bleed damage.

entities.name: Shielding Skin (Advanced)
entities.description: Your skin is biologically engineered to protect your entire body, including your brain, from harmful effects. You gain a +3 item bonus to saving throws.

entities.name: Shielding Skin (Commercial)
entities.description: Your skin is biologically engineered to protect your entire body, including your brain, from harmful effects. You gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws.

entities.name: Shielding Skin (Tactical)
entities.description: Your skin is biologically engineered to protect your entire body, including your brain, from harmful effects. You gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws.

entities.name: Slime Gland (Advanced)
entities.description:
A slime gland is implanted into an accessible orifice, such as your mouth or nose, where it can easily expel a sticky and often chunky slime.

**Activate—Excrete Slime** 1 (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per minute

**Effect** You expel slime into an empty adjacent square, a 15-foot line, or a 15-foot cone. The area becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute or until washed off by a water effect.

entities.name: Spinneret (Commercial)
entities.description:
You can produce a small amount of sturdy silk every day by extruding it from a specially implanted spinneret. The silk is nonsticky but extremely durable, functioning like a commercial cable line, but it degrades after 24 hours. The spinneret is unobtrusive when not in use and can only be found with a detailed medical scan. You can extrude up to 25 feet of silk per day.

**Activate—Spin** 1 (manipulate) You extrude 5 feet of silk.

entities.name: Spinneret (Tactical)
entities.description:
You can produce a small amount of sturdy silk every day by extruding it from a specially implanted spinneret. The silk is nonsticky but extremely durable, functioning like a commercial cable line, but it degrades after 24 hours. The spinneret is unobtrusive when not in use and can only be found with a detailed medical scan. You can extrude up to 100 feet of silk per day.

**Activate—Spin** 1 (manipulate) You extrude 5 feet of silk.

entities.name: Ultralight Wings (Advanced)
entities.description: Foldable wings are attached to your shoulder blades or a similar location on your body that allows them to lift your weight and assist your flying movements. You can deploy the wings with an Interact action, but you can't deploy or use them while you're wearing more than light armor. While the wings are deployed and you're not encumbered, you gain a fly Speed of 40 feet and a +2 item bonus to Acrobatics checks to Maneuver in Flight.

entities.description: Foldable wings are attached to your shoulder blades or a similar location on your body that allows them to lift your weight and assist your flying movements. You can deploy the wings with an Interact action, but you can't deploy or use them while you're wearing more than light armor. While the wings are deployed and you're not encumbered, you gain a fly Speed of 20 feet and a +1 item bonus to Acrobatics checks to Maneuver in Flight.

entities.description: Foldable wings are attached to your shoulder blades or a similar location on your body that allows them to lift your weight and assist your flying movements. You can deploy the wings with an Interact action, but you can't deploy or use them while you're wearing more than light armor. While the wings are deployed and you're not encumbered, you gain a fly Speed of 30 feet and a +1 item bonus to Acrobatics checks to Maneuver in Flight.

entities.name: Vacuum-Adapted Lungs (Commercial)
entities.description: Your lungs contain extra valves that protect you against decompression and special glands that inject chemical antifreeze into your bloodstream. You can hold your breath for 10 minutes and are immune to the normal environmental effects of being in a vacuum for as long as you hold your breath. You're also acclimated to either thin or thick atmospheres, chosen when you install this augmentation.

entities.name: Vacuum-Adapted Lungs (Tactical)
entities.description: Your lungs contain extra valves that protect you against decompression and special glands that inject chemical antifreeze into your bloodstream. You can hold your breath for 1 hour and are immune to the normal environmental effects of being in a vacuum for as long as you hold your breath. You're also acclimated to both thin and thick atmospheres.

entities.name: Venom Spur
entities.description: A retractable spur attached to one of your appendages delivers a poisonous sting. You gain a venom spur unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing plus 1d4 persistent poison damage. Your venom spur is in the brawling group and has the finesse, poison, and unarmed traits.

entities.name: Vestibular Enhancement (Commercial)
entities.description: Your vestibular system is enhanced with delicate structures from a species accustomed to zero gravity. At the end of each round in which you're Untethered, attempt a DC 15. On a success, you ignore the clumsy and Off-Guard conditions imposed by being in zero-g for 1 minute.

entities.name: Vestibular Enhancement (Tactical)
entities.description: Your vestibular system is enhanced with delicate structures from a species accustomed to zero gravity. At the end of each round in which you're Untethered, attempt a DC 5. On a success, you ignore the clumsy and Off-Guard conditions imposed by being in zero-g for 1 minute.

entities.name: Wildwise Graft
entities.description: This soft purple fungus attaches to your vocal cords and extends fine filaments into portions of your brain. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals, plants, and fungi. This communication is rudimentary and elicits basic responses, such as "hungry," "over there," or "frightened."

entities.name: Additional Appendage (Commercial)
entities.description:
You gain an additional arm, tentacle, or similar appendage, usually with the same anatomy as your existing arms, though alternatives are available, such as tails engineered to carry items. Regardless of its appearance, the additional appendage functions identically to your existing arms and hands, or the equivalent for your ancestry. You can hold an additional hand's worth of weapons and equipment but must Switch Hands to wield items with the additional appendage, as normal for characters with more than two hands.

**Special** If you have a second additional appendage augmentation, you can treat them both as a single pair of hands for the purposes of Switching Hands. If you have a third, it's treated as its own set of hands, though you can treat it as a pair with a fourth additional appendage, and so on. Each additional appendage still applies to your body's implant limit, even if they're paired together.

entities.name: Additional Appendage (Tactical)
entities.description:
You gain an additional arm, tentacle, or similar appendage, usually with the same anatomy as your existing arms, though alternatives are available, such as tails engineered to carry items. Regardless of its appearance, the additional appendage functions identically to your existing arms and hands, or the equivalent for your ancestry. You can hold an additional hand's worth of weapons and equipment but must Switch Hands to wield items with the additional appendage, as normal for characters with more than two hands.

The additional appendage has an advanced coprocessor that can briefly take control. You gain the following activation.

**Activate—Animated Limb** 1 Until the beginning of your next turn, you count one additional hand or pair of hands as your active hands. At the beginning of your next turn, choose which set of active hands remains your active hands.

**Special** If you have a second additional appendage augmentation, you can treat them both as a single pair of hands for the purposes of Switching Hands. If you have a third, it's treated as its own set of hands, though you can treat it as a pair with a fourth additional appendage, and so on. Each additional appendage still applies to your body's implant limit, even if they're paired together.

entities.name: Cosmetic Cybernetics
entities.description: While most creatures get cybernetic implants to enhance their bodies and minds or to restore lost abilities, many choose to make their enhancements as flashy as possible, matching their personal aesthetics or making a bold statement. Some, however, prefer to have just the flash, hold the enhancement. Cosmetic cybernetics have no mechanical benefit but alter your appearance in an obvious, dramatic way. They might represent cables and wires extending from your head or limbs, additional limbs that can't hold items, wings that can't fly, glowing patterns in your skin that offer no real illumination, a fiber-optic mohawk, or any of hundreds of other options, including those that resemble other types of augmentations. This augmentation doesn't count toward your implant limit.

entities.name: Danger Sensor (Advanced)
entities.description: This advanced sensor and microprocessor suite, installed directly into your central nervous system, automatically detects incoming danger and signals your brain in nanoseconds, improving your reaction time when you need it most. You gain a +3 item bonus to Perception checks for initiative or against hostile creatures and hazards.

entities.name: Danger Sensor (Commercial)
entities.description: This advanced sensor and microprocessor suite, installed directly into your central nervous system, automatically detects incoming danger and signals your brain in nanoseconds, improving your reaction time when you need it most. You gain a +1 item bonus to Perception checks for initiative or against hostile creatures and hazards within 60 feet.

entities.name: Danger Sensor (Tactical)
entities.description: This advanced sensor and microprocessor suite, installed directly into your central nervous system, automatically detects incoming danger and signals your brain in nanoseconds, improving your reaction time when you need it most. You gain a +2 item bonus to Perception checks for initiative or against hostile creatures and hazards within 120 feet.

entities.name: Linguistic Coprocessor (Advanced)
entities.description: Installed just behind your aural cavity, this tiny processing unit intercepts and interprets verbal audio using its limited onboard database, translating it on the fly into a language you can understand. You can understand and speak, two additional languages, chosen when you install this augmentation. You can change the stored languages during your daily preparations, but it must be to languages you can secure translation data for, typically one spoken by your companions or near the current settlement.

entities.name: Linguistic Coprocessor (Commercial)
entities.description: Installed just behind your aural cavity, this tiny processing unit intercepts and interprets verbal audio using its limited onboard database, translating it on the fly into a language you can understand. You can understand, but not speak, one additional language, chosen when you install this augmentation. You can change the stored language during your daily preparations, but it must be to a language you can secure translation data for, typically one spoken by your companions or near the current settlement.

entities.name: Linguistic Coprocessor (Superior)
entities.description: Installed just behind your aural cavity, this tiny processing unit intercepts and interprets verbal audio using its limited onboard database, translating it on the fly into a language you can understand. You can understand and speak any language commonly spoken on the current planet as the coprocessor pulls data from local networks.

entities.name: Linguistic Coprocessor (Tactical)
entities.description: Installed just behind your aural cavity, this tiny processing unit intercepts and interprets verbal audio using its limited onboard database, translating it on the fly into a language you can understand. You can understand, but not speak, two additional languages, chosen when you install this augmentation. You can change the stored languages during your daily preparations, but it must be to languages you can secure translation data for, typically one spoken by your companions or near the current settlement.

entities.name: Mechanical Leap Accelerators (Advanced)
entities.description:
A combination of springs, hydraulic pistons, and electromagnetic accelerators replace or augment the muscles in your legs, letting you jump longer and higher.

You gain a +2 item bonus to Athletics checks to high-jump or long-jump and you don't automatically fail the check if you didn't Stride at least 10 feet.

When you use the leap action, you can move 5 feet further if jumping horizontally or 3 feet higher if jumping vertically.

entities.name: Mechanical Leap Accelerators (Commercial)
entities.description:
A combination of springs, hydraulic pistons, and electromagnetic accelerators replace or augment the muscles in your legs, letting you jump longer and higher.

When you use the leap action, you can move 5 feet further if jumping horizontally or 3 feet higher if jumping vertically.

entities.name: Mechanical Leap Accelerators (Superior)
entities.description:
A combination of springs, hydraulic pistons, and electromagnetic accelerators replace or augment the muscles in your legs, letting you jump longer and higher.

You gain a +3 item bonus to Athletics checks to high-jump or long-jump and you don't automatically fail the check if you didn't Stride at least 10 feet.

You can High Jump or Long Jump as a single action. You can travel up to 10 feet further in a horizontal Leap or Long Jump, or 6 feet higher in a vertical Leap or High Jump.

entities.name: Mechanical Leap Accelerators (Tactical)
entities.description:
A combination of springs, hydraulic pistons, and electromagnetic accelerators replace or augment the muscles in your legs, letting you jump longer and higher.

You gain a +1 item bonus to Athletics checks to high-jump or long-jump.

When you use the leap action, you can move 5 feet further if jumping horizontally or 3 feet higher if jumping vertically.

entities.name: Memory Expansion (Advanced)
entities.description:
A high-capacity storage drive, equipped with an onboard organic-to-digital communication bus, is installed in your cerebral cortex, giving you access to additional information on a narrow topic. While you have the memory expansion installed, you become master in a single Lore skill, chosen when you install or improve the augmentation. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a skill increase or a permanent character option like a feat.

**Activate—Solid State Memory** 1 (concentrate, fortune)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You Recall Knowledge using the Lore skill granted by this augmentation, rolling the skill check twice and taking the higher result. The question must be relevant to the chosen skill.

**Special** If you have a datajack augmentation, a single memory expansion you have installed doesn't count toward your implant limit. Further memory expansions still count.

entities.name: Memory Expansion (Commercial)

While you have the memory expansion installed, you become trained in a single Lore skill, chosen when you install or improve the augmentation. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a skill increase or a permanent character option like a feat.

**Special** If you have a datajack augmentation, a single memory expansion you have installed doesn't count toward your implant limit. Further memory expansions still count.

entities.name: Memory Expansion (Tactical)
entities.description:
A high-capacity storage drive, equipped with an onboard organic-to-digital communication bus, is installed in your cerebral cortex, giving you access to additional information on a narrow topic. While you have the memory expansion installed, you become expert in a single Lore skill, chosen when you install or improve the augmentation. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a skill increase or a permanent character option like a feat.

**Special** If you have a datajack augmentation, a single memory expansion you have installed doesn't count toward your implant limit. Further memory expansions still count.

entities.name: Mobility Enhancer (Augmentation, Advanced)
entities.description: Cybernetic enhancements and synthetic nanomuscle fibers are installed throughout your fins, wings, or digging arms. You gain a +15-foot item bonus to one of your burrow, climb, fly, or swim Speeds, chosen when you install this augmentation. You can't choose a Speed you don't have or a Speed you have from a temporary source, such as a different augmentation.

entities.name: Mobility Enhancer (Augmentation, Commercial)
entities.description: Cybernetic enhancements and synthetic nanomuscle fibers are installed throughout your fins, wings, or digging arms. You gain a +5-foot item bonus to one of your burrow, climb, fly, or swim Speeds, chosen when you install this augmentation. You can't choose a Speed you don't have or a Speed you have from a temporary source, such as a different augmentation.

entities.name: Mobility Enhancer (Augmentation, Tactical)
entities.description: Cybernetic enhancements and synthetic nanomuscle fibers are installed throughout your fins, wings, or digging arms. You gain a +10-foot item bonus to one of your burrow, climb, fly, or swim Speeds, chosen when you install this augmentation. You can't choose a Speed you don't have or a Speed you have from a temporary source, such as a different augmentation.

entities.name: Quantum Multitool Appendage (Commercial)
entities.description:
Cleverly designed nanoparticles replace your hands or similar appendages. In their inactive state, they resemble normal hands, but they can transform with a single Interact action into a tactical infiltrator's toolkit, tactical maker's toolkit, or tactical repair toolkit.

**Activate—Self-correct** r (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You critically fail a Crafting or Thievery check while your quantum multitool appendage is transformed

**Effect** The onboard AI partly corrects your error, turning the triggering critical failure into a failure.

entities.name: Quantum Multitool Appendage (Tactical)
entities.description:
Cleverly designed nanoparticles replace your hands or similar appendages. In their inactive state, they resemble normal hands, but they can transform with a single Interact action into a tactical infiltrator's toolkit, tactical maker's toolkit, or tactical repair toolkit. The item bonus granted by the tactical toolkits produced by the augmentation increases to +2.

**Activate—Self-correct** r (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per hour

**Trigger** You critically fail a Crafting or Thievery check while your quantum multitool appendage is transformed

**Effect** The onboard AI partly corrects your error, turning the triggering critical failure into a failure.

entities.name: Quick-Charge Hand (Advanced)
entities.description:
Capacitive pads are woven into the surface of your fingers, building and storing a charge of electricity throughout the day that you can use to quickly and wirelessly charge other batteries and devices.

**Activate—Rapid EMF Charge** f

**Frequency** twice per day

**Requirements** You're touching, holding, or wielding a advanced or lower grade battery or an item that contains such a battery

**Effect** You fully recharge the required battery.

entities.name: Rocket Fist (Advanced)
entities.description:
Sometimes you just want to punch somebody from across the room. The rocket fist is the perfect augmentation for those situations: a detachable fist that flies toward your enemies, tethered with a thin steel cable.

**Activate—Rocket Punch** 1 (manipulate)

**Effect** You make a ranged fist Strike. Your fist gains the thrown 60 feet and tethered traits for this attack. Whether or not the Strike hits, your fist falls to the ground. You can't make fist attacks or hold items with that hand until you retrieve it with a free action to retract the cable.

entities.name: Spinal Struts (Commercial)
entities.description: These implants reinforce your spinal column with nanocarbon rods, improving your leverage while lifting and carrying. You can carry up to 1 additional Bulk without becoming encumbered, and you gain a +1 item bonus to your Fortitude DC against checks to reposition or shove you.

You can carry up to 3 additional Bulk without becoming encumbered, and you gain a +2 item bonus to your Fortitude DC against checks to reposition or shove you.

entities.name: Tremor Soles (Commercial)
entities.description: These highly sensitive gyrometers are placed in the soles of your feet, amplifying minute vibrations in surfaces you stand on. You gain tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet.

entities.name: Tremor Soles (Tactical)
entities.description: These highly sensitive gyrometers are placed in the soles of your feet, amplifying minute vibrations in surfaces you stand on. You gain tremorsense as a precise sense with a range of 30 feet.

entities.name: Charmed Smile (Advanced)
entities.description:
Used by entertainers and companions throughout the Pact Worlds, these cerebral implants emit subtle psychic impulses that make you more desirable to those around you, allowing you to manipulate them more easily. Lashuntas often eschew this particular augmentation, seeing it as a corruption of their natural abilities. Some platforms, especially those hosting contests, claim to ban this augmentation.

**Activate—Turn On the Charm** 1 (emotion, magical) You attempt to make-an-impression on a creature within 15 feet. They then become immune to Turn On the Charm for 24 hours.

Twice per day, when you Turn On the Charm, the target must attempt a DC 34 save against the effects of a 1st-rank Charm spell in addition to the normal effects.

entities.name: Chronoculus Eye
entities.description:
A *chronoculus eye* is an ocular implant that allows you to see in a wide spectrum of wavelengths as well as partially predict the future. You gain darkvision, you aren't Off-Guard to hidden, undetected, or flanking creatures of your level or lower, and you gain a +2 item bonus to Perception checks for initiative.

**Activate—Wide-Spectrum Scan** 1

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Effect** Until the start of your next turn, you gain the effects of a 7th-rank truesight spell and can see infrared and ultraviolet light as well as all other wavelengths of light and radiation.

**Activate—Future Sight** r (fortune)

**Frequency** once per hour

**Trigger** You fail or critically fail an attack roll or saving throw

**Effect** You roll the triggering attack roll or saving throw again, taking the second result.

entities.name: Cloaking Skin (Advanced)
entities.description:
Many of your pores are replaced with magically regulated and directed holographic projectors that synchronize when activated to automatically match your surroundings, rendering you Invisible.

**Activate—Cloak** 1 (concentrate)

**Frequency** three times per day

**Effect** You gain the effects of 4nd-rank Invisibility for 1 minute or until you spend an action, which has the concentrate trait, to deactivate it.

entities.name: Cloaking Skin (Commercial)
entities.description:
Many of your pores are replaced with magically regulated and directed holographic projectors that synchronize when activated to automatically match your surroundings, rendering you Invisible.

**Activate—Cloak** 1 (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You gain the effects of 2nd-rank Invisibility for 1 minute or until you spend an action, which has the concentrate trait, to deactivate it.

entities.name: Cloaking Skin (Tactical)
entities.description:
Many of your pores are replaced with magically regulated and directed holographic projectors that synchronize when activated to automatically match your surroundings, rendering you Invisible.

entities.name: Despoiler Maw (Advanced)
entities.description:
Developed by a team of scientists who experienced a Swarm attack firsthand, this augmentation is inspired by how they appropriated resources from the worlds they despoiled. The despoiler maw is implanted in the back of your throat and allows you to expel thick, noxious acid, then harvest the smoke left behind by its victims into raw materials.

**Activate—Spew Acid** 2 (acid, magical)

**Frequency** twice per day

**Effect** You exhale a torrent of acid in a 15-foot cone. Creatures and objects in the area take 6d6 acid |options:area-damage damage (DC 29 save). For each living creature you damage this way, you generate one tube of a bland nutritional paste that contains enough nutrition to function as sustenance for a day. If you damage at least one object or nonliving creature, you can spend 1 minute to gather a number of UPBs equal to the damage dealt.

entities.name: Drift Valve (Commercial)
entities.description:
Your heart is linked to a miniature Drift portal on an automatic switch, instantly transporting you through the Drift in response to a high heart rate to take you away from danger. This augmentation was inspired by prismenis and their close connection to the Drift, though its effects are far more limited.

**Activate—Drift Charge** r (magical, teleportation)

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You take damage

**Effect** You teleport up to 30 feet. The destination must be within your line of sight and line of effect.

entities.name: Drift Valve (Tactical)
entities.description:
Your heart is linked to a miniature Drift portal on an automatic switch, instantly transporting you through the Drift in response to a high heart rate to take you away from danger. **Activate—Drift Charge** r (magical, teleportation)

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You take damage

**Effect** You teleport up to 30 feet. The destination must be within your line of sight and line of effect.

When you Drift Charge, you can attempt to swap places with another creature within 30 feet instead of teleporting to a free space. The target must attempt a DC 37 saving throw.

**Success** The target remains where it is, and you teleport to a free space adjacent to it.

**Failure** You switch places with the target, and the target takes the triggering damage along with you.

**Critical Failure** You switch places with the target, and the target takes the triggering damage instead of you.

entities.name: Extradimensional Cavity (Advanced)
entities.description: Your body has been fitted with an extradimensional space Concealed underneath a subtle seam in your skin, allowing you to carry weapons or contraband into areas where they might otherwise be restricted. The extradimensional cavity functions as a commercial null space chamber, except that it holds a maximum of 20 Bulk. The opening to the cavity is very discreet, and you gain a +2 item bonus to Stealth checks to Conceal it or the items within.

The extradimensional cavity functions as a commercial null space chamber, except that it holds a maximum of 5 Bulk. The opening to the cavity is very discreet, and you gain a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks to Conceal it or the items within.

entities.name: Forceful Evolution
entities.description: Through magical manipulation of your genes, you can temporarily access the abilities of other species. You gain a 1st-level ancestry feat from a different ancestry than your own, chosen when you install this augmentation. You must meet the other prerequisites for this feat. By spending 1 hour and 500 credits' worth of genetic material, you can change this feat to a different one, which doesn't need to be from the same ancestry. Since the feat is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a permanent character option like another feat. In addition, you take on traits that are common in the chosen ancestry, such as antennae for shirren or cheek pouches for ysoki. These changes are vestigial and have no mechanical effect other than the feat you gained, but they're always noticeable and memorable.

entities.name: Hellsight (Tactical)
entities.description:
Your eyes conceal a tiny psychic projector that, when focused on a target, allows you to imprint an image of Hell straight into their consciousness.

**Activate—Hellsight** 2 (concentrate, fear, mental, visual)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You focus your eyes on a creature that can see you within 30 feet, forcing them to see nightmarish visions of Hell. The target attempts a DC 34 saving throw.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target is Frightened 1.

**Failure** The target is frightened 1 and becomes Fatigued and Drained 1 for as long as it's fatigued.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the target is also Drained 1 and Doomed 1 for as long as it's fatigued.

entities.name: Hellsight
entities.description:
Your eyes conceal a tiny psychic projector that, when focused on a target, allows you to imprint an image of Hell straight into their consciousness.

**Activate—Hellsight** 2 (concentrate, fear, mental, visual)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You focus your eyes on a creature that can see you within 30 feet, forcing them to see nightmarish visions of Hell. The target attempts a DC 27 saving throw.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target is Frightened 1.

**Failure** The target is frightened 1 and becomes Fatigued.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the target is also Drained 1 for as long as it's fatigued.

entities.name: Homunculus Limb
entities.description:
Your hand (or equivalent appendage) is a magitech prosthetic that can detach from your body and operate semi-autonomously. You can detach your hand as a single Interact action, and it becomes a Tiny construct with the magical and magitech traits on the ground in your space. It also has the minion trait, meaning it gains 2 actions during your turn if you Command it. Your hand can't make Strikes or wield weapons while detached. While it's detached, you can't use your hand other than by Commanding it. You can reattach your hand as a single Interact action as long as it shares your space. If your hand is destroyed, you can use it normally after reattaching it, though it can't be detached or Commanded until repaired.

Your hand's level, save modifiers, and AC are equal to yours. It uses 3 + your level as its modifier for Acrobatics, Perception, and Stealth checks, and for other skill checks, its modifier is equal to your level or your modifier in that skill, whichever is lower. It doesn't have or use its own attribute modifiers and can never benefit from item bonuses. Your hand has Hit Points equal to 5 times your level.

Your hand has low-light vision, and you can see through its sensors as long as it remains within 100 feet of you. It has a Speed of 25 feet and a climb Speed of 25 feet. It can perform manipulate actions as if it had a single hand, using its whole body, but it can't move while holding an item unless the item is of negligible Bulk.

entities.name: Living Ink Tattoo
entities.description:
This elaborate tattoo is inked with ferrofluid that moves about your body of its own accord, seemingly with a minimal level of intelligence. It comes in a multitude of colors and designs, but its magic requires that it sharply contrasts with your skin color, making it highly noticeable. The tattoo reacts in response to damage, deploying magic electro-magnetic defenses to protect its host.

**Activate—Magnetic Shielding** r

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Trigger** You would take physical damage from an attack

**Effect** The tattoo creates an electromagnetic shield until the start of your next turn, as a shield cantrip of a rank equal to half your level, rounded up. You gain the effects of Shield Block with it against the triggering attack. Unlike a normal shield cantrip, the effect doesn't end after you Shield Block in this way.

entities.name: Moodskin
entities.description: Magically infused nanites injected into your skin automatically react to your mood by changing the pigmentation of your skin. The color change is gradual, typically taking at least 30 seconds to fully transition from one color to another. Moodskin can be customized to adjust which colors correspond to each mood during installation. This augmentation doesn't count toward your implant limit.

entities.name: Moonlight Fibers (Commercial)
entities.description:
Several different blends of chemicals and magical accelerants have been applied to your brain stem, allowing you to speed up your response time briefly.

**Activate—Engage Overdrive** f

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You're about to gain actions at the start of your turn

**Effect** You immediately gain the Quickened condition until the end of your turn, but you can use the additional action granted only to Stride or Strike. When you lose this quickened condition, you become Stunned 1.

entities.name: Moonlight Fibers (Tactical)
entities.description:
Several different blends of chemicals and magical accelerants have been applied to your brain stem, allowing you to speed up your response time briefly.

**Activate—Engage Overdrive** f

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You're about to gain actions at the start of your turn

**Effect** You immediately gain the Quickened condition until the end of your turn, but you can use the additional action granted only to Stride or Strike.

entities.name: Phasic Limb
entities.description: One of your hands is implanted with a runic mesh infused with the essence of the Ethereal Plane, allowing you to reach into that dimension. You can touch incorporeal creatures and objects with the chosen hand and with any items you hold with it. Unarmed attacks made with the chosen hand, and one-handed weapons you wield with it, trigger vulnerabilities and bypass resistances as if they have the ghost killer upgrade.

entities.name: Psychoactive Eyes (Commercial)
entities.description:
Your irises are injected with psychoactive dyes that cause a signature kaleidoscopic effect, or your eyes have been completely replaced with delicate magitech devices. You can activate these dyes to enthrall those you look upon with varying effects depending on the item's type.

**Activate—Gaze** 2 (concentrate, mental, visual)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You focus your eyes on a creature that can see you within 30 feet. The creature attempts a DC 17 saving throw with the following results.

**Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Failure** The creature is Fascinated for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** The creature is fascinated for as long as it can see you. Taking a hostile action against the creature ends the effect.

entities.name: Psychoactive Eyes (Tactical)
entities.description:
Your irises are injected with psychoactive dyes that cause a signature kaleidoscopic effect, or your eyes have been completely replaced with delicate magitech devices. You can activate these dyes to enthrall those you look upon with varying effects depending on the item's type.

**Activate—Gaze** 2 (concentrate, mental, visual)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You focus your eyes on a creature that can see you within 30 feet. The creature attempts a DC 20 saving throw with the following results.

**Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Failure** The creature is Fascinated for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** The creature is fascinated and becomes helpful for as long as it can see you. Taking a hostile action against the creature ends the effect.

entities.name: Regenerative Rune Splice
entities.description:
Your genes are enchanted with microscopic runes that you can activate to recover from traumatic injury.

**Activate—Regenerate** 2 (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You gain the effects of a 4th-rank Genetic Regeneration spell.

entities.name: Tangle Vine Germinator
entities.description:
The interiors of your wrists are replaced with miniature cloches that germinate magically enhanced tangle vine seeds under the perfect conditions, ready to grow in an instant in response to magical stimulus.

**Activate—Vinesnare** 2 You release one of the seeds stored in your wrists, growing a whiplike vine in an instant. Attempt an unarmed Strike with the effects of a 1st-rank Tangle Vine cantrip. You can also target a surface instead of a creature; if you do, the vine roots itself into the surface, acting as a 30-foot rope securely attached to that surface until you cut the vine. You can't use Vinesnare again for 1 minute after using it to target a surface.

entities.name: Telepathy Node
entities.description: A rune-carved device of treated alloys and crystal the size of a pebble is implanted into your brain's communication center. You gain limited telepathy to a range of 30 feet.

entities.name: Bone Blade (Commercial)
entities.description:
Skeletal bone shards are implanted in your elbow, wrist, or knuckles on one arm, able to spontaneously regenerate into a wicked blade made from bone that extends through your skin. You gain a bone blade unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage, is in the knife group, and has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits. You can retract or extend the blade as a single Interact action, and it's undetectable without a detailed medical scan while retracted.

**Special** If you have more than one bone blade, they gain the twin trait. In addition, you can extend or retract all your bone blades with a single Interact action, or with any other ability that allows you to draw or stow a weapon (such as the Tactical Swap feat).

entities.name: Bone Blade (Tactical)
entities.description:
Skeletal bone shards are implanted in your elbow, wrist, or knuckles on one arm, able to spontaneously regenerate into a wicked blade made from bone that extends through your skin. You gain a bone blade unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage, is in the knife group, and has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits. You can retract or extend the blade as a single Interact action, and it's undetectable without a detailed medical scan while retracted.

Whenever you get a critical hit with your bone blade unarmed attack, you get its critical specialization effect.

**Special** If you have more than one bone blade, they gain the twin trait. In addition, you can extend or retract all your bone blades with a single Interact action, or with any other ability that allows you to draw or stow a weapon (such as the Tactical Swap feat).

entities.name: Corpseskin (Advanced)
entities.description: You graft the skin of one or more types of undead over your own, becoming cold to the touch. You gain a +2 item bonus to Deception checks to Impersonate corporeal undead and resistance 8 to void damage. A creature that would identify you as living, such as with lifesense, must succeed at a DC 10 or perceive you as undead instead.

entities.name: Corpseskin (Commercial)
entities.description: You graft the skin of one or more types of undead over your own, becoming cold to the touch. You gain a +1 item bonus to Deception checks to Impersonate corporeal undead and resistance 1 to void damage. A creature that would identify you as living, such as with lifesense, must succeed at a DC 5 or perceive you as undead instead.

entities.description: You graft the skin of one or more types of undead over your own, becoming cold to the touch. You gain a +3 item bonus to Deception checks to Impersonate corporeal undead and resistance 15 to void damage. A creature that would identify you as living, such as with lifesense, automatically fails and perceives you as undead instead.

entities.name: Corpseskin (Superior)
