You gain a +3 item bonus to Deception checks to Impersonate corporeal undead and resistance 12 to void damage. A creature that would identify you as living, such as with lifesense, must succeed at a DC 15 or perceive you as undead instead.

entities.name: Corpseskin (Tactical)
entities.description: You graft the skin of one or more types of undead over your own, becoming cold to the touch. You gain a +2 item bonus to Deception checks to Impersonate corporeal undead and resistance 4 to void damage. A creature that would identify you as living, such as with lifesense, must succeed at a DC 10 or perceive you as undead instead.

entities.name: Enervating Hand (Advanced)
entities.description:
Your hand is infused with void energies, causing it to drain the vitality of creatures you touch.

**Activate—Draining Touch** 2 (void)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You empower your hand to drain the energy of a living creature within reach. The target attempts a DC 34 saving throw.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target becomes Drained 1 until the start of your next turn. For 1 minute, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the Hit Points the target lost due to the drained condition.

**Failure** The target becomes drained 1 for 1 minute. For 1 minute, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points the target lost due to the drained condition.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the target becomes Drained 2.

entities.name: Eyes of the Soul (Commercial)
entities.description:
Your eyes have been augmented to see the life energy of creatures around you, though your black sclera betray the undead nature of your augmented body. You gain a +2 item bonus to Medicine checks.

**Activate—See Vitality** 1 (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per hour

**Effect** For the next minute, you gain lifesense as a precise sense with a range of 10 feet, allowing you to sense and distinguish between the life force of living and undead creatures.

entities.name: Ghoul Stomach (Advanced)
entities.description: Your stomach is replaced with that of a ghoul, allowing you to safely ingest a wide range of usually stomach-churning cuisine. Some with this augmentation report having subtle cravings for food they'd usually avoid. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against ingested poisons and to retch while sickened. You become extremely hungry, needing to constantly satiate yourself. If you've eaten within the last hour, you gain a +10-foot item bonus to your Speeds and a +2 item bonus to Athletics checks to high-jump and long-jump. Otherwise, you take a –5-foot item penalty to your Speeds.

entities.name: Hollowed Eardrums (Advanced)
entities.description:
Your eardrums are filled with hollow, necrotic tissue that can open and close to protect you from loud sounds.

**Activate—Seal Drums** 1 For 1 minute, your eardrums seal, muffling the sounds around you. You take a –1 circumstance penalty to Perception checks to hear. You gain resistance 12 to sonic damage and a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against auditory effects. You aren't clumsy while Untethered.

entities.name: Mummified Wraps
entities.description:
The skin of your forearms is replaced with animated cloth strips, often used to wrap a creature when they die. While not necessary for the augmentation to function, many claim the wraps are only authentic if they were once used to properly mummify a corpse with traditional ritualistic practices. Some undead wrapped in their own burial clothes are highly offended by others using this augmentation. The strips blend into your skin but are easily visible upon close inspection.

**Activate—Wrap Treasure** 1 (manipulate)

**Requirements** You have a free hand

**Effect** You use your wraps to grab an item. Choose an unattended item within 30 feet of no more than light Bulk, and move it up to 10 feet in any direction.

**Activate—Wrap Prey** 2 (manipulate)

**Requirements** You have a free hand

**Effect** The wraps consume a creature. You disarm, grapple, or trip a creature within 15 feet. If you successfully Grab a creature, it remains Grabbed or Restrained as long as you stay within 15 feet of it, unless it Escapes.

entities.name: Necrocortex (Advanced)
entities.description:
Your brain is augmented with necrotic energies and portions of necrotic tissue, enhancing your ability to communicate with and control your minions, especially the undead. These augmentations are installed with multiple layers of protective magic to prevent its user from being taken control of as if they were undead, but manufacturers are quick to claim that so far there have been no confirmed cases of such a situation. When you Command an undead minion you summoned or permanently control that you can see or whose senses you're sharing, you can do so telepathically, in which case Command loses the auditory trait.

**Activate—Project Senses** 2 (concentrate) You project your senses to an undead creature with the minion trait within 10,000 miles. The target must be a creature you summoned or permanently control. While projecting your senses, you can see and hear what your undead minion perceives, but you can't hear, see, smell, or taste what your own body experiences, though your senses of touch and pain remain. You can return your senses to your own body as a single action.

In addition, you can bind your necrocortex to a single, willing undead creature (which requires 1 hour of concentration), allowing you to Project Senses to that creature as if it were under your control.

entities.name: Necrolung (Advanced)
entities.description:
Spongy black webbing radiates from this grayish purple mass of necrotized flesh that pulses when exposed to air. Specially grown in vats from waste produced in the necrograft manufacturing process, necrolungs allow living creatures to breathe efficiently and safely on Eox. You can breathe in any toxic atmosphere for up to 24 hours without taking damage, and you gain a +2 status bonus to saves against inhaled diseases and poisons.

Installing or removing a necrolung takes only 1 minute and requires no skill checks as it slithers down your throat and integrates into your respiratory system. Unlike a commercial necrolung, this augmentation does count toward your implant limit.

entities.description:

Specially grown in vats from waste produced in the necrograft manufacturing process, necrolungs allow living creatures to breathe efficiently and safely on Eox. You can breathe the specific toxins in Eox's atmosphere for up to 24 hours before you begin taking damage, after which you must flush the lung in a clean atmosphere.

Installing or removing a necrolung takes only 1 minute and requires no skill checks as it slithers down your throat and integrates into your respiratory system. This augmentation doesn't count toward your implant limit.

entities.name: Necrotic Infusion (Commercial)
entities.description:
You've received an infusion of necrotized blood and void energy, causing your body to react positively to energies that would normally kill you.

**Activate—Necrotize Blood** r (void)

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You would take void damage

**Effect** Until the start of your next turn, you gain resistance to void damage and weakness to vitality damage equal to twice your level. If the triggering damage would heal undead, you take no damage and are instead healed as if you were undead.

entities.name: Nihili Gaze (Commercial)
entities.description:
Your eyes are replaced with those of a nihili, decompressing your enemies with your gaze and preventing them from filling their lungs.

**Activate—Decompressing Stare** 2 (concentrate, occult, visual)

**Frequency** once per hour

**Effect** Your eyes glaze over with the hollow void of space, forcing a creature you can see within 30 feet to attempt a DC 20 saving throw.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target is Fatigued until the start of your next turn.

**Failure** The target is fatigued for 1 minute.

**Critical Failure** As failure, and the target is Off-Guard until the start of your next turn.

entities.name: Rope Guts (Commercial)
entities.description: Your entrails can be pulled from your insides and used as a rope without damaging your body. You can pull out up to 10 feet of your entrails as a single Interact action. You can do this multiple times, up to 50 feet worth of entrails, but one end must remain attached to you. As a single Interact action, you can have your entrails release anything currently attached to them and retract back into your body. If your entrails are destroyed while acting as a rope, you take 2d6 slashing damage and can't pull more out for 24 hours.

entities.name: Rope Guts (Tactical)
entities.description:
Your entrails can be pulled from your insides and used as a rope without damaging your body. You can pull out up to 10 feet of your entrails as a single Interact action. You can do this multiple times, up to 50 feet worth of entrails, but one end must remain attached to you. As a single Interact action, you can have your entrails release anything currently attached to them and retract back into your body. If your entrails are destroyed while acting as a rope, you take 2d6 slashing damage and can't pull more out for 24 hours.

You can grab-an-edge from up to 10 feet away, pulling out 10 feet of your entrails and wrapping them around the edge.

entities.name: Shrieking Modulator (Advanced)
entities.description:
Your throat is implanted with a necrotic modulator that can unleash a powerful screech. The tissue is typically taken from a banshee, though some come from tech zombies and other more common undead.

**Activate—Shriek** 2 (sonic)

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Effect** Each creature in a 15-foot cone takes 5d10 sonic damage with a DC 34 save. Creatures that fail this save become Deafened until the start of your next turn (or for 1 minute on a critical failure).

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Effect** Each creature in a 15-foot cone takes 1d10 sonic damage with a DC 17 save. Creatures that fail this save become Deafened until the start of your next turn (or for 1 minute on a critical failure).

entities.name: Vampiric Teeth (Commercial)
entities.description:
Your teeth are replaced with the large, hollow incisors of a vampire, designed to tear into flesh. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d4 piercing damage, is in the knife group, and has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits. If you hit a creature that's taking persistent bleed damage with your jaws unarmed attack, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level, rounded up, that last for 1 minute.

**Activate—Ripping Teeth** 1

**Requirements** Your last action was a successful Strike with your jaws unarmed attack

**Effect** You rip through your prey's flesh. The target of the required Strike takes 1d4 persistent bleed damage.

entities.name: Vampiric Teeth (Tactical)

Whenever you get a critical hit with your jaws unarmed attack, you get its critical specialization effect.

**Activate—Ripping Teeth** 1

**Requirements** Your last action was a successful Strike with your jaws unarmed attack

**Effect** You rip through your prey's flesh. The target of the required Strike takes 1d4 persistent bleed damage.

entities.name: Autodreamer
entities.description: A microchip embedded into your nervous system activates whenever you sleep, immersing you in constant lucid dreams unless you choose to sleep normally. Once per day when you awaken after getting a full 8 hours of sleep, you count as having spent a day of downtime retraining. Your dreams draw from your own experiences, so you can't use them for retraining that requires an instructor or specialized knowledge.

entities.name: Autorecognition Lens
entities.description: An artificial eye lens microscopically wired into your brain automatically tracks a database of associated names and faces as you meet or interact with individuals. After you've learned someone's name and appearance, a tiny HUD displays their name to you whenever you're looking at them as long as you're aware of their presence and their appearance hasn't dramatically changed (at the GM's discretion). This doesn't help you see or identify people who are trying to hide or disguise their appearance. This augmentation doesn't count toward your implant limit.

entities.name: Cardiac Accelerator
entities.description:
This implant integrates directly into your heart. You can trigger the accelerator to briefly overclock your body's cardiovascular system.

**Activate—Accelerate** f

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Trigger** You Climb, Stride, or Swim

**Effect** You increase your Speed by 20 feet for the triggering action.

entities.name: Darkvision Capacitors (Commercial)
entities.description: These replacement cybernetic eyes grant you darkvision. Darkvision capacitors operate by emitting low-powered ultraviolet lasers that receptors in the capacitors can detect. These lasers are visible to creatures that can see on the ultraviolet light spectrum.

entities.name: Darkvision Capacitors (Tactical)
entities.description:
These replacement cybernetic eyes grant you darkvision. Darkvision capacitors operate by emitting low-powered ultraviolet lasers that receptors in the capacitors can detect. These lasers are visible to creatures that can see on the ultraviolet light spectrum.

These upgraded capacitors include a wide-spectrum ocular implant that allows you to see infrared and ultraviolet light, including the lasers from other darkvision capacitors. You gain darkvision and a +2 item bonus to Perception checks to Seek if they involve sight.

entities.name: Datajack (Advanced)
entities.description:
This cybernetic is a programmable data port installed into your body, allowing you to access computers and digital storage devices. Any handheld computer can connect to the port, while larger systems typically require an adapter cable. You don't need an interface to access the system, as it connects directly to your nervous system via the datajack. You must still attempt any skill checks associated with operating the device, such as Computers to access a system. Some closed systems don't allow direct data access at all.

You gain a +2 item bonus to Computers checks when accessing a system with an advanced datajack.

entities.name: Dermal Plating (Advanced)
entities.description: Hardened plates protect your skin and help you deflect physical blows. A limb with dermal plating functions as a shield. You can Raise a Shield with your limb, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use. You can use the Shield Block reaction with your limb. Dermal plating has Hardness 15. After you use Shield Block, your dermal plating becomes damaged and can't be used for 24 hours as the nanites repair the durable plates.

After you use Shield Block, your dermal plating becomes damaged and can't be used for 24 hours as the nanites repair the durable plates.

entities.name: Dermal Plating (Ultimate)
entities.description: Hardened plates protect your skin and help you deflect physical blows. A limb with dermal plating functions as a shield. You can Raise a Shield with your limb, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use. You can use the Shield Block reaction with your limb. Dermal plating has Hardness 30. After you use Shield Block, your dermal plating becomes damaged and can't be used for 24 hours as the nanites repair the durable plates.

entities.name: Hearing Aid
entities.description: This device fits into your ear canal or other suitable auditory organs. Commonly available at UPB printing kiosks, this augmentation restores or enhances hearing. This augmentation doesn't count toward your implant limit.

entities.name: Hideaway Limb (Commercial)
entities.description:
You can conceal items inside a hidden compartment in one of your limbs (such as an arm, leg, or tail) and protect them with a passcode. The compartment holds items of negligible Bulk and items of light Bulk that are small enough to fit in your limb or can otherwise be folded or contracted to fit. A hideaway in a leg (in a human) can typically hold more than one in an arm, and your size also adjusts the capacity at the GM's discretion.

When the compartment is closed, the seam in your limb is difficult to detect. You gain a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks to Conceal an Object in a hideaway limb. Though this compartment can foil a cursory pat down, many security checkpoints include a scan to detect such devices.

**Activate—Draw** 1 (manipulate)

**Effect** You Interact to draw an item Concealed in your hideaway limb.

entities.name: Hideaway Limb (Tactical)
entities.description:
You can conceal items inside a hidden compartment in one of your limbs (such as an arm, leg, or tail) and protect them with a passcode. The compartment holds items of negligible Bulk and items of light Bulk that are small enough to fit in your limb or can otherwise be folded or contracted to fit. A hideaway in a leg (in a human) can typically hold more than one in an arm, and your size also adjusts the capacity at the GM's discretion.

When the compartment is closed, the seam in your limb is difficult to detect. You gain a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks to Conceal an Object in a hideaway limb. Though this compartment can foil a cursory pat down, many security checkpoints include a scan to detect such devices.

**Activate—Draw** 1 (manipulate)

**Effect** You Interact to draw an item Concealed in your hideaway limb.

When you use Draw, if the item can be activated or otherwise used with a single action, you can use the item as part of the same action. For example, you Interact to draw a weapon, then Strike with that weapon.

entities.name: Nano-Optics Node
entities.description:
A crystalline nanocarbon node implanted in your occipital lobe connects to optic nerves by microscopic fibers. You can activate the node to overlay your normal vision with X-ray data. You can deactivate the overlay as a single action, which has the concentrate trait.

**Activate—X-Ray Overlay** 1 (concentrate)

**Effect** Your nano-optics node relays collected X-ray data directly to your eyes, overlaying your normal vision. You can see through most materials and walls within 60 feet. Your sight is blocked by 2 feet of wood or plastic, 1 foot of stone, 2 inches of common metal, or any amount of lead or any starmetal, and you can only see in black and white. Due to the distracting amount of visual information, you take a –2 circumstance penalty to Perception checks while the overlay is active.

entities.name: Prosthetic Limb
entities.description: This prosthesis replaces a missing or damaged limb. Prosthetic limbs are common augmentations available at UPB printing kiosks on many worlds and come in many different materials and sizes. The augmentation restores functionality, including the ability to install other augmentations in the limb, but it's no more durable than and doesn't otherwise function differently from the replaced limb. A prosthetic limb can replace one you've lost, or you can have a limb removed to replace it with a prosthetic. This augmentation doesn't count toward your implant limit.

entities.name: Retinal Reflectors
entities.description: These sheets of reflective material, implanted in your visual organs, enhance your vision without changing your appearance. You gain low-light vision and a +1 item bonus to Perception checks to Seek if they involve sight.

entities.name: Speed Suspension (Advanced)
entities.description: High-performance cybernetics replace the joints and tendons in your legs. You gain a +15-foot item bonus to your land Speed.

entities.name: Speed Suspension (Commercial)
entities.description: High-performance cybernetics replace the joints and tendons in your legs. You gain a +5-foot item bonus to your land Speed.

entities.name: Speed Suspension (Tactical)
entities.description: High-performance cybernetics replace the joints and tendons in your legs. You gain a +10-foot item bonus to your land Speed.

entities.name: Vocal Modulator
entities.description: A series of miniature actuators and dynamic hyper-resonant chambers reshape your voice box. A vocal modulator allows you to change the pitch, timbre, and tone of your voice so you can imitate accents or pronounce alien languages. When using Deception to Impersonate, you gain a +1 item bonus if the change in your voice also helps your disguise (at the GM's discretion).

entities.name: Voice Amplifier
entities.description: A voice amplifier greatly increases the volume of your voice. You can switch a voice amplifier on or off by spending an action, which has the concentrate trait. While active, a voice amplifier grants you a +1 item bonus to Intimidation checks and lowers the DCs of Perception checks to hear you speaking by 5.

entities.name: Electroencephalon
entities.description:
This magical matrix records the consciousness, thoughts, and soul of a necrovite and also grants a limited form of telepathy. Such augmented psychic awareness is key to the process of preserving a necrovite's memories when their body is destroyed, including memories of whatever caused their destruction.

When a necrovite is destroyed, *electroencephalon* begins rebuilding their their physical form over the next 1d10 days. Not even disintegrating a necrovite's corpse can fully destroy the creature. The necrovite's new body manifests next to the electroencephalon, fully healed but without any equipment from their old body.

A standard electroencephalon is a piece of complex magitech about the size of a comm unit that has been constructed via occult means. This device typically has Hardness 10 and 40 HP.

entities.name: Accelerator Ammunition
entities.description: These rounds include onboard gyrojets that increase velocity the farther they travel. Attacks against targets further than 60 feet away gain a circumstance bonus to damage equal to the number of weapon damage dice (or twice the number of dice using a sniper weapon). Attacks against targets further than 120 feet away instead gain a circumstance bonus to damage equal to twice the number of weapon damage dice (or three times the number of dice using a sniper weapon).

entities.name: Coalescing Ammunition
entities.description: These rounds are coated in a dull gray, gritty substance that reacts with airborne particulates, condensing them harmlessly to the ground. When you hit a target that's within an airborne effect, such as a mist or toxic cloud spell, with this ammunition, the effect is Suppressed in a 5-foot emanation around the target until the end of your next turn.

entities.name: Drift Pulse Ammunition
entities.description:
These rounds are transparent canisters filled with swirling green gas. Once fired, the projectile phases in and out of the Universe, allowing it to pass through barriers between you and your target. Strikes made with this ammunition treat the target's cover as one stage lower (none instead of lesser, lesser instead of standard, or standard instead of greater).

**Activate—Controlled Pulse** 1 (manipulate)

**Requirements** You're wielding a weapon loaded with drift pulse ammunition

**Effect** You adjust the parameters of your pulse shot to account for physical barriers between you and your target. If your next action is to Strike with the required weapon, the target doesn't benefit from cover. In addition, the Strike can target a creature you don't have line of effect to as long as there's no more than 5 feet of material between you and it; you treat such a creature as invisible.

entities.name: Flashbang Ammunition (Advanced)
entities.description: Filled with phosphorescent chemicals, these rounds flash brightly on impact. A creature hit by this ammunition must succeed at a DC 27 save or be Dazzled for 1 round.

entities.name: Flashbang Ammunition (Commercial)
entities.description: Filled with phosphorescent chemicals, these rounds flash brightly on impact. A creature hit by this ammunition must succeed at a DC 16 save or be Dazzled for 1 round.

entities.name: Flashbang Ammunition (Superior)
entities.description: Filled with phosphorescent chemicals, these rounds flash brightly on impact. A creature hit by this ammunition must succeed at a DC 34 save or be Dazzled for 1 round.

entities.name: Flashbang Ammunition (Tactical)
entities.description: Filled with phosphorescent chemicals, these rounds flash brightly on impact. A creature hit by this ammunition must succeed at a DC 23 save or be Dazzled for 1 round.

entities.name: Flesh Eater Ammunition
entities.description: The heads of these menacing rounds look like teeth, often etched with strange symbols. This ammunition deals an additional 1d4 persistent,void damage on a successful Strike, and on a critical hit, the target is Clumsy 1 for as long as it takes this void damage, as the projectile feeds on its blood.

entities.name: Graviton Ammunition
entities.description: These rounds feel noticeably heavier than mundane ammunition. Their cores contain magical catalysts that cause tiny gravity implosions on impact. On a critical hit with this ammunition, the target takes an additional 1d6 persistent,bludgeoning |options:area-damage damage as it's repeatedly crushed by aftershocks. As long as it takes this persistent damage, squares in a 5-foot emanation around the target are difficult terrain.

entities.name: Mercy Ammunition
entities.description: Preferred by the more benevolent law enforcement agencies and those adventurers who find themselves in danger but are unwilling to kill, these springy polymer rounds pack a punch but little penetration. Weapons loaded with this ammunition gain the nonlethal trait.

entities.name: Pacifier Ammunition (Commercial)
entities.description: Beloved by tyrants, mentalists, and law enforcement officers alike, these multicolored projectiles make targets more susceptible to mental effects. On a critical hit with this ammunition, the target takes a –1 status penalty to its Will saves for 1 minute.

entities.name: Pacifier Ammunition (Tactical)
entities.description: Beloved by tyrants, mentalists, and law enforcement officers alike, these multicolored projectiles make targets more susceptible to mental effects. On a critical hit with this ammunition, the target takes a –2 status penalty to its Will saves for 1 minute.

entities.name: Painter Ammunition
entities.description: The heads of these rounds glow in a variety of neon colors. When you hit with this ammunition, the target is coated in phosphorescent chemicals until the start of your next turn. The target isn't Concealed due to dim lighting, and if it would be hidden or undetected due to darkness or invisibility, it's concealed instead. If you critically hit the target, it's instead fully visible in dim light or darkness and has any invisibility Suppressed until the start of your next turn.

entities.name: Cairn Form Spell Amp (Commercial)
entities.description:
Known on most worlds as "spell amps," spell ampoules are ready-to-use magic injections that confer the benefits of a spell of the specified rank.

**Activate—Inject** 1 (manipulate)

Type commercial cairn form spell amp; Level 7; Price 720 credits

**Effect** 4th-rank Cairn Form spell

entities.name: Spell Gem (10th-Rank Spell)
entities.description:
These latticed gemstones are suspended in a silicon casing and encoded with the magical script necessary to cast a single, specific spell. Casting a spell from a spell gem requires holding the gem in one hand and activating it with a Cast a Spell activity using the normal number of actions for that spell. The spell must appear on your spell list. Because you're the one Casting the Spell, use your spell attack modifier and spell DC. The spell must be of your spellcasting tradition. The spell in a spell gem can be cast only once, and the spell gem is destroyed as part of the casting. Spell gems can't contain cantrips or rituals. The traits for this item vary based on the spell it contains.

**Activate** Cast a Spell

**Effect** You Cast the Spell at the indicated rank.

entities.name: Basic Environmental Protection
entities.description: This upgrade protects the user against the effects of space as well as thick and thin atmospheres. This armor loses the exposed trait for as long as the upgrade is installed.

entities.name: Filtered Rebreather (Advanced)
entities.description:
This armor upgrade supplements your armor's environmental protections and filters out common contaminants, including protection from most toxic atmospheres.

You gain a +2 status bonus to Fortitude saves against inhaled effects.

entities.name: Filtered Rebreather (Commercial)
entities.description: This armor upgrade supplements your armor's environmental protections and filters out common contaminants, including protection from most toxic atmospheres.

entities.name: Filtered Rebreather (Elite)

You gain a +4 status bonus to Fortitude saves against inhaled effects.

entities.name: Filtered Rebreather (Tactical)
entities.description:
This armor upgrade supplements your armor's environmental protections and filters out common contaminants, including protection from most toxic atmospheres.

You gain a +1 status bonus to Fortitude saves against inhaled effects.

entities.name: Radiation Buffer (Advanced)
entities.description: A layer of treated lead lines your armor with integrated radiation sensors networked into your comm unit. While you're wearing armor with this upgrade, you gain resistance 8 to poison damage from radiation effects and a +3 status bonus to Fortitude saves against radiation.

entities.name: Radiation Buffer (Commercial)
entities.description: A layer of treated lead lines your armor with integrated radiation sensors networked into your comm unit. While you're wearing armor with this upgrade, you gain resistance 2 to poison damage from radiation effects and a +1 status bonus to Fortitude saves against radiation.

entities.name: Radiation Buffer (Superior)
entities.description: A layer of treated lead lines your armor with integrated radiation sensors networked into your comm unit. While you're wearing armor with this upgrade, you gain resistance 12 to poison damage from radiation effects and a +4 status bonus to Fortitude saves against radiation.

entities.name: Radiation Buffer (Tactical)
entities.description: A layer of treated lead lines your armor with integrated radiation sensors networked into your comm unit. While you're wearing armor with this upgrade, you gain resistance 4 to poison damage from radiation effects and a +2 status bonus to Fortitude saves against radiation.

entities.name: Thermal Capacitor (Advanced)
entities.description: This armor upgrade regulates heat, protecting you from extreme temperatures. You're protected from extreme cold and mild heat.

entities.name: Thermal Capacitor (Commercial)
entities.description: This armor upgrade regulates heat, protecting you from extreme temperatures. You're protected from mild cold and mild heat.

entities.name: Thermal Capacitor (Superior)
entities.description: This armor upgrade regulates heat, protecting you from extreme temperatures. You're protected from incredible cold and mild heat.

entities.name: Thermal Capacitor (Tactical)
entities.description: This armor upgrade regulates heat, protecting you from extreme temperatures. You're protected from severe cold and mild heat.

entities.name: Antimagic Grenade (Advanced)
entities.description:
**Activate** 1 Area Fire

**Critical** Stupefied 1

This grenade resembles a large coin that rapidly spins when used. When it explodes, the grenade creates an area of antimagic for 1 minute. Creatures in the 15-foot when the grenade detonates must attempt a  save. Creatures that fail their save have difficulty casting spells for the next minute: during that time, 1- and 2-action spells require an additional action to cast. If you have the critical weapon specialization of grenades, creatures that critically fail their save are additionally Stupefied 1 for 1 minute.

entities.description:
**Activate** 1 Area Fire

This grenade explodes into a cloud of glitter. All creatures in the 15-foot must attempt a  save. While the glitter is merely an annoyance for most, it interferes with creatures that are Invisible (or that later become invisible). The glitter lasts for 1 hour.

**Critical Success** The creature avoids the glitter entirely.

**Success** The creature avoids most of the glitter and is Concealed instead of invisible.

**Failure** The creature is covered in glitter and can be targeted with no flat check due to being invisible.

**Critical Failure** As failure, and the creature is also Dazzled for 1 minute as the glitter gets in their eyes, though they can end the dazzled condition with an Interact action.

entities.name: Reality-Splicing Grenade (Advanced)
entities.description:
**Activate** 1 Area Fire

**Radius** 20-foot

This grenade is constantly changing, appearing as different colors, materials, and sizes. When detonated, it taps into another plane or reality. Roll a d20 to determine the effect, and use your class DC if the effect calls for a saving throw.

REALITY SPLICING GRENADE EFFECTS

Result

Effect

1

Each creature in the blast radius switches positions with another randomly determined creature in the blast radius (no save).

2

The area is cloaked in magical darkness that darkvision doesn't penetrate for 1 minute.

3

The blast radius becomes an area of zero gravity for 2d4 rounds.

4

Each creature in the blast radius is affected by a 1st-rank wisp ally spell for 1 round.

5

Each creature in the blast radius is affected by a 2nd-rank invisibility spell.

6

Creatures in the blast radius are affected as if by a 3rd-rank fireball spell.

8

About 5,000 harmless, beautiful flying insects appear within the blast radius, granting everyone in the area concealment for 2d4 rounds.

9

Radiation fills the area. Creatures in the area are exposed to severe radiation sickness with a Fortitude DC equal to your class DC.

10

The blast radius becomes an area of high gravity for 2d4 rounds.

11

The blast radius fills with a windstorm dealing 8d8 bludgeoning damage ( save).

12

A laser light show begins. Each creature in the blast radius must succeed at a  save or be Blinded for 1 round.

13

Relaxing music fills the area. Each creature in the blast radius gains 10 temporary Hit Points for 1 round.

14

Loud screeching noises burst forth, dealing 8d8 sonic damage ( save).

15

The blast radius becomes the area of a 6th-rank pocket vacuum spell for 1 round.

16

Each creature in the blast radius changes color to a random neon hue for 24 hours.

17

Ghosts fill the area, floating through everyone present. Creatures in the blast radius take 8d8 void damage ( save).

18

Dozens of adorable, harmless Tiny animals appear in the blast radius, covering the ground. This horde makes the blast radius difficult terrain for 5 rounds.

19

The blast radius becomes the area of a 6th-rank corrosive haze spell for 1d4 rounds.

20

Roll twice more on this table and choose one effect to happen.

entities.name: Disc Thrower
entities.description: Little more than a narrow curved channel installed along a weapon's haft or blade, a disc thrower uses the momentum of the wielder's swing to fling a razor-edged circular blade. The disc returns to the weapon at the end of its flight, where it's recaptured by magnetic fields in the launcher.

entities.name: Honor Enforcer
entities.description: Created by the Veskarium to deal with cowards who refuse to stand and fight, this boxy contraption fires whirling, high-density weights connected by woven titanium cable. Properly aimed, these projectiles wrap around the target's limbs and bring them to the ground.

entities.name: Skyfire Volt Caster
entities.description: Originally deployed by Skyfire Legionnaires as an enhancement to their dragonglaives, these devices were designed to channel electrical energy into ranged attacks. The design proved so effective that other versions adapted for any large weapon have spread throughout the Pact Worlds, channeling electricity from a battery instead.

entities.name: Biometric Lock (Dna Matching)
entities.description:
Biometric locks use unique physical characteristics as access keys. The number of Thievery checks required to bypass a biometric lock can be reduced if the creature attempting the check has access to a sample or recreation of the key; the remaining Thievery checks represent the finesse needed to properly use these fake samples.

Bypass requires six successful DC 35 or DC 42 checks; DNA sample reduces the number of required Thievery checks by 4.

entities.name: Electronic Guard Dog (Commercial)
entities.description:
This electronic "guard dog" resembles a squat black box the size of a toaster with a screen. Upgraded versions use holograms to resemble guard dogs, although many are customized to resemble more exotic pets, ranging from hell hounds to baby wyverns.

These speakers are tied to motion sensors that, when activated, emit the realistic sounds of an agitated barking canine. Like a real dog, the barking grows louder and more frequent the closer the subject approaches. It has the following statistics: +12 Intimidation; +15 Perception.

Assigning authorized users and establishing an electronic guard dog's territory takes 10 minutes.

**Activate—Dogged Deterrence** r (auditory)

**Trigger** The guard dog detects an unauthorized creature within its designated territory

**Effect** The electronic guard dog attempts an Intimidation check to demoralize one unauthorized creature within 30 feet, using 5 charges of the electronic guard dog's battery.

This projects a holographic depiction of a Medium-sized creature to scare intruders. The item's sensors are just responsive enough for it to calculate how to lunge at intruders without getting close enough to make contact. It has the following statistics: +21 Intimidation (on a critical success to demoralize, the target is also Fleeing for 1 round); +18 Perception.

entities.name: Keypad Lock (Commercial)
entities.description:
Keycard and keypad locks balance security and convenience, trading the keys of commercial locks for chip-based card scanners and numerical codes, respectively. Keycards for keycard locks are level 0 items that cost 1 credit.

Bypass requires two successful DC 20 checks or one successful DC 25 check.

entities.name: Laser Grid (Advanced)
entities.description:
These grids surround important objects or protects corridors with webs of bright lasers. With 10 minutes of work, one laser grid can be installed to cover an area up to 30 feet wide and up to 30 feet high. Additional laser grids of the same type can be combined to expand their coverage. A laser grid can be set to emit invisible beams, requiring a successful DC 30 check to detect them if a creature isn't already aware of the lasers. Reduce the Perception DC to seek an invisible laser grid by 5 in the presence of fog, mist, smoke, or other particulates. If there's no external power source, each laser grid takes a battery of the same grade or higher and uses 5 charges when triggered (or 1 charge if it only sounds an alarm).

**Activate—Broken Beam** r

**Trigger** A creature or object crosses the laser beam between two emitters, breaking it

**Effect** An alarm signal is activated, it deals 2d8+3 slashing , 3d8+3 fire damage, DC 28 save;

**Disable**DC 32.

entities.name: Motion Sensors (Infrared)
entities.description:
Motion sensors have a standard detection range of 30 feet and can be used to sound an alarm, send an alert to a phone, or even trigger another tech hazard or item. Creatures can detect a motion sensor they aren't already aware of as they would any other trap or hazard, using the higher of the Crafting or Survival DC of whoever installed it. If there's no external power source, each motion sensor takes a battery of the same grade or higher and uses 1 charge per day.

Infrared sensors respond to warm-blooded creatures but can't detect cold-blooded or artificial creatures.

**Evade** DC 20

**Disable** DC 23 or DC 23

entities.name: Aeon Stone (Containing)
entities.description:
This irregular gray torus is pitted and scarred, and it glows green in an environment with at least low levels of radiation, with higher levels causing a more intense glow. In addition to serving as a simple radiation detector, the stone absorbs radiation around the wearer. You gain resistance 8 to poison damage from radiation effects and a +3 status bonus to Fortitude saves against radiation.

The resonant power allows you to cast protection as a 1st-rank occult innate spell once per day.

**Activate—Radiation Pulse** 2 (concentrate, magical, manipulate, radiation)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You unleash a 10-foot burst centered on you that irradiates the area for 1 hour. Creatures that enter the area must attempt a DC 22 save against severe radiation sickness. This magical radiation has an immediate onset, and the interval between each stage is 1 round.

entities.name: Aeon Stone (Guiding)
entities.description:
Staple items within the Azlanti Star Empire, these gemstones are popular status symbols for adventurers and wealthy collectors. Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to build the Universe in ancient times.

When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head (or another visible part of your anatomy if you don't have a head) instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an *aeon stone* with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful Disarm action against you. A stowed or removed stone remains invested, but its effects are Suppressed until you return it to orbit your head again.

There are various types of *aeon stones*, each with a different appearance and magical effect. Each *aeon stone* also gains a resonant power when slotted into specific items, such as weapons with the aeon trait or antique magical devices called *wayfinders*.

This gold star glitters with joyful energy. Its resonant power allows you to cast Guidance as an occult innate cantrip.

**Activate—Cosmic Luck** 1 (concentrate, fortune)

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You critically fail an attack roll, saving throw, or skill check

**Effect** You change the critical failure into a failure.

This convoluted web of synthweave straps is worn as a fashion statement in some subcultures but has a useful application in extreme environments. You gain a +3 item bonus to Acrobatics checks, and you aren't Off-Guard or clumsy while untethered in zero-g.

**Activate—Gravity Alteration** 1 (manipulate)

**Effect** You treat gravity as being two steps higher or lower (for example, zero-g becomes standard gravity, low gravity becomes high gravity, standard gravity becomes extreme gravity, or vice versa). This only affects you, your gear, and your movement and lasts 1 minute.

entities.name: Antigrav Harness (Commercial)
entities.description:
This convoluted web of synthweave straps is worn as a fashion statement in some subcultures but has a useful application in extreme environments. You gain a +1 item bonus to Acrobatics checks, and you aren't Off-Guard or clumsy while untethered in zero-g.

**Activate—Gravity Alteration** 1 (manipulate)

**Effect** You treat gravity as being one step higher or lower (for example, zero-g becomes low gravity, low gravity becomes standard, standard gravity becomes high gravity, and high gravity becomes extreme gravity, or vice versa). This only affects you, your gear, and your movement and lasts until the end of your next turn.

entities.name: Antigrav Harness (Tactical)
entities.description:
This convoluted web of synthweave straps is worn as a fashion statement in some subcultures but has a useful application in extreme environments. You gain a +2 item bonus to Acrobatics checks, and you aren't Off-Guard or clumsy while untethered in zero-g.

This only affects you, your gear, and your movement and lasts 1 minute.

entities.name: Biometric Thief (Commercial)
entities.description:
This strange-looking glove, covered in wires and runes, uses a combination of magic and science to steal identities.

**Activate—Steal DNA** 1 (manipulate) You touch an organic creature within reach, attempting to absorb some of its DNA. Attempt a Thievery check to Steal the target's DNA, storing it in the glove on a success. Your biometric thief can only store one creature's DNA at a time.

**Activate—Biometric Shift** 2 (magical, morph)

**Frequency** once per day

**Requirements** A creature's DNA is stored in the biometric thief

**Effect** You replicate minor biometric traits of the required creature, such as fingerprints, eye irises, and blood type, and your DNA appears to be theirs if analyzed. Otherwise, you still look like yourself. The effects last for 10 minutes and are temporary even for organic detritus you leave behind; for example, hair or blood left behind would read as the target's DNA if analyzed during the duration, but as yours if collected and analyzed later.

entities.name: Biometric Thief (Tactical)
entities.description:
This strange-looking glove, covered in wires and runes, uses a combination of magic and science to steal identities.

**Activate—Steal DNA** 1 (manipulate) You touch an organic creature within reach, attempting to absorb some of its DNA. Attempt a Thievery check to Steal the target's DNA, storing it in the glove on a success. Your biometric thief can only store one creature's DNA at a time.

**Activate—Biometric Shift** 2 (magical, polymorph)

**Frequency** once per day

**Requirements** A creature's DNA is stored in the biometric thief

**Effect** You replicate minor biometric traits of the required creature, such as fingerprints, eye irises, and blood type, and your DNA appears to be theirs if analyzed. You also take on the required creature's appearance, as a 3rd-rank Illusory Disguise spell. The appearance of your clothing and items doesn't change. The effects last for 10 minutes and are temporary even for organic detritus you leave behind; for example, hair or blood left behind would read as the target's DNA if analyzed during the duration, but as yours if collected and analyzed later.

entities.name: Chronowatch
entities.description:
This sleek smartwatch functions as a datapad, but it also features unique firmware and magical components that allow the user control over their own personal chronology.

**Activate—**

**Access Chrono-App** 1 (time)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You open the chronowatch's specialized software, altering the flow of time for yourself. Select one of the following options.

**Accelerate** You speed up time, making yourself a minute older. One condition affecting you that would end within the next minute ends immediately instead.

**Freeze** You briefly halt time, giving you precious seconds to strategize. You Recall Knowledge or seek up to three times, in any combination, and you gain a +1 item bonus to your Perception or skill checks to do so.

**Rewind** You rewind time, making yourself a minute younger. Choose one ongoing effect affecting you that started within the last minute and that you failed a saving throw

entities.name: Cosmic Defender Core
entities.description:
**Activate** 1 (manipulate, polymorph)

This small silvery box is covered in fine circuitry. When you Activate the box by opening it, it reveals a bright blue light and engulfs you in crackling energy that expands to form an enormous hardlight robot, with you in a central cockpit. The effect lasts for 1 minute or until you Dismiss the effect or are reduced to 0 Hit Points. The robot is a battle form that grants you the following statistics and abilities.

- AC = 22 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.

- 25 temporary Hit Points

- Speed 40 feet, fly Speed 70 feet

- Darkvision

- The following unarmed attacks, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them, your attack modifier is +31, and you use the listed damage. Both attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the enfeebled condition, for example). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead;

- **Melee** 1 stellar blade (reach 15 feet), Damage 3d12+15 slashing;

- **Ranged** 1 galactic beam (range increment 120 feet), Damage 6d6+6 force.

- Athletics modifier of +33, unless your own is higher.

entities.name: Diva's Microphone (Advanced)
entities.description:
This ostentatious crystal microphone is embellished with glimmering jewels and delicate lights that pulse in time to music. It functions as both a microphone and speaker, amplifying your voice loud enough for you to be heard clearly by all listeners up to 500 feet away, even if other ambient noise would otherwise block the sound. This doesn't increase the range or area of other auditory or linguistic effects, and physical barriers such as walls still block or muffle your voice as normal.

The *diva's microphone* grants a +3 item bonus to Performance checks attempted with it.

**Activate—Grand Finale** 2 (auditory)

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Effect** Your song reaches an eardrum-bursting climax as you cast a 8th-rank Sonic Scream originating from your space (DC 38).

**Effect** Your song reaches an eardrum-bursting climax as you cast a 1st-rank Sonic Scream originating from your space (DC 18).

entities.name: Duo-Enhancers
entities.description:
This magitech interface is a sophisticated pair of linked bracers, wristbands, gloves, or other garments suitable to the part of a creature's anatomy it uses to wield weapons. One of the paired enhancers includes a screen that displays data about the weapons the wearer is wielding, and the other enhancer contains magical crystals. When you wield a weapon in the hand wearing the display, the weapon's grade (such as tactical) is replicated onto the weapon you're wielding in the hand with the crystal enhancer, but only for purposes of determining the weapon's extra damage dice and tracking trait (which adds an item bonus to attack rolls). Any other properties of the weapon, such as its damage type, ammo, or upgrades, aren't replicated.

The replication functions only if you wear both enhancers, and it ends as soon as you cease wielding a weapon in one of your hands. Consequently, the benefit doesn't apply to thrown attacks or if you're holding a weapon but not wielding it (such as holding in one hand a weapon that requires two hands to wield, or holding a weapon in non-active hands).

entities.name: Environmental Inverter (Commercial)
entities.description:
This small medallion depicts half a snowflake on one side and half a sun on the other. It can be worn anywhere on your person, usually attached to an article of clothing or jewelry.

**Activate—Invert Temperature** 1 (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You invert the weather in your space. Creatures in the affected area treat the current temperature as the opposite—mild cold becomes mild heat, severe heat becomes severe cold, and so on. You can deactivate the effect as a single Interact action. This effect lasts 8 hours or until you Dismiss it.

entities.name: Environmental Inverter (Tactical)
entities.description:
This small medallion depicts half a snowflake on one side and half a sun on the other. It can be worn anywhere on your person, usually attached to an article of clothing or jewelry.

**Activate—Invert Temperature** 1 (aura, manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Area** 10-foot emanation

**Effect** You invert the weather in your space. Creatures in the affected area treat the current temperature as the opposite—mild cold becomes mild heat, severe heat becomes severe cold, and so on. You can deactivate the effect as a single Interact action. This effect lasts 8 hours or until you Dismiss it.

entities.name: Ephemeral Exoskeleton
entities.description:
This set of small bands encircle your wrists, elbows, chest, hips, knees and ankles, each embedded with a small glowing crystal. When worn together, ghostly machinery connects these bands, forming an exoskeleton that supplements your strength and endurance and gives you one foot in the Ethereal Plane. You gain a +3 item bonus to Athletics checks, and you can carry an additional 3 Bulk without becoming encumbered.

**Activate—Slip Between** 1 (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You slip partially into the Ethereal Plane until the end of your next turn. Creatures on the Universe can't see you, and you can move through objects and walls in the Universe. You can still see onto the Universe, though anything there is Concealed from you. You can't affect the Universe and can't be affected by the Universe, except by ghost killer upgrades and similar effects, which treat you as an incorporeal creature. You move at half your normal Speeds but can move in any direction (including up and down).

When the effect ends, you return fully to the Universe. If you're in the air, you fall (unless you can fly), and if you're inside an object, you're pushed to the nearest open space and take 1d6 untyped damage per 5 feet you were pushed. You can extend the effect by 1 round when you Sustain it, to a maximum duration of 1 minute.

entities.name: Fixit Paint
entities.description:
**Activate** 1 (manipulate)

This magical paint comes in small aerosol cans and has a very distinct reddish-orange color that many recognize as "fixit red." When activated by spraying it on an object that isn't destroyed, the object regains up to 20 healing Hit Points (potentially losing the broken condition). Fixit paint can affect an object of up to 5 Bulk and can only affect a single object per can.

entities.name: Genetic Backup
entities.description:
This circuit-laced headband creates a backup of your genetic code each morning, providing insight not only into your own physical wellbeing but that of others. You gain a +2 item bonus to Medicine checks.

**Activate—Reset Code** 1 (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You press a button on the back of the headband, partially resetting your physiology. You immediately regain 8d8 healing Hit Points. You can immediately attempt a flat check to recover from any persistent damage you're taking, as if assisted. You can also immediately attempt a new saving throw against any ongoing effects that have Paralyzed you or that have the disease or poison traits, taking the new result. A creature adjacent to you can also Activate the genetic backup, but its effects still apply to you.

entities.name: Ghostviz Headset
entities.description:
This clunky, old-fashioned VR headset supposedly plunges the wearer into the realm of the supernatural, displaying a world totally unlike the one you're presently in, though the size and vague shape of walls and obstacles remain the same. This world often resembles places or events important to nearby incorporeal undead, such as a burning building or how a station appeared decades ago.

**Activate—Goggles On** 1 (manipulate) You pull the headset over your eyes and power it on, plunging you into its simulated supernatural world. All corporeal creatures are Concealed to you, but you can clearly see any incorporeal creatures, such as ghosts and the denizens of the Ethereal Plane. You also gain a +1 item bonus to Recall Knowledge about the past of any undead creature within 1,000 feet. You can end the effect by raising the headset as a single Interact action.

entities.name: Gimmick (Basic)
entities.description:
*Gimmicks* are small devices designed to be harnessed by magic users, available in any number of designs. When you purchase a gimmick, you choose a theme that applies to all spells you cast while holding it, though it doesn't change their effects. For example, a gambler's Force Barrage might resemble throwing cards. You can reprogram a gimmick during your daily preparations to alter its theme. Some gimmicks can also apply additional effects by activating them before Casting a Spell.

This entry-level *gimmick* only changes the theme of the spell and has no other change to its effects, except the spell is different enough that spellcasters who have the spell prepared or in their repertoire do not automatically know what the spell is.

**Activate—Gimmick!** 1 (magical, spellshape)

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Effect** If your next action is to Cast a Spell, it changes the theme of the spell and has no other change to its effects, except the spell is different enough that spellcasters who have the spell prepared or in their repertoire do not automatically know what the spell is.

entities.name: Gimmick (Devastating)
entities.description:
*Gimmicks* are small devices designed to be harnessed by magic users, available in any number of designs. When you purchase a gimmick, you choose a theme that applies to all spells you cast while holding it, though it doesn't change their effects. For example, a gambler's Force Barrage might resemble throwing cards. You can reprogram a gimmick during your daily preparations to alter its theme. Some gimmicks can also apply additional effects by activating them before Casting a Spell.

This flashy *gimmick* is especially popular with spellcasters who want their most amazing feats to be even more jaw-dropping. When you purchase this gimmick or when you reprogram it during your daily preparations, choose a critical specialization effect from corrosive, cryo, flame, laser, plasma, poison, shock, and sonic.

**Activate—Gimmick!** 1 (magical, spellshape)

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Effect** If your next action is to Cast a Spell that deals damage, targets of the spell that you critically succeed on your spell attack roll against or that critically fail their saving throws are also affected by the chosen critical specialization effect. If none of the spell's targets are affected by this effect, you can Activate this *gimmick* again on your next turn, regardless of its frequency.

entities.name: Gimmick (Elegant)
entities.description:
*Gimmicks* are small devices designed to be harnessed by magic users, available in any number of designs. When you purchase a gimmick, you choose a theme that applies to all spells you cast while holding it, though it doesn't change their effects. For example, a gambler's Force Barrage might resemble throwing cards. You can reprogram a gimmick during your daily preparations to alter its theme. Some gimmicks can also apply additional effects by activating them before Casting a Spell.

This subtly beautiful gimmick is equally popular among scheming nobility and spellcasting thieves.

**Activate—Gimmick!** 1 (magical, spellshape)

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Effect** If your next action is to Cast a Spell, it gains the subtle trait. In addition, its effects cause no damage to your surroundings and create only soft sounds like tinkling chimes and string music. Creatures slain by the spell appear relaxed and resting unless investigated closely.

entities.name: Gimmick (Elemental)
entities.description:
*Gimmicks* are small devices designed to be harnessed by magic users, available in any number of designs. When you purchase a gimmick, you choose a theme that applies to all spells you cast while holding it, though it doesn't change their effects. For example, a gambler's Force Barrage might resemble throwing cards. You can reprogram a gimmick during your daily preparations to alter its theme. Some gimmicks can also apply additional effects by activating them before Casting a Spell.

This colorful *gimmick* is especially popular with spellcasters who have a preference for a particular element. When you purchase this gimmick or when you reprogram it during your daily preparations, choose an elemental trait: air (electricity or slashing), earth (bludgeoning or piercing), fire (fire), metal (piercing or slashing), radiation (acid or poison), water (bludgeoning or cold), and wood (piercing or vitality).

**Activate—Gimmick!** 1 (magical, spellshape)

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Effect** If your next action is to Cast a Spell with an elemental trait (as listed above), replace it with the chosen trait and replace one of its damage types with one of the damage types associated with your chosen trait.

entities.name: Gimmick (Foul)
entities.description:
*Gimmicks* are small devices designed to be harnessed by magic users, available in any number of designs. When you purchase a gimmick, you choose a theme that applies to all spells you cast while holding it, though it doesn't change their effects. For example, a gambler's Force Barrage might resemble throwing cards. You can reprogram a gimmick during your daily preparations to alter its theme. Some gimmicks can also apply additional effects by activating them before Casting a Spell.

This disgusting *gimmick* is especially popular with the unsettling undead and mischievous tricksters.

**Activate—Gimmick!** 1 (magical, spellshape)

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Effect** If your next action is to Cast a Spell, one creature adjacent to you when you do so must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw against your spell DC or become Sickened 1.

entities.name: Hardlight Handwraps (Advanced)
entities.description:
**Upgrades** 2

These handwraps can be customized to shine in any color in the visible spectrum when used, and some manufacturers offer custom firmware that modifies their appearance to manifest as a claw, oversized fist, or hammerhead. They can even be worn in alternate ways on other parts of the body. These handwraps enhance your unarmed attacks as if they were manufactured weapons, allowing you to add an upgrade to your unarmed attacks. Treat the handwraps as melee weapons in the brawling group with light Bulk for these purposes.

Your unarmed attacks gain the tracking +1 trait and increase the damage to two dice.

entities.name: Magical Mixtape
entities.description:
These archaic cassette tapes always have the perfect music for your tastes and the situation you find yourself in. While you listen to them on the included music player, you gain a +1 item bonus to skill checks using your key attribute modifier.

**Activate—Play Rad Music** 1 (auditory, tech)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** With the click of a button, you listen to the perfect music to get you through a situation. For 1 minute, you gain a +10-foot item bonus to your Speed and deal an additional 1d6 precision damage on any successful Strike.

entities.name: Miniaturization Tag
entities.description:
This metallic sticker adheres to any object.

**Activate—Shrink** 1 (magic, manipulate)

**Frequency** once per minute

**Requirements** The applied item is its normal size

**Effect** The item shrinks to fit in your palm. Its Bulk becomes negligible, and it can be easily Concealed in a pocket.

**Activate—Grow** 1 (magic, manipulate)

**Frequency** once per minute

**Requirements** The applied item is miniaturized

**Effect** The item returns to its normal size, appearing in an adjacent space if it's too big for you to hold. You can't Grow the applied item if there isn't enough space for it to appear.

entities.name: Mnemonic Editor (Advanced)
entities.description: A *mnemonic editor* consists of a complex series of virtual reality programs, occult runes, brain implant injectors, and electronic muscle stimulants that can rewrite experiences in dreams and alter muscle memory to learn new skills. Your new memories are remembered as fake, but more vivid than your old memories, which can be vaguely recalled. If you sleep the full 8 hours uninterrupted while wearing a mnemonic editor, when you wake it, count as having spent a month of downtime retraining. The delicate magitech causes it to break down after use; some urban myths claim that the memories it replaces can be salvaged from improperly disposed mnemonic editors.

entities.name: Mnemonic Editor (Commercial)
entities.description: A *mnemonic editor* consists of a complex series of virtual reality programs, occult runes, brain implant injectors, and electronic muscle stimulants that can rewrite experiences in dreams and alter muscle memory to learn new skills. Your new memories are remembered as fake, but more vivid than your old memories, which can be vaguely recalled. If you sleep the full 8 hours uninterrupted while wearing a mnemonic editor, when you wake it, count as having spent a day of downtime retraining. The delicate magitech causes it to break down after use; some urban myths claim that the memories it replaces can be salvaged from improperly disposed mnemonic editors.

entities.name: Mnemonic Editor (Tactical)
entities.description: A *mnemonic editor* consists of a complex series of virtual reality programs, occult runes, brain implant injectors, and electronic muscle stimulants that can rewrite experiences in dreams and alter muscle memory to learn new skills. Your new memories are remembered as fake, but more vivid than your old memories, which can be vaguely recalled. If you sleep the full 8 hours uninterrupted while wearing a mnemonic editor, when you wake it, count as having spent a week of downtime retraining. The delicate magitech causes it to break down after use; some urban myths claim that the memories it replaces can be salvaged from improperly disposed mnemonic editors.

entities.name: Null Space Chamber (Advanced)
entities.description:
This sleek black device attaches to a backpack, purse, or key ring. When you press a button on the side of the device, it creates a circular portal to an extradimensional pocket space. The space's capacity depends on the device's type.

You can Interact with the null space chamber to stow items in it or remove them. The null space chamber can be opened and closed only from the outside. When a null space chamber is opened in an atmosphere with air, it fills with 10 minutes' worth of air for every Bulk left in its capacity. An item inside the null space chamber provides no benefits unless it's retrieved first. Connecting the null space chamber to a computer causes it to display a readout of all items stored within it.

**Capacity** 100 Bulk

entities.name: Null-Space Holster
entities.description:
These stylish faux-leather holsters store weapons in a specialized extradimensional space and eject them on command. They're a favorite of trick shooters, smugglers, and professional soldiers alike. A null-space holster functions as a commercial null-space chamber, except that it can only hold weapons and has a capacity of only 12 Bulk. It comes with a set of six tags that can be affixed to weapons, allowing them to be recalled remotely.

**Activate—Call Weapon** f (auditory)

**Frequency** once per round

**Effect** With a whistle, snap, or other command, you summon a weapon into your hand. You can drop any number of weapons you're already wielding, then you Interact to draw a single weapon from your null-space holster.

**Activate—Recall Weapons** 2 (auditory)

**Effect** You utter a different command sound, and any of your tagged weapons within 100 feet return to the null-space holster.

entities.name: Pain Journal (Commercial)
entities.description:
Your raw emotions empower the poems and phrases penned in this synthetic leather journal. After spending 1 day writing in your pain journal, select Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Performance. Once a skill is selected for a pain journal, it can't be changed. Reading directly from the journal harnesses your painful memories, projects your emotions, and gives you a +1 item bonus to checks using the selected skill.

entities.name: Reusable Grenade Shell
entities.description:
This ordinance was originally shaped like a brutaris ball and intended to add both visual effects and additional risk to the already dangerous game. You can throw the shell to explode the installed grenade, using the grenade's range, damage, and other effects. The shell remains and repairs the grenade over the course of 24 hours, during which time you can't install another grenade. The shell is too large for a grenade launcher.

**Activate—Install Grenade** 1 (manipulate)

**Effect** You install a commercial, tactical, or advanced grenade in the shell. You can store one grenade in the shell at a time, and you can Interact to retrieve the grenade normally.

entities.name: Spell Chip (1st-Rank Spell)
entities.description:
**Usage** installed in computer or comm unit;

These chips can be installed in comm units and other computers to allow the device to cast spells. Each device can have only one spell chip. Casting a spell from a spell chip requires holding the computer or comm unit in one hand and activating it with a Cast a Spell activity using the normal number of actions for that spell. The spell must appear on your spell list. Because you're the one Casting the Spell, use your spell attack modifier and spell DC. The spell must be of your spellcasting tradition. If the spell has a locus, you must still have that locus to cast the spell from a spell chip. Spell chips can't contain cantrips or rituals. The traits for this item vary based on the spell it contains.

In addition to the charge expended to Cast the Spell, the delicate components that make up the core lattice of a spell chip can be destroyed if used in quick succession. Attempting to use a spell chip more than once per day requires overclocking it. Cast the Spell again, then roll a DC 10. On a success, the spell chip is broken. On a failure, the spell chip is destroyed. If anyone tries to overclock a spell chip that's already been overclocked that day, the spell chip is automatically destroyed (even if it's been repaired) and no spell is cast.

**Activate** Cast a Spell

**Frequency** once per day, plus overclock

**Effect** You Cast the Spell at the indicated rank.

entities.name: Spell Server of the Robot Master (Advanced)
entities.description:
This steel box features colorful cascading LED lights, a convenient carrying handle, and a deep indentation in the side with a universal charging port. The indentation can accommodate a single minibot, which is linked to the spell server of the robot master.

**Activate—Direct Minibot** 1 (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per hour

**Effect** You turn some dials and flick some levers to activate the linked minibot. You Activate Minibot for the linked minibot.

- **Cantrip** Analyze Target

- **1st** Mending, Mindlink

- **2nd** Inject Nanobots, Logic Bomb

- **3rd** Mending, upgrade construct

- **4th** cable management, optics feed

- **5th** bugfix, reparative nanites

- **6th** positronic helmet, upgrade construct

entities.name: Spell Server of the Streamer (Advanced)
entities.description:
This collapsible pole has screens and cameras connected to it at all angles, with an oversized hardlight emoji at the top. It includes camera equipment that allows you to Livestream to the local infosphere across multiple platforms, making you appear extra likable in the process. You gain a +3 item bonus to skill checks to Access Infosphere by using the spell server to stream and asking viewers directly, and you can roll access-infosphere skill=performance instead of Computers to do so.

entities.name: Torchbox Truck
entities.description:
This detailed die-cast metal truck fits in the palm of the hand, appearing to be nothing more than a high-end toy or collectible model. With a single command word, however, it can instantly expand into a full-sized, fully functional vehicle. Torchbox trucks are available in a wide variety of designs, though they all have the same statistics.

**Activate—Expand** 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Requirements** The truck is in its miniature form, and there's enough space to fit its vehicle form

**Effect** The torchbox truck instantly expands to full size next to you. In its vehicle form, the torchbox truck has the statistics of an all-terrain dune buggy.

**Activate—Contract** 1 (concentrate, manipulate)

**Requirements** The truck is in its vehicle form

**Effect** The torchbox truck instantly contracts into its miniature form, appearing in your hand. Any passengers appear in spaces adjacent to you.

This bright pink serum is coveted by new recruits in militaries and mercenary companies alike. For the next hour after using this serum, you gain a +3 item bonus to Will saving throws or +4 to Will saving throws against fear effects.

entities.description:
**Activate** 1 (manipulate)

This thick red serum isn't actually made of giant's blood, but rather a cocktail of proprietary nanites. One minute after you use this serum, you and your equipment grow become Large for 5 minutes. Your reach increases by 5 feet (or by 10 feet if you started out Tiny), and you gain a +2 status bonus to melee damage. You're Clumsy 1 for 10 minutes. This serum has no benefits for a Large or larger creature, but they're still clumsy 1 for 10 minutes.

entities.name: Hypopen (Advanced)
entities.description:
This tiny cylinder contains specialized nanites that either

- Remove the Fatigued or Paralyzed condition
- Decrease the value of the Clumsy or Sickened condition by 1.
- Attempt a counteract check against one poison or disease afflicting the target. Use your  modifier for the counteract modifier and a counteract rank of 3.

entities.name: Hypopen (Commercial)
entities.description:
This tiny cylinder contains specialized nanites that either

- Remove the Fatigued condition
- Decrease the value of the Clumsy or Sickened condition by 1.

entities.name: Hypopen (Elite)
entities.description:
This tiny cylinder contains specialized nanites that either

- Remove the Fatigued or Paralyzed condition
- Decrease the value of the Clumsy or Sickened condition by 1.
- Attempt a counteract check against one poison or disease afflicting the target. Use your  modifier for the counteract modifier and a counteract rank of 6.
- Attempt a flat check to end persistent poison or bleed damage. As this is particularly effective assistance, the DC of the flat check is reduced from 15 to 10 for this check.
- Allow you to become Quickened for 1 minute. You can use the extra action to Step, Stride, or Strike.

Effect: Hypopen (Quickened)

entities.description:
