- Grant you fast healing 10 for 1 minute. If you have the Drained condition, decrease its value by 1 instead of gaining fast healing.

Effect: Hypopen (Quickened or Fast Healing)

entities.name: Infiltrator Serum
entities.description:
**Activate** 1 (manipulate)

This oily serum grants a +1 item bonus to checks to Sneak and Disable a Device for 10 minutes.

Effect: Infiltrator Serum

entities.name: Medpatch (Advanced)
entities.description:
**Activate** 1 (manipulate)

Medpatches accelerate the body's natural healing. You regain 5d6+12 healing Hit Points and gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

Effect: Medpatch

entities.name: Medpatch (Commercial)
entities.description:
**Activate** 1 (manipulate)

Medpatches accelerate the body's natural healing. You regain 1d6 healing Hit Points and gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

Effect: Medpatch

entities.name: Medpatch (Elite)
entities.description:
**Activate** 1 (manipulate)

Medpatches accelerate the body's natural healing. You regain 8d6+21 healing Hit Points and gain a +3 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

Effect: Medpatch

entities.name: Medpatch (Superior)
entities.description:
**Activate** 1 (manipulate)

Medpatches accelerate the body's natural healing. You regain 7d6+18 healing Hit Points and gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

Effect: Medpatch

entities.name: Medpatch (Tactical)
entities.description:
**Activate** 1 (manipulate)

Medpatches accelerate the body's natural healing. You regain 3d6+6 healing Hit Points and gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

Effect: Medpatch

entities.name: Medpatch (Ultimate)
entities.description:
**Activate** 1 (manipulate)

Medpatches accelerate the body's natural healing. You regain 10d6+27 healing Hit Points and gain a +4 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

Effect: Medpatch

entities.name: Sharpshooter Serum (Commercial)
entities.description:
**Activate** 1 (manipulate)

This smoky orange liquid enhances your senses and reduces the circumstance bonus to AC your targets gain from cover by 1 against your ranged Strikes for 5 minutes.

Effect: Sharpshooter Serum

entities.name: Sharpshooter Serum (Tactical)
entities.description:
**Activate** 1 (manipulate)

This smoky orange liquid enhances your senses and reduces the circumstance bonus to AC your targets gain from cover by 2 against your ranged Strikes for 5 minutes.

Effect: Sharpshooter Serum

entities.name: Shimmerstone Serum
entities.description:
**Activate** 1 (manipulate)

A blue tincture distilled from shimmerstone. You gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws against mental effects and a +2 item bonus to checks to Recall Knowledge for 10 minutes.

entities.name: Sprayflesh
entities.description:
**Activate** 1 (manipulate)

A canister sprays neutral biomass into a wound or area of concern (such as a clearly diseased or poisoned section of the body). For 1 hour, or until the creature fully recovers to their maximum Hit Points, you can attempt Medicine checks to Treat Wounds on the target creature even if they're temporarily immune to Treat Wounds.

entities.name: Amphitheatarge
entities.description: This curved shield is terraced to mimic the tiered seating of a classical amphitheater, ensuring acoustic affronts are lifted up and away from the shield's wielder.

entities.name: Beauty Barrier
entities.description: A beauty barrier consists of several angled mirrors on a lightweight armguard to get the best look at oneself or one's foes. Originally developed as a fashionable accessory for infosphere influencers, the shield's ability to deflect laser attacks resulted in its rebranding for mercenaries.

Stats.Traits: blocking-fire, compact, deflecting-ranged-fire, tech, Hardness 2, HP 10

entities.name: Carbon Shield
entities.description: This durable yet lightweight defensive plate comes in a variety of shapes and sizes, and it's often customized with LED displays that broadcast personal insignia or an organization's colors and symbols.

entities.name: Compact Shield
entities.description: This sleek shield is a favorite of operatives and other mobile combatants. It's most common design is a polycarbon panel contoured to fit snugly over a forearm or other limb.

entities.name: Deflecting Field
entities.description: This shield isn't held—instead, it's installed as an armor or weapon upgrade. A deflecting field appears as a translucent panel integrated into the upgraded item and creates a temporary protective hardlight barrier when activated.

entities.name: Doshkalani
entities.description: A doshkalani is a vesk shield that mixes defense and offense, featuring a ridge of spikes like those on a doshko.

entities.name: Firewall Projector (Superior)
entities.description:
This unassuming dongle features a hardlight projector, taking the form of a shield (+1 AC, Hardness 5, HP 66, BT 33).

**Activate—System Maintenance** 1 (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Effect** The firewall projector reduces the Glitching value of itself or the gear its installed in by 2.

Stats.Traits: blocking-cold, blocking-electricity, deflecting-cold, fire, fortifying, fortifying-electricity, installed, tech, Hardness 5, HP 66

entities.name: Firewall Projector (Tactical)
entities.description:
This unassuming dongle features a hardlight projector, taking the form of a shield (+1 AC, Hardness 5, HP 44, BT 22).

**Activate—System Maintenance** 1 (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Effect** The firewall projector reduces the Glitching value of itself or the gear its installed in by 1.

Stats.Traits: blocking-cold, blocking-electricity, deflecting-cold, fire, fortifying-electricity, installed, tech, Hardness 5, HP 44

This unassuming dongle features a hardlight projector, taking the form of a shield (+1 AC, Hardness 8, HP 98, BT 49).

**Effect** The firewall projector reduces the Glitching value of itself or the gear its installed in by 3.

Stats.Traits: blocking-cold, blocking-electricity, deflecting-cold, fire, fortifying-electricity, installed, tech, Hardness 8, HP 98

entities.name: Independent Obstructobot (Advanced)
entities.description:
This orbiting minibot protects its user. You can Raise a Shield with an independent obstructobot (+2 AC, Hardness 5, HP 50, BT 25) without a free hand. The controls for this minibot must be installed in your armor and use an armor upgrade slot.

**Activate—Reconfigure Fields** 1

**Frequency** once per round

**Effect** You Raise a Shield and choose bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing. The shield gains the deflecting trait for that damage type for 10 minutes or until you Reconfigure Fields again, whichever comes first.

entities.name: Independent Obstructobot (Elite)
entities.description:
This orbiting minibot protects its user. You can Raise a Shield with an independent obstructobot (+2 AC, Hardness 7, HP 74, BT 37) without a free hand. The controls for this minibot must be installed in your armor and use an armor upgrade slot.

**Activate—Reconfigure Fields** 1

**Frequency** once per round

**Effect** You Raise a Shield and choose two of bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing. The shield gains the deflecting trait for those damage type for 10 minutes or until you Reconfigure Fields again, whichever comes first.

entities.name: Independent Obstructobot (Ultimate)
entities.description:
This orbiting minibot protects its user. You can Raise a Shield with an independent obstructobot (+2 AC, Hardness 8, HP 94, BT 47) without a free hand. The controls for this minibot must be installed in your armor and use an armor upgrade slot.

**Activate—Reconfigure Fields** 1

**Frequency** once per round

**Effect** You Raise a Shield and the shield gains the deflecting trait for bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing for 10 minutes or until you Reconfigure Fields again, whichever comes first.

entities.name: Irising Shield
entities.description: An irising shield is made of flexible polycarbon with a retractable design. When retracted, an irising shield looks like a decorative bangle, gauntlet, or glove. When deployed, its panels flare out and form a miniature circular shield.

entities.name: Lissalan Barrier (Superior)
entities.description:
This shield (+2 AC, Hardness 5, HP 66, BT 33) prominently features Lissala's religious symbol. When a *spell gem* attached to the Lissalan barrier's weapon component is activated to Cast a Spell, the shield regains Hit Points equal to twice the spell's rank.

The included weapon can have both a single *aeon stone* and a single *spell gem* attached to it at once.

Stats.Traits: battlement, blocking-mental, fortifying-mental, magical, Hardness 5, HP 66

entities.name: Lissalan Barrier (Tactical)
entities.description: This shield (+2 AC, Hardness 6, HP 48, BT 24) prominently features Lissala's religious symbol. When a *spell gem* attached to the Lissalan barrier's weapon component is activated to Cast a Spell, the shield regains Hit Points equal to twice the spell's rank.

Stats.Traits: battlement, blocking-mental, fortifying-mental, magical, Hardness 6, HP 48

entities.name: Lissalan Barrier (Ultimate)
entities.description:
This shield (+2 AC, Hardness 9, HP 102, BT 51) prominently features Lissala's religious symbol. When a *spell gem* attached to the Lissalan barrier's weapon component is activated to Cast a Spell, the shield regains Hit Points equal to twice the spell's rank.

The included weapon can have both a single *aeon stone* and up to seven *spell gems* attached to it at once.

Stats.Traits: battlement, blocking-mental, fortifying-mental, magical, Hardness 9, HP 102

entities.name: Magnetic Edge
entities.description: This simple series of magnets is designed to be integrated into another defensive item.

entities.name: Mediblocker
entities.description: This sterile circular shield includes a Concealed needle to neutralize threats with modern medicine.

entities.name: Mobile Bulwark
entities.description: This bulky shield is advertised as the ultimate protection in battle for those strong enough to hoist them. Mobile bulwarks create an iconic rectangular silhouette and are popular with heavily armored mercenaries and soldiers, notably among the Veskarium military and some orders of Hellknights. A mobile bulwark is often constructed of carbon steel, with a transparent aluminum view port.

entities.name: Overlord Buckle
entities.description: This shield resembles a buckled leather glove until its buckle deploys a sturdy carbon steel plate and uses injected adrenal responses to defend against mental intrusions.

entities.name: Phase Shield
entities.description: A phase shield is an intricate but durable technological device often worn strapped to a limb or belt that projects a protective hardlight barrier when deployed. Phase shields are translucent and tinted, with a wide variety of fully customizable colors and image projectors. Many wielders choose an image of a favorite celebrity, loved one, or pleasant scenery to bolster their fighting spirit in a dire situation.

entities.name: Riot Shield
entities.description: Riot shields are constructed from sheets of transparent aluminum reinforced with nanocarbon panels layered over polymers or resins. These sleek but sturdy shields are designed to protect most of the wielder's body when raised while allowing them to march in tight tactical formations. Sometimes they're transparent to allow inexperienced wielders to see the other side while the shield is raised, but most experienced warriors have no problem seeing around these shields, and the transparent material quickly becomes too scuffed to see through after a few hits.

entities.name: Shelter Wall
entities.description: This large shield is made from metallic alloys used in Akitonian bomb shelters. Its lack of advanced tech allows it to endure nuclear hazards.

entities.name: Spliced Geneshield
entities.description: When wielded as a pair, these shields use corrosive agents emitted by a force field to disrupt enemies.

entities.name: Vaccikite
entities.description: A vaccikite is a Vercite kite shield that integrates microfiber filters to catch toxins before bodily exposure.

entities.name: Watchful Timepiece
entities.description: This wristwatch can be deployed into a clockwork shield and is popular among munitions executives.

entities.name: +1 Weapon Potency Crystal
entities.description: This item crystallizes the focus needed to replicate the actions of a star. Attack rolls with the solar weapon or flare gain a +1 item bonus, and the weapon or flare can benefit from one orbital crystal.

entities.name: +2 Weapon Potency Crystal
entities.description: This item crystallizes the focus needed to replicate the actions of a star. Attack rolls with the solar weapon or flare gain a +2 item bonus, and the weapon or flare can benefit from two orbital crystals.

entities.name: +3 Weapon Potency Crystal
entities.description: This item crystallizes the focus needed to replicate the actions of a star. Attack rolls with the solar weapon or flare gain a +3 item bonus, and the weapon or flare can benefit from three orbital crystals.

entities.name: Cycling Crystal
entities.description:
A cycling crystal gives you greater control over the cycle of energies flowing through your solar manifestations.

**Activate—Halt Cycle** f (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Trigger** You critically hit with your solar weapon or solar flare as part of an action with the cycle trait

**Effect** You can choose whether to change your attunement state or remain in your current attunement state.

entities.name: Gluon Crystal (Advanced)
entities.description: A gluon crystal harnesses entropy to cause serious lasting wounds. Your solar weapon or solar flare deals an extra 1d8 persistent,bleed damage. On a critical hit, the target is Clumsy 1 until it recovers from the persistent bleed damage.

entities.name: Gluon Crystal (Commercial)
entities.description: A gluon crystal harnesses entropy to cause serious lasting wounds. Your solar weapon or solar flare deals an extra 1d4 persistent,bleed damage. On a critical hit, the target is Clumsy 1 until it recovers from the persistent bleed damage.

entities.name: Gluon Crystal (Superior)
entities.description: A gluon crystal harnesses entropy to cause serious lasting wounds. Your solar weapon or solar flare deals an extra 1d10 persistent,bleed damage. On a critical hit, the target is Clumsy 1 until it recovers from the persistent bleed damage.

entities.name: Gluon Crystal (Tactical)
entities.description: A gluon crystal harnesses entropy to cause serious lasting wounds. Your solar weapon or solar flare deals an extra 1d6 persistent,bleed damage. On a critical hit, the target is Clumsy 1 until it recovers from the persistent bleed damage.

entities.name: Graviton Crystal (Commercial)
entities.description: A graviton crystal increases the forces of gravity around your solar manifestations, accelerating its impact and possibly trapping foes within its gravity field. While graviton attuned, your solar weapon or solar flare deals an extra 1d6 untyped damage of your solar weapon's or flare's damage type. On a critical hit while you're graviton attuned, the target must succeed at a DC 23 save or be Slowed 1 until the end of your next turn.

entities.name: Graviton Crystal (Tactical)
entities.description:
A graviton crystal increases the forces of gravity around your solar manifestations, accelerating its impact and possibly trapping foes within its gravity field. While graviton attuned, your solar weapon or solar flare deals an extra 1d6 untyped damage of your solar weapon's or flare's damage type. On a critical hit while you're graviton attuned, the target must succeed at a DC 31 save or be Slowed 1 for 2 rounds.

Additionally, when you hit an immobilized or suppressed creature with your solar weapon or solar flare, the target must succeed at a DC 31 save or be knocked prone.

entities.name: Photon Crystal (Commercial)
entities.description: A photon crystal increases the flow of photon into your solar manifestations, burning and blinding your foes. While photon attuned, your solar weapon or solar flare deals an extra 1d6 fire damage. On a critical hit while you're photon attuned, the target must succeed at a DC 23 save or be Blinded for 1 round.

entities.name: Photon Crystal (Tactical)
entities.description:
A photon crystal increases the flow of photon into your solar manifestations, burning and blinding your foes. While photon attuned, your solar weapon or solar flare deals an extra 1d6 fire damage. On a critical hit while you're photon attuned, the target must succeed at a DC 31 save or be Blinded for 2 rounds.

Damage dealt by your solar weapon or flare while photon attuned ignores the target's resistance to fire.

entities.name: Quasar Crystal
entities.description: Quasar crystals condense your solar energy into a single point ready to release on impact. Attacks with this weapon are a critical hit on a 19 on the die as long as that result is a success. This property has no effect on a 19 if the result would be a failure.

entities.name: Striking Crystal (Advanced)
entities.description: This gem contains the condensed matter of a star and increases the weapon damage dice of a solar weapon or flare to four instead of one.

entities.name: Striking Crystal (Commercial)
entities.description: This gem contains the condensed matter of a star and increases the weapon damage dice of a solar weapon or flare to two instead of one.

entities.name: Striking Crystal (Tactical)
entities.description: This gem contains the condensed matter of a star and increases the weapon damage dice of a solar weapon or flare to three instead of one.

entities.name: Autopilot (Advanced)
entities.description:
Autopilots are ubiquitous throughout the Pact Worlds on all manner of vehicles. It takes 10 minutes to install an autopilot into a vehicle, during which time the vehicle can't be occupied as it calibrates itself and runs extensive diagnostics. Once installed, you can control the vehicle remotely using your comm unit with a range of 20 miles. A commercial autopilot has a +9 modifier to Piloting and can forego rolling a skill check for Piloting to instead receive a result of 10 + its modifier.

**Activate—Autopilot** 1

**Requirements** The autopilot is attached to a vehicle

**Effect** The autopilot Drives, Speeds Up, or Stops its attached vehicle.

entities.name: Universal Translation App (Advanced)
entities.description:
Developed by vulkarisu linguists on Absalom Station, the Universal Translation App (or UTA) automatically scans any written text to display a phonetic translation in Common on the comm unit or any head-up display, such as an armor's visor. This provides a +2 item bonus to Society checks to Decipher Writing.

Using advanced linguistics and artificial intelligence, the advanced UTA can translate to and from any spoken and written language, but it can't be used when you attempt to use a skill action with the linguistics trait without the Digital Ambassador skill feat. GMs can determine that a Rare language with completely alien phonetics is beyond the capabilities of the advanced UTA.

entities.name: Universal Translation App (Commercial)
entities.description: Developed by vulkarisu linguists on Absalom Station, the Universal Translation App (or UTA) automatically scans any written text to display a phonetic translation in Common on the comm unit or any head-up display, such as an armor's visor. entities.description:

This provides a +2 item bonus to Society checks to Decipher Writing.

The tactical UTA can translate verbal speech into Common with proper phonetic spelling, but it can't be used when you attempt to use a skill action with the linguistics trait without the Digital Ambassador skill feat.

entities.name: Acid Module (Commercial)
entities.description: This module adds destructive nanobots to the weapon. The weapon deals an additional 1d6 acid damage. On a critical hit, the target also takes a –1 status penalty to its AC until the end of your next turn unless it succeeds at a DC 24 save.

entities.name: Acid Module (Tactical)
entities.description: This module adds destructive nanobots to the weapon. The weapon deals an additional 1d6 acid damage. On a critical hit, the target also takes a –1 status penalty to its AC until the end of your next turn unless it succeeds at a DC 34 save. Acid damage dealt by this weapon ignores the target’s acid resistance.

entities.name: Animated Intelligence (Advanced)
entities.description:
Magical circuitry generates a virtual animated intelligence with a customizable personality and no free will. Rarely, a virtual intelligence might eventually evolve into a true artificial intelligence with self-awareness and free will, usually with the help of powerful magic or a miracle.

**Activate—Autoattack** 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

**Effect** You Release the weapon and it glides through the air, fighting on its own against the last enemy you attacked, or the nearest enemy to it if your target has been defeated. At the end of your turn each round, the weapon can Fly up to its fly Speed of 60 feet, and then can either Fly again or Strike one creature within its range or reach.

The weapon has a space of 5 feet, but it doesn't block or impede enemies attempting to move though that space. It provides but does not benefit from flanking. The animated intelligence is considered a technological creature for the purpose of effects that can target it. The weapon can't move through an enemy's space. The weapon can't use reactions, and its Fly actions don't trigger reactions.

While it's activated, the animated intelligence Strikes with an attack modifier of +32 plus its item bonus to attack rolls. It uses the weapon's normal damage but has a +0 Strength and Dexterity modifier. The weapon's abilities that automatically trigger on a hit or critical hit still function, but the weapon can't be activated or benefit from any of your abilities while animated.

Each round, when the weapon finishes using its actions, attempt a DC 4. On a failure, the activation ends. The weapon falls to the ground and can't Autoattack again for 10 minutes.

entities.name: Arcane Adapter (Commercial)
entities.description:
This barrel shroud is covered in complex magical symbols. It transmutes rounds as they leave the chamber.

**Activate—Transmute Ammo** 1 (magical)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** Select cold iron or silver. For the next minute, ammunition fired from this weapon is treated as the chosen material for the purposes of determining immunities, resistances, weakness, and other effects.

entities.name: Arcane Adapter (Tactical)
entities.description:
This barrel shroud is covered in complex magical symbols. It transmutes rounds as they leave the chamber.

**Activate—Transmute Ammo** 1 (magical)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** Select cold iron, silver, or adamantine. For the next minute, ammunition fired from this weapon is treated as the chosen material for the purposes of determining immunities, resistances, weakness, and other effects.

entities.name: Bipod (Advanced)
entities.description:
A bipod can be attached to powerful weapons—those with the kickback trait—to allow wielders with lower Strength to use them at the cost of mobility. You can set up the bipod with a single Interact action using one appendage, setting the bipod in your square. When using a bipod, you don't take the –2 penalty for firing a kickback weapon, even if your Strength isn't high enough to avoid the penalty.

You can Interact as a free action to retrieve the bipod before you can move the weapon to a different position. Deploying or retrieving a bipod with an Interact action doesn't automatically make you observed like an Interact action normally would, so long as you don't set up or remove the bipod when it's in a spot where creatures can see it.

Once per round, you can either deploy or retrieve this automatic bipod as a free action instead of an Interact action.

entities.name: Bipod (Commercial)
entities.description:
A bipod can be attached to powerful weapons—those with the kickback trait—to allow wielders with lower Strength to use them at the cost of mobility. You can set up the bipod with a single Interact action using one appendage, setting the bipod in your square. When using a bipod, you don't take the –2 penalty for firing a kickback weapon, even if your Strength isn't high enough to avoid the penalty.

However, you must spend a single Interact action to retrieve the bipod before you can move the weapon to a different position. Deploying or retrieving a bipod with an Interact action doesn't automatically make you observed like an Interact action normally would, so long as you don't set up or remove the bipod when it's in a spot where creatures can see it.

entities.name: Bipod (Tactical)
entities.description:
A bipod can be attached to powerful weapons—those with the kickback trait—to allow wielders with lower Strength to use them at the cost of mobility. You can set up the bipod with a single Interact action using one appendage, setting the bipod in your square. When using a bipod, you don't take the –2 penalty for firing a kickback weapon, even if your Strength isn't high enough to avoid the penalty.

You can Interact as a free action to retrieve the bipod before you can move the weapon to a different position. Deploying or retrieving a bipod with an Interact action doesn't automatically make you observed like an Interact action normally would, so long as you don't set up or remove the bipod when it's in a spot where creatures can see it.

entities.name: Boom Ripple (Commercial)
entities.description: This upgrade charges a weapon to create shock waves. When you critically hit with this weapon, you create a shock wave in a 10-foot burst at a corner of your choice on the space of the Strike's target or, if you critically hit using the primary target class feature, the shock wave uses the area of your Area Fire instead. Creatures in the area take 2d6 bludgeoning |options:area-damage damage (DC 20 save), and creatures that critically fail their save are knocked back 10 feet from the center of the area. This is forced movement.

entities.name: Boom Ripple (Tactical)
entities.description: This upgrade charges a weapon to create shock waves. When you critically hit with this weapon, you create a shock wave in a 20-foot burst at a corner of your choice on the space of the Strike's target or, if you critically hit using the primary target class feature, the shock wave uses the area of your Area Fire instead. Creatures in the area take 4d6 bludgeoning |options:area-damage damage (DC 30 save), and creatures that critically fail their save are knocked back 10 feet from the center of the area. This is forced movement.

entities.name: Cryolizer
entities.description:
This hyperthermic reducing module can be used to tactfully incapacitate enemies using cryogenics.

**Activate—Cryolize** r (cold)

**Trigger** You reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points with damage from the installed weapon

**Effect** The target must succeed at a DC 31 save or be frozen solid, Paralyzed until it's thawed (using a medkit and substantial hot water for an hour), instead of dying. The target can choose to fail its save.

entities.name: Disintegrator Module
entities.description:
These frequency modulators enhance disintegrating weapons.

**Activate—Disintegrate** r (death, incapacitation)

**Trigger** You roll a natural 20 on a Strike with the installed weapon and deal acid or fire damage

**Effect** The target must succeed at a DC 38 save or be reduced to ashes. This instantly kills a corporeal creature and generally destroys any non-magical items on its body.

entities.name: Distributed Blast Unit
entities.description:
This altered energy projection unit extends the lifetime of the exotic particles used by the weapon in lingering energy pools.

**Activate—Reigning Fire** 1 (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Effect** If your next action is to Area Fire the installed weapon, the affected area becomes hazardous terrain for 1 minute. The hazardous terrain deals 1 untyped damage per weapon damage die of the same damage type as the installed weapon.

entities.name: Entropic Destabilizer (Commercial)
entities.description: Tendrils of dark energy soar from the unit affixed to this weapon, coating it and its ammunition in a disturbing purple hue. When you hit with the weapon, add 1d4 void damage to the damage dealt. In addition, on a critical hit, the target takes 2d4 persistent void damage; if the target has a shield raised, the shield takes the same amount of persistent damage (its wielder rolls the flat check to see if the persistent damage ends, or the GM rolls if the shield is no longer in someone's possession). Unlike normal void damage, the void damage from an entropic destabilizer damages objects, constructs, and the like by eroding them away.

entities.name: Entropic Destabilizer (Tactical)
entities.description:
Tendrils of dark energy soar from the unit affixed to this weapon, coating it and its ammunition in a disturbing purple hue. When you hit with the weapon, add 1d4 void damage to the damage dealt. In addition, on a critical hit, the target takes 4d4 persistent void damage; if the target has a shield raised, the shield takes the same amount of persistent damage (its wielder rolls the flat check to see if the persistent damage ends, or the GM rolls if the shield is no longer in someone's possession). Unlike normal void damage, the void damage from an entropic destabilizer damages objects, constructs, and the like by eroding them away.

The void damage dealt by this weapon ignores the target's void resistance or immunity.

entities.name: Exhaust Disperal Unit (Advanced)
entities.description:
This upgrade vents the weapon's exhaust into propulsion.

**Activate—Exhaust Vents** f (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per round

**Trigger** You Area Fire or Strike with the installed weapon

**Effect** You can Push Off in a direction of your choice without needing a free appendage. You float up to your Speed when you Push Off or, if you aren’t untethered, you can Leap.

entities.name: Exhaust Disperal Unit (Commercial)
entities.description:
This upgrade vents the weapon's exhaust into propulsion.

**Activate—Exhaust Vents** f (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per minute

**Trigger** You Area Fire or Strike with the installed weapon

**Effect** You can Push Off in a direction of your choice without needing a free appendage.

entities.name: Exhaust Disperal Unit (Tactical)
entities.description:
This upgrade vents the weapon's exhaust into propulsion.

**Activate—Exhaust Vents** f (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per minute

**Trigger** You Area Fire or Strike with the installed weapon

**Effect** You can Push Off in a direction of your choice without needing a free appendage. You float up to your Speed when you Push Off or, if you aren’t untethered, you can Leap.

entities.name: Fear Projector (Commercial)
entities.description: This integrated hologram projector makes the wounds caused by the weapon look way worse than they are. When you critically hit with this weapon, the target becomes Frightened 1.

entities.name: Fear Projector (Tactical)
entities.description: This integrated hologram projector makes the wounds caused by the weapon look way worse than they are. When you critically hit with this weapon, the target becomes Frightened 2.

entities.name: Fireburst Chamber
entities.description:
A fireburst chamber allows you to direct the detonation of a grenade inside of a grenade launcher or an undermounted grenade launcher.

**Activate—Fireburst Mode** 1 (manipulate)

**Effect** The grenade launcher or the undermounted grenade launcher gains the area (cone) trait with a range of 15 feet and uses the properties of the grenade it fires instead of using its normal range. You can end this effect with an Interact action.

entities.name: Flaming Module (Commercial)
entities.description: This module overheats the weapon's striking edge and ammunition. The weapon deals an additional 1d6 fire damage on a successful Strike, plus 1d10 persistent fire damage on a critical hit.

entities.name: Flaming Module (Tactical)
entities.description:
This module overheats the weapon's striking edge and ammunition. The weapon deals an additional 1d6 fire damage on a successful Strike, plus 2d10 persistent fire damage on a critical hit.

Fire damage dealt by this weapon (including the persistent fire damage) ignores the target's fire resistance.

entities.name: Frost Module (Commercial)
entities.description: This module siphons the heat from the weapon's striking edge and ammunition, powering itself with the excess energy as it chills the air around it. It deals an additional 1d6 cold damage on a successful Strike. On a critical hit, the target is also Slowed 1 until the end of your next turn unless it succeeds at a DC 24 Fortitude save.

entities.name: Frost Module (Tactical)
entities.description:
This module siphons the heat from the weapon's striking edge and ammunition, powering itself with the excess energy as it chills the air around it. It deals an additional 1d6 cold damage on a successful Strike. On a critical hit, the target is also Slowed 1 until the end of your next turn unless it succeeds at a DC 34 Fortitude save.

Cold damage dealt by this weapon ignores the target's cold resistance.

entities.name: Ghost Killer
entities.description: This upgrade lets you harm creatures without physical form. A ghost killer weapon is particularly effective against incorporeal creatures, which almost always have a specific vulnerability to ghost killer weapons. Incorporeal creatures can touch, hold, and wield ghost killer weapons (unlike most physical objects).

entities.name: Gravitational Generator
entities.description: This generator increases the mass of creatures struck by the weapon, causing gravity to affect them more heavily. When you critically hit a flying creature with a Strike with the installed weapon and deal damage, the target immediately falls up to 20 feet to the nearest surface and reduces its fly Speed by 5 feet for 1 minute. Subsequent successful Strikes against the same creature further reduce its fly Speed each time. This upgrade has no effect in zero gravity.

entities.name: Holy Module (Commercial)
entities.description: This upgrade is often adorned with a religious symbol and channels celestial power. It deals an additional 1d4 spirit damage, or 3d4 spirit against an unholy target. If you are unholy, you are Enfeebled 2 while carrying or wielding this weapon. On a critical hit, the target is also Dazzled (or Blinded if unholy) until the end of your next turn unless it succeeds at a DC 28 save.

entities.name: Holy Module (Tactical)
entities.description: This upgrade is often adorned with a religious symbol and channels celestial power. It deals an additional 1d4 spirit damage, or 3d4 spirit against an unholy target. If you are unholy, you are Enfeebled 2 while carrying or wielding this weapon. On a critical hit, the target is also Dazzled (or Blinded if unholy) until the end of your next turn unless it succeeds at a DC 35 save.

entities.name: Impact Enhancer (Advanced)
entities.description:
Magic runes increases the mass of the projectiles fired through the weapon's barrel. When you critically hit with the installed weapon, the target must attempt a DC 34 save.

**Failure** The target is pushed back 10 feet. If it collides with an obstacle or another creature, it's knocked Prone.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the target is pushed back 15 feet.

entities.name: Impact Enhancer (Commercial)
entities.description:
Magic runes increases the mass of the projectiles fired through the weapon's barrel. When you critically hit with the installed weapon, the target must attempt a DC 17 save.

**Failure** The target is pushed back 5 feet. If it collides with an obstacle or another creature, it's knocked Prone.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the target is pushed back 10 feet.

entities.name: Impact Enhancer (Tactical)
entities.description:
Magic runes increases the mass of the projectiles fired through the weapon's barrel. When you critically hit with the installed weapon, the target must attempt a DC 24 save.

**Failure** The target is pushed back 5 feet. If it collides with an obstacle or another creature, it's knocked Prone.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the target is pushed back 10 feet.

entities.name: Junk Hopper
entities.description:
This rugged steel box has a wide mouth on one side and an ammo feed on the other. It uses nanites to convert scrap fed to the bin into battery charges, chemical fuel, or projectiles. Generated chems or projectiles are held in shape by the device's magnetic field, so they disintegrate into useless junk if removed from the installed weapon.

**Activate—Recycle Ammo** 1 (manipulate)

**Effect** You pour 1 Bulk of junk into the junk hopper. At the start of your next turn, the hopper finishes converting the junk into 10 chems, 10 battery charges, or 10 rounds of projectile ammo, which are automatically loaded into the installed weapon. Any ammunition produced that exceeds the installed weapon's magazine capacity is wasted.

entities.name: Loudener (Commercial)
entities.description: This specialized cone is installed over the muzzle or hilt of a weapon to use pneumonic pulses and passive acoustics to increase the volume of its attacks. It deals an extra 1d6 sonic damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed at a DC 24 save or be Deafened for 1 minute (or 1 hour on a critical failure).

entities.name: Loudener (Tactical)
entities.description:
This specialized cone is installed over the muzzle or hilt of a weapon to use pneumonic pulses and passive acoustics to increase the volume of its attacks. It deals an extra 1d6 sonic damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed at a DC 34 save or be Deafened for 1 minute (or 1 hour on a critical failure).

Sonic damage dealt by this weapon ignores the target's sonic resistance.

entities.name: Merciful
entities.description:
Merciful weapons are limned in a green glow recognized around the galaxy. A merciful weapon has the nonlethal trait and can't be used to make a lethal attack. Any persistent damage the weapon would deal is negated.

On a critical hit, a merciful weapon causes the target to become Fascinated with the weapon's wielder for 1 minute, as the target is bombarded with feelings of guilt and remorse. This is a mental effect. If you have access to the weapon's critical specialization effect, you choose whether to use it or the merciful effect.

entities.name: Protection Grid (Commercial)
entities.description: This upgrade embeds an energy shield generator into the weapon. The weapon gains the parry trait.

entities.name: Protection Grid (Tactical)
entities.description: This upgrade embeds an energy shield generator into the weapon. The weapon gains the parry trait. The circumstance bonus to AC from positioning the weapon defensively increases to +2.

entities.name: Quicklock
entities.description: A quicklock weapon has multiple tracking devices and additional computer processors to increase the rapidity of its built-in targeting systems, allowing its wielder to strike rapidly. While wielding a quicklock weapon, you gain the Quickened condition, but you can use the additional action granted only to make a Strike with the weapon.

entities.name: Radiation Module (Commercial)
entities.description: This radioactive core irradiates the weapon. The weapon deals an extra 1d6 poison damage. On a critical hit, the target must attempt a DC 22 save against severe radiation sickness.

entities.name: Radiation Module (Tactical)
entities.description:
This radioactive core irradiates the weapon. The weapon deals an extra 1d6 poison damage. On a critical hit, the target must attempt a DC 32 save against severe radiation sickness.

Poison damage dealt by this weapon ignores the target’s poison resistance.

entities.name: Residual Energy Conductor (Advanced)
entities.description:
This magical mesh refines residual magic into ammunition.

**Activate—Conduct Ammunition** f (manipulate)

**Trigger** Your last non-cantrip spell this turn had the acid, cold, electricity, fire, poison, or sonic trait

**Effect** The installed weapon's battery regains 3 charge. If this would exceed the maximum charges for its magazine, the weapon instead deals an additional 3 untyped damage of the triggering type until the end of your next turn.

entities.name: Residual Energy Conductor (Commercial)
entities.description:
This magical mesh refines residual magic into ammunition.

**Activate—Conduct Ammunition** f (manipulate)

**Trigger** Your last non-cantrip spell this turn had the acid, cold, electricity, fire, poison, or sonic trait

**Effect** The installed weapon's battery regains 1 charge. If this would exceed the maximum charges for its magazine, the weapon instead deals an additional 1 untyped damage of the triggering type until the end of your next turn.

entities.name: Residual Energy Conductor (Elite)
entities.description:
This magical mesh refines residual magic into ammunition.

**Activate—Conduct Ammunition** f (manipulate)

**Trigger** Your last non-cantrip spell this turn had the acid, cold, electricity, fire, poison, or sonic trait

**Effect** The installed weapon's battery regains 5 charge. If this would exceed the maximum charges for its magazine, the weapon instead deals an additional 5 untyped damage of the triggering type until the end of your next turn.

entities.name: Residual Energy Conductor (Superior)
entities.description:
This magical mesh refines residual magic into ammunition.

**Activate—Conduct Ammunition** f (manipulate)

**Trigger** Your last non-cantrip spell this turn had the acid, cold, electricity, fire, poison, or sonic trait

**Effect** The installed weapon's battery regains 4 charge. If this would exceed the maximum charges for its magazine, the weapon instead deals an additional 4 untyped damage of the triggering type until the end of your next turn.

entities.name: Residual Energy Conductor (Tactical)
entities.description:
This magical mesh refines residual magic into ammunition.

**Activate—Conduct Ammunition** f (manipulate)

**Trigger** Your last non-cantrip spell this turn had the acid, cold, electricity, fire, poison, or sonic trait

**Effect** The installed weapon's battery regains 2 charge. If this would exceed the maximum charges for its magazine, the weapon instead deals an additional 2 untyped damage of the triggering type until the end of your next turn.

entities.name: Retrieval Boosters
entities.description: When you make a thrown Strike with this weapon, a complex combination of stabilizers and boosters propels it back into your free hand (or other appendage) after the Strike is complete. If your hands are full when the weapon returns, it falls to the ground in your space.

entities.name: Shock Module (Commercial)
entities.description: This circuit safely courses electricity through your weapon. It deals an extra 1d6 electricity damage. On a critical hit, electricity arcs out to deal an equal amount of electricity damage to up to two other creatures of your choice within 10 feet of the target.

entities.name: Shock Module (Tactical)
entities.description:
This circuit safely courses electricity through your weapon. It deals an extra 1d6 electricity damage. On a critical hit, this increases to 2d10 electricity damage, and electricity arcs out to deal an equal amount of electricity damage to up to two other creatures of your choice within 10 feet of the target.

Electricity damage dealt by this weapon ignores the target's electricity resistance (and the other creatures' on a critical hit).

entities.name: Silencer (Commercial)
entities.description: A cylinder is filled with internal sound baffles to reduce noise. The weapon doesn't make a loud noise when fired. However, creatures hit by the ammunition might still cry out in pain.

entities.name: Silencer (Tactical)
entities.description:
A cylinder is filled with internal sound baffles to reduce noise. The weapon doesn't make a loud noise when fired. However, creatures hit by the ammunition might still cry out in pain.

A tactical silencer is a hybrid item with the magical and tech traits. Shots fired from a tactical silencer magically dampen sounds around them. On a critically successful Strike, the target becomes unable to make sound. The target can't use sonic attacks, nor can it use actions with the auditory trait. This also prevents the target from casting spells due to the incantations or sounds involved in casting, with the exception of subtle spells. The target can resist the effects of the silencer with a successful DC 27 save.

entities.name: Smuggler's Grip (Commercial)
entities.description: These grips are designed to make it easy to conceal your weapon and are frequently used by detectives, diplomats, and smugglers. The weapon gains the concealable trait.

entities.name: Smuggler's Grip (Tactical)
entities.description:
These grips are designed to make it easy to conceal your weapon and are frequently used by detectives, diplomats, and smugglers. The weapon gains the concealable trait.

A tactical smuggler's grip is a hybrid item with the extradimensional, magical, and tech traits. You can pull the weapon into an extradimensional space as an Interact action, leaving behind a palm-sized disk and granting you a +4 item bonus to your Stealth check to Conceal the Object. You can't draw the weapon while it's in the extradimensional space, but you can use an Interact action to retrieve it.

entities.name: Sniper's Scope (Advanced)
entities.description:
A telescopic sighting attachment helps view distant targets.

The scope grants you a +2 item bonus to visual Perception checks to Seek creatures through the scope.

**Activate—Adjust Sight** 1 (manipulate)

**Effect** Increase the range increment of the weapon the scope is attached to by 20 feet. If the weapon has a base range increment of 50 feet or more, increase the range of the weapon by 40 feet instead. This lasts until the beginning of your next turn or until you're no longer wielding the weapon this scope is attached to, whichever comes first. This does not increase the size of area attacks.

entities.name: Sniper's Scope (Commercial)
entities.description:
A telescopic sighting attachment helps view distant targets.

**Activate—Adjust Sight** 1 (manipulate)

**Effect** Increase the range increment of the weapon the scope is attached to by 10 feet. If the weapon has a base range increment of 50 feet or more, increase the range of the weapon by 20 feet instead. This lasts until the beginning of your next turn or until you're no longer wielding the weapon this scope is attached to, whichever comes first. This does not increase the size of area attacks.

entities.name: Sniper's Scope (Superior)
entities.description:
A telescopic sighting attachment helps view distant targets.

The scope grants you a +3 item bonus to visual Perception checks to Seek creatures through the scope.

**Activate—Adjust Sight** 1 (manipulate)

**Effect** Increase the range increment of the weapon the scope is attached to by 40 feet. If the weapon has a base range increment of 50 feet or more, increase the range of the weapon by 80 feet instead. This lasts until the beginning of your next turn or until you're no longer wielding the weapon this scope is attached to, whichever comes first. This does not increase the size of area attacks.

entities.name: Sniper's Scope (Tactical)
entities.description:
A telescopic sighting attachment helps view distant targets.

The scope grants you a +1 item bonus to visual Perception checks to Seek creatures through the scope.

**Activate—Adjust Sight** 1 (manipulate)

**Effect** Increase the range increment of the weapon the scope is attached to by 10 feet. If the weapon has a base range increment of 50 feet or more, increase the range of the weapon by 20 feet instead. This lasts until the beginning of your next turn or until you're no longer wielding the weapon this scope is attached to, whichever comes first. This does not increase the size of area attacks.

entities.name: Suppression Matrix (Commercial)
entities.description: This unit creates holographic figments emulating further attacks. When you critically hit with this weapon, the target becomes Suppressed until the beginning of your next turn.

entities.name: Suppression Matrix (Tactical)
entities.description: This unit creates holographic figments emulating further attacks. When you critically hit with this weapon, the target becomes Suppressed until the beginning of your next turn. The target can’t take reactions while suppressed in this way.

entities.name: Suspended Fire Modulator
entities.description: This smartfire modulator causes a barrage of projectiles to travel at hyper-reduced speeds, dramatically delaying their impact. This weapon gains the delayed trait. You can use a single Interact action to ignore or resume using the delayed trait, switching the weapon's functionality. You can use this upgrade to ignore the delayed trait on weapons that normally have it.

entities.name: Tactical Bioscanner
entities.description:
This upgrade gathers the target's biological data and displays it on an autorecognition lens or other heads-up display on the wielder's armor or weapon.

**Activate—Scan Complete** f

**Trigger** You hit or critically hit on a Strike with the weapon

**Effect** You Recall Knowledge about the Strike's target, with a +1 circumstance bonus to your skill check to do so. If you critically hit on the triggering Strike, you get a +2 circumstance bonus instead. The target is then temporarily immune to Scan Complete for 1 day.

entities.name: Tracer Matrix Projector (Advanced)
entities.description:
This scope-like projector apparatus mounts on top of a weapon. When activated, the projector sends out a pulse of full-spectrum energy, outlining even targets that are invisible to the naked eye when viewed through the device.

**Activate—Trace Targets** 1 Until the start of your next turn, treat invisible creatures in a 60-foot cone as Concealed instead, and other concealed creatures in the cone aren't concealed to you.

entities.name: Tracer Matrix Projector (Commercial)
entities.description:
This scope-like projector apparatus mounts on top of a weapon. When activated, the projector sends out a pulse of full-spectrum energy, outlining even targets that are invisible to the naked eye when viewed through the device.

**Activate—Trace Targets** 1 Until the start of your next turn, treat invisible creatures in a 15-foot cone as Concealed instead, and other concealed creatures in the cone aren't concealed to you.

entities.name: Tracer Matrix Projector (Tactical)
entities.description:
This scope-like projector apparatus mounts on top of a weapon. When activated, the projector sends out a pulse of full-spectrum energy, outlining even targets that are invisible to the naked eye when viewed through the device.

**Activate—Trace Targets** 1 Until the start of your next turn, treat invisible creatures in a 30-foot cone as Concealed instead, and other concealed creatures in the cone aren't concealed to you.

entities.name: Truesight Sight (Commercial)
entities.description:
Lenses are made of crystals specially infused with spells as they're cut, then installed into autofocusing sights. You gain a +1 item bonus to visual Perception checks to Seek when looking through the scope.

**Activate—See the Truth** 2 (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** For the next 10 minutes, while looking through the scope, you can see Invisible creatures as though they weren't invisible. Additionally, you can see incorporeal creatures, like ghosts, hiding within 10 feet of an object's surface.

entities.name: Truesight Sight (Tactical)
entities.description:
Lenses are made of crystals specially infused with spells as they're cut, then installed into autofocusing sights. You gain a +2 item bonus to visual Perception checks to Seek when looking through the scope.

**Activate—See the Truth** 2 (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** For the next 10 minutes, while looking through the scope, you can see Invisible creatures as though they weren't invisible. Additionally, you can see incorporeal creatures, like ghosts, hiding within 10 feet of an object's surface.

When you activate See the Truth, you see the truth of the world. The GM rolls a secret counteract check with a +20 counteract modifier and a counteract rank of 7 against any illusion, morph, or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it, not to end the spell or effect.

entities.name: Undermounted Grenade Launcher (Advanced)
entities.description:
This bracket-mounted grenade launcher is most often advertised for use with fragmentation grenades, but can efficiently deploy utility ordinances, such as smoke grenades and flashbangs. Unlike a dedicated grenade launcher, it takes 10 minutes to load an undermounted grenade launcher, reassembling the grenade into ammunition by mounting it on a specialized reusable firing cap. Once a grenade has been loaded, it can only be safely removed by disassembling the entire grenade, destroying it in the process.

This grenade launcher has a range of 40 feet and the tracking +2 trait.

**Activate—Launch** 1 (attack)

**Effect** You launch the loaded grenade.

entities.name: Undermounted Grenade Launcher (Commercial)
entities.description:
This bracket-mounted grenade launcher is most often advertised for use with fragmentation grenades, but can efficiently deploy utility ordinances, such as smoke grenades and flashbangs. Unlike a dedicated grenade launcher, it takes 10 minutes to load an undermounted grenade launcher, reassembling the grenade into ammunition by mounting it on a specialized reusable firing cap. Once a grenade has been loaded, it can only be safely removed by disassembling the entire grenade, destroying it in the process.

This grenade launcher has a range of 20 feet.

**Activate—Launch** 1 (attack)

**Effect** You launch the loaded grenade.

entities.name: Undermounted Grenade Launcher (Superior)
entities.description:
This bracket-mounted grenade launcher is most often advertised for use with fragmentation grenades, but can efficiently deploy utility ordinances, such as smoke grenades and flashbangs. Unlike a dedicated grenade launcher, it takes 10 minutes to load an undermounted grenade launcher, reassembling the grenade into ammunition by mounting it on a specialized reusable firing cap. Once a grenade has been loaded, it can only be safely removed by disassembling the entire grenade, destroying it in the process.

This grenade launcher has a range of 50 feet and the tracking +3 trait.

**Activate—Launch** 1 (attack)

**Effect** You launch the loaded grenade.

entities.name: Undermounted Grenade Launcher (Tactical)
entities.description:
This bracket-mounted grenade launcher is most often advertised for use with fragmentation grenades, but can efficiently deploy utility ordinances, such as smoke grenades and flashbangs. Unlike a dedicated grenade launcher, it takes 10 minutes to load an undermounted grenade launcher, reassembling the grenade into ammunition by mounting it on a specialized reusable firing cap. Once a grenade has been loaded, it can only be safely removed by disassembling the entire grenade, destroying it in the process.

This grenade launcher has a range of 30 feet and the tracking +1 trait.

**Activate—Launch** 1 (attack)

**Effect** You launch the loaded grenade.

entities.name: Uniclamp
entities.description: This is the ultimate all-purpose accessory item for holding everything from a fire extinguisher or flashlight to a musical instrument or comm unit. You can securely attach a single piece of tech gear of up to 1 Bulk to a uniclamp when you install the upgrade. You can activate the attached item using the same number of hands you use to wield your weapon while still wielding your weapon. The uniclamp can be properly configured to handle only non-magical tech gear and doesn't function with weapons or shields. The GM might determine that some items don't fit on certain weapons.

entities.name: Acid Dart Rifle
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This rifle uses compressed air to shoot tiny, chambered darts loaded with components for a highly corrosive compound that remains separated until launched, allowing for nearly unlimited shelf life with minimal risk of accidental exposure.

entities.name: Adhesive Dispenser
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 0

You shoot adhesives that solidify midair into nonlethal globs. When you use Area Fire with this weapon, instead of dealing damage, you create difficult terrain in the affected area that lasts for 2 rounds. If you're trained with this weapon, creatures that end their turns in the difficult terrain become Immobilized. Creatures can attempt to Escape against your class DC to remove the immobilized condition. If you have the primary target class feature, you can attempt to trip your primary target instead of Strike (with a –2 circumstance penalty, as normal for the ranged trip trait).

entities.name: Aeon Rifle
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 0

A mainstay of the Azlanti Star Empire, this sleek laser rifle includes a slot for *aeon stones* to enhance and focus the intensity of its beams.

entities.name: Aeon Storm
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This submachine gun is a favored weapon of the Azlanti Star Empire's elite strike forces.

entities.name: Anti-Life Crossbow
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This crossbow's bolts can be charged with void energy that disincorporate the cells of living creatures on impact.

entities.name: Arc Emitter
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Composed of two 4-foot-long protracting rails, this weapon shoots arcs of electricity at targets, emitted safely away from its wielder.

entities.name: Arc Pistol
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Instead of traditional ammunition, this bulky pistol contains a capacitor that generates arcs of electricity. Its stock is crafted from polycarbon or other synthetic insulators, often tinted bright yellow and inscribed with the universal bolt symbol for high voltage.

entities.name: Arc Rifle
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This rifle's oversized body contains a larger version of an arc pistol capacitor, with a short barrel and polycarbon stock designed to insulate the wielder from high voltage. The arc rifle's larger capacitor allows it to produce a charge with enough power to subdue a rampaging renkroda.

entities.name: Artillery Laser
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

The fast-firing and continuous beams of this laser cannon converge on the target to create enough heat to melt a steel door into slag.

entities.name: Assassin Rifle
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This sniper rifle breaks down into small parts, allowing its wielder to smuggle the weapon without attracting attention. Most assassin rifles are equipped with powerful scopes and digital sights.

Stats.Traits: analog, backstabber, breakdown, deadly-d10, kickback, unwieldy, volley-30

entities.name: Assassin's Garrote
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This thin conductive wire can be spooled out of a bracelet to assassinate via asphyxiation. If you're Grabbing a creature with an assassin's garrote you're trained with, it begins suffocating as long as it remains Grabbed, and it loses 1 round worth of air each time you damage the creature with the assassin's garrote (in addition to the air it also loses if you score a critical hit).

entities.name: Atomic Spear
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

These spears can switch between a simple sharp point to an entropically charged degradation blade.

entities.name: Aucturnite Chakram
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This bladed hoop is carved from a chunk of aucturnite and sculpted to resemble a planet's ring. The material has mysteriously appeared light-years from Aucturn's original orbit.

entities.name: Autotarget Rifle
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This short, bulky assault rifle incorporates a piston system that allows the user to switch to auto-fire and unload a magazine with one trigger squeeze.

entities.name: Ball Lightning Cannon
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This triple-coiled, artillery, ionized, atmospheric amplifier, or ball lightning cannon, creates slow moving orbs of electricity that detonate in arcs of lightning when they finally hit their targets. If you're trained with this weapon, the Area Fire arcs from each creature in the burst that fails (or critically fails) its Reflex save to the closest creature within 10 feet that doesn't take any damage from the Area Fire, dealing electricity damage to that creature equal to 1 per weapon damage die.

entities.name: Baton
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This reinforced rod is commonly made from metal alloys and designed to strike and parry incoming blows.

entities.name: Battle Ribbon
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This sheer nanocarbon ribbon is sharp enough to cut through flesh without interrupting the traditional battle dances that make the weapon famous.

entities.name: Battleglove
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

These durable gloves fit over a wielder's hands (or other appendages) and feature weighted plates or spikes over the knuckles.

entities.name: Binary Blaster
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This shotgun rotates between two barrels: a flat vent for lasers or a vertical muzzle for ballistic shells. The laser uses a battery with a capacity of 40 and an expend of 4.

entities.name: Biotic Equalizer
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This heavyweight biotech cannon has a chitinous exterior adorned with pumps, combining acids and peroxides to lob chemical payloads. If you're trained with this weapon, the expend is 1 when you make a ranged Strike against a single creature, such as when attacking your primary target, if you have that soldier class feature.

entities.name: Blast Knife
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This adamantine knife has a sheet of combustible material folded into its base that can be detonated remotely using a remote in its sheath. When you successfully Strike a creature with a *blast knife*, you can spend your reaction to release the knife and embed it into your target. A creature must spend an Interact action to remove an embedded *blast knife*.

**Activate—Remote Detonation** 1 (fire, manipulate)

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Effect** Your blast knife explodes, dealing 1d6 fire |options:area-damage damage to all creatures in a 10-foot emanation or 2d6 fire |options:area-damage damage per weapon damage die if the knife was embedded in a target, with a basic Reflex save equal to your class DC. The knife maneuvers back into its sheath, safely avoiding creatures and obstacles to reach its destination.

entities.name: Bone Scepter
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This engraved club of solid bone is tempered using material from the void that can drain life energy.

entities.name: Boom Pistol
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

A boom pistol resembles a megaphone with a trigger, emitting sudden bursts of sound capable of shattering bulletproof glass or rupturing organs.

entities.name: Boom Shot
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 0

This shotgun uses compressed air to create a loud boom. A boom shot doesn't use a battery but instead uses centrifugal force and regains 1 charge when you Interact to boost the weapon (maximum of 3 charges).

entities.name: Breaching Gun
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This snub-nosed scattergun is commonly used to blast through doors and walls. Smaller than a reaction breacher, this scattergun is infamous for its mighty recoil.

entities.name: Card Slinger
entities.description:
**Upgrade:** 1

This ceramic weapon sharpens and fires playing cards, such as those from an infinity deck. Their folding design and innocuous ammunition make it ideal for infiltrating secure locations, especially casinos. While the weapon often relies on lucky hits, in the hands of a gambler familiar with card trajectory, it can become deadly.

entities.name: Chordpocalypse
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This showstopping techno-electric guitar emits a wave of sonic energy when played and is usually boosted by strumming a power chord. If you're trained with this weapon, you can expend 11 charges to increase its range when you Area Fire to 20 feet. If you aren't trained with this weapon, decrease its range when you Area Fire to 10 feet.

entities.name: Coil Rifle
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

The barrel of this rifle is surrounded by a coil that accelerates ammunition with power and accuracy using carefully aligned magnetic fields.

entities.name: Crimson Claw
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This clawed glove's tips end in sharp steel points that glow bright red with superheated veins of trace starmetal alloys.

entities.name: Crossbolter
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This high-tech crossbow uses a series of pistons to propel bolts along its barrel. These quiet-firing semiautomatic weapons are popular in high-density settlements where gunfire might cause a panic.

entities.name: Cryo-Carbine
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

These low-density carbon fiber rifles use a more compact model to allow for longer range cryo damage than their pistol counterparts.

entities.name: Cryopike
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This polearm's shaft houses rapidly circulating supercooled gas that condenses and channels endothermic energy into a cryogenic blade.

entities.name: Degeneration Derringer
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This close-range pistol fires small cannisters that burst into a corrosive gas, often used to destroy dangerous objects.

entities.name: Dirge Pistol
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This small pistol is often used to disorient the enemy with bursts of sound described by many as a cacophony of screams.

entities.name: Disintegration Lash
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Appearing as an undulating black snake when powered, this whip crackles with red-tinged energy that sunders whatever it strikes at the atomic level.

Stats.Traits: disarm, finesse, powered, razing, reach, tech

entities.name: Disintegration Rifle
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Despite using shells, shots fired from disintegration rifles contain ionized condensed chemical gas rather than physical projectiles, and as such, specific ammunition, including magic ammunition and ammunition made using special materials, don't affect Strikes with a disintegration rifle. Living creatures brought to 0 Hit Points by a disintegration rifle leave behind no corpse, but their gear is unaffected.

Stats.Traits: critical-corrosive, fatal-d12, razing, tech, unwieldy, volley-30

entities.name: Doshko
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

The traditional weapon of the Veskarium, this powered poleaxe features one to three triangular blades forged for both wide overhead swings and tactical parrying.

entities.name: Dueling Sword
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Coming in a variety of styles, these traditional and time-tested weapons have been honed with advanced smithing techniques and modern materials.

entities.name: Electroflail
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

A favored weapon of Hellknights of the Order of the Eclipse, the spiked head of this menacing flail is attached to a 2-foot-long chain that ominously suspends itself for a few seconds after each deadly blow, crackling with electricity capable of frying foes and circuits alike. If you're trained with an electroflail, on a critical hit with a Strike or trip attempt, you confer the glitching condition with a value equal to twice your weapon dice to one tech item wielded by your target (or the target themself, if they have the tech trait).

Stats.Traits: arc, critical-shock, powered, sweep, tech, trip

entities.name: Fangblade
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Durable teeth line the edges of this motorized sword and spin with the force of an industrial chainsaw.

entities.name: Flamethrower
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This bulky, rifle-shaped weapon spews flames using a tank of highly combustible, pressurized chemicals housed in its stock.

entities.name: Force Needle
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

When a full vial of liquid is inserted into the bottom of this weapon's hilt, it creates an energy needle to hold and inject its payload.

Stats.Traits: agile, backstabber, concealable, finesse, injection, ratfolk, tech

entities.name: Fractal Hook
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 2

These weapons are curved with repeating fractals that grow smaller along its edge, capable of sawing through nearly anything. If you're trained with this weapon and Strike a creature taking persistent damage, the creature doesn't recover from persistent damage unless it rolls a 20 on the flat check (or 15, if it's receiving a particularly appropriate type of help). This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

entities.name: Frostmaw
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

The study of Triaxan space worms in cryo-anesthesia research led to first frostmaw, an armored, toothy tube that can be wielded as a weapon. A frostmaw can't be reloaded, but the liquid inside regenerates at a rate of 1 projectile every round. These weapons are living creatures that can be directed by telepathic wielders. Unlike most area weapons, a frostmaw can be used to make ranged Strikes, expending a single projectile with a range increment of 15 feet.

entities.name: Frytech Rifle
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This rifle is capable of disrupting technology. It deploys a telescoping ring containing spools of wire that glow blue with electromagnetic energy. When you Area Fire with a frytech rifle you're trained with, you can expend 10 charges instead of 5 to confer the glitching condition to all creatures and wielded tech items in the area instead of dealing any damage. Creatures that fail their saving throw against the Area Fire become glitching with a value equal to the number of weapon dice (twice the number of weapon dice on a critical failure).

entities.name: Grapnel Pick
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This multipurpose hiking and climbing tool doubles as a modular weapon. It has a retractable carbon fiber cable that can support up to 14 Bulk. If you're trained with this weapon, and it has the grapple trait, you can use it to grapple a Medium or smaller creature up to 20 feet away. You can continue to Grapple to keep your hold on the target so long as the target remains within 20 feet, and you continue to hold the grapnel pick. The Grabbed creature gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Escape, and Grapple checks attempted with grapnel picks take a –2 penalty unless you're adjacent to the target.

entities.name: Grindblade
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

The edge of this broad-tipped sword is composed of micro-splitting nanoparticles that slice apart targets with surgical precision.

entities.name: Gyrojet Pistol
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Valued for its stopping power, this pistol sports a large caliber reinforced barrel designed to shoot tiny rockets capable of knocking enemies to the ground.

entities.name: Hammer
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Valued as both a crafting tool and an effective weapon, this hammer uses specially weighted heads and handles to deliver maximum force with each strike.

entities.name: Injection Rifle
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This rifle is favored by big-game hunters stalking stubborn prey, allowing them to use tranquilizers or even deadlier injections to subdue an enemy from a safe distance.

Stats.Traits: analog, critical-dart, deadly-d10, kickback, ranged-injection, unwieldy, volley-30

entities.name: Injection Shotgun
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

These weapons are used to fire poison darts into multiple enemies at once. If you're trained with this weapon and have the primary target class feature, it gains the ranged injection trait, but it only injects a substance into your primary target.

entities.name: Ionized Slag Lobber
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This weapon lobs a bead of ionized slag, baking creatures on impact. If you're trained with this weapon, you leave the affected squares as hazardous terrain until the end of your next turn. A creature takes 1 fire damage per weapon die each time it moves into one of these squares. The ionized slag lobber must be loaded with at least light Bulk of worthless junk each time you reload it, but the ionizing process ignores whether or not the junk is made out of any precious materials.

entities.name: Knife
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Invaluable as both a weapon and a tool, knives come in a variety of shapes, styles, and materials ranging from starmetals to ceramics.

entities.name: Knuckle Sheller
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 0

The knuckle sheller resembles battlegloves with two large barrels that extend at the wrist. This weapon is often used by formidably trained mercenaries to surprise enemies in close-quarters combat. You can't use this weapon to make ranged attacks if you're wielding a ranged weapon in the same hand. If you fire this weapon and aren't trained with it, you take 1 bludgeoning damage and can't use that hand again until you're restored to full Hit Points.

entities.name: Laser Pistol
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This compact pistol is the most popular sidearm in the Pact Worlds thanks to its reliability, durability, and affordability. Most common laser pistols have a lightweight polycarbon body ending in a long, slim barrel.

entities.name: Laser Rifle
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

These dependable, mass-produced rifles shoot concentrated beams of energy out of square-shaped barrels. The universal standard Pact Worlds model is highly modifiable and designed to function with a variety of accessories and upgrades, with wielders adapting the laser rifle to their preferences and even kit-bashing it into a nearly unrecognizable weapon.

entities.name: Laserdisc
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This disc has been retrofitted to generate a circular blade of razor-sharp hardlight when thrown. Xenoarchaelogists have found some evidence that some antique laserdiscs might have been used as a rudimentary form of data storage, but finding a device capable of reading that data would be a challenge.

entities.name: Liquidator
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Compact and power hungry, the spinning barrels of this merciless weapon spray the battlefield with a corrosive storm of liquifying energy. Known to be a weapon capable of great collateral damage, it's discerningly popular among unscrupulous mercenaries and Devourer cultists.

entities.name: Machine Gun
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

These proven and reliable automatic weapons are capable of firing in short bursts or completely emptying their magazines to clear a battlefield.

entities.name: Maglock Spine
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This rod uses fin-shaped plates to become a greatpick, taking one action to reassemble itself with the breakdown trait.

**Activate—Graviton Drag** 1 (attack, electricity)

**Requirements** You are trained with the maglock spine

**Cost** 5+ charges (maximum 5 for every weapon die)

**Effect** Attempt a melee Strike against the Reflex DC of a creature within 5 feet for every 5 charges spent to Activate this ability. On a success, the creature is pulled 5 feet closer to you for every 5 charges spent to Activate this ability. On a critical success, it's also Suppressed for 1 round. This attack deals no damage.

entities.name: Magnet-Directed Battleglove
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

There's a round electromagnet on the back of this battleglove. You can Install a one-handed melee weapon with light Bulk into the battleglove as if the installed weapon was an upgrade.

**Activate—Launch Weapon** 1 (attack)

**Requirements** You have a weapon with which you're trained Installed in the battleglove

**Cost** 5 charges

**Effect** Attempt a ranged Strike against a target as if the weapon had the thrown (20 feet) weapon trait. The weapon is no longer Installed. The weapon flies back to the hand with the battleglove after the Strike is complete. If that hand is full when the weapon returns, it falls to the ground in your space.

entities.name: Magnetar Rifle
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This rifle uses powerful electromagnets to accelerate simple slugs into deadly, highly accurate projectiles without the use of any moving parts.

entities.name: Mass-Distributed Hammer
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This hammer's self-distributed mass improves its user's swings.

entities.name: Molten Edge
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 0

This utility axe glows bright white when drawn and exposed to air, melting away into superheated slag after a single Strike.

entities.name: Monowhip
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This whip's hilt unspools a long monofilament wire that can slice grievous wounds into its targets with shocking ease.

entities.name: Nano-edge Rapier
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

The edge of this precision-crafted foil is sharpened to the thickness of a single atom, using regenerating nanites to maintain itself after countless strikes.

entities.name: Neural Lash
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This whiplike tendril of electricity subtly responds to psychic signals. Telepaths who wield a properly calibrated neural lash treat it as an extension of their body.

entities.name: Painglaive
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This fierce but deceptively elegant polearm rips apart enemies with a motor-powered fangblade. An adjustable pulse trigger allows the wielder to channel extra pain through the weapon.

entities.name: Phase Cutlass
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

A phase cutlass resembles a traditional curved sword until it's powered. Then its blade morphs into a shimmering void, with a tiny star for each life it ended.

entities.name: Phoboverge
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 2

A micro-singularity at the center of this sinister submachine gun siphons negative emotions it projects onto others. A rumor suggests that phoboverges harvest and curate particularly exquisite suffering for some unknown extraplanar entity.

entities.name: Plasma Cannon
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This long-barreled weapon shoots charges of ionized gas that explode in a blast of superheated plasma.

entities.name: Plasma Caster
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This compact pistol shoots balls of condensed plasma. Holding down the trigger and safety clip at the same time before firing results in the barrel building up more plasma.

entities.name: Plasma Doshko
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Unlike a traditional doshko, this poleaxe uses blades of magnetically stabilized plasma that spin to cleave through multiple enemies with ease.

entities.name: Plasma Pike
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1
