Derived from spectra technology, this high-tech spear can release a gout of plasma to reach any foe.

**Activate—Fulminating Pike** 1 to 2 (manipulate)

**Requirements** You're trained with this weapon

**Cost** 10 battery charges

**Effect** Your plasma spike briefly lengthens, expands, and pulses, gaining the arc trait and increasing its reach to 15 feet for the duration of this effect. Strike for each action spent to use this ability, but each Strike must have a different target.

entities.name: Plasma Sword
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This sword generates a focused beam of plasma around a localized force field powered by a generator in the sword's hilt. The beam only blazes to life when the sword is powered.

entities.name: Pneumatic Basher
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Automated pistons and side exhausts discharge compressed air when this pneumatic cylinder collides with flesh or surface.

**Activate—Pneumatic Shove** f

**Trigger** You successfully Strike a creature with this weapon

**Cost** 10 battery charges

**Effect** The pneumatic basher discharges compressed air, allowing you to Shove the target using the same multiple attack penalty as the triggering Strike, if any.

entities.name: Polyglove
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This glove features dozens of delicate tools for building or repairing computers and other technological items, requiring an entire hand (or suitable appendage) to manipulate. Overclocking the polyglove's components generates voltage between a wielder's fingertips.

entities.name: Psyche Pistol
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This pistol uses quickly dissolving neurotoxic compounds that wrack a target's nervous system to incapacitate them.

entities.name: Pulse Gauntlet
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Popularized in underground fighting circles, this heavy-duty nanocarbon glove amplifies and weaponizes sounds made by its wielder, generating a sonic boom strong enough to knock an enemy off their feet.

Stats.Traits: agile, critical-brawling, free-hand, powered, shove, tech, trip

entities.name: Pulsecaster Pistol
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This imposing pistol fires a jolt of paralyzing electricity from its barrel. Its remaining charges are visible as glowing lines of energy radiating down its body. Pulsecaster pistols are often used by bounty hunters and law enforcement who need to keep their targets alive.

entities.name: Puzzleblade
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This kasathan sword breaks down into interlocking pieces for storage and transport. Traditionalists practice the art of ritually assembling puzzleblades, with different pieces symbolizing the kasathan virtues of conviction, dedication, moderation, and tradition. Criminals and smugglers value the puzzleblade for its discreet design.

entities.name: Reaction Breacher
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This portable reaction cannon launches flak from miniature cluster missiles that rip through a fortified structure and anyone unfortunate enough to be inside.

entities.name: Reverb Knife
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This knife vibrates at incredible speeds, allowing it greater penetrating power and the ability to disrupt victim's hearing.

entities.name: Rotating Pistol
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

A time-tested design favored by traditional gunslingers, the multiple barrels on this pistol mechanically rotate while firing, making it less likely to malfunction.

entities.name: Rotolaser
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

A rotolaser fires multiple beams of plasma at once. This massive assault rifle has a set of rotating barrels that prevent overheating when spewing auto-fire.

entities.name: Runic Pick
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This pick shimmers with delicate runes on its surface when its wielder casts spells.

entities.name: Scattergun
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

A scattergun is a long-barreled firearm that fires numerous spherical projectiles to hit multiple targets.

entities.name: Screamer
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Resembling a large directional speaker held in two hands, a screamer produces a deafening boom. At lower volumes, a screamer functions as a portable loudspeaker.

entities.name: Seeker Rifle
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This single-shot sniper rifle is one of the most popular weapons in the Vast thanks to its stability and reliability with minimal upkeep.

entities.name: Semi-Auto Pistol
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This pistol automatically ejects used cartridges and loads new ammunition after every shot fired.

entities.name: Shirren-eye Rifle
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This sniper rifle comes with a compound technological scope that allows snipers to adjust focus and magnification with natural eye movements instead of using moving parts that might disrupt their aim.

entities.name: Shock Pad
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This flexible nanocarbon circuit can be installed as an upgrade into gloves, kneepads, or similar appendage protectors to emit a powerful electric shock when forcefully applied to a target.

entities.name: Shock Truncheon
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Popular among security forces, this retractable baton discharges electricity with each Strike. A whirring device inside the grip generates voltage, creating a sound like a swarm of buzzing insects when it's fully charged.

entities.name: Shooting Starknife
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This traditional star-shaped blade design of lost Golarion is often forged from reinforced carbon steel and treated with chemicals that create an iridescent sheen. When properly balanced and honed, a shooting starknife sings as it slices through the air.

Stats.Traits: agile, analog, deadly-d6, finesse, thrown-20, versatile-s

entities.name: Shuriken Drone
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This star-shaped weapon surrounds a tiny single rotor drone designed to return to its thrower if it doesn't hit its target.

entities.name: Singing Coil
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Resembling a resonant transformer circuit, this weaponized stringed instrument produces sound by using high-frequency alternating currents to cause air molecules to vibrate.

entities.name: Singing Spear
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Classically shaped like an oversized musical note, this spear intones melodious pitches when it strikes, creating a new song with each battle.

entities.name: Skitterstaff
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

These long crooks have a triangular, hooked end and are balanced to reposition creatures out of harm's way.

**Activate—Helping Repositioning** 1

**Effect** You reposition one willing ally within reach. If you use a third hand to manipulate the skitterstaff when you use this action, you can Reposition one willing ally within 15 feet by hooking your weapon around their weapon. The target can't move you on a critical failure. This action doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Reposition attempt.

entities.name: Skyfire Sword
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Famously wielded by warriors of the Skyfire Legion, this flaming blade is powered by burning gas held in place by magnetic fields.

entities.name: Sonic Rifle
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

A sonic rifle creates a narrow beam of ultrasound that effectively turns whatever it hits into a speaker, breaking its targets apart with hypersonic vibrations.

entities.name: Spellcarver
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This polearm typically ends with a long, curved crystal blade that takes on the magical properties of a spell gem or aeon stone.

**Activate—Safeguard Spell** 1 (force, spellshape)

**Cost** 10 battery charges

**Effect** Make a Strike. If your Strike is successful, and your next action is to Cast a Spell, then your polearm's force field protects you, and Casting the Spell doesn't trigger reactions from the target of your Strike.

entities.name: Starfall Pistol
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

While originally a kit-bashed plasma caster, the commercial models fire streams of superheated plasma. Akitonian revelers enjoy discharging these pistols into the air during outdoor celebrations.

entities.name: Stellar Cannon
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

The rounds of this portable cannon are loaded with carefully positioned mini-missiles packed with flechettes that shred anyone too close to the blast.

entities.name: Streetsweeper
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This enormous portable cannon uses speakers to broadcast dense ultrasonic waves powerful enough to sweep a street clean of anything in its path.

entities.name: Subliminator
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This sublimation-based long-range weapon uses gas to create large spikes of ice mid-flight. If you're trained with the weapon, it deals modular damage and gains the modular (C, area [burst 10 feet], delayed, and unwieldy or P) trait and expends 8 charges to Area Fire.

entities.name: Supercharged Dynafan
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

These warfans are sold and wielded in pairs (the price given is for one), although one can still be wielded even if the other is not being held. The twin weapons share upgrade slots, so upgrading one fan automatically upgrades the other for no additional cost. If you're trained with this weapon, it gains one charge each time you Strike (maximum 3) that lasts for 1 minute. A supercharged dynafan with 3 charges can be used to Area Fire as a ranged weapon with the area (cone) trait and a range of 20 feet.

Stats.Traits: agile, concealable, finesse, modular, powered, tech, twin

entities.name: Syringe Skewer
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

A syringe-tipped spear commonly used when farming or hunting to facilitate the injection of anesthetic toxins.

entities.name: Tailblade
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Adjustable bands secure this lightweight blade to a tail, tentacle, or similar appendage.

entities.name: Talon
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This stylized knife tapers into a curved and serrated blade. When powered, it spews a highly corrosive acid inspired by the armor-melting talons evolved by several species of the Swarm.

entities.name: Thermal Dynafan
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This warfan is a modified handheld environmental comfort device that changes the pressure in the air to create a frigid chill or a brilliant plume of fire.

Stats.Traits: agile, concealable, finesse, modular, powered, tech, twin

entities.name: Unseen Saw
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 2

This wrist guard has a spinning blade that can be concealed under a hidden zipper. If you're trained in this weapon and Prone, you can use the Booster Rip skill feat as though this weapon was already charged with the boost trait.

Stats.Traits: agile, concealable, finesse, free-hand, powered, tech

entities.name: Void Cutlass
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

While some void cutlasses are crafted out of void energy condensed to a slow vibration, rumors suggest some evolve after absorbing 999 souls and no longer need a physical blade, or battery, to contain the void energy. This weapon deals vitality damage instead of void damage to creatures that are immune to void damage.

entities.name: Voltaic Rifle
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Early iterations of this supercharged weapon were too dangerous to wield until insulated plating was added. Soldiers on the field found that the shape of the rifle and added bulk make it effective for parrying melee attacks.

entities.name: Waspslicer
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Favored by Vindicators of Calistra, this pistol's glass darts leave behind glass shards usually coated with poisons.

entities.name: Zero Cannon
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

This triple-barreled cannon's generator churns rapidly, circulating coolant into a blast of endothermic energy. While powered, frost rimes the barrel and stock of this weapon, causing experienced wielders to wear thermal gloves.

entities.name: Zero Knife
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Unfolding like a switchblade, a supercooled chamber within this weapon instantly forms a blade of ice.

entities.name: Zero Pistol
entities.description:
**Upgrades:** 1

Zero pistols use transparent canisters of supercooled liquid as ammunition.

entities.name: Android
entities.description:
*Androids first emerged as synthetic beings crafted by many technologically advanced civilizations throughout the galaxy. The first androids were created by humanoid peoples in their own images, but after the technology that animated the living constructs spread, androids began displaying a fantastic diversity of forms. Androids in the Pact Worlds were originally designed as servants, but today androids and other robotic beings stand as equals to organic ancestries under the Pact. Some androids have formed their own independent communities, while most integrate seamlessly into Pact Worlds societies. Unlike many other technological constructs, androids are more than intricate synthetic organs and complex programming, and each possesses their own soul.*

Android

Stats.Boosts: DEX; INT; STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, CHA

entities.name: Barathu
entities.description:
*Barathus are floating beings with bizarre body shapes who evolved on the gas giant Bretheda. Barathus rewrite their own genetic code instinctively and at will, shaping their bodies into a stunning array of unique forms.*

Barathu

Stats.Boosts: CON; WIS; STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, CHA

entities.name: Human
entities.description:
*Humans are known for their ability to adapt and thrive in the most challenging situations, including the mysterious loss of their home world, Golarion. Ambitious, creative, and endlessly curious, humans maintain a robust presence in the galaxy, often taking on positions of leadership or acting at the forefront of exploration. Humans can be found almost anywhere, doing almost anything.*

Human

Stats.Boosts: CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS;

entities.name: Kasatha
entities.description:
*Steeped in the ancient traditions of a distant home world orbiting a dying star, kasathas are four-armed humanoids who arrived in the Pact Worlds aboard a massive worldship named Idari. Striving for cosmic balance in all things, kasathas take pride in tempering their technological advances with the wisdom of their ancestors.*

Kasatha

Stats.Boosts: STR; WIS; STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, CHA

entities.name: Lashunta
entities.description:
*Long ago, lashuntas evolved psychic abilities and a unique dimorphism that helped them survive on their home world of Castrovel. In modern times, lashuntas manipulate their own genetics at puberty, allowing each individual to develop into an enhanced scholar or warrior, though not every lashunta commits to these traditional choices.*

Lashunta

Stats.Boosts: CHA; ; STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, CHA

entities.name: Living Hologram
entities.description: *Living holograms are true artificial intelligences, stored in a processing core, who interact with the physical world through a tangible hardlight body projected by their core.*

Stats.Boosts: DEX; CHA; STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, CHA

entities.name: Pahtra
entities.description:
*Pahtras are a humanoid feline species from a nearby star system. They're highly competitive and known for their achievements in magic, music, and war. Their home world was recently freed from the Veskarium's occupation, and they've joined the Pact Worlds.*

Pahtra

Stats.Boosts: CHA; DEX; STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, CHA

entities.name: Shirren
entities.description:
*The insectile shirrens split from the destructive Swarm, forsaking the ruthless hive mind to pursue personal freedom and end the cycle of interstellar violence. Shirrens are a species of telepaths devoted to their own individualism, building chosen communities, and living in harmony with other peoples.*

Shirren

Stats.Boosts: CON; WIS; STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, CHA

entities.name: Skittermander
entities.description:
*Skittermanders are energetic, six-armed humanoids with brightly colored fur. Skittermanders accomplish tasks with chaotic enthusiasm and typically enjoy teamwork, defying even their would-be conquerors through collaboration.*

Skittermander

Stats.Boosts: CHA; DEX; STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, CHA

entities.name: SRO
entities.description: *Neither born nor deliberately constructed, sentient robot organisms (SROs) are machines who possess self-awareness and a soul. Variable in frame, appearance, and origin, no two SROs are alike.*

Stats.Boosts: DEX, STR; INT; STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, CHA

entities.name: Verthani
entities.description: *Verthanis are a collaborative and resourceful people with long limbs and bulbous black eyes. They can manipulate the pigments in their skin at will with astonishing precision, creating a bevy of colors, designs, and patterns on their bodies. Native to the planet Verces, verthanis were among the first spacefarers in the Pact Worlds and now live throughout the galaxy.*

Stats.Boosts: CON; INT; STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, CHA

entities.name: Vesk
entities.description:
*Vesk are a warmongering, reptilian people who conquered the eight worlds in their solar system shortly after they developed spaceflight, forming the Veskarium empire. Vesk tend to embrace conflict and respect strength and military might.*

Vesk

Stats.Boosts: CON; STR; STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, CHA

entities.name: Ysoki
entities.description:
*Once known as ratfolk, ysoki are clever and flexible. With roots on countless worlds, ysoki work alongside larger species, helping to establish communities and accomplish tough tasks. From the largest of crowds to the tightest of tunnels, a ysoki always knows how to find their way.*

Ysoki

Stats.Boosts: DEX; INT; STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, CHA

entities.name: Artificial Scion Android
entities.description: Your body wasn't created in the image of a biological creature; a powerful artificial intelligence created you to interface with other machines. Your physiology is nearly identical to other androids, but uncanny details give away your non-standard origins (for example, you might have impossibly symmetrical features, extra fingers, or double pupils). You become trained in Computers, and you gain the Phreaker skill feat.

entities.name: Mod Fanatic Android
entities.description: You or your previous iterations have modified your body to be compatible with armor upgrades, enabling you to personally customize your body and its capabilities. Your body has one armor upgrade slot that you can use to install armor upgrades and that doesn't count toward your armor's total number of upgrades. You can install and uninstall armor upgrades into your personal upgrade slot using the Install Upgrade activity. Choose one common armor upgrade with an item level of 1 or less. You begin with this armor upgrade already installed in your upgrade slot (you don't need to pay the credits to purchase this starting upgrade).

entities.name: Networked Android
entities.description: Your body was modified to network seamlessly with other tech creatures. You gain shortwave, allowing you to communicate wirelessly with any creatures within 30 feet, as long as they have shortwave or are a construct with the tech trait. This doesn't give any special access to their thoughts or programming and communicates no more information than normal speech would. You can attempt Computers checks to Hack systems, Combat Hack, create a Digital Diversion, Disable a Device, or Pick a Lock without a hacker's toolkit or free hand at a range of 30 feet.

entities.name: Renewed Android
entities.description: Many souls have inhabited your synthetic body before you, and you might incorporate a number into your name to honor them. You might know your body's history and work toward a goal bequeathed to you by a departed soul, or you might seek to learn the mystery of a forgotten legacy. Muscle memory hints at your body's past, and people you've never met sometimes recognize your face. The first time in a day that you lose the dying condition, you don't gain the wounded condition. You become trained in a skill of your choice that has the Recall Knowledge action, and you gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat.

entities.name: Dreamer Barathu
entities.description:
You've communed with the cosmic melody of Liavara and it changed you. You struggle to express the fragments of memory and sensation you recall from the experience, except through singing and similar psychic emanations. Choose one cantrip from the occult spell list. By weaving magic into your song, you can cast this spell as an occult innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

Your magic is adaptable, and you can channel your music to enhance it. Once per day, you can meditate on your cosmic song to change the cantrip you've chosen to a different cantrip from the occult spell list. This is a 10-minute activity that has the concentrate trait.

entities.name: Early Stage Barathu
entities.description: You're young and inexperienced compared to other barathus, with an individualistic worldview likely shaped by your interactions with other cultures. You have yet to see the full breadth of the cosmos and haven't adapted yourself to overcome its many threats or understand its various life-forms. Your form is highly mutable, as you haven't yet chosen to specialize or merge with other barathus. You're Small instead of Medium. You gain Quick Squeeze as a bonus feat. Additionally, you gain resistance to precision damage equal to half your level (minimum 1).

entities.name: Manufacturer Barathu
entities.description: Your body is a living laboratory, allowing you to ingest raw materials and refine them into useful medicines and other products. You become trained in Crafting (or another skill of your choice if you're already trained in Crafting) and gain the Serum Crafting feat.

entities.name: Merged Barathu
entities.description: You're a unique entity formed from the constant union of two or more barathus who enjoy the act of combination so much that they chose not to return to isolation as their former selves. You're Large instead of Medium. You gain 10 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 8, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion effects.

entities.name: Golarion Survivor Human
entities.description: Your ancestors lived on Golarion, and though the precise circumstances of their survival are lost to the Gap, you strongly identify with the lost planet's cultures. You become trained in Golarion Lore, and you learn a bonus language that was spoken in your lineage's region of origin. You have familiarity with archaic weapons and, for purposes of proficiency, treat one archaic weapon of your choice that's a martial weapon as a simple weapon, or that's an advanced weapon as a martial weapon.

entities.name: Skilled Human
entities.description: Your ingenuity allows you to train in a wide variety of skills. You become trained in one skill of your choice. At 5th level, you become an expert in the chosen skill.

entities.name: Urbanite Human
entities.description: You have grown up in a big city and are accustomed to the press and pull of the largest crowds, the electric buzz and tangle of streets, or the dense nature of vertical living on a station or megaplex. You ignore difficult terrain from crowds and lesser cover from crowds. You become trained in a Lore skill for one specific city of your choice.

entities.name: Versatile Human
entities.description: Humans were the most common ancestry on Golarion before that world disappeared, and they've since spread to the stars thanks to their versatility. Select a general feat of your choice for which you meet the prerequisites (as with your ancestry feat, you can select this general feat at any point during character creation).

entities.name: Akitonian Kasatha
entities.description: You (or one of your ancestors) traveled to the Pact Worlds on the *Idari* and settled on Akiton. Akiton's significantly lower gravity grants you an advantage in the fun and practical art of leaping, and you likely revel in the many rituals surrounding the desert world's popular sports. You gain the Quick Jump feat and don't treat sand as uneven ground.

entities.name: Kasath Survivalist
entities.description: You and your ancestors were among those who chose not to abandon your dying home world. Your people trek through wasted lands under dim skies, seeking shelter and resources even as they slowly dwindle. You might have finally decided to seek a better life, or perhaps you hope to convince others to return to Kasath with you. You can Hustle twice as long while exploring before you have to stop. If you're in a group that's Hustling, you increase the total number of minutes the group can Hustle by 10 minutes, or by 20 minutes if you're 13th level or higher. You gain the Feather Step feat.

entities.name: Shipborn Kasatha
entities.description: You were one of the kasathas born and raised on the Idari worldship that now orbits the Pact Worlds' sun. Your family kept hope and tradition alive while enduring the hardships of lengthy space travel. For you, the Idari is the only home you've ever known. When you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.

entities.name: Stellar Nomad Kasatha
entities.description: You choose to travel abroad, leaving your birthplace to embark on a journey through the wider cosmos. During your daily preparations, you can study a particular ancestry, faction, philosophy, or religion to learn one of their edicts or anathemas and gain a broader understanding of that culture's customs and traditions. While you follow that edict or anathema, you become trained in the associated lore (such as Vesk Lore or Damoritosh Lore). This proficiency lasts until you prepare again. Since this training is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a permanent character option like a feat or a skill increase.

entities.name: Tempering
entities.description: You're undergoing your Tempering, a coming-of-age ritual during which a kasatha rejects the formal traditions of their family and experiences other customs and traditions. You might be one of the Untempered, a kasatha who chooses to continue their Tempering beyond the traditional period. You become trained in Society and gain the Streetwise feat.

entities.name: Damaya Lashunta
entities.description:
You've chosen the adaptive genetics to become a damaya. You might have a leaner, lither body type than other lashuntas and are likely encouraged to pursue work as a scholar or politician.

In addition to what you gain from your ancestry, you gain an attribute boost to Intelligence and an attribute flaw to Constitution, but the free ancestry boost can't also be Intelligence. You become trained in Diplomacy. If you would automatically become trained in Diplomacy (from your background or class, for example), you become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the Additional Lore general feat.

entities.name: Korasha Lashunta
entities.description: You've chosen the adaptive genetics to become a korasha. You might be stockier and more muscular than other lashuntas. In addition to what you gain from your ancestry, you gain an attribute boost to Strength and an attribute flaw to Wisdom, but the free ancestry boost can't also be Strength. You gain 8 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 6, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to Shove or Trip.

entities.name: Unbound Lashunta
entities.description: You decided against activating your ancestry's adaptive genetics. You might show a combination of damaya and korasha traits; you might be tall and muscular or short and lithe, or perhaps you have unusual features, such as bumps and swirls covering your body or long, fuzzy antennae. You gain the Unbound Mind reaction.

entities.name: Aeonheart Living Hologram
entities.description: To survive an endless journey through the void at the outset of Azlanti space exploration, you transferred your soul into an aeon stone, eschewing your physical form to become an unaging aeonheart. You tended to your sleeping crewmates and maintained your starship as it slowly traversed the space between stars. Unlike modern hardlight projectors, your aeonheart core emits a magical hardlight shell that perfectly reflects the form you had before becoming an aeonheart. Your appearance must be a Medium Azlanti human. You gain Azlanti as a bonus language, and you can select ancestry feats from the human ancestry, in addition to the living hologram ancestry, as long as the feat doesn't require any physiological feature that you lack. Whenever you invest an aeon stone, you gain its resonant power.

entities.name: Educator Living Hologram
entities.description: You might have been programmed to narrate a nature documentary while swimming with sea life, or you might resemble an anthropomorphic electrovore created to sing educational songs to children. Regardless of your appearance and original purpose, the collective love and respect you received over the years coalesced into a soul. You gain the Additional Lore skill feat and the Assurance skill feat for the chosen Lore.

entities.name: Emojiborn Living Hologram
entities.description: Spawned from an infosphere emoji subculture, you wear your emotions on your face for all to see. Your appearance includes exaggerated facial expressions; perhaps your body has a monitor for a head that broadcasts a stream of emojis across its screen, or you're an oversized, stylized head with small invisible limbs. You become trained in Diplomacy. If you would automatically become trained in Diplomacy (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. When you attempt a Diplomacy check to make-an-impression, you can choose to have the action lose the auditory and linguistic traits and gain the visual trait.

entities.name: Hover Ad Living Hologram
entities.description: You were a holographic advertisement originally created to be displayed in the sky or hover mid-air. Your appearance is brightly colored and bold, perhaps accompanied by flashing text or snappy slogans, and showcases a product you likely have strong feelings about. Your land Speed gains the hover trait, and you treat falls as 10 feet shorter.

entities.name: Mascot Living Hologram
entities.description: You were a digital avatar of some mortal design, spreading their message and sharing their ideas. You represent a club, company, team, or simply an idea brought to life. Your appearance might be based on the creature a sports team named themselves after, a piece of art that a particular museum is known for, a vehicle driven by a popular junkracer, or an abstract symbol chosen to represent an organization. You gain the Let Me Hear You Cheer action.

entities.name: Wacky Living Hologram
entities.description: You have a big personality and a nonsensical appearance that occasionally breaks the laws of physics. You might be overly animated and cartoonish, or your coloration might change drastically based on your mood. You gain the Cartoonish Stretch action.

entities.name: Hunter-Stalker Pahtra
entities.description: You descend from a long line of hunters, and your fur is especially well suited to blending into multiple environments. As long as you're in a natural and undeveloped environment, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks to Hide and Sneak, to Survival checks to Subsist, and to your Survival DC to Cover Tracks.

entities.name: Meyel's Chosen Pahtra
entities.description: You have an undeniable streak of luck that you believe is a blessing from your ancestral god Meyel. You might come from a long line of mystics. Perhaps you were born at a holy site on Pulonis, or you reached out in fervent prayer at a time of crisis. Most of Meyel's chosen can point to at least one past event when their goddess might have intervened to save them from death or some other awful fate. Whether metaphorically or literally, you always seem to land on your feet. The first time each day that you critically fail a saving throw, you immediately reroll the saving throw as a free action; this is a fortune effect.

entities.name: Rime Walker Pahtra
entities.description: You've adapted to cold environments by growing a fluffy fur coat. You might be the descendant of ancient pahtras who dwelled in the frigid regions of Pulonis long before the Veskarium's exploitation changed its climate, or you might have unlocked this genetic potential through bioengineering. You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).

entities.name: Sand Roamer
entities.description: Your ancestors roamed blasted terrain leached of vital nutrients by the Veskarium. You're shorter and stockier than most pahtras, with wide, tufted ears and fur-covered paw pads. Your size is Small instead of Medium. You ignore difficult terrain and uneven ground caused by sand and gain fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).

entities.name: Courtier Shirren
entities.description: Your telepathy is stronger than most shirrens', allowing you to combine physical, verbal, and telepathic communication. You can transmit emotions alongside your messages whenever you use limited telepathy. In addition, when a creature communicates with you using limited telepathy or telepathy, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to Sense Motive against that creature.

entities.name: Defiant Shirren
entities.description: Despite the passage of time, you remain resolute in your defiance of the Swarm and all forms of mental control. If you roll a success on a Will saving throw against an effect that was created by a creature with the kucharn trait or a creature that you know is allied with the Swarm, you get a critical success instead. You gain these benefits against any creature affected by a spell or effect that controls it. Additionally, you gain the Rebellious Defiance action.

entities.name: Iridescent Shirren
entities.description: You descend from shirrens who were originally programmed as decoys for the ravenous Swarm. Your chitin is iridescent and creates shimmering patterns that fascinate and distract most other creatures. You can Feint at a range of 10 feet, rather than solely while within melee reach of your intended target. You also gain the Shimmering Dazzle action.

entities.name: Swarm Exile Shirren
entities.description:
While most shirrens broke away from the Swarm long ago, you're a more recent convert. You come from a group of castaways that have more in common with the Swarm than most other shirrens.

You gain a bio-cannon ranged unarmed attack with a range increment of 20 feet that deals 1d6 acid damage. Your bio-cannon is in the corrosive weapon group. When you select this heritage, choose whether this attack comes from an underslung launcher on one of your arms, a launcher mounted over one of your shoulders, or from your mouth. You can't change this selection.

entities.name: Winged Shirren
entities.description: Your ancestors were members of the Swarm who evolved wings. You possess a fully functional pair of wings that grant you a fly Speed of 15 feet.

entities.name: Everwhelp Skittermander
entities.description: Despite being a full-grown adult, you've retained your stomach-mouth—either through a quirk of evolution, purposeful genetic manipulation, or a biotech augmentation. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage, is in the brawling group, and has the finesse, skittermander, and unarmed traits.

entities.name: Gadraveech Skittermander
entities.description: You grew up in the subterranean realm of Gadraveech, or a similar dangerous underground environment. You have wispy, pale-colored fur, a slender build, and large, luminous eyes. You gain darkvision.

entities.name: Scrabbler Skittermander
entities.description: You never mastered coordinating all six of your arms for manual manipulation, instead using the lowest two limbs for the extra mobility, balance, and stabilization of a natural climber. You have four arms (rather than six) and four legs (rather than two). You gain a climb Speed equal to your base land Speed and can climb using your feet, leaving your four arms free.

entities.name: Skitter Raised
entities.description: You've spent your life as part of a tight-knit community, where teamwork makes the dream work and crowds are giant group hugs waiting to happen. You gain the Group Impression skill feat. In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Aid an ally at skill checks that don't have the attack trait.

entities.name: Combatant SRO
entities.description: You were originally built for security or defense, and as a result, combat has been etched into your circuits from the very beginning. Perhaps you were a soldier built as a disposable vanguard in a conflict that had nothing to do with you, a bodyguard assigned to protect your wealthy owner to the end, or the loyal sniper bot of a deadly assassin. Regardless of origin or present outlook, you're a dangerous enemy to have. You gain one of the following general feats of your choice: Armor Proficiency or Weapon Proficiency.

entities.name: Medic SRO
entities.description: You were designed to be a surgeon, nurse, or battlefield medic, or were otherwise tasked with caring for the health of organic beings. You're familiar with the anatomical structure of many types of organic creatures and the sorts of illnesses, diseases, and injuries they're vulnerable to. You become trained in Medicine. If you would automatically become trained in Medicine (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the Battle Medicine skill feat.

entities.name: Repair SRO
entities.description: The level of technology achieved in the Pact Worlds today wouldn't be possible without the army of advanced engineering bots that maintain the industrial infrastructure of every city, satellite, and space station. You were one of these bots, tasked with repairing hardware or debugging software so that people could live in comfort. You become trained in one of the following skills: Computers or Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in both of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. If you selected Computers, you gain the Phreaker skill feat. If you selected Crafting, you gain the Quick Repair skill feat.

entities.name: Specialist SRO
entities.description: You were created with a very specific purpose in mind. Whether you were a DJ, automated tour guide, or botanical analyst, there's something that you were very skilled at before you became self-aware. Perhaps you became bored of your task and awoke craving variety, or perhaps you realized you could do more than just what you were built for. Whether this skill brings you joy or is mindless drudgery, you retain a talent for it. You gain the Additional Lore feat and the Assurance feat for the chosen Lore.

entities.name: Swift SRO
entities.description: Your ability to get from one place to another as rapidly as possible was paramount to your creators. This doesn't just mean you can accelerate to a high speed, but also, you can calculate how to maneuver quickly through different terrains and obstacles without damaging your delicate components or overheating and shutting down. Perhaps you were a delivery drone working in food service, shipping, or medical transports; a messenger robot designed to deliver highly sensitive mail and missives from point to point; a scout tasked with remotely exploring new worlds; or a spy working for the military or engaged in corporate espionage. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.

entities.name: Worker SRO
entities.description: Machines all over the Pact Worlds are used to assist in manual labor. These machines are often practical in appearance, sturdy in build, and inexpensive to maintain. They often work in conditions that would kill an organic laborer. Whether you were a free-floating vacuum miner in the Diaspora or a bot that worked on the assembly line to create Drift engines, you eventually realized you were more than just the tasks you were programmed to accomplish. You become trained in Athletics. If you would automatically become trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the Hefty Hauler skill feat.

entities.name: Borai
entities.description: You've returned from the brink of death as a borai—at once both living and undead. You gain the borai and undead trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. Unlike other undead, you don't gain void healing. You're healed by vitality effects and damaged by void damage, as if you were a living creature. Likewise, you can be stabilized, healed, and brought back to life as if you were a living creature, save that you always return to life in your normal undead state (as a borai). You gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision. You can choose from borai feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

entities.name: Cyborg
entities.description:
*Augmentations and self-modifications are common throughout the galaxy, but a cyborg takes this a step further, replacing at least half of their original body with augmentations.*

Your body has been substantially augmented with cybernetic modifications, well beyond standard augmentation procedures. You gain the cyborg and tech traits, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. Your body has an integrated comm unit you can operate by thought alone, even making calls and taking photos without audibly speaking or moving. This doesn't count as an augmentation. Your implant limit is increased by 4. You can choose from cyborg feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

entities.name: Prismeni
entities.description: You have an innate connection to the Drift. You gain the prismeni trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. While you're in the Drift, you can automatically pinpoint the location of Drift beacons, Drift lanes, Drift engines, and other Drift-related technology within a 100-mile radius. If you're Piloting a starship that doesn't have a Drift engine, you can serve as a connection between the Drift and that starship. This is a 1-minute activity that has the concentrate trait, and it allows the starship you're Piloting to enter or exit the Drift. Once within the Drift, the starship travels via conventional thrusters, as normal. When you get a critical failure on a Piloting check to Navigate or Plot Course through the Drift, you get a failure instead. You gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision. You can choose from prismeni feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

entities.name: Aetherkin Verthani
entities.description: You're accustomed to life in the vast expanse of space. You become trained in Piloting. If you would automatically become trained in Piloting (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. In addition, you gain the Breath Control general feat.

entities.name: Bioharmonic Verthani
entities.description: You spend a lot of your time in environments with extreme temperatures. You gain the Temperature Acclimation reaction.

entities.name: Colorweaver Verthani
entities.description: You've mastered your skin's pigmentation. The bonus you gain from Shift Skin whenever the color of your skin generally matches your surroundings increases to +2, rather than +1.

entities.name: Devotional Verthani
entities.description:
You've dedicated much of your life to gaining a deeper understanding of a god or philosophy. You gain the Additional Lore skill feat for one Lore skill tied to a deity, faith, or philosophy of your choice, such as Oras Lore or Green Faith Lore. The religious symbol of this deity or philosophy is permanently marked onto your flesh, either as a birthmark, intentional pattern choice, or a devotional branding.

This religious symbol sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius around you (and dim light to the next 20 feet). You can extinguish or rekindle this light as a single action that has the concentrate trait.

entities.name: Moodsynced Verthani
entities.description:
The colors and patterns on your skin shift naturally to match your mood. This has the same effect as a moodskin augmentation, though it doesn't count as an augmentation. You decide which color corresponds to each emotion when you select this heritage. You don't gain the skin artistry ability or Skin Shift action.

In addition, your open and honest manner makes it easy for you to influence others. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on Diplomacy checks to make-an-impression and Request whenever you're feeling a positive emotion (such as happiness or curiosity) and on Intimidation checks to coerce and demoralize whenever you're feeling a negative emotion (such as anger or frustration).

entities.name: Synthflesh Verthani
entities.description: You have an augmentation already installed in your body that you consider a part of you despite its synthetic nature. You gain the Augmented Body general feat.

entities.name: Briskwander Vesk
entities.description: You come from a line of vesk who were constantly on the move. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.

entities.name: Nightstalker Vesk
entities.description: You've adapted to live in darkness, perhaps due to living underground, in dim starship corridors, under smoke-shrouded skies, or on a planet far from its sun. You gain darkvision.

entities.name: Plated Vesk
entities.description: Your ancestors were the hardiest specimens of vesk, having traveled far and wide while enduring hostile environments. Your scales count as medium armor in the plate armor group. They grant a +3 item bonus to AC, have a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, and a Strength threshold of +3, and have the comfort and exposed traits. This item bonus increases to +4 at 5th level. You can wear a flight suit, but you can't wear other armor. You can etch armor runes onto your scales, but you can't install armor upgrades.

entities.name: Venomthought Vesk
entities.description: You're one of the notable vesk born with psychic talents. According to folklore, your lineage originated with an ancient cave-dwelling society on Vesk Prime who modified themselves with occult rituals, which granted them "venomous thoughts" that could manifest in any future progeny. You can cast daze as an occult innate cantrip at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Occultism checks to Recall Knowledge about psychic traditions and philosophies.

entities.name: Warblood Vesk
entities.description: You come from a bloodline of renowned and honored warriors who have honed their bodies over centuries to become lethal weapons. You gain the Brutal Anatomy ancestry feat twice.

entities.name: Akitonian Ysoki
entities.description: You or your ancestors grew up on Akiton, scrapping crashed starships or combing junk heaps for treasures. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Crafting and can use Crafting instead of Thievery to Disable a Device. If you're already trained in Crafting, you instead gain the Quick Repair general feat.

entities.name: Deep Ysoki
entities.description: You're accustomed to living in dark places, such as maintenance shafts, asteroids, and on distant moons and planetoids far from the sun. You gain darkvision.

entities.name: Longsnout Ysoki
entities.description:
The long snouts that run in your family give you a keener sense of smell than most ysoki. You gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet. This means you can use your sense of smell to determine a creature's location. The GM will usually double the range if you're downwind from the creature or halve the range if you're upwind.

In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to seek a creature or object within the range of your scent.

entities.name: Shipborn Ysoki
entities.description:
You were born aboard a starship, inside a space station's access corridors, or another similar environment. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Piloting. If you would automatically become trained in Piloting (from your background or class, for example), you become trained in another skill of your choice. If you get a success on a Piloting check to Navigate or Plot Course, you get a critical success instead.

You've adapted to maneuvering in close quarters. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to Tumble Through the spaces of Medium or larger enemies, and the presence of an enemy doesn't make the squares difficult terrain.

entities.name: Tunnel Ysoki
entities.description: Your incredibly small bones allow you to easily compress your body and squeeze through gaps, whether it's the space between walls to reach a severed data cable or the ductwork of a space station. You gain the Quick Squeeze feat, even if you aren't trained in Acrobatics. Tight spaces not tight enough to require the Squeeze action aren't difficult terrain for you.

entities.name: Athlete
entities.description:
You've strengthened your body through practice drills and workouts, making sure not to waste a single drop of sweat in your quest for gains. You might be a champion fighting in arena matches, a hardcore gym rat, or a heavy hitter on a competitive sports team—what matters to you is the rush you get when you beat a personal record.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Strength** or **Dexterity**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Athletics skill and the Sports Lore skill. You gain the Deadlift skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: DEX, STR; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Bounty Hunter
entities.description:
You hunt people down for credits. You might work with a corporation, military, or some other organization.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Strength** or **Constitution**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Survival skill and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Tracker skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: CON, STR; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Brutaris Player
entities.description:
The sound of a roaring crowd still sends your heart pumping as you recall your glory days as a brutaris player. Whether you retired successfully or were taken out of commission at the height of your career, you maintained your conditioning and are always ready for your next big game.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Strength** or **Constitution**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Athletics skill and the Sports Lore skill. You gain the Quick Jump or Titan Wrestler skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: CON, STR; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: City Slicker
entities.description:
You've lived long enough in a major settlement to know how to keep your head down, avoid direct eye contact, and otherwise move about your day without drawing any attention to yourself. Whether you were a detective tailing a suspect or just lived in a crime-ridden neighborhood, you've always been able to slip into a crowd to avoid causing trouble.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Dexterity** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Deception skill and a Lore skill about a specific settlement. You gain the Face in the Crowd skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: CHA, DEX; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Cleaner
entities.description:
You know how to remove all traces of a crime. Whether you worked under the table for legitimate clients like AbadarCorp or learned your trade working for shady organizations and crime bosses, you know how to leave a crime scene as good as new.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Dexterity** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Deception skill and Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Without a Trace skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: CHA, DEX; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Comedian
entities.description:
Whether you're the office joker, a professional comedian, or just a troll on the infosphere, you're always prepared with a well-timed joke, even if it occasionally gets you in hot water when you cross the line.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Wisdom** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Performance skill and the Media Lore skill. You gain the Just Kidding skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: CHA, WIS; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Corporate Agent
entities.description:
You're one among many professionals working in the corporate world, but you're not just any suit. You're a negotiator, dealmaker, or perhaps even a spy working to advance a particular corporation's agenda. You might be a cog in a corporation's massive machine or a shill for an up-and-coming entrepreneur no one has heard of... yet.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Society skill and the Corporate Lore skill. You gain the Management Material skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: CHA, INT; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Cyberborn
entities.description:
Your body is a temple to change and technology. Since a young age, you've been upgrading your anatomy with augmentations, perhaps after a terrible accident, as part of an experiment, or because you desire to transform your body into something more.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Strength** or **Constitution**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Augmentation Lore skill. You gain the Augmented Body feat.

Stats.Boosts: CON, STR; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Detective
entities.description:
You solved crimes as a police inspector or took clandestine jobs for various clients as a private investigator. You might have become an adventurer as part of your next big mystery, but it's equally likely it was due to the consequences or aftermath of a prior case.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Society skill, and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Streetwise skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: INT, WIS; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Diplomat
entities.description:
You've dedicated your career to facilitating peaceful alliances between different factions and peoples. You might work at an intergalactic embassy or travel aboard a starship on a mission to remote space. First contact situations are your specialty.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Diplomacy skill and one Lore skill for a planet of your choosing. You gain the Group Impression skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: CHA, INT; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Disciple
entities.description:
You're a loyal disciple of a particular deity. You might have been raised in a religious culture or perhaps felt a kindred calling toward a god later in life, but you've honed your skills and devoted your life to living as a follower of that deity.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be an attribute specified in your deity's Divine Attribute entry, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the deity's listed divine skill and a Lore skill related to your deity (Abadar Lore, for example). You gain the Religious Talisman skill feat even if you do not meet the feat's prerequisites.

Stats.Boosts: CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Doctor
entities.description:
You're an accomplished healer expertly using the latest tech and pharmaceuticals to treat your patients. You might work at a clinic, supervise a starship's medbay, serve as a military medic, or ply your trade in shady back alleys.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Dexterity** or **Intelligence**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Medicine skill and the Life Science Lore skill. You gain the Battle Medicine skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: DEX, INT; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Dream Prophet
entities.description:
A mysterious entity haunts your dreams, granting you a glimpse of transcendence. These supernatural experiences have inspired you to seek greater connection with this power. You might find meaning in the Liavaran Dreamers' songs, recognize potential for universal change in the Newborn's birth, or embrace some other cosmic mystery.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Wisdom** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Occultism skill and a Lore skill related to your choice of metaphysical topics. You gain the Schooled in Secrets skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: CHA, WIS; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Electrician
entities.description:
You know better than most the power of electricity, having survived several close calls yourself, and you know firsthand how shocking it can be when something goes wrong. Whether you learned by installing power stations or repairing broken circuits, you're familiar with the positives and negatives of electricity.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Constitution** or **Intelligence**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Physical Science Lore skill. You gain the Electrical Engineer skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: CON, INT; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Emissary
entities.description:
As a diplomat or messenger, you traveled extensively, communicating with new people and brokering alliances wherever you went.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Society skill and a Lore Skill related to one city or region you've visited often. You gain the Multilingual skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: CHA, INT; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Gambler
entities.description:
The thrill of the win drew you into games of chance. This might have been a lucrative pastime that paled in comparison to the real risks of adventuring, or you might have fallen on hard times due to your gambling and pursued adventuring as a way out of a spiral.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Dexterity** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Deception skill, and the Games Lore skill. You gain the Lie to Me skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: CHA, DEX; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Gene Splicer
entities.description:
You're an expert on biotech and genetics and frequently experiment on your own body. You might have worked with patients who needed gene therapy, conducted research in laboratories looking for the next breakthrough in biotech, or even concocted serums for your own personal use.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Strength** or **Intelligence**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Augmentation or Life Science Lore skill. You gain the Serum Crafting skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: INT, STR; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Grifter
entities.description:
You're a con artist and trickster who swindles unsuspecting dupes and blackmails rubes, but it's nothing personal—you're just in it for the credits. You might run an operation on the side, or you might spend your career moving from settlement to settlement until you get caught in the act.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Deception skill and a Lore skill related to a profession or subject you fake expertise in. You gain the Charming Liar skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: CHA, INT; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Hacker
entities.description:
You've always had a knack for computers and virtual spaces and pride yourself on your ability to learn technical secrets. The open networks known as infospheres are your home and the place you can do your best work. You're highly competent when it comes to cracking code or accessing secure data.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Dexterity** or **Intelligence**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Computers skill and the Infosphere Lore skill. You gain the Phreaker skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: DEX, INT; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Icon
entities.description:
Everybody wants their 15 minutes of fame, but for you, it's somehow become a lifestyle. Whether by luck or dedication, you're a star performer, celebrity, or popular influencer. Your face, voice, and style are commodities across known space, but for every adoring fan, there's a hater spreading gossip or paparazzi looking to capture your flaws.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Constitution** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Performance skill and the Media Lore skill. You gain the Impressive Performance skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: CHA, CON; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Outlaw
entities.description:
You're a career criminal with a nasty reputation. Perhaps unfair circumstances forced you into a life of crime, or maybe you enjoy the thrill you get from pulling off a heist or living through a shoot-out. Either way, this life is the only one you know, and thanks to the bounty on your head, you're in it until the casket drops or you make enough creds to buy a new one.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Strength** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Intimidation skill and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Intimidating Shot skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: CHA, STR; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Prisoner
entities.description:
You've been imprisoned or punished for a crime, whether you were guilty or not. Now that your sentence has ended or you've escaped, you take full advantage of the newfound freedom of your adventuring life.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Strength** or **Constitution**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Stealth skill, and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Smuggler skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: CON, STR; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Raised by Belief
entities.description:
Whether in a monastery, a religious household, or just as part of your everyday life, your upbringing was steeped in the traditions of a particular deity. You might remain committed, or you might have turned from your childhood creed, but your skills are still founded in your devotion.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be an attribute specified in your deity's **divine attribute** entry, and the other is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the deity's listed divine skill and gain the Assurance feat with that skill. You are also trained in a Lore skill related to your deity (Abadar Lore, for example).

Stats.Boosts: CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Recluse
entities.description:
You used to be someone, but that was in another life. You keep to yourself these days, eking out an existence as a hermit in the wilderness or a loner in a rundown neighborhood. You thought you put your past behind you, until a new disciple or an old enemy dragged you back into a life of adventure.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Constitution** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Survival skill and a Lore skill related to your former life. You gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: CON, WIS; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Scientist
entities.description:
You work in a lab and conduct research about a scientific topic. Perhaps you're a biotechnician, chemist, computer programmer, theoretical physicist, or accomplished researcher in some other field. Regardless of your specific training, you can employ your known science for personal gain or the betterment of galactic society.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Crafting skill and a Lore skill related to your field of research. You gain the Assurance skill feat with that Lore skill.

Stats.Boosts: INT, WIS; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Smuggler
entities.description:
You make your living smuggling cargo, whether on a planet or in the depths of space. You don't ask your clients too many questions, and the cargo could be anything—counterfeit products, illegal goods, stolen weapons... the bigger the risk, the bigger the payday.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Dexterity** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Stealth skill and the Piracy Lore skill. You gain the Experienced Smuggler skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: DEX, WIS; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Socialite
entities.description:
Thanks to generational wealth or lucky circumstance, you live a charmed life flitting between galas dressed in the latest designer fashion. You memorialize every glittering moment on social media, and if nobody pays attention, that's just because they're jealous.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Society skill and a Lore skill related to your home planet. You gain the Plant Rumor skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: CHA, INT; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Space Pirate
entities.description:
You're a crewmate on a pirate vessel with ambitions of pillaging interstellar shipping lanes or taking over a chunk of a notable planetary body. Perhaps you grew up on such a ship, were taken prisoner by the crew at a young age and adapted to their lifestyle, or commandeered a vessel from a pirate captain.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Strength** or **Dexterity**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Intimidation skill and the Piracy Lore skill. You gain the Group Coercion skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: DEX, STR; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Spacefarer
entities.description:
Some people might say you've been out in the Drift too long, but the truth is, you don't feel at home away from your post on a starship deck. You might crew a long-haul freighter, military gunship, or tourist shuttle. Truth is, you'd probably sign up for any job that took you off-world.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Dexterity** or **Constitution**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Piloting skill and the Drift Lore skill. You gain the Express Driver skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: CON, DEX; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Street Rat
entities.description:
You know the streets because they raised you. You grew up scraping by in a massive cityscape like those on Verces or Castrovel, or on a crowded space station like Absalom Station. You might have even managed to eke out a living in the claustrophobic vents of Aballon's megaplex settlements. Navigating dense crowds or scavenging useful rubbish is nothing new for you.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Dexterity** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Survival skill and a Lore skill about a specific settlement. You gain the Urban Survivalist skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: DEX, WIS; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Tech Support
entities.description:
Whether working in a military outpost, a deep space exploration vessel, or a local office, you have experience supporting your comrades by assisting with their tech. While you've undoubtedly survived several all-nighters protecting against hackers and restoring lost files, you've also learned how to quickly install updates on demand while minimizing downtime.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Constitution** or **Intelligence**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Computers skill and the Business Lore skill. You gain the Quick Install skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: CON, INT; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Timelost
entities.description:
You're not from this timeline. Somehow you became unstuck in time, or perhaps you attempted temporal travel and ended up getting trapped somewhen you don't belong.

You gain two free attribute boosts.

You're trained in the Society skill and the History Lore skill. You gain the Dubious Knowledge skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Trooper
entities.description:
You enlisted in a military or were recruited by a paramilitary group as a career trooper. As long as you've got enough guns and the right squad to back you up, you can handle just about anything.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Strength** or **Constitution**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Athletics skill and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Barricade feat.

Stats.Boosts: CON, STR; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Vidgamer
entities.description:
Gaming is more than just a hobby for you: it's your way of life. Whether you're a professional player, game designer, hobbyist influencer, or just a gamer who has mastered every vidgame you can install, you're a true connoisseur who can spot the subtle signs of a virtual creation without a second glance.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Dexterity** or **Intelligence**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Computers skill and the Vidgame Lore skill. You gain the Hologram Skeptic skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: DEX, INT; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Akitonian Activist
entities.description:
Whether you were on Akiton during the Drift Crisis protests or you were inspired by the brave activists, you've become aware of how economic inequality accelerates disasters into humanitarian crises. You know that governments and megacorporations that rely on exploitation will inevitably be brought to justice, and you're willing to educate, prepare, and protect the people by any means necessary.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Legal Lore skill. You gain the Akiton Battery Hack skill feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites.

Stats.Boosts: CHA, INT; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Animator
entities.description:
Whether you work on vidgames or holovid entertainment, you're part of the creative team that illustrates entertainment that inspires the galaxy. Whether you use traditional methods supplemented with specialty software or are all-in on the latest in computer-generated animation, you use years of training to turn storyboards and character designs into stunning visuals.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Computers skill and the Media Lore skill. You gain the Hologram Skeptic skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: CHA, INT; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Arms Dealer
entities.description:
You've made your living by giving dangerous people access to dangerous things. Hauling loads of expensive arms into the kinds of places that need them often necessitates having to grab what you can and run when a third party gets involved. You've become skilled at the unsubtle art of being the biggest threat in the room, often just by showing that you aren't afraid to use your own wares in a pinch.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Strength** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Intimidation skill and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Intimidating Shot skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: CHA, STR; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Coder
entities.description:
You're fluent in the language of computing, and you can write programming like others write prose. While others can only use or manipulate existing applications, you can create them from a blank terminal.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Computers skill and the Technology Lore skill. You gain the Programmer skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: INT, WIS; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Combat Engineer
entities.description:
You're a soldier trained in keeping your mechanical equipment and synthetic allies upright and operational. You keep a cool head in battle, the better to complete your objectives.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Strength** or **Intelligence**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the Repair Expert skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: INT, STR; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Documentarian
entities.description:
A picture is worth a thousand words, but a recording can tell epic tales. You're constantly looking for the little moments that convey the big story, whether it's recording the perfect shot or deriving meaning in the editing room.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Wisdom** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Performance skill and a Lore skill of your choice related to your subject of study. You gain the Hit Record skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: CHA, WIS; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Field Quartermaster
entities.description:
You keep equipment in isolated or dangerous areas ready and operational. Keeping yourself and your gear organized can be the difference between life and death when adverse conditions strike.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Strength** or **Intelligence**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Survival skill and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the Principled Packer skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: INT, STR; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Gearhead
entities.description:
You love cars. Sure, lots of people love their specific car, but it's about more than that for you. Automobiles have been your lifelong passion, and your professional expertise has possibly led to a career as a professional racer, pit crew engineer, or trusted local mechanic.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Dexterity** or **Intelligence**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Vehicle Lore skill. You gain the Pit Stop skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: DEX, INT; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Getaway Driver
entities.description:
You had one simple job: getting your associates as far away from danger as quickly as possible. Whether you were part of a security force protecting a VIP or a member of heist waiting for the rest of your crew to return, you know how to quickly and safely put as much distance between yourself and an active crime scene as possible, even if that means having to abandon one vehicle and pick up another along the way.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Dexterity** or **Intelligence**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Vehicle Lore skill. You gain the Quick Starter skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: DEX, INT; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Infosphere Troll
entities.description:
For whatever personal reasons, you once took pleasure in the aggressive and deliberate provocation of strangers on the infosphere. You sought to provoke, upset, and perhaps even bring harm to others through inflammatory messages and posts. You might have grown out of this phase, but the skills stuck with you.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Constitution** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Intimidation skill and the Infosphere Lore skill. You gain the Cyberbully skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: CHA, CON; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Junkyard Picker
entities.description:
People discarding perfectly good junk has always made you sick to your stomach, more so than the stench of the dumpsters you frequent for the treasures you use to cobble together your repurposed tech.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Strength** or **Intelligence**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Junker Lore skill. You gain the Junk Cobbler skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: INT, STR; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Living Rocket
entities.description:
Whether a natural prodigy with jetpacks or a veteran soldier airdropped into the fray of battle, you've become accustomed to fighting in the air and using jet propulsion to your advantage. Even if you're still saving up for a jetpack of your own, you already have enough experience to soar like a starship helmed by an ace pilot.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Dexterity** or **Intelligence**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Acrobatics skill and the Technology Lore skill. You gain the Living Missile skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: DEX, INT; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Maker
entities.description:
You're a digital creator, using programming, modeling, and your own creativity to transform raw universal polymer base (also known as UPBs) into valuable equipment. You might use high-tech equipment instead of hand tools, but the process is the same: dream, design, build.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Dexterity** or **Intelligence**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Computers skill and the Technology Lore skill. You gain the Fabricator skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: DEX, INT; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Nanomechanical Organical
entities.description:
Whether you were the subject of a secret government experiment, medical malpractice, or wanted to enhance your own capabilities, you've become infused with self-replicating nanomachines that can heal your otherwise organic body. Over the years, you've learned how to maintain these molecular-sized medical marvels, forming a symbiotic bond with the nanite swarm.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Constitution** or **Wisdom**, and the other one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Medicine skill and the Technology Lore skill. You gain the Nanomedical Safeguards skill feat.

Stats.Boosts: CON, WIS; CHA, CON, DEX, INT, STR, WIS

entities.name: Off-the-Grid Owner
entities.description:
No matter how wondrous and advanced modern technology becomes, to many it will never compare to the raw beauty and strength of the natural world and its countless inhabitants.
